summary: Into the Night begins with a sudden solar event, as the sun inexplicably starts killing everything in its path. The show centers around the 'lucky' passengers and crew of an overnight flight out of Brussels, as they attempt to fly west - into the safety of the dark night. The plane's manifest is multinational and multilingual, with passengers, rich and poor, young and old, civilian and military. The seemingly ordinary travelers share but one thing: A desire to survive the sun - and each other - by any means necessary.

lead_actors: Fabien Cloutier, Steve Laplante, Julien Poulin, Mario Jean, Marie-Laurence Moreau
title: Léo
summary: At 40, single and with no work experience, Léo wants to take his life in his own hands. Raised alone by his father, Leo graduated from the University of Life. He loves hunting, fishing and can repair almost anything that comes to hand. Former pot seller with his friend Chabot, he's tired of his bad boy ways.

lead_actors: Kimiko Glenn, Megan Hilty, Parvesh Cheena, Chris Diamantopoulos, Megan Nicole Dong
creators: Hannah Friedman, Megan Nicole Dong, Daniel Dominguez, Jen Bardekoff
title: Centaurworld
summary: Centaurworld follows a war horse who is transported from her embattled world to a strange land inhabited by silly, singing centaurs of all species, shapes, and sizes. Desperate to return home, she befriends a group of these magical creatures and embarks on a journey that will test her more than any battle she's ever faced before.

lead_actors: Lee Jung Jae, Wi Ha Joon, Lee Byung Hun, Park Hae Soo, Jung Ho Yun
title: Squid Game
summary: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.

lead_actors: Yuji Oda, Yuto Nakajima, Yuko Araki, Anne Nakamura, Hayato Isomura
title: Suits
summary: Shogo Kai, a graduate from Harvard University is a competent lawyer who works at a famous legal firm in the city. Due to his slightly arrogant personality as a result of his top class earnings, he occassionally becomes the subject of debate amongst his co-workers. However, he dismisses many of the opinions thrown at him, as he continues to successfully solve major litigation cases.One day, he gets ordered by his boss to hire an associate partner for his position, so he decides to hold a interview session with his secretary. Meanwhile, Daiki Suzuki, a young man with highly proficient skills comes for an interview. Despite his abilities, he had been spending much of his life up until this moment as a delinquent, without a stable job.However, after weighing up the pros and cons, he decides to hire him, even though he was originally reluctant to hire anyone with the background such as his.

lead_actors: Joel Dommett, Jonathan Ross, Davina McCall, Mo Gilligan, Rita Ora
title: The Masked Singer
summary: Part guessing game and part singing show, The Masked Singer sees 12 famous faces compete to pull off the best performance, with their identity elaborately and imaginatively concealed, thanks to an expert team of talented costume designers. The stars will be transformed and they will take on a masked identity and become a fantastic character which will disguise them for the whole series. Forget any thoughts of fancy dress – they'll be full-on, original, movie-standard creations taking inspiration from worlds as varied as manga, superheroes, and wild animals and mythical creatures. Their transformations will be total, even their speaking voices will be disguised in interviews. It will be up to a superstar panel to lead the viewers at home in their quest to discover who they are. Although the stars aren't judged on their voices, they'll still need to give their best performance – the audience's least favourite will be eliminated, before the panel try to guess their identity and unmask them.

lead_actors: Izabella Alvarez, Alex Cazares, Carlos PenaVega, Rubén Garfias, Carlos Alazraqui
creators: Miguel Puga, Michael Rubiner, Nora Kroopf
title: The Casagrandes
summary: The Casagrandes tells the story of Ronnie Anne, an independent, adventurous, 11-year-old who explores city life with her big, loving, multi-generational Mexican-American family.

title: Starting From...Now!
summary: Starting From...Now! is a lesbian web series that explores the lives of four inner-Sydney women as they struggle to work out who they are, find a place where they belong, and maybe even find someone to love along the way.

title: La Malédiction de Jonathan Plourde
summary: Every time Jonathan Plourde falls in love, death robs him of his girlfriends. Convinced that he is afflicted with a curse, he resolves to give up life together forever...until Jeanne, a new colleague, makes his heart throb again. Jonathan will try to ignore her feelings, but the mutual attraction is too strong. In order to be able to love again without danger, Jonathan begins an agonizing investigation accompanied by Nic, his best friend, and Marianne, a bizarre work colleague adept at the supernatural.

lead_actors: Ismail Demirci, Aslıhan Güner, Toygan Avanoğlu, Cezmi Baskın, Gizem Güneş
title: Kuzey Yildizi
summary: Yildiz has loved Kuzey for as long as she has known. She has seen no one but him. Families are also friendly to each other. Kuzey and Yildiz are engaged. But when Kuzey goes to Istanbul to study at university, he forgets all his words and sets sail for new love. When this is learned by his family, Kuzey is excommunicated by everyone in the village, including his own family. Kuzey married the woman he loved. He had three children. Twenty years later, he experienced the pain that Yildiz experienced. He was abandoned by the woman he loved. Kuzey returns to his hometown with his three daughters. Yildiz swore to send him where he came from.

lead_actors: Hermione Corfield, Eve Myles, Babou Ceesay, Vicki Pepperdine, Babirye Bukilwa
title: We Hunt Together
summary: We Hunt Together begins with the collision of two extraordinary people; Baba, a former child soldier desperate to suppress his violent conditioning, and Freddy, a magnetic and disarmingly charming free spirit. When Baba rescues Freddy from an attack following a date that has turned sour, something dark is ignited in them both.In this bold new take on the classic cat and mouse story, two star-crossed killers are on the loose with two dysfunctional detectives in hot pursuit. DS Lola Franks and DI Jackson Mendy have to come to terms with their mismatched partnership and polar opposite outlooks on the culpability of the criminal mind as they try to outsmart the killers.

lead_actors: Nick A. Fisher, Benjamin Valic, Alkaio Thiele, Jakari Fraser, Carter Young
title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
summary: Our favorite neighborhood web-slinger is used to working solo, but now Peter Parker must discover what it takes to become a truly amazing super hero: being a spider friend who works well with others. Together with his friends Miles Morales and Gwen AKA Ghost-Spider, they will team up with heroes such as Hulk, Black Panther and Ms. Marvel, to defeat evil foes and learn that teamwork is the best way to save the day.

title: Ryomaden
summary: NHK's 49h taiga drama centers around Ryoma Sakamoto a leader of the movement to overthrow the feudal regime of Tokugawa shogunate. Ryoma Sakmoto is thought to have been a visionary who helped spur Japan to modernization.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
title: Ohisama
summary: Set in Nagano prefecture, Ohisama covers the life of Yoko Sudo through World War II. Yoko Sudo with her smile is able to bring brightness to those around her & she follows her mother's motif to laugh through the hard times. During the onset of WWII, Yoko is a high school student and "Ohisama" follows her as she eventually becomes a teacher and then gets married and has a child. Yoko then opens a soba restaurant with her student.

lead_actors: Osvaldo Benavides, Irene Azuela, Juan Manuel Bernal
title: Monarca
summary: Set in the powerful world of Mexican billionaires, Monarca is a high stakes, multi-generational family saga about a tequila-born Mexican business empire, and the battle that ensues when a member of the family decides to fight the dirty system her family helped create.

lead_actors: Tony Hale, Rosamund Pike, Kari Wahlgren, Adam Pally, Chelsea Kane
title: Archibald's Next Big Thing
summary: Archibald's Next Big Thing follows the adventures of Archibald Strutter, a simple chicken who ‘yes-ands' his way thru life. Though living in the moment often leads him astray, Archibald always finds his way back home, to an egg-shaped house in the center of Crackridge he shares with his three siblings, Sage, Finly, and Loy, and his trusty sidekick, Bea. Archibald's Next Big Thing is a fresh comedy about one chicken's joy for life and celebrating the journey, not just the destination.

lead_actors: Yolanthe Sneijder-Cabau, Loes Haverkort, Maaike Martens, Matteo van der Grijn, Sinan Eroglu
title: DNA
summary: Murder, manslaughter, tension, emotion and humour... DNA is a series in which female detectives work together with a female prosecutor to solve cases and to find a balance in a far from perfect private life. The murders they investigate are often thrilling and always personal. You will feel the connection with the victim, but also feel some sort of sadness for the offender. They are cases who hit hard and could have happened to you too. Cause hatred, love, jealousy, revenge, anger and greed is a recognisable emotion amongst any of you.

lead_actors: Полина Максимова, Дарья Руденок, Егор Корешков, Михаил Грищенко, Максим Лагашкин
title: 257 причин, чтобы жить
summary: When terminal cancer patient Zhenya unexpectedly receives a clean bill of health, she can't believe it. She's in remission. But then her life implodes. Homeless, unemployed, and newly single - she stumbles across a list she wrote while she was sick of things she wanted to do when she got better. 257 of them - and now she won't give up until she checks off them all!

title: The Family Man
summary: The Family Man follows the journey of Srikant Tiwari, a man who tries to strike a balance between the responsibilities of his family while working for a highly secretive special cell of the National Intelligence Agency, attempting to spot and prevent large-scale terror attacks on the country and its citizens.

title: Mr. Corman
summary: Mr. Corman follows the days and nights of Josh Corman, played by Gordon-Levitt, an artist at heart but not by trade. A career in music hasn't panned out, and he teaches fifth grade at a public school in the San Fernando Valley. His ex-fiancée Megan has moved out and his high school buddy Victor has moved in. He knows he has a lot to be thankful for, but finds himself struggling nevertheless through anxiety, loneliness and a sinking suspicion that he sucks as a person. Darkly funny, oddly beautiful and deeply heartfelt, this relatable dramedy speaks for our contemporary generation of 30-somethings – rich with good intentions, poor with student loans and yearning to become real grown-ups sometime before they die.

lead_actors: David Corenswet, Jeremy Pope, Dylan McDermott, Jake Picking, Patti LuPone
title: Hollywood
summary: In post-World War II Hollywood, an ambitious group of aspiring actors and filmmakers will do almost anything to make their showbiz dreams come true.

title: Babbar Ka Tabbar
summary: Babbar Ka Tabbar is a ZEE5 Original web series starring Manu Rishi, Ayesha Raza, Bhavin Bhanushali, Avneet Kaur and Anshuman Jha. The story revolves around the Babbar family, who struggle to bridge the generation gap with their millennial kids. The parents and kids try their best to cope up with each other's lifestyles which often gets them in hilarious situations.

title: BOSS: Baap of Special Services
summary: An undercover detective joins Shimla's Task Force under strange circumstances. His ways are peculiar. His style is unconventional. But results are effective in solving crimes, which make him the BAAP of Special Services.

title: Alarm
summary: This action thriller revolves around a cop who has 12 hours to save a kidnapped girl. The search leads to a massive crackdown on a prostitution ring in Chennai.

title: Apharan
summary: Rudra Srivastava, a senior inspector with Uttarakhand police, is lured into kidnapping a young girl at her request. The plot begins as a simple plan to extort money in exchange for her release. When the chain of events go wrong and a series of lies unfold, he realizes that he is now a part of a deadly conspiracy. Will he be able to escape the outcome of his choices or become a victim of the web of lies?

title: Med
summary: If the carefree attitude of youth had a name, it would be MED. Mehdi, alias Med, is a refreshingly unconventional teen, born from an Arab mother and a Quebecois father.

title: Jérémie
summary: A gang of teenagers try to make their way to adulthood. Jeremie gets a job for the summer as a lifeguard and meets an original crew.

title: Ruptures
summary: Ariane Beaumont, a promising young family law attorney devotes her life to protecting children. When professional issues force her to start her own practice, Ariane discovers that saving others will come at a personal price.

title: The Island, seuls au monde
summary: A group of individuals must attempt to survive without outside help on a desert island for 28 days.

lead_actors: Karime Pindter, Manelyk González, Luis Méndez, Luis Caballero, Tadeo Fernández
title: Acapulco Shore
summary: MTV Latin America has kicked off production on Acapulco Shore, the first Latin American version of MTV's hit reality show "Jersey Shore," which ran 2009-2012. Skein will track the lives of eight young Mexicans living in and around the beach resort town of Acapulco.

title: Armans Geheimnis
summary: Five teens find a new home, new friends, a new family on the Lilientals' horse ranch - a truly magical place: An ancient curse traps them here between heaven and earth. Will the teens manage to band together, solve Arman's secret and vanquish the evil sorcerer Garwin?

title: Trop
summary: The existence of two sisters is jostled when the youngest, Anaïs, joins her eldest, Isabelle, in Montreal (Canada). What seems like a happy reunion is a little less funny when Isabelle finds out that her little sister is living with bipolar disorder.

title: Queendom
summary: The show puts the six teams head-to-head in a comeback battle, where each will release a new single on the same day at the same time and see which one reigns supreme on the charts.

lead_actors: Fleur Monharoul, Pierre Bedouet, Enora Marcelli, Valentin Naulin, Lola Coipeau
title: Random

lead_actors: Sunny Suwanmethanont, Davika Hoorne, Putthipong Assaratanakul, Krit Amnuaydechkorn, Wongravee Nateetorn
title: My Ambulance
summary: My Ambulance follows a few characters and their private lives in the emergency room of a hospital.

title: Babysitter Gin!
summary: Babysitter Gin Shimochiai's wish is to deliver love to children and parents! Gin, a man dressed as an English maiden inspired by her childhood nanny and the story of Mary Poppins, established a babysitting agency solving the problems of parents from different families in his own way.

title: Your Turn to Kill
summary: Nana and Shota are a newlywed couple and Nana is 15 years older than Shota. Nana works as a designer and Shota works as a gym trainer. They both enjoy mystery. The newlywed couple then move to an apartment and they attend a resident's meeting there. Nana and Shota become involved in murder cases that take place at the apartment. Residents get murdered one by one. Some residents have a motive, but those suspects have an alibi. Because of this, an arrest has yet to be made.

lead_actors: Konstantin Khabensky, Михаил Пореченков, Ingeborga Dapkunaite
title: Небесный суд
summary: Andrey and Veniamin are friends and lawyers, who always find themselves on the opposing sides. The peculiarity of their job is that they deal with afterlife cases. They are the members of the Heavenly Judgement that decides where a human soul will go after death. But one day, a man who made an offer to Andrey's widow finds himself in the dock.

title: L'heure bleue
summary: L'Heure bleue follows a family trying to recover from a devastating loss. Anne-Sophie leaves her house and family hoping to start afresh and fleeing the grief.

title: Yo soy Franky
summary: Franky is a girl unlike any other. She's a robot girl! She looks like a 14-year-old teenager, but she's actually a secret project created by Sofia, a scientist Franky calls "Mom." Although Franky's brain operates like a state-of-the-art supercomputer with unlimited internet access and a large storage memory, that's not enough to pass for a human teen: Franky doesn't know what feelings are or what they're for, nor does she understand jokes or double meanings. And of course, she's incapable of experiencing any emotions. Of course, the biggest challenge will be falling in love... without crashing her operating system!

title: Euh
summary: At 28, Benoit still has no girlfriend, let alone work, and especially no project in mind. Forced by his only friend, he agrees to participate in group therapy to learn to know what he really wants in life. This is where he will get acquainted with Sylvie, a young and pretty girl with whom he would like to engage.

title: Presque normal
summary: This is the true fake story of Dan, a stand-up comedian who suffers his life and the anger of others. And who spends his life in comedy clubs.

lead_actors: Emily Watson, Denise Gough, Thalissa Teixeira
title: Too Close
summary: Dedicated forensic psychiatrist, Dr Emma Robinson is not easily shocked. She's worked with her fair share of high security patients. Then she's sent to assess Connie for trial. Connie has a searing insight into Emma's deepest insecurities and starts to brutally exploit them. Their sessions become a complex psychological game with confusing undercurrents. Can Emma find out what happened on the night of the crime? Or what happened to turn Connie into a monster? She tries to understand Connie, and her complicated relationship with her beautiful best friend, Ness, which seems to have made her snap. But as Emma tries to uncover the truth behind the madness and learn what triggered Connie's despicable behaviour, it seems that her attempts to see justice done may destroy her instead.

lead_actors: Lee Min Ki, Lee Yoo Young
title: The Lies Within
summary: The Lies Within is about a woman whose husband disappears after the sudden death of her father. She joins the National Assembly and teams up with a detective in her search for the truth. The two characters work together to break through the silence and lies that people spill to protect their own interests.

lead_actors: Awkwafina, Lori Tan Chinn, B.D. Wong
title: Awkwafina Is Nora from Queens
summary: Awkwafina stars as Nora Lin in this scripted series based on her real-life beginnings in Queens, NY. Raised alongside her cousin by her dad and grandma, Nora leans on her family as she navigates young adulthood in outer borough New York City.

title: Warigami
summary: Wendy Ohata has just made three startling realizations: One, she has a twin brother named Vincent. Two, she's a kami-jin - a descendant of ancient Japanese masters of origami, who can turn paper into deadly weapons. And three, there's a kami-jin warrior named Sadako hunting her down for reasons she doesn't understand.

lead_actors: Nehir Erdoğan, Kutsi, Kaan Çakır, Mustafa Mert Koç, Rabia Soytürk
title: Benim Adim Melek
Blue Flame (The Lost City of West River)
summary: James Dowling tries to fulfil an ancient prophesy to protect West River from an evil sorcerer and his army of goblins.

lead_actors: Stephanie D'Abruzzo, Martin P. Robinson, Tim Lagasse, Ingrid Hansen, Jennifer Barnhart
title: Helpsters
summary: Meet Cody and the Helpsters, a team of vibrant monsters who love to solve problems. Whether it's planning a party, climbing a mountain, or mastering a magic trick, the Helpsters can figure anything out—because everything starts with a plan.

title: DreamWorks Dragons: Rescue Riders
summary: DreamWorks Dragons: Rescue Riders is about twins, Dak and Leyla, who because they were raised by dragons, share a unique ability to communicate with them. The brother and sister lead a team of five young dragons that spend their days rescuing other dragons, and helping the people in their adopted town of Huttsgalor.

lead_actors: Isaac Arellanes, Amadi Chapata, Hannah Levinson, Justin Sanchez, Princess K. Mapp
title: Ghostwriter
summary: When a ghost haunts a neighborhood bookstore and starts releasing fictional characters into the real world, four kids must team up to solve an exciting mystery surrounding the ghost's unfinished business.

title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun
summary: Suzuki Iruma has just been abandoned and sold to a demon by his irresponsible parents! Surprisingly, the next thing he knows he's living with the demon who has adopted him as his new grandson, and has been transferred into a school in the demon world where his new "demon" grandfather works as the principal. Thus begins the cowardly Iruma-kun's extraordinary school life among the otherworldly as he faces his true self, takes on challenges, and rises to become someone great.

title: Val x Love
summary: Takuma Akutsu has a "unique" appearance that, unfortunately, leaves him feeling isolated and alone among his high school classmates who shun him. Enter the Valkyries sent by Odin himself! Once they descend into Takuma's life, he discovers they aren't scared of him one bit! In fact, they're super keen to get to know him better. As the intimacy between the Valkyries and Takuma grows, so too do their powers. And that's a good thing because they're on orders to slay the vicious monsters intent on destroying the earth. How far will they go to deepen their connection, level up, and save the world… by any means necessary!?!

lead_actors: Haruki Ishiya, Shiori Izawa, Fumiyoshi Shioya
title: XL Joushi.
summary: Saki Watase is a female office worker who is running out of money. She takes a part-time job as a product tester and has to review an XL-size condom. Keisuke Sudō, Saki's "demon boss" she dislikes, reveals that he is XL-size. A romance then develops between Saki and Keisuke.

lead_actors: Mayim Bialik, Swoosie Kurtz, Cheyenne Jackson, Kyla Pratt, Julian Gant
title: Call Me Kat
summary: Kat is a 39-year-old woman who struggles every day against society and her mother to prove that you can NOT have everything you want - and still be happy. Which is why she spent her life savings to open a Cat Café in Louisville, Kentucky.

lead_actors: Natouch Siripongthon, Thitiwat Ritprasert, Katsamonnat Namwirote, Noppakao Dechaphatthanakun, Warut Chawalitrujiwong
title: Until We Meet Again
summary: Thirty years ago, Korn and Intouch were university students in Bangkok. Intouch entered into Korn's life despite knowing that he was a son of the most influential people. At first, Korn kept pushing Intouch away, but in the end, he could not resist Intouch who was so full of life and decided to let him into his heart. However, homosexuality was unacceptable at the time, and so their parents were against their relationship. While Intouch kept fighting for their future, Korn could not deal with all the sufferings and decided to give up. Their story ended with tragedy, but something has tied them together even after they were dead. Years after, Pharm (Intouch's reincarnation), always feels that he is waiting to meet 'someone.' Dean (Korn's reincarnation) also spends his entire life searching for 'the one.' The red thread of fate will bring them together and ties them to the past that is not worth remembering.

title: Invisible Heroes
summary: Invisible Heroes tells the heroic tale of young Finnish diplomats in Chile during 1973's infamous military coup. Finnish diplomats Tapani Brotherus and Ilkka Jaamala along with Tapani's wife Lysa Brotherus helped over 2000 left-wing Chileans escape the military junta's persecution. The Finns acted without official authorization while Swedish ambassador Harald Edelstam was the most visible defendant of human rights with the backing of Sweden's Prime Minister, Olof Palme. Finns were the invisible heroes.

title: Halloween Cake-Off
summary: Duff Goldman welcomes talented bakers from across America for a baking and design competition involving the most ghoulish, outlandish and spookiest Halloween cakes. The winner takes home bragging rights and $10,000.

lead_actors: Akio Ohtsuka, Kenjiro Tsuda, Satoshi Shimono, Akira Ishida, Hina Kino
title: African Office Worker
summary: A lively comedy of sweat and tears of African office workers living in a Japanese society. The daily life of an animal company employee who completely forgot both the savanna and the food chain is here!

title: Mugen no Juunin: Immortal
summary: Edo, an era of warriors: the immortal, Manji, the Hundred Killer, meets Rin, a woman who has sworn to avenge her parents and is looking for a group of swordsmen - Ittou-ryu. Rin asks Manji to be her bodyguard during her journey. The man refuses, but in Rin he sees his dead sister. Thus begins the battle that will bring the immortal Manji to its knees.

title: Olivia
summary: A lawyer deals with the case of a woman who has just discovered that the man with whom she lives is not the father of their child. It's a total mystery.

title: The Good Place: The Selection
summary: Set in The Bad Place and following the compromise that bought Michael, Eleanor, and the rest of the crew one last chance to save themselves from an eternity of suffering, The Selection tracks the efforts of Shawn and his Bad Place underlings to find people that will help their side emerge victorious.

title: Коронация

lead_actors: Olivia Holt, Chiara Aurelia, Froy Gutierrez, Harley Quinn Smith, Sadie Stanley

All signs point to Jeanette's guilt, but is Kate really who she seems to be? Set over three summers and told through shifting points of view, the series challenges perception and follows how one girl can go from being a sweet outlier to the most despised person in America.

lead_actors: Павел Деревянко, Ангелина Поплавская, Дмитрий Караневский, Дарья Пицик, Надежда Карпова

summary: Mikhail Kovalev, the protagonist, is a talented and successful coach of a Super League men's volleyball team. He is pretty short but compensates it with bad temper and aggressive behavior. He lives large and often drops his girlfriends whom he treats like sex objects. After his another escapade he is confronted by the new president of the Volleyball Federation, who is a woman. As a result, he is fired from the big sports. Now to have a chance to return, he has to make a university women's team the winner of a tournament in his provincial hometown. Such is a condition his mother set to him, a despotic and autocratic woman who used to be a famous volleyball player and the first coach of the current president of the Volleyball Federation. Mikhail has to change and learn to respect girls, accept their problems and stop treating them as sexual objects.

title: Thanksgiving
summary: Vincent, the cofounder of a security software start-up, lives in Paris with his American wife Louise, who recently set up a rental agency offering chic apartments to fortunate clients. When the cutting-edge software developed by Vincent is stolen by the competition, suspicion and doubt worm their way into the relationship. Against a backdrop of espionage, this powerful thriller explores a couple's ties and secrets.

lead_actors: Lee Dong Gun, Jun Hye Bin, Kim Sae Ron, Yeo Hoe Hyun, Kim Kwon
title: Leverage
summary: Leverage follows the story of a former insurance investigator who forms a team of thieves and con artists to catch the real bad guys.Lee Tae Joon is an excellent insurance fraud investigator. An unexpected case changes his life. He quits his job and recruits talented criminals, that he once caught, to form an elite fraud team. The team includes Hwang Soo Kyung, Go Na Byul, Roy Ryu and Jung Ui Sung. They scam wealthy criminals and return the money that they stole to the victims.

title: Ripley

Tom's acceptance of the job is the first step into a complex life of deceit, fraud and murder.

title: Η Εκδρομή
summary: 13 people are trapped in a hotel (refuge) in the remote side of a mountain. Unidentified most among them, there are each with a different occasion. The history of the past will be revealed in relief and will form relationships and situations, upsetting everything.

summary: Ant Anstead is paying homage to the legendary 1930s Alfa Romeo 158 Grand Prix race car by building his own from the ground up.

summary: Eva Jordan, gender equality officer, seeks to enforce gender equality in changing institutions and places such as the fire station or nursing home.

summary: Produced by Hitoshi Matsumoto, Documental pits ten comedians against each other. The objective is to make each other laugh in a closed room. Each contestant brings a one million yen participation fee. The last person to stay in the room without laughing wins. The winner is awarded a 10 million yen prize and bragging rights as the funniest comedian.

title: Escape to the Perfect Town
summary: House buyers find their dream in one of the UK's best market towns.

title: The Holzer Files
summary: Paranormal investigator Dave Schrader, psychic medium Cindy Kaza, equipment expert Shane Pittman and researcher Gabe Roth investigate terrifyingly true hauntings from the recently discovered case files of America's first ghost hunter, Dr. Hans Holzer. Recognized as the "father of the paranormal," Holzer's four-decades-long exploration into disturbing hauntings like the Amityville Horror house spawned legions of supernatural enthusiasts, more than 120 books and even inspired Dan Aykroyd to write Ghostbusters. For the first time ever, Holzer's daughter, Alexandra Holzer, reopens her father's most captivating case files -- along with thousands of his documents, letters, photographs and hours of chilling audio-visual recordings from as early as the 1950s. Equipped with this treasure trove of paranormal knowledge and state-of-the-art technology, the team compares their findings with Holzer's to see if their modern research sheds new light on these half-century-old investigations.

title: The Very VERY Best Of The 70s
summary: The Very Very Best of the 70s puts the spotlight on the enduring films, series, and pop culture moments that defined the 70s. Each week diverse cast of experts count down through a catalogue of topics ranging from The Top 70s Action TV Shows and Sci-Fi Films to Stand-Up Comedians, TV Moms, and Amazing Toys.

title: Dorothy and the Wizard of Oz
summary: Dorothy and the Wizard of Oz is about Dorothy, who is granted princess of Emerald City by Queen Ozma after defeating the Wicked Witch.

title: Null Peta

lead_actors: Zak Bagans, Aaron Goodwin, Billy Tolley, Jay Wasley
title: Ghost Adventures: Serial Killer Spirits
summary: Zak Bagans, Aaron Goodwin, Billy Tolley and Jay Wasley embark on a terrifying cross-country journey to document if evil energy lingers within the infamous locations associated with America's notorious serial killers. As they delve into each case, they will retrace the killer's steps, visit known hangouts and speak with leading experts to gain insight on why these sociopaths committed their evil acts.

lead_actors: Sophie Skelton, Oriana Charles, Duran Fulton Brown, Alexander Hackett, Richard Zeman
title: Ren: The Girl with the Mark

Cast out from her small village, she is forced to leave behind the family she has spent her whole life protecting and journey across the land to find the real meaning behind the mark she bears.

title: Un Si Grand Soleil
summary: A woman accuse of murder, must prove her innocent, by exposing the secrets of her past.

summary: A bachelorette party is often for better and sometimes for worse...

Day in and day out, Tony reviews the files of the newly dead and decides singlehandedly whether they're approved or denied to get into Heaven. He's unqualified, unsure of himself and unbelievably burdened by the weight of his choices. It's just one thing after another!

creators: Alice Vial, Louise Massin, Marie Lelong

Tycoon

lead_actors: Lene Maria Christensen, Morten Hee Andersen, Claus Riis Østergaard, Dar Salim, Anders Juul

summary: In a small town five people join forces and plan the perfect murder of the local town psycho only to realize that once you start playing God, it's easy to end up as the Devil.

summary: The Amelia Gething Complex presents online sensation Amelia Gething, in this female-led comedy sketch show which harnesses her aspirational style and surreal humour. Amelia lives in a flat with her two best friends, Vinny and Poppy. It's a home like any other, except that anything can happen. Interspersing the madcap antics in the flat, the show spins off into other sketches in the outside world and breaks the fourth wall by directly engaging the audience.

title: Pants on Fire
summary: Emma Willis hosts this comedy bluffing show in which three daredevil teams attempt some of the stupidest, bravest but often pointless challenges in locations around the globe, and then have to convince a celebrity jury they have been successful - even if they haven't.

summary: When a black woman is killed on an island where everyone is white, every inhabitant looks guilty. "Citygirl" detective, Ella, tries to solve the shocking murder on the desolate Scandinavian island. As she gets closer to solving the mystery, the small island gradually starts to captivate her.

summary: Malcolm, an American student, challenges a Comrade to a real dual. The video become so popular on the net that people organize duels to settle a score with their enemies. In this outburst of violence, will Malcolm escape to this vicious circle?

title: Pineapple
summary: When a miner's daughter is assaulted in the local coal mine, she utters only one word, leaving the town's sheriff baffled. The event quickly spirals out of control, impacting the entire town.

summary: What do a cop, a TV presenter, a politician and a dangerous criminal all have in common?

summary: A series set in the 1960s that showcases the economic and social resurgence of the Spanish population at the time through the "El Asturiano" café.

It features petty criminals who do not always understand the scope of their actions. Gradually, we enter a game of chat and mouse between the police and the bandits. A game from which no one will emerge unscathed.

summary: This series follows bea, an out of work Chicago actor, as she navigates her twenties and its inevitable dramas.

lead_actors: Dou Xiao, Coulee Nazha, Xu Zheng Xi, Cecilia Boey, Rain Wang

summary: A story about six young individuals with different backgrounds and different outlooks who work hard to build a life for themselves in the big city.

summary: Inspired by true events, the crime thriller revolves around Abhay Pratap Singh, a sharp investigating officer with the mind of a criminal, who goes to any extent to solve a case. Join Abhay as he sets out in the dark gruesome world of crime to save innocent lives, while dealing with his own personal demons.

lead_actors: Henry Cole, Sam Lovegrove, Allen Millyard, Guy Willison
title: Junk and Disorderly
summary: Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove are going to scour the country, answering the question on everyone's lips: can you make money from autojumbles and auctions?

summary: In the near future, a civil war leaves Manhattan a demilitarized zone (DMZ), destroyed and isolated from the rest of the world. DMZ chronicles the journey of a female medic who saves lives while desperately searching for her lost son. She has to contend with the gangs, militias, demagogues and warlords that control the lawless no man's land.

lead_actors: Thomas Gauthier, Laurent-Christophe de Ruelle, Olivier Aubin
title: 100 Amis
summary: Yannick is a socially maladaptive young man who discovers he is the heir of his eccentric... and multimillionaire uncleThe deceased, died without friends and without family ties, does not want his nephew to end like him. To receive the inheritance, it is very simple: Yannick must have "100 friends" by the end of the year. Unfortunately, as no one likes, this rule seems impossible to overcome. However, he finds a loophole! Facebook friends count. He currently has 90, so he has only ten left to find.!

lead_actors: Otto Farrant, Brenock O'Connor, Vicky McClure, Ronkẹ Adékoluẹjo, Stephen Dillane
title: Alex Rider
summary: When Alex Rider learns that his uncle Ian has been killed in the line of duty as a British spy – and not in a car accident like he's been told – everything changes for this otherwise normal teen. He is approached by Alan Blunt, head of a shadowy offshoot of MI6 known as The Department, who reveals that Alex has been unknowingly trained since childhood for the dangerous world of espionage. Pressured to help investigate his uncle's death – and how it connects to the assassination of two high-profile billionaires – Alex reluctantly assumes a new identity and goes undercover in a remote boarding school called Point Blanc. Isolated far above the snowline in the French Alps, Point Blanc claims to set the troubled teenage children of the ultra-rich back onto the right track. But as he digs deeper, Alex discovers that the students are in fact the subjects of a disturbing plan by the mysterious Doctor Greif – a plan which he will have to risk his life to stop.

title: You Do You
summary: The Violet girls find themselves on quite an adventure when they travel to the wedding of their childhood friend, Kate. In the midst of all the chaos, Quinta must confront her past when her ex-boyfriend Stephen appears at the wedding, Sara gets lost in the nearby woods, and Ashly is torn between a completely unexpected love triangle.

summary: Originally polar opposites, an American fashion student and the daughter of an industry mogul form an everlasting bond and start a rock band in Milan.

summary: Tasked with hosting her 16 year old cousin Izzy, Ashly fumbles through a summer of hot neighbors, millennial nonsense, and - bird stalkers?

He wanted to avenge his brother.

summary: An after-hours crime scene cleanup crew navigate the landscape of Los Angeles.

summary: In Nickelodeon's new music competition series hosted by Nick Lachey, 30 amazing families take the stage to perform for judges Ciara, David Dobrik and Debbie Gibson but only one will become America's Most Musical Family.

summary: The friendship between two middle-aged couples is in jeopardy when one of them dies in a supposed "car accident".

summary: From the mind of Iliza Shlesinger comes a secret world filled with absurd characters, insight into the female experience, and irreverent yet poignant social commentary.

Warriors from Guo Gai Tou who are dispatched to other teams become aces in the field.

These authentic, relevant, stories are told in short, clickable snapshots. Each themed episode starts with the pair of besties in their 20s in 2008 then jumps to them in their 30s in 2018. They grow, they win, they fail - but they're always there for each other.

He meets an unconventional team comprised of the beautiful, middle-aged Niu Mei Li, the chubby and unemployed Fu Zi and Fu Zi's dad who works as a driver. The three are determined to turn Hao Ze Yu into a big star. Through a stroke of luck, Hao Ze Yu gets his shot at stardom which ignites a series of events. The interim family unit is in danger of falling apart as romance complicates Hao Ze Yu's choices between personal interest and family.

But on the wedding night they will find themselves in an unexpected situation. After that night, they cannot leave the beautiful town of the Aegean and are forced to live together. This imperative condition gradually leaves its place to the adventure of discovering brotherhood, friendship and solidarity.

Part mystery, part relationship drama, it puts a human face on what's coming down the road and the heroism that lies inside us all when our backs are against the wall.

title: Semi-Detached
summary: Each episode of Semi-Detached plays out in real time and follows a perennial loser called Stuart as his life goes down the pan in a suburban cul-de-sac. All Stuart wants is a quiet life as a wedding DJ but his family seems to have other ideas. On top of barely coping with a (much younger) partner April and a new born baby, Stuart also has to look out for his jailbird brother Charlie and his promiscuous, drug-taking Dad Willie. Then there's the ex-wife Kate, who lives across the cul-de-sac with their teenage daughter Madonna and Kate's husband Ted who thinks he's better than Stuart because he sells fish to sushi restaurants.

lead_actors: Seo Ji Soo, Shin Jun Sup, Park Gun Il
title: 7 Days of Romance
summary: Da Eun works part-time and Kim Byul is an idol in her 5th years since debut. These two girls who look alike decide to change each other's lives just for 7 days. It tells the romantic encounters of these 2 girls.

creators: Pablo Barrera, Juanjo García, Fernando Bassi
title: Brigada Costa del Sol
summary: A team of intrepid and impulsive police officers is formed to combat the birth of drug trafficking in 1970s coastal Spain.

title: Sandylands
summary: The series follows twenty-seven-year-old Emily Verma as she begrudgingly returns to her seaside hometown of Sandylands, following the news that her semi-estranged father Les Vegas is 'lost at sea' after a bloodied pedalo is found on the shore. Charged with putting his affairs in order, Emily quickly becomes a key person of interest for a mysterious one-eyed man, who's recently arrived in Sandylands and works for the life insurance company that's due to pay out over Les' unfortunate demise.

title: Feast Mansion
summary: Joji and Rich Brian are celebrating 88rising's Head in the Clouds album and getting ready for their upcoming tour by partying in the Hollywood Hills. There's only one problem: Who's going to bring all the food? In Feast Mansion, Brian and Joji are determined to feed their friends by any means necessary.

lead_actors: Михаил Пореченков, Катерина Шпица, Иван Охлобыстин, Мария Кравченко, Карина Зверева
title: Полярный
summary: The bandit Vitya Myasnik, known in the mid-90s, who retired long ago and owns an eco-farm, at the request of a former accomplice, agreed to overstay the thieves' community on his offshore bank account. When it came time to return the money, by the will of circumstances, Vitya forgot the password from the account. Realizing that no one will believe him, he runs and accidentally ends up in the city of Polyarny located in the North.

title: Pixar in Real Life
summary: Pixar in Real Life brings iconic characters and moments from Pixar films into the real world. Filmed on location in and around New York City, the series surprises and delights real people in public places when they least expect it.

lead_actors: Thanapon Jarujitranon, Varodom Khemmonta, Darvid Kreepolrerk, Panuwat Kerdthongtavee, Hassanat Piniwat
title: Hotel Stars
summary: Every year, LP Paradise Hotel will accept only 10 internships from universities throughout the country in the "Hotel Stars" project, and 2 out of 10 will have the opportunity to receive outstanding internships. They will be placed as hotel staff immediately after the internship is complete and will be given a salary. High service charges and outstanding students will also have a chance to study hotel trips abroad. This year, the selected students, Akarotonpong, Kinteeyanuk, Ying K and Valen, all ten will be divided into groups. To switch internships in three missions, namely kitchen work, housewife work, and reception work. Including a special mission as well. Can all ten interns pass the Arahan checkpoint like the management team and supervisors to become an excellent intern? How about the relationship that Erung Tung Nang between them will be a hindrance to this competition?

lead_actors: Joe Chen, Wang Yi Bo, Tong Da Wei
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Love Actually
summary: Do opposites really attract? An Qing Huan is a career woman who is highly driven to succeed. She is focused on her career and works very hard to work toward her goals in life. Ding Ren Jian is an IT engineer who doesn't think much past what he needs to do on a daily basis. He lives in the moment and tries to deal with what life throws at him. When Qing Huan meets Ren Jian, the two can't seem more different from each other. But as they both deal with their bustling lives, will they realize that they have more in common than they thought?

lead_actors: Barry Brewer, Tahir Moore, Troy Damien
title: The Perfect Plan
summary: The series follows three roommates, who fall behind in bills and rent and get caught up in a dramatic tale that leaves them running from dangerous gang lords, angry landlords, and crooked cops. The only way out is to come up with "The Perfect Plan".

title: Nashville Squares
summary: Nashville Squares puts a country music twist on the classic game show "Hollywood Squares," by staying true to the beloved tic-tac-toe format and infusing it with some of the most influential and charismatic personalities in country music, pop culture, entertainment, sports, fashion, comedy and more.

title: Klassentreffen
summary: 17 ex-pupils meet again after 25 years at a class reunion in Hürth. Of course, the archetypes should not be missing: the former best in class, the genius, the brat, the bully. But they are all in their mid-40s now and may have changed more or less. What has become of your former dreams and goals?

title: Brace: The Series
summary: In the not so distant future, a violent chemical attack decimated the world's population and leaves those who survived without the ability to speak. As the remaining populace regains their voice, the government has their own agenda in mind for society.

title: Wait 'Til Next Year
summary: The Lincoln Park Railsplitters are the laughingstock of Michigan high school football. They've lost 43 games in a row--a five-year losing streak--and they're just 5 losses away from owning the worst losing streak in state history. But the football team is sick of being kicked around. The cheerleaders are finished being taunted. This year everything is going to change. The kids from Lincoln Park are on a mission to do what nobody thinks they can: win. The series follows one season of football the team's players, cheerleaders, parents and fans embark on a journey to turn their lives around. From dating relationships to social struggles and family drama, they deal with the growing pains of high school while uniting first as friends, then as a team, and finally as a school hoping to start new legacy at Lincoln Park.

title: Craftopia
summary: On Craftopia, 9 to 15-year old contestants put their imaginations to the test and make their crafting dreams come true in a magical studio. After racing to fill up their carts with inspiring materials from the studio "store," crafters meet larger-than-life challenges, making the most amazing creations the world has ever seen.

title: Karma
summary: Karma takes sixteen contestants, ranging in age from 12 to 15, completely off the grid, away from parents and the normal comforts of home, to solve puzzles and overcome physical challenges, with the laws of karma setting the rules. This adventure competition series, led by YouTube host Michelle Khare, will test the mental and physical stamina of its young contestants as they unravel how their social actions impact their success in the game. Focus, giving, humility, growth, connection, change, and patience are the path to becoming the "Karma Champion." But more importantly, the players learn one of life's most profound lessons: "What you give out, you get back."

lead_actors: Guðrún Ýr Eyfjörð, Ingvar Eggert Sigurðsson, Þorsteinn Bachmann, Aliette Opheim, Valter Skarsgård
title: Katla
summary: One year after the violent eruption of the subglacial volcano Katla, the peace and tranquility in the small town of Vik is dramatically disturbed. As people evacuate the area, the ice near the volcano starts to melt. The few remaining people manage to provide necessary community service. But despite its grand location, the area turns out to be somewhat apocalyptic — mysterious elements that have been deeply frozen into the glacier from prehistoric times start to emerge from the melting ice and cause consequences no one could have ever foreseen.

lead_actors: Freddie Fox, Alexa Davies, Mark Stanley, Mark Addy, Stephen Graham
title: White House Farm
summary: White House Farm is a factual drama that tells the story of when members of the same family were murdered at an Essex farmhouse.

title: Aux Animaux La Guerre
summary: The intersecting stories of Martel, a union worker who takes on a dubious job to get himself out of a hole, Bruce, a bodybuilder on steroids, and Rita, a conscientious works inspector.

title: Jan Thomas og Einar blir venner
summary: We get to follow when the two quite different people Jan Thomas and Einar Tørnquist become friends, for real!

title: Mental
summary: Welcome to the Primevères child psychiatry clinic. Marvin, a 17 years old teenager who is more accustomed to custody than medical exams, is interned after a court decision. He doesn't understands why he is here and makes it clear to the other residents and to the doctors. However, with Mélodie, Simon and Estelle, who have been in therapy for several weeks, they are going to shake up the daily life of the clinic while trying to find their own balance. Between recoveries and relapses, it is this new friendship that heals better than any pill.

lead_actors: Josephine Bornebusch, Sverrir Gudnason, Johan Ulveson, Gustav Lindh, Sofia Karemyr
title: Älska mig
summary: Friendship, grief and romance intersect with love in the lives of three generations of people living in Stockholm.

lead_actors: Yoon Shi Yoon, Park Sung Hoon, Jung In Sun, Jung Su Bin
title: Psychopath Diary
summary: Psychopath Diary is about a man named Yook Dong Shik, who coincidentally witnesses a murder and loses his memory after an accident that occurs while fleeing the scene. He wakes up with no sense of identity and mistakes himself as the killer when he finds the murderer's diary in his hands.

lead_actors: Solène Hébert, Patrick Ridremont, Slimane Yefsah
title: Emma

lead_actors: Nilperi Sahinkaya, Kerem Bürsin, Uraz Kaygılaroğlu
title: Aynen Aynen
summary: The series tells the story of Emir and Nil's entertaining relationship by explaining the relationship between men and women in a humorous as well as realistic language. We see the situations in which Nil and Emir want to show themselves to the other party in the relationship and in fact their own real thoughts.

title: L'Accident
summary: In the peaceful Brittany town of Sainte-Lune, the body of Rebecca Cauvy is found in her car on a busy highway: drunk, parked in the wrong direction, she was hit hard by another vehicle. Gabriel, her husband, refuses to accept that this was a suicide or an accident. Anxious to restore Rebecca's honour and protect their young daughter, he leads the investigation, gradually revealing the results of a small community hit by recession. Is this "accident" just the tip of a terrifying iceberg?

creators: Isabel Sebastian, Lionel Bailliu, Yann Le Gal
title: Innocente
summary:
Marseilles. Roxanne Delage is a professor of archeology. She is married to Alexis, they have an 8 year old daughter, Alma. One afternoon, she goes to a private individual to assess a Mayan mask. She wakes up several hours later, half-naked next to a man's corpse. She panics and runs away.

The police come to arrest her shortly after at her home, in front of her family, accused of having killed her lover. Charged, imprisoned, tried and sentenced to 12 years in prison, she decides to cut ties with those she loves to spare them the painful hours of visiting rooms.

8 years later, Roxane leaves prison and she is determined to prove her innocence. She will meet Hugo, the cop who had arrested him while he was ill, and gradually convince him that the real culprit is still in nature ...

title: Sleep Tight
summary: In the tradition of The Twilight Zone, each episode pulls you inside a new nightmare as Gen Z's favorite influencers fight to survive strange and supernatural horrors you can never unsee.

title: Smoking
summary: Seeking a greater justice, a band of homeless assassins flays their human targets and delivers the tattooed skins as proof of a contract fulfilled.

title: Ahi Afuera
summary: They dreamed of a better world, but now they're living a nightmare. Neo-Western and love story in Patagonia.

title: Gundam Build Divers Re:Rise
summary: Set two years after the story of Gundam Build Divers, a new version of the "Gunpla Battle Nexus Online" (GBN) game launches. The story centers on four Divers who participate with completely different play styles and levels. Hiroto is a lone Diver, Kazami is a Diver that plays in different parties, May is Diver who plays the game all day, and Parviz is a shy beginner with the determination to be in a party with other players. All four band together to form a team and experience something that goes beyond the game.

title: Flirty Dancing
summary: Flirty Dancing is part performance, part blind date, and all about romantic chemistry. In the show, complete strangers are each taught half of a dance routine, then meet for the first time on a blind date at a breathtaking location, where they will then dance together without saying a word. In this romantic approach to dating, these singles will push themselves out of their comfort zones in the hope of being swept off their feet, rather than swept to the left or right on a phone.

lead_actors: Callum Turner, Anthony Boyle, Austin Butler, Stephen Campbell Moore, Nate Mann
title: Masters of the Air
summary: Masters of the Air follows the men of the 100th Bomb Group (the "Bloody Hundredth") as they conduct perilous bombing raids over Nazi Germany and grapple with the frigid conditions, lack of oxygen and sheer terror of combat conducted at 25,000 feet in the air. Portraying the psychological and emotional price paid by these young men as they helped destroy the horror of Hitler's Third Reich, is at the heart of Masters of the Air. Some were shot down and captured; some were wounded or killed. And some were lucky enough to make it home. Regardless of individual fate, a toll was exacted on them all.

lead_actors: Jared Padalecki, Keegan Allen, Violet Brinson, Kale Culley, Jeff Pierre
title: Walker
summary: Walker centers on Cordell Walker, a widower and father of two with his own moral code, who returns home to Austin after being undercover for two years, only to discover there's harder work to be done at home. He attempts to reconnect with his children, navigate clashes with his conservative family, and find unexpected common ground with his new partner (one of the first women in Texas Rangers' history), while growing increasingly suspicious about the circumstances surrounding his wife's death.

lead_actors: Phil Wright, Ariel Martin, Trevor Flannagan-Tordjman
title: Disney Fam Jam
summary: Each episode of Disney Fam Jam featuring two families hitting the floor in three unique rounds of dance battles to see which family will be crowned Disney Fam Jam Champs.

title: LEGO Friends: Girls on a Mission
summary: Meet Andrea, Mia, Emma, Olivia and Stephanie. They're five best friends. And they're on a heroic mission: to save Heartlake City from wily swindlers.

lead_actors: Choi Jin Hyeok, Park Seong Ung, Jo Dong Hyuk, Jung Hye In, Han Ji Wan
title: Rugal
summary: Rugal is about an elite detective who attempts to bring down a nationwide criminal organization named Argos. In the process, he ends up being targeted by the powerful criminals behind Argos, and not only does he lose his beloved wife and both of his eyes, but he is also framed for murder. After receiving a set of artificial eyes with special abilities created using biotechnology developed by an organization named Rugal, he sets out on a quest to wipe out the criminal organization responsible for his suffering.

title: Pariu cu viața
summary: Pariu cu viața centers upon the love story between two teenagers Ioana Popa and Andrei Anghel whose destinies are switched at birth. Ioana and Andrei are students in their senior year at the National College of Arts. They are happily in love or at least this is what Ioana thinks until the moment she learns shes nothing but a bet Andrei made with Cristi, his best friend. What nobody knows is that Andrei has truly fallen for her. Disappointed, Ioana takes refuge in music, especially in LaLa Band, the modern music club created by the new music teacher at the college, Raluca. The 20 talented members of LaLa Band promise to insert new adrenaline into the post-Beatles music. They all have a great passion for music and big dreams to become international stars and have sold out concerts. Ioana was raised in a poor family by Gica Popa and Tantica together with her brother, Rafael and her sister, Gio. With plenty of humor and always looking for fun, the Popas live by the motto education is not important, only money matters. Andrei is a charismatic young guy who comes from a wealthy family that seems to be perfect. But the truth starts to come up when Anca, Andreis sister, is diagnosed with a severe kidney disease, inherited from Mara Anghels family. Her only chance of survival is a kidney transplant. After running the blood tests, Mara and Sandu Anghel have to face another shocking truth: Andrei is revealed as not being related to Anca or the family at all. Mara and Sandu Anghel realize their child was switched at birth in the tragic fire that occurred at the maternity hospital 17 years ago. And they begin the search of their real child the child that could save Anca's life as well as their own.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: O nouă viață
summary: O nouă viață is a sequel to the 2011 TV series Pariu cu viața and it's the first Romanian musical soap opera.

title: Numai Iubirea
summary: The first ever romanian TV show follows Dan Bratu and Bianca still dealing with Ioana Bratu's death, a beloved wife and mother.

lead_actors: Jung Yoo Mi, Choi Tae Joon, Go Se Won, Go Doo Shim, Uhm Hyun Kyung
title: Mother's Garden
summary: A woman gets to live at her biological mother's boarding house with her stepmother after her father dies and his business goes down. This struggling family overcomes life challenges together through love and compassion to reach a happy ending.

title: O Săptămână Nebună
summary: Alex Puica, a young man that seems to be followed by trouble and bad luck, is soon to marry Maria, daughter of the respectable Emilian and Natalia Codrescu.

title: Take Me to Your Mother
summary: Take Me to Your Mother follows Andrea Rosen as she meets moms from different parts of society and with different backgrounds, learning about how to best raise her children.

title: Best før
summary: Lena has reconciled herself with the old-age job, but life at home is becoming increasingly complicated. Lena and Morten's plan to maintain a normal and relatively harmonious relationship becomes difficult to implement because Anemone wants full control over Morten and Lena at a long distance. At the same time, Lena continues the pursuit of love!

title: XXX: Uncensored
summary: It's sexy. It's racy. It's India's hottest original show.

lead_actors: Kim Ji Soo, Ryu Jung Han, Choi Chul Ho, Lee Ah Hyun
title: Love Again
summary: A story of graduates from a co-ed school reuniting after 30 years and facing reality reflected by their past.

lead_actors: Stefano Accorsi, Antonio Gerardi, Paolo Pierobon, Guido Caprino, Miriam Leone
creators: Stefano Sardo, Ludovica Rampoldi, Alessandro Fabbri
summary: After the breakdown of the old government, and with it the First Republic, Italy changed for good in 1994. Spinster Leo is all too aware of this. He pushed hard to see Berlusconi get elected Prime Minister. He knows it's not easy to win power, but holding on to it verges on the impossible. By the same token, it seems equally impossible for populist politician Pietro to change. Even now that he has an office at the Prime Minister's premises in Rome, he still can't cast off his old bad habits. Nor can he forget the only woman he has ever loved. A former TV starlet now turned politician and Congresswoman, Veronica has to decide who the man of her life is going to be. She has realized she no longer wants to be just a woman on the arm of powerful men. It is the start of her own push for power.

title: Prost Mortem – Die letzte Runde
summary: The second German in-house production of the pay TV station 13th Street is a classic, black-humored crime thriller in a modern guise.

title: La Dernière Vague
summary: In Brizan, a quiet seaside resort in the french Landes, everything changes with the arrival of the first wave which, like a tsunami, will cause the disappearance of surfers and disrupt the intimate life of the inhabitants.

lead_actors: Amber Stevens West, Bresha Webb, Corbin Reid, Tosin Morohunfola, Stephen Bishop
title: Run the World
summary: Run the World is the story of a group of Black, vibrant, fiercely loyal best friends who work, live and play in Harlem as they strive for world domination. At its core, it's an unapologetically female show about enviable friendship and not only surviving—but thriving together.

lead_actors: Chen Du Ling, Shen Yue, Dylan Xiong, Zhou Ting Wei, Connor Leong
title: Another Me
summary: Two best friends' relationship is strained when they fall in love with the same man.

title: The Hustler
summary: Each episode of The Hustler follows five contestants as they collaborate to answer a series of trivia questions, with the goal of building a collective prize pot that increases with each correct answer. The catch? One of the five contestants, the Hustler, already knows the answers but must keep their identity a secret in order to have a shot at winning the grand prize. Throughout each episode, two contestants are anonymously eliminated by the Hustler, leaving three remaining contestants – the Hustler and two others, who must collectively decide who they think the Hustler is. If they are right, they share the prize pot. If the two contestants are wrong, the Hustler goes home with the full cash reward.

lead_actors: Kim Ji Hoon, Jo Hee Bong, Im Jung Eun, Kim Gab Soo
title: Joseon X-Files: Mystery Investigation Record
summary: Joseon X-Files is based on cases detailed in the Annals of Joseon History with a bizarre twist; these incidents incorporate mysterious, supernatural elements that cannot be explained through science. Kim Hyung Do is an inspector of the state whose single-minded focus on his investigations into administrative misdeeds bring him into direct contact with these strange mysteries. Heo Yoon Yi is a government employee who aids him and attempts to understand these scientific impossibilities with an open mind, in contrast to his cynicism.

title: Dr. Blackson
summary: "The Therapist" has nothing on Dr. Blackson…as in the unfiltered and unbothered comedian, Michael Blackson. Have issues in the bedroom, with body image, or your sexual orientation? Come to Dr. Blackson and he will fix you like that. But is he kind, gentle, and caring? Hell, no. Get your mind right or else, modasucka! This series is the natural next step for Michael's hugely popular ‘advice column' on his Social Media pages, where random people write to Michael with their problems, then await his usually outrageous advice.

lead_actors: Keeley Hawes, Nigel Havers, Joanna Lumley, Dominique Moore, Isabella Pappas
creators: Roger Goldby, Keeley Hawes, Simon Nye
title: Finding Alice
summary: Finding Alice is a drama series about a woman who loses her husband in a freak accident only to find he has left her to unravel a trail of secrets, debt and criminality.

lead_actors: Jason Sudeikis, Brendan Hunt, Hannah Waddingham, Jeremy Swift, Brett Goldstein
creators: Brendan Hunt, Joe Kelly, Bill Lawrence, Jason Sudeikis
title: Ted Lasso
summary: Ted Lasso centers on an idealistic — and clueless — all-American football coach hired to manage an English football club — despite having no soccer coaching experience at all.

title: Your Room or Mine?
summary: Four teams make over each other's homes to see who has the best taste in interior design.

lead_actors: Marisa Davila, Tricia Fukuhara, Ari Notartomaso, Jason Schmidt, Madison Thompson
title: Grease: Rise of the Pink Ladies
summary: Grease: Rise of the Pink Ladies is inspired by the 1978 Golden Globe® nominated film Grease. A joyous musical series set in and around the world of Rydell High, the show reimagines the global smash hit movie with some characters you already know, and a whole lot more you will soon meet. It's still the 1950s, a world that rocks with big musical numbers from the period combined with new original songs as well. It's the peer pressures of high school, the horrors of puberty, and the rollercoaster of life in middle America with a modern sensibility that will bring it to life for today's musical lovers.

title: 2gether The Series
summary: To evade an admirer, Tine plays up a relationship with a pretend boyfriend, Sarawat, until the act turns to reality.  Adapted from JittiRain's novel.

title: Squadra mobile
summary: When Roberto Ardenzi is promoted to police chief, he finds himself managing a new group of strong-willed policemen afflicted by personal problems, as well as trying to reconcile work with his private life, especially in the relationship with his twenty-year-old daughter Mauretta.

lead_actors: Choi Yoon So, Sul Jung Hwan, Shim Ji Ho, Jung Yoo Min
title: Unasked Family
summary: A housewife who has gone through a stormy marriage and a man with an upbeat personality who also weathered a tough times try to "reset" their lives.

title: The Demon Headmaster
summary: All is not what it appears at Lizzie's new school. There's something seriously spooky about the strange Headmaster and Lizzie is determined to find out what's going on, before it's too late.

lead_actors: Владимир Яглыч, Павел Табаков, Юлия Хлынина, Sabina Akhmedova, Никита Тарасов
title: Колл-центр
summary: Twelve co-workers of the call center of the online shop "Boutique for Adults" are trapped on the 12th floor of the Gloria Plaza business center in Moscow. Suddenly the intruders named "mom" and "dad" tell them that the building is mined. For a bomb not to explode, the workers must comply with the criminals' demands. Will the hostages be able to defuse the bomb in 8 hours, escape and still remain humans?

lead_actors: Seçkin Özdemir, Özge Özpirinçci, Barış Falay, Saygın Soysal, Nesrin Cavadzade
title: Al Yazmalim
summary: A beautiful love story between two young adults. Is it going to be the love of his life or the dream of his life? based on the novel My Poplar in a Red Scarf by Chinghiz Aitmatov and the Turkish romantic drama film The Girl with the Red Scarf.

title: Big Bounce, la course de trampoline
La smala s'en mêle
summary: Twenty-five years of marriage: it's time to celebrate! A couple as envied as they are united, three children, two of whom are adopted, Isabelle Garnier is more than ever delighted with this success, her success, that of a lifetime! A pithy note from her husband left on the pillow, bank accounts emptied, in less than 24 hours, and now the life, as peaceful as it is installed, of this housewife, charitable bourgeois, a blessed ass nothing, turns to the survival operation.

title: Victor Hugo, ennemi d'État
summary: 1848, Paris under Siege: Victor Hugo is torn between his family, his mistresses and political turmoil - never mind finally completing his classic novel Les Miserables. Although Hugo is a confirmed Royalist, he supports the Republic and Louis Napoléon Bonaparte, who is soon to become president, convinced that he will initiate social reforms. But when the new government is formed and Hugo is overlooked for office, he realizes that he has been used. Furious at the deception, he and his sons launch a daily newspaper to give the people a voice. Nor is it less chaotic on the home front, as he is juggling his love life between two mistresses and his long-suffering wife and mother of his children. When Napoléon seizes power and his sons are jailed for insurrection, Hugo insists that his wife and daughter leave Paris, where he remains, devoting himself wholeheartedly to the resistance. Openly denouncing repression, he is declared Enemy of the State and has to face disgrace and exile.

title: Anatane et les enfants d'Okura
summary: Paris, 2213. Like all boys approaching the age of 15, Anatane Goliatkine knows that he will soon be taken to Okura. Like his father before him, he will become a docile Buzi, a worker destined to work on the Great Project of Clunk, the dictator ruling the new world order since the end of the third Great War which ravaged the planet. However, during a simple snowball fight, Anatane's fate changes. Discovering an incredible power of invisibility, the boy then becomes the most wanted fugitive in the world... Representing a direct threat to the Clunk dictatorship, Anatane also reveals new hope for all the rebels and resistance fighters dispersed around the world. To put an end to the dictatorship, to free men from their Buzi condition, Anatane Goliatkine leaves Paris with his friends Nikita and Nevenaa, and his younger sister Ariane. Thus begins a long journey to the East, towards Okura.

lead_actors: Midori Francis, Austin Abrams, Dante Brown, Troy Iwata
title: Dash & Lily
summary: Dash & Lily revolves around cynical Dash and optimistic Lily who trade dares, dreams, and desires in the notebook they pass back and forth at locations all across New York City, finding they have more in common with each other than they would have expected.

title: I Don't Love You Yet
summary: Mitari Yo is a career woman who works for a shoe company. She finds her work rewarding and has successfully advanced in her career. Her love life, on the other hand, isn't doing as well. Ishida Ren works for a real estate developer and is Yo's best friend. An ex-classmate from both high school and university days, he understands her best and is the only person she pours her heart out to. On Yo's 29th birthday, the two friends place a wager to give 300,000 yen as a congratulatory gift to the one who is the first to get married by the last day they are both 30. Although they declare that it is impossible for them to fall in love with each other, this wager, as well as advances by Ren's junior in the company and Yo's reunion with her ex-boyfriend, lead to gradual changes in the relationship of the two best friends.

title: Andy op Patrouille
summary: Most people know Andy Peelman as an actor, but did you know that he is also a real police officer? In Andy op Patrouille we will follow Andy when he is visiting his foreign colleagues.

title: Quart de vie
summary: A crazy comedy inspired by the sitcom, Quarter Life follows the adventures of three friends who struggle to find their place in a world where, in their twenties, there are three ways to fulfill themselves: by starting a family, by creating Facebook or by participating in Occupation Double. Thus, when her boyfriend announces to her in surprise that he has bought a house so that they can start a family, Ariane, mid-twenties, decides to flee. Lost, homeless and penniless, she meets Constance and Bam, two unbalanced but well-meaning roommates who take her under their wing. Together, the three friends will discover through fiascos that there is only one way to get out of the quarter-life crisis alive: it is by being surrounded by friends who are as disoriented as you are.

title: No te puedes esconder
summary: No te puedes esconder follows the lives of a nurse who is trying to rebuild her life, a former policeman turned into a hit-man, a photographer obsessed with death, a politician with forbidden relationships, and a group of idealistic friends.

lead_actors: Dakota Laden, Chelsea Laden, Tanner Wiseman
title: Destination Fear
summary: Maverick paranormal explorer Dakota Laden takes his sister, Chelsea, and best friend, Tanner, across the country in an RV to spend the night in the most haunted locations in America, testing the limits of human fear.

title: My Famous Babysitter

At the end of their time in charge they face some honest feedback from the parents and the kids, and it proves to be an emotional experience for everyone involved.

This love will drag both families into endless pain and will ignite an irreversible conflict. On the other hand, the successful, intelligent and handsome son of the Avcıoğlu family, Sinan, who has been away from his home for years, will meet Bahar, the young and beautiful wife of the mining king Şahin Yılmaz, who loves him like his own son, and one of the Kılıçoğlus, whom Şahin wants to put in charge of his business. his wife Bahar; A very different future awaits, which the two families do not even want to imagine. In addition, Birgül, who does not bow to her grandfather's pressure and wants to study ballet in Batumi, and her mentally disabled brother Orhan, who is trying to hold on to life despite everything, will try to overcome all the obstacles that stand in their way for their dreams and will fight until the end.

A failed bank robber locks himself in with an over-enthusiastic real estate agent, two bitter IKEA-addicts, a pregnant woman, a suicidal multi-millionaire and a damn rabbit. In the end the robber gives up and lets everyone go, but when the police storm the apartment it is...empty.In a series of dysfunctional testimonies afterwards, the witnesses all tell their version of what really happened, whereupon a classic puzzle mystery develops around the questions: How did the robber manage to escape? Why is everyone so angry? And: What is WRONG with people these days?

Puritanical Christianity, deep-seated superstition and a willingness to scapegoat outsiders have created a tinderbox of suspicion in which few are safe. In this environment, witchfinding has flourished, as self-appointed witch experts achieve hero status by investigating accusations of witchery and extracting confessions.A failing witchfinder transports a suspected witch across 1640s East Anglia to a trial that could change his fortunes forever. But his captive is the worst possible travel companion: an inquisitive, uncouth woman whose ability to prick his pomposity and ask uncomfortable questions turns a straightforward journey into a life-changing ordeal.

Star chef Steffen Henssler, comedian Ingo Appelt, TV lawyer Christopher Posch, reporter Johanna Maria Knothe ("Bambule - the magazine") and cabaret artist Florian Schroeder stand by his side and present further examples of wasted money.

She wants up. He wants out. She wants to secure her future; he wants to leave his old life behind. The pair are forced to rethink when they end up in a tricky situation where the past catches up, where future dreams are shattered, and where nothing is what it seems.

Meanwhile, the middle-aged daughter of the family lives love secretly with Kerem, the son of one of the oldest families in the region. Youth excitement and love fire cause both to make mistakes and Kerem and Hayat get together before they get married.

Usually they perform in activities around Nerima ward in Tokyo to raise the awareness of the promising future energy source "Photon Power" (koushiryoku). However, there are times when "Mechanical Beast" team of girls emerge from the "Subterranean Empire" and attempt to steal the energy. Thus "Team Z" has to battle them to prevent this, though sometimes they just go and beat up the "bad girls" to relieve stress.

lead_actors: Ella Bright, Danya Griver, Imogen Lamb, Beth Bradfield, Jennifer Wigmore

summary: Based on the hugely popular book series of the same name by Enid Blyton, Malory Towers is a live-action series following 12-year-old Darrell Rivers as she leaves home for the first time to attend an all-girls' boarding school. Set in the 1940s on the sun-drenched cliffs of the Cornish coast, Malory Towers explores this nostalgic world of midnight feasts, lacrosse, pranks, and lasting friendships. For a contemporary audience, the show is both aspirational and inspirational, telling the story of universal experiences include shifting cliques, FOMO, bullying, crushes, peer pressure, and self-doubt. The girls keep an eye on each other and, like a family, are forever connected by their shared experiences.

André is a young man who starts working in the school cafeteria, dazzling with his image and charisma. Lana falls in love with him when she discovers him singing at the piano in the school's music room. André has the desire to make a musical career as a singer on his own, moving away from the contacts of his father, the film director Víctor Vegas. Lana's best friends will convince André to turn to her to promote himself as a singer on social networks, for Lana it is a good excuse to be close to him.

title: À l'état sauvage
summary: They are famous... Singers, comedians, comedians... Their life is comfortable and urban. For the first time in their lives, they will live a completely new and particularly difficult experience: for a week, a famous artist will experience the unusual and uncomfortable daily life of the greatest explorer in the world, Mike Horn. They will face the hostility of nature with the minimum necessary to survive: a knife, some ropes, a little water and nothing else: only nature will provide them with what they will need! Whether in the ancestral desert of Namibia or in the suffocating jungles of Sri Lanka, Mike Horn will serve as their guide in these wild and hostile territories... In the heart of nature and returned to the wild state, these personalities will lose all their bearings. During this experience, the artist will discover a whole new way of life, be confronted with the intensity and beauty of nature, causing him to question himself.

title: What's Up France
summary: Right now, we live in a crazy world, but meanwhile in France...
