lead_actors: Kate Box, Madeleine Sami, Nina Oyama, Alicia Gardiner, Holly Austin
title: Deadloch
summary: The Tasmanian town of Deadloch, a once sleepy seaside hamlet, is left reeling when a local man turns up dead on the beach. Two female detectives are thrown together to solve the case, fastidious local Senior Sergeant Dulcie Collins and a rough as guts blow in from Darwin, Senior Investigator Eddie Redcliffe along with their overeager junior constable Abby. As the town prepares to launch the annual arts, food and culture Winter "Feastival", the trio has to put their differences aside and work together to find the killer.

lead_actors: Anick Lemay, Jean-Nicolas Verreault, Luc Picard, Caroline Dhavernas, Rémi-Pierre Paquin
title: Aller simple
summary: Six people who do not know each other are invited under various pretexts to stay at the prestigious estate of a billionaire. The helicopter that is to transport them is forced into an emergency landing. As the group settles down to wait for help, mysterious accidents and disappearances follow one another. What could a former policeman, a religious art dealer, a retired teacher, a marketing director, a star criminal lawyer and a businesswoman have in common to find themselves trapped in this way?

title: L'Homme que j'ai condamné
summary: Appointed to be a juror in a criminal trial, Inès, a 40-year-old nurse, helps to convict the accused, a man with a violent past. At the end of the trial, she is seized with a terrible doubt: what if she had just sent an innocent man behind bars? If she had just unjustly separated a father from his 8-year-old son, whom he will not see grow up? With the help of a private detective with a strong character, Inès will start her own counter-investigation, which will take her much further than she thinks...

lead_actors: Kim Dong Wook, Kim Sung Kyu, Chae Jeong An
title: The King of Pigs
summary: Two men became victims of school violence 20 years ago. One of them becomes a serial killer to punish evil and the other one a detective on a case trying to catch him.

title: Hotel Margaret
summary: Hungary's favorite influencers arrive at a prestigious awards ceremony in Tihany to find out who has become the most successful videographer of the year. During the award ceremony, after the shooting of a faulty confetti cannon, the winner collapses on stage. Was there an accident or an intentional murder?

lead_actors: Владимир Жеребцов, Екатерина Олькина, Виктор Добронравов
title: Технарь
summary: Igor Odintsov is a unique specialist in security systems. But even the most sophisticated technology can fail. An unknown person easily penetrates into his "smart house", stuffed with miracle gadgets up to the roof, and takes Igor's wife and son hostage. Now, in order to save his loved ones, Odintsovo needs to commit a crime himself: apply his skills to please the bandits. However, a slippery path rarely leads to a happy ending, and now the hero is rushing through Moscow at night with a heap of new problems, without a clue how to fix his seemingly perfect life.

lead_actors: Magdalena Boczarska, Leszek Lichota, Agnieszka Grochowska, Krzystof Oleksyn, Grzegorz Damięcki
title: Zachowaj spokój
summary: Zachowaj spokój is another Netflix title based on the novel by Harlan Coben. The six-episode series is set in a wealthy housing estate, where the local community leads a quiet life with close relationships. Everything changes when 18-year-old Adam disappears without a trace. The danger escalates quickly, and the worried parents do everything they can to protect their children who, on the verge of adulthood, have decided to take matters into their own hands. Hold Tight is a dynamic, twist-filled thriller that, while not a sequel to The Woods, will feature the fate of several protagonists of Harlan Coben's first screen adaptation.

title: Après
summary: Après recounts the aftermath of a tragic event that suddenly arose in Lac Sabin, a small town in the Laurentians. The story begins in the seconds following the disastrous event and depicts the physical, psychological and social consequences of this tragedy that no one could have foreseen or avoided. Nothing will now be the same in the quiet municipality. It is fear, mourning, incomprehension. There are the victims, the survivors and all those around them who try to understand the irreparable.

title: Unpaused: Naya Safar
summary: Unpaused: Naya Safar continues to takes the legacy of the first anthology forward and yet again brings together 5 unique filmmakers - Nupur Asthana, Ayappa KM, Ruchir Arun, Shikha Makan and Nagraj Manjule - with new stories of hope, love, connections and second chances that celebrate the resilient human spirit in these uncertain times.

title: Dangerous
summary: Revolves around the life of Aditya Dhanraj, a young struggling entrepreneur, who discovers that his wife Diya Dhanraj has gone missing. He sets out to find his wife with the help of the police, only to discover that his ex-girlfriend Neha Singh will be handling his case. In pursuit of the truth, will they dig into many 'dangerous' hidden secrets like murder, kidnapping or even a case of business rivalry? Or is there something more to the case than meets the eye?

title: The Great Indian Murder
summary: When notorious industrialist Vicky Rai gets killed at a party, the main suspects are the guests - both invited and uninvited.

title: Dale Gas
summary: After a race they drive in ends fatally, friends Kike and Noche flee to Mexico City to hide, rebuild their lives and escape danger ... or at least try.

title: Superfan
summary: Superfan is a musical spectacle disguised as a game show that will feature several rounds of play where fans will have the ability to advance to a final round for the chance to prove they are the ultimate fan. Each episode will name one superfan who will win the ultimate experience with the featured artist.

title: Supernormal
summary: A comedy about what it means to be the top executive at an investment bank at the same as being a mother in the 21st century.

title: Is It Cake?
summary: Deception is the name of the game for the world's most talented bakers who will compete to create hyper-realistic cakes that look exactly like everyday objects – with cash on the line. But are they good enough to deceive a panel of celebrity judges… and you? You'll be asking yourself ‘is it real?' Or…Is It Cake?"

title: Lov3
summary: Siblings Sofia, Beto and Ana refuse to experience love and sex like their parents. And that feeling grows stronger when their mother decides to end a 30-year-long marriage. The separation is the event that makes the three of them reevaluate their own emotional choices — and their ability to take care of each other while, at the same time, trying not to stifle their own identities.

title: Villa Oranje
summary: With the European Championship just around the corner, Wesley Sneijder, Dirk Kuyt, Mark van Bommel and John Heitinga look back, but also ahead to the upcoming European Championship.

title: Byron Baes
summary: Australian influencers flock to Byron Bay for its warm, beachy beauty and cool, creative vibe. Follow these friends as they negotiate life and love.

title: Last One Standing
summary: They're comedians starring in a thrilling drama, but if their jokes don't land in the unscripted scenes, they're off the show. Let the mayhem begin!

title: Не приходи ко мне во сне
summary: Lesya and Veronica are sisters on their father's side, and more recently, best friends. Lesya dreams of singing on stage, Veronica helps her sister make her dream come true. But the fashion producer chooses not Lesya, but the liberated Veronica... Suddenly, misfortunes begin to haunt Veronica - people close to her die under mysterious circumstances. The girl herself gets into an accident and miraculously survives. Lesya discovers that she dreamed of all these misfortunes before and then became reality... Is she subconsciously jealous of her sister and going crazy? Or does she have a split personality and is a killer?

title: Власть
summary: To save a beloved girl who needs expensive treatment, the artist kidnaps nine young female fans of a popular music group. He gets in touch with their relatives and demands a ransom. However, when the money is collected, the kidnapper disappears without a trace. This is how a dangerous game begins, where power passes from the hands of the executioners into the hands of their victims.

lead_actors: Louisa Zhu, James Hartnett, Christian Potenza, Mark Little, Deven Mack
title: Transformers: BotBots
summary: When the lights go out at the mall, the BotBots come out to play! Meet a fun-loving crew of everyday objects that morph into robots at closing time.

lead_actors: Oliver Cunliffe, Krish Misra, Maiya Silveston, Aoife Hughes, Katy Byrne
title: Silverpoint
summary: Four kids at Silverpoint Adventure Camp stumble upon something strange buried out in the woods, which sends their lives and the world around them spiralling out of control.

lead_actors: Елизавета Ищенко, Анна Михалкова, Дмитрий Лысенков, Таисия Вилкова, Степан Девонин
title: Алиса не может ждать
summary: "Alyssa" is a story about the fragility of growing up, the fear of loneliness and the importance of motherly love and support. Alyssa is only fifteen, and her teachers are tired of calling her mother into school, while Alyssa's mother can't understand what is going on with her child. Alyssa then finally learns what has been hidden from her for years: she will soon go completely blind. A little longer, and she will be in total darkness. She vows to live to the fullest while she can and decides that it would be stupid to waste time on school. It is better to grow up fast, earn some easy money, and move to a big and beautiful city. But pretty soon Alyssa's teenage illusions are shattered by reality, and her mother's strategy of pretending that all is well will inevitably lead to disaster.

title: Irodorimidori
summary: At Maigahara Music College Affiliate School Maigahara Senior High (abbreviated as MaiMai) that gathers the most promising musical talents, there's a rumor circulating among students. "If you give an amazing performance at the school festival, you get special extra credit (or so they say)." Serina's grades are not very good, so she immediately believes the rumor and decides to form a band.

title: L'Oeil Du Cyclone
summary: A cyclone is a meteorological phenomenon that occurs when you have to manage 3 children, a self-employed job, an ex-boyfriend and his new too-young girlfriend, daycare schedules, meals, school, lunches, the new employee - And in the eye of this Cyclone is Isabelle, 39 years old, a single mother who has the mental burden of all this in addition to having to put up with a sister who is better than she is at everything, a mother who reminds her that her sister is better than she is at everything, and a barren love life.

title: Gossip: #Kanojo ga Shiritai Honto no ○○
summary: Depicts the connection between people in a new era through the work, way of life, and romance of the people who work there, with the editorial staff of the news site as the main character.Kanfuru News is an online news media website, run by a large publishing company. Their articles are written by the editorial team, who are all men, and consists mostly of rearranged stories and comments from other websites. Their goal is to only increase page views. One day, Seko Ririko is transferred to the editorial team from the accounting department.

lead_actors: Adel Imam, Dalal Abdel Aziz, Hamdy Marghany, Mohamed Kelany, Tarek Elebiary
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Valentino
summary: Nour Abdel Mejid, AKA Valentino, owns a number of international schools, "Valentino Schools", run by him and his domineering wife with whom he's not in agreement. Their disagreements, however, get them on several adventures and reveals many surprises along the way.

title: ZERV - Zeit der Abrechnung
summary: ZERV tells of the first years after the fall of the Wall, the breaks in life courses, of completely different biographies and of the successful encounter in the common fight against crime, which knows neither East nor West. ZERV stands for "Zentrale Ermittlungsstelle für Regierungs- und Vereinigungskriminalität", the Central Investigation Agency for Government and Association Crime, which was founded in Berlin in 1991 by decision of the federal government. Karo Schubert fought for a position as chief inspector in reunified Germany. When she investigates the murder of a high-ranking employee of the Ministry of Disarmament, she meets Peter Simon, the newly appointed Western Commissioner from the special unit ZERV for the first time. They are forced to investigate together - because both claim the murder case for their department. But the various tasks of the ZERV can only be solved for Peter Simon and his team in cooperation with the Eastern colleagues.

title: Matar al padre
summary: Matar al padre shows the story of Jacobo Vidal, an authoritarian lawyer in his work and in his family who wants to have control of all areas of his life and those around him, especially his children Valeria and Tomás. At the time of post-Olympic Barcelona, he will have no qualms about overcoming all obstacles that may arise so that the well-being of his family fits in with his vision of life. But fifteen years later, in the economic crisis, Jacobo will realize that his life is not as planned: his wife has thrown him out of the house, his son has given himself to alternative therapies, his daughter wants to live away from him and above it he is ruined and homeless. For all this, he begins to question his way of seeing life.

title: Victor Sauvage
summary: After twenty years of traveling the world to take care of wild animals, Victor decided to get closer to his children aged 10 and 15. This is why he accepted the proposal of his childhood friend, Laurent, to take over the management of the Paraclete animal reserve. Victor still finds himself very sensitive to the charm of his wife, Mathilde, whom he has never stopped loving. For her part, if she had really turned the page, she would have asked for a divorce, right? Unless she has found comfort and tranquility with this "brave Henri", the good friend of always... Baptiste and Zoé rediscover a full-time father, and Victor must now assume shared custody of his children. A mission at least as demanding as his job as a veterinarian, and for which he is not quite prepared. Twenty years in the bush makes you forget the refueling at the supermarket and the traffic jams! But Victor chose this "reconversion" because he no longer wanted to live away from his children. Basically, he just changed jungle...

title: Ice Age: Scrat Tales
summary: Scrat, the hapless saber-toothed squirrel of the "Ice Age" adventures, who experiences the ups and downs of fatherhood, as he and the adorable, mischievous Baby Scrat, alternately bond with each other and battle for ownership of the highly treasured Acorn.

title: Käthe und ich
summary: The psychologist Paul, who specializes in animal-assisted therapies, and the Australian Shepherd bitch Käthe take on demanding cases. The tandem helps people get back on their feet after accidents and illnesses.

title: Brave Animated Series
summary: A group of superheroes sets out to rid the world of evil — only to realize they may not be standing on the side of justice. Based on a popular comic.

lead_actors: Kate Garraway, Guddi Singh, Dr. Karan Rajan
title: Your Body Uncovered with Kate Garraway
summary: See your body like never before - from the inside out. Kate Garraway and Dr Guddi Singh use the latest technology to help patients understand their everyday medical conditions.

title: Viral
summary: The media reports on the rapid spread of a virus that transforms humans into wild beasts. Given this, Anna seeks to escape and get away from her family, but on the way, chaos takes over the situation and Anna will try to survive the infected who are dangerous in order to reunite with her family, however, on this journey she will be put in I play the line between life and death.

title: Pillow Talk
summary: The series revolves around four couples, and one set of roommates, of varying ages and backgrounds. With a realistic tone, the dramatic comedy explores in a raw and unexpected way the drama and hilarity experienced by couples in the intimacy of the bedroom.

lead_actors: Andy Day, Marcus Ramtouhi, Holly Mallett, Stewart McCheyne, Marcello Cervone
title: Andy and the Band
summary: Andy and the Band risk missing their next gig by taking on super-weird odd jobs for their fans.  A madcap mix of songs, slapstick and silliness.

title: Million Dollar Wheels
summary: What do Jeff Bezos, Jamie Foxx and the most baller orthodontist in Beverly Hills have in common? They're all DM'ing celebrity car dealer RD Whittington. This is a behind-the-scenes look at how he connects the ultra-rich with their million-dollar toys.

title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
summary: Marcus Wareing steps back from his hectic schedule to spend more time expanding his smallholding in East Sussex with the help from the country's very best British producers.

lead_actors: Jessica Brown Findlay, Anthony Welsh, Jonah Hauer-King, Shaniqua Okwok, Bart Edwards
title: The Flatshare
summary: The Flatshare follows Tiffany and Leon, two cash-strapped London twentysomethings who share a bed. The catch is – Tiffany and Leon have never met and, if their plan works out, they never will.

lead_actors: Jacob Fortune-Lloyd, Amaka Okafor, Kyle Soller, Shira Haas, Greta Scacchi
title: Bodies
summary: Four detectives. Four timelines. One body. To save Britain's future, they'll need to solve the murder that altered the course of history first. Stephen Graham stars in this time-hopping crime drama inspired by Si Spencer's graphic novel.

lead_actors: Rémy Girard, Rachel Graton, Sophie Lorain, Adrien Belugou, Kathleen Fortin
title: Portrait Robot
summary: Eve Garance is a remarkable sketch artist capable of "reading" people. In the Investigation Unit of the Police Department, she uses her talents to create composite sketches to catch criminals. Her colleagues include Maryse Ferron, the methodical director whose disability has never stopped her; Bernard Dupin, the seasoned investigator who keeps the dark regions of his life under wraps, and Anthony Kamal, the new technician who doesn't know what he is getting into. This is the team assigned to solve a laundry list of sordid crimes. They will tackle also cold cases - even if old wounds are opened in the process. The return of Eve's ex will force her to reopen a very personal cold case: that of the disappearance of their son William, then six months old. For five years, Eve has been secretly imagining and sketching the faces that her son could have today in the hope of finding him one day.

lead_actors: Axel Bøyum, Ingrid Giæver, Mikkel Bratt Silset, Martin Wallström, Mads Ousdal
title: Hodejegerne – Den første løgnen
summary: The place is Oslo, the year is 2002, and Roger Brown is a newly employed headhunter in an exclusive recruitment agency. He is given the prestigious task of finding a new top manager for the oil company Njord Oil. Roger is willing to do whatever it takes to quickly climb the career ladder.

title: Survivre à ses enfants
summary: Becoming parents has not broken the ties that unite Nadine, Kamyar, Annie, Philippe and Josée. On the contrary, it is the humor and the frankness that allows this long-standing friendship that allows them to - survive their children.

lead_actors: Will Arnett, Joe Seanoa, Anthony Mackie, Stephanie Beatriz, Anthony Carrigan
creators: Michael Jonathan Smith, Paul Wernick, Rhett Reese
title: Twisted Metal
summary: Twisted Metal is about a motor-mouthed outsider offered a chance at a better life, but only if he can successfully deliver a mysterious package across a post-apocalyptic wasteland. With the help of a trigger-happy car thief, he faces savage marauders driving vehicles of destruction and other dangers of the open road, including a deranged clown who drives an all too familiar ice cream truck.

lead_actors: Khaled Anwar, Khalid Kamal, Amr Abdul Gelil, Bayoumi Fouad, Ahmed Saeed Abdul Ghani
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: El Meshwar
summary: Two restless labourers find themselves facing larger-than-life challenges amid falling in love and rising from lower rungs.

title: Love, Life & Everything in Between
summary: This pan-Arab anthology series tinged with dark humor explores love at large — and relationships up close.

title: Érase una vez… pero ya no
summary: A couple forced to separate must find each other in another life to break a spell on their town, where no one can fall in love.

lead_actors: Vihaan Samat, Rahul Bose, Suchitra Pillai, Dalai, Jim Sarbh
title: Eternally Confused and Eager for Love
summary: Often (mis)guided by a cheeky imaginary wizard, an awkward and lonely 20-something struggles to get out of his own way in his quest for a girlfriend.

title: Krakowskie potwory
summary: A young woman haunted by her past joins a mysterious professor and his group of gifted students who investigate paranormal activity — and fight demons.

title: Watashi no Tadashii Onii-chan
summary: Riyo is a university student who works part-time at a retail outlet. One day, while at work, she meets a young man named Kairi who bears an uncanny resemblance to her older brother – who she has not seen for many years. Kairi is an insomniac who has tried unsuccessfully to overcome his ailment. When they meet, sparks fly – she is attracted to him, and he discovers that when he is with her, his insomnia eases and he is finally able to get a good night's sleep. But while she is staying at his apartment, Riyo finds Kairi's diary and decides to look inside. She gets a terrible fright when she reads an entry that appears to involve her new boyfriend confessing to a murder. She knows that she must get to the bottom of the matter and find out whether this secret confession was really sincere. Has there been a mixup...or has she just fallen in love with a murderer?

lead_actors: Lee Joon Ki, Lee Kyung Young, Kim Ji Eun, Jung Sang Hoon
title: Again My Life
summary: When Kim Hee Woo was a high school student, his academic grades ranked at the bottom of his school. Through hard work, Kim Hee Woo entered a university and eventually passed the bar exam. He now works as an enthusiastic prosecutor. While he investigates possible corruption related to a politician named Jo Tae Sub, he gets killed by an unidentified man. However, Kim Hee Woo wakes up and finds himself alive again.

lead_actors: Olivia Wang, Edward Zhang, Calvin Yu, Yu Ming Jia
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Second Time Is a Charm
summary: A cute and bubbly divorced mom faces life's challenges head on and works hard to turn her dreams into reality. She meets a single dad, thus beginning a story about two families coming together. An An is a young mom in her twenties. She got married right after graduating from college and had a kid right after marriage. When her son turned 5, her picture perfect life as a housewife was shattered when her marriage fell apart. Xu Lang is a man in his thirties and a prodigy in the legal world. Having never been married before, he ends up becoming a single dad due to a car accident. He had planned to take the truth of the car accident to his grave as he single-handedly raises his 5-year-old daughter. However, an unexpected meeting with An An and her son breaks the tranquility in his once peaceful life. Two completely different families start to nurture and heal each other by learning from their misunderstandings and finding love.

lead_actors: Mori Nana, Tomoya Nakamura, Nakano Taiga, Ishibashi Shizuka
title: Kono Koi Atatamemasu Ka
summary: Kiki Inoue works part-time at a convenience store, spending the better part of her day lazing about or reviewing sweets on her social media account. One day at work, she is introduced to the chain's CEO, Takumi Asaba, who, as it turns out, is familiar with Inoue's online reviews. Asaba asks Inoue to develop new desserts to sell chain-wide. As CEO, Asaba is tasked with turning around the chain's fortunes, as it is now ranked the lowest among its competitors. Close collaboration leads Inoue and Asaba to become sweet on each other.

lead_actors: Lies Visschedijk, Romana Vrede, Peter Blok, Jade Olieberg, Bram Suijker
title: Nemesis
summary: Nemesis is a conspiracy thriller about financial crimes and tax evasion among the highest levels of the Dutch business community: a shadow world of shell companies and dead-end paper trails. Sylvia van Maele, public prosecutor in The Hague, and Lars van Deurnen, detective at the Dutch Revenue Service FIOD, follow money trails and investigate hit jobs in search of criminals. At every turn, they are confronted with a merciless elite that wants to maintain its wealth and power at all costs. When the lines between Sylvia's work and her private life start to blur, it won't take long before she realizes that the rules and practices that make her work impossible are put in place for a reason. She will need to learn to trust her intuition in order to survive, even if that means standing up against those she trusts the most.

title: Kare, Otto, Otoko Tomodachi
summary: Haruko, an events producer, is the second of the Inuyama family's three daughters. She turns down a proposal from the man she has been cohabiting with, causing their relationship to turn awkward. Her older sister, Asako, is hides her husband's domestic violence while her younger sister, Ikuko, cannot instinctively understand love. Haruko is at a critical point in her career and love life, but she scrambles about for the sake of her sisters. The three of them are helped by the family ties and eventually break out of their shell.

lead_actors: Khaled El Nabawy, Hana Shiha, Nour, Wafaa Amer, Tarek Abdelaziz
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Raj'een Ya Hawa
summary: After going bankrupt in Europe, Baleegh returns to his homeland to reclaim his inheritance, but his mission soon turns into an attempt to fix his broken family.

lead_actors: Riham Haggag, Tawfik Abdel Hamid, Abeer Sabry, Mohamed Kelany, Karim Kassem
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: U-Turn
summary: Yara sacrifices her career as a navigation officer for her possessive husband, but an encounter with an old friend sends her on a perilous journey.

title: Knuckles
summary: Follow Knuckles on a hilarious journey of self-discovery when he agrees to teach Wade the ways of the Echidna warrior.

lead_actors: Hamada Helal, Heba Magdi, Nesreen Tafesh, Kamal Abu Rayyah, Walaa Elshrif
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Al Maddah
summary: An unsettling dream alters the course of Saber's life, and as he tries to look for an explanation, he finds himself on the cusp of war with the supernatural.

title: Making Fun
summary: Grumpy expert maker Jimmy DiResta fields kids' ideas for delightfully pointless inventions.

title: Immortality
summary: Fang Han, a humble family slave, always held the belief that "I would rather be a beggar than a slave", traversing the world only by himself. With an unyielding stubbornness, he cracked the mystery of supernatural powers and forged his body into an immortal body. He worked hard to step into the fairyland, and eventually became the peak king.

title: Don't Hurt Me, My Healer!
summary: Fantasy adventuring comedy with a dark elf cleric who invested too much in her insulting skills and her companion, the swordsman who has to put up with her antics.

lead_actors: Takeo Ōtsuka, Kana Ichinose, Ai Fairouz, Akira Ishida, Ayane Sakura
title: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs.
summary: Office worker Leon is reincarnated into a particularly punishing dating sim video game, where women reign supreme and only beautiful men have a seat at the table. But Leon has a secret weapon: he remembers everything from his past life, which includes a complete playthrough of the very game in which he is now trapped. Watch Leon spark a revolution to change this new world in order to fulfill his ultimate desire...of living a quiet, easy life in the countryside!

title: Sweat and Soap
summary: Natori Kotaro works in the planning department of a cosmetics company and has a fetish for smells. Aesima Asako works in accounting and is very complex about her own smell.

lead_actors: Lu Yang Yang, Sun Ze Yuan
title: Assistant of Superstar
summary: A popular superstar with a bad character and a lack of education, Wang Yuxi is forced to hire an assistant for training, otherwise he will not get the desired role. The place of his assistant is given to a student Wei Chiao - an intelligent, educated girl who treats Wang Yuxi with discontent (which is mutual), is afraid of the crowd and dreams of becoming a teacher since childhood, but receives a bad review about her tutoring platform.

title: Chijou no Seppun
summary: Kamijo Shinobu, unrequited in love with his former classmate Kashiwagi Kazuka, returns to Japan for the first time in 10 years after moving with his parents to Germany. Kazuko works as a librarian. She has loved books since childhood, and, based on certain experiences in the past, is fond of reading, believing that books are more important than romance. Shinobu, who once kissed Kazuka in high school, suddenly appears in front of her and offers to live with him... a sweet and slightly mischievous love story that begins with a kiss. Based on the manga of the same name by Kisaragi Hirotaka.

lead_actors: Joe Jonas, Becky G, Sean Bankhead
title: Becoming a Popstar
summary: Becoming a Popstar features eight up-and-coming artists originally discovered on TikTok who will showcase their talents to the judges, who are TikTok creators themselves. One winner will walk away as a popstar with their very own Pepsi commercial set to premiere on television during the upcoming MTV VMAs.

lead_actors: Milo Ventimiglia, Catherine Haena Kim, William Fichtner, Sarah Wayne Callies, Felisha Terrell
title: The Company You Keep
summary: The Company You Keep follows con man Charlie and undercover CIA officer Emma. A night of passion leads to love between the pair, who are unknowingly on a collision course professionally. While Charlie ramps up the "family business" so he can get out for good, Emma's closing in on the vengeful criminal who holds Charlie's family debts in-hand — forcing them to reckon with the lies they've told so they can save themselves and their families from disastrous consequences.

title: Hoffman Family Gold
summary: A mining partner in Alaska has invested in nearly 2,500 acres of rugged land, and they're about to go belly up. Todd will try to turn around the operation. Will he be able to do it in just six weeks before the winter season sets in?

title: Blippi
summary: FUN EDUCATIONAL videos for children! Kids will learn colors, learn shapes, learn numbers, learn letters, the alphabet, abc's and so much more with Blippi's nursery rhymes, educational songs, and educational videos! Blippi ties in things children love like Backhoes, Tractors, Planes, Trains, Animals, Boats, Unicorns, Construction Equipment, Firetrucks, Horses, and the list goes on! Incorporating cartoons and animation with real life footage!

title: Blippi's Treehouse
summary: Join Blippi in his Treehouse and meet his best friend Meekah and critter-friends Scratch and Patch. Curiosity abounds as they ask questions of the world around them, are visited by neighborhood experts (meteorologists, paleontologists, athletes and more!) and go on exciting field trips. We will sing, dance, and even see animated Blippi exploring places he has never been before!

title: Mithya
summary: A dangerous relationship between a university professor and her student after a plagiarism incident that eventually leads to murder.

title: Kaun Banegi Shikharwati
summary: A former king schemes to get his estranged daughters back together even as tax authorities threaten seizure of his properties.

title: Sutliyan
summary: Estranged siblings come together on the occasion of Diwali. Will their conflicts be resolved?

lead_actors: Vanessa Hudgens, Jenna Warren, James Marsden, JJ Gerber, Ana Sani
title: My Little Pony: Make Your Mark
summary: Created with a dazzling 3D CG animation style evocative of the recent film, the series will follow the Mane 5 on a journey of self-discovery told through action-packed, hilarious, and heartfelt stories.

title: Love All Play
summary: The story follows a group of high-schoolers in a badminton club, as they navigate school and teen life. Mizushima joined his middle school's badminton team full of motivation — but without a proper coach, ended up in obscurity. Nevertheless, he did eventually reach the prefectural tournament on his physical strength. Now, Ryo Mizushima joins Yokohama-Minato High School's prestigious badminton club under the legendary coach, Ebihara, and has to learn how to deal with clubmates who have very unique personalities, all while getting to work with the upperclassman he looks up to, as he strives to become a top athlete and take his high school team to the inter-high tournament.

title: Birdie Wing: Golf Girls' Story
summary: Birdie Wing: Golf Girls' Story is a youth story centering on two female golfers. Two girls, Eve and Aoi, who grew up in completely different circumstances and have different play styles, are caught up in the world of women in golf.

title: Breakers
summary: Jack is reliving the same day over and over again so he seeks help from a therapist, but when Jack discovers a murder and finds himself pursued by gangsters and a psychopath he must find a way to stop the murder or wind up stuck forever.

title: The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On
summary: Get hitched or call it quits? Couples put their love to the test — while shacking up with other potential matches — in a provocative reality series.

lead_actors: Iori Saeki, Moe Kahara, Hisako Kanemoto, Tamie Kubota, Yuko Kaida
title: The Executioner and Her Way of Life
summary: The Lost Ones are wanderers who come here from a distant world known as "Japan." No one knows how or why they leave their homes. The only thing that is certain is that they bring disaster and calamity. The duty of exterminating them without remorse falls to Menou, a young Executioner. When she meets Akari, it seems like just another job...until she discovers it's impossible to kill this girl! And when Menou begins to search for a way to defeat this immortality, Akari is more than happy to tag along! So begins a journey that will change Menou forever...

title: Make It With You
summary: Two different individuals who, despite having different priorities in life, found love in each other. But after series of encounter, they will have to decide whether it's a love worth choosing.

lead_actors: Haluk Bilginer, Öner Erkan, Uğur Yücel
title: Uysallar
summary: In the haze of a midlife crisis, an architect begins living a double life as a punk while members of his family lead their own crisis-ridden lives.

lead_actors: Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Lauren Cohan, Logan Kim, Gaius Charles, Željko Ivanek
title: The Walking Dead: Dead City
summary: The Walking Dead: Dead City envisions the popular Maggie and Negan characters travelling into a post-apocalyptic Manhattan long ago cut off from the mainland. The crumbling city is filled with the dead and denizens who have made New York City their own world full of anarchy, danger, beauty, and terror.

lead_actors: Abigail Lawrie, Rhianne Barreto, Jay Ryan, Sean Keenan, Colette Dalal Tchantcho
title: No Escape
summary: No Escape centers on best friends Lana and Kitty, who are on the run from their lives in the UK. Together they find refuge on a romantic yacht, The Blue, crewed by a group of enigmatic people sailing through South-East Asia. But The Blue harbours dark secrets and the paradise the girls thought they had found turns into a nightmare.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Trivia Quest
summary: Trivia Quest is Netflix's first daily, interactive trivia series. It takes players on a mission to help our hero, Willy, rescue the animated citizens of Trivia Land from the Evil Rocky, who's bent on hoarding all the knowledge in the world. One new episode will be available every day in April (30 total), with each episode featuring 24 questions (12 standard and 12 hard) across categories including science, history, entertainment, sports, art and geography. Each question is a multiple-choice play, with four potential answers to choose from. It's all based on etermax's hit Trivia Crack, the #1 multi-platform trivia franchise in the world. And it's up to you to select the right answers and save the day!

title: Titipo Titipo
summary: Train Production Plant's new born little train TITIPO has just passed the driving examination and is prepared to work at Choo Choo Town. Although TITIPO dreams of becoming the best train in the world, his curious yet random personality catches him in unforeseen events and troubles everyday. TITIPO expands his experience in the greater world and befriends GENIE, DIESEL, and other little trains. Will TITIPO achieve his dream of becoming the best train? Come join the railroad journey and meet TITIPO and the little train friends.

lead_actors: Giancarlo Esposito, Zackary Momoh, Ivan Mbakop, Dax Rey, Skeet Ulrich
title: Parish
summary: The drama series is about a taxi driver whose life is turned upside down when he agrees to chauffer a New Orleans-based Zimbabwean gangster notorious for exploiting undocumented immigrants at the U.S. southern ports.

title: Mud, Sweat and Beards
summary: In the all-new, four-part adventure series Mud, Sweat and Beards, Donny Dust and Ray Livingston tackle some of earth's most remote locations, where they'll build a new primitive paradise using their unrivaled wit and wilderness ingenuity. While exploring the Alaskan wilderness, Louisiana swampland, New Mexico desert and Icelandic shores, these best friends and world-class wilderness experts will work hand-in-hand as they do everything from building elaborate shelters to tracking down natural food sources, all while combating extreme weather, hunger, predators and wicked BO.

title: Zi Chuan
summary: Two hundred years ago, on the Battlefield of the Blue River, the last remaining army of the Empire of Light collapsed in the midst of demonic outcries. In the south-eastern part of the land, a powerful faction with over two hundred years of history – House ZiChuan – fought off the Demons to the east, defended against the House Liu Feng to the west, and contained the House Lin to the south. In order to accomplish their great ambitions and extend the bloodline of their family, countless heroes of ZiChuan gave their lives in order to make this magnificent hymn come to life. This is a story about this legendary family and a hundred years of their blood and tears.

title: Contre Offre
summary: The series follows the adventures of the members of a family-owned real estate agency on the South Shore of Montreal. The patriarch of the Lévesque family, exhausted, wants his three daughters to take over the business.

lead_actors: Colin Farrell, Cristin Milioti, Rhenzy Feliz, Deirdre O'Connell, Carmen Ejogo
title: The Penguin
summary: Starring Colin Farrell as Oz Cobb (aka The Penguin), the DC Studios series continues filmmaker Matt Reeves' The Batman epic crime saga that began with Warner Bros. Pictures' global blockbuster The Batman. Developed by showrunner Lauren LeFranc, the series centers on the character played by Farrell in the film.

title: Meningen med livet
summary: Alva, who wants nothing more than to become a parent together with boyfriend Nico but it's just not happening. Meanwhile, her sister Ellen has three children with husband Alex - and dearly wishes she hadn't.

title: Etterglød
summary: When Ester finds out that she is seriously ill, she and her friends decide to make the most of life - because it can end at any moment.

title: Forræder
summary: This is a driving, intense psychological game that is unlike anything you have seen on Norwegian television before. 20 players move into a villa and have to complete a series of missions to win a big prize, but three of the players are chosen to be traitors.

lead_actors: Takahata Mitsuki, Jun Shison, Shota Matsuda
title: Muchaburi!: Watashi ga Shachou ni Naru nante
summary: Takanashi Hinako is a 30-year-old office lady who has been working as a secretary at Relation Gate for the past 8 years. Everyday, the company's charismatic president would give her various "impossible tasks", making her single for the past 6 years and have no time to think about her future. One day, the president gives Hinako an extremely huge "impossible task" - Be the president of the company's subsidiary.

lead_actors: Zhu Ya Wen, Yang Zi Shan, Li Yuan, Mike He
title: The Lion's Secret
summary: The story of the lion and the lazy cat follows two people who get married first before falling in love. Mu WanQing is a successful lady CEO and Liu Qing is an unemployed former soldier. Mu WanQing and Liu Qing's first encounter was on their wedding day. With no feelings for each other, their relationship started out hostile until it turns into one of mutual love and support. Liu Qing helps Mu WanQing resolve the crises in her company while at the same time averting the provocations from her ex-boyfriend. As their love is severely tested, a bigger challenge rises to the surface. In order to fulfill the wishes of their elders, they start on a journey to Thailand.

lead_actors: Lamman Rucker, Elise Neal, Karon Joseph Riley, Mike Merrill, Brian White
title: Carl Weber's The Black Hamptons
summary: Family drama set in the quaint town of Sag Harbor, known as "The Black Hamptons," in Long Island, NY. From luxury communities to historic beachfront enclaves, this epic story will follow the brewing feud between the ‘Brittons' and the ‘Johnsons,' where the difference between old and new money is very apparent. Carl Weber's The Black Hamptons not only features the glitz and gloss of the Black elite but also exposes the underbelly of wealth and prestige. With a mix of legacy families thriving for generations, friends, wannabes, and thirsty developers, drama can never be too far behind.

title: Здравствуйте, вам пора!
summary: The messenger of death appears on Earth under the name of Pavel, he's come to people with a warning. Death makes no exception for anyone, and thanks to Pasha, they can correct the mistakes of life before their last breath. Of course, if they believe that death is near. With each new mission, the herald grows more sympathetic to these strange people, and appreciates his work less and less. He doesn't know what love is, but he falls in love. He does not know what humor is, but he laughs more and more often. He does not know what life is, but every time he delays the moment of departure of his wards.

title: Munya and Filly Get Chilly
summary: Munya and Filly Get Chilly is the spin-off show to Freeze the Fear with Wim Hof. In each episode, presenters and viral comedy stars, Munya and Filly will immerse themselves in the sub-zero temperatures and take on Wim's challenges, from breathing exercises to ice baths and beyond. They'll have the chance to collaborate musically with Wim (who loves a singsong) and they have lots of pranks for each other and the celebs in store.

title: Bridge of Lies
summary: Ross Kemp has turned his hand to quiz show hosting for the very first time, and will preside over teams of contestants as they compete for cash by crossing the Bridge – a collection of stepping stones featuring various truths and lies based on general knowledge categories.Each player must try to safely step on the truths and avoid the lies, or risk falling off and out of the game. Once they've conquered the Bridge on their own, successful contestants will join forces to face the dramatic final crossing for a chance to take home some cash.

title: Taskmaster
summary: Five public figures are challenged by "Taskmaster" Vasco Palmeirim and his assistant Nuno Markl to overcome a series of fun tests with a small dose of madness. Over the course of 8 programs, guests put personal assets at stake and face challenges that put their physical dexterity, creativity and especially their dignity in check. In each program, there is only one objective: to achieve the best performance in the tasks to accumulate the maximum points, which will allow each guest to recover their precious asset, in case they are considered the winner, after the scrutiny of Taskmaster Vasco Palmeirim and the precious help from his assistant, Nuno Markl.

title: Tabu
summary: For a week, Bruno Nogueira will live with each group, listen to their stories, understand how they integrate, how they are looked at and what obstacles they live with. After that, he will make them and their stories, protagonists of a stand up show without limits.

lead_actors: Gergely Váradi, Márton Patkós, Szabolcs Thuróczy, Benjámin Lengyel, Júlia Szász
title: A Besúgó
summary: A Besúgó is set in 1985, behind the Iron Curtain, as Geri leaves for college. He is looking forward to meeting girls and partying and joins a group of radicals, led by the charismatic Száva. But Geri has a secret. He's an informant of the totalitarian state and to save his brother, he's been forced to spy on his new friends for State Security. While Geri's life changes forever – juggling parties and political debates – he wrestles with a daily challenge; whose side should he be on? Especially when the group's increasingly radical leader, Száva realizes that there is an informant among them.

title: Gordon Ramsay's Future Food Stars
summary: Gordon's always been at the cutting edge of his industry and has hand-picked 12 of the UK's best up-and-coming food and drink entrepreneurs to compete to earn his investment - a whopping £150,000 of his own cash. But to win Gordon's support will take more than just a great idea - the contenders will need to prove they possess the raw ingredients required to succeed: determination, dedication, passion and talent.Gordon will drive the contenders through a series of relentless challenges designed to test their character and showcase their business skills because, according to Gordon, an idea is only as good as the person who's had it.

title: Loaded in Paradise
summary: Loaded in Paradise is an action packed, adrenalised reality game show where party-loving pairs island hop Greece's Aegean Islands in a race to take control of - and spend - 50,000 euros.

lead_actors: Suranne Jones, Eve Best, George Costigan, Stockard Channing, Hugh Quarshie
title: Maryland
summary: In Maryland, Becca and her sister, Rosaline, have forged ahead with family lives and careers, growing distant through time and circumstance. But when the body of an older woman is discovered at sunrise on Laxey Beach in the Isle of Man, it brings devastating news for the sisters.Each sister flies out to the Isle of Man to discover and repatriate the body of their mother, Mary, who they learn has been living a double life, leaving their father Richard at home in Manchester, whilst creating another world for herself….. Maryland. Confined on the island with each other, the sisters can't escape the ripple effect of their mother's secrets and lies.

lead_actors: Mone Kamishiraishi, Takeru Sato, Mario Kuroba
title: Mada Mada Koi wa Tsuzuku yo Dokomademo
summary: A spin-off special drama series from "Koi wa Tsuzuku yo Doko Made mo", this show is set in the bar where nurse Nanase and her workmates often go for drinks after work. The bar is known for a good-looking waiter who has fortune-telling skills, they say that those who have worries or troubles with their love life ought to ask him.

lead_actors: Leah Brotherhead, Taj Atwal, Sinéad Matthews, Perry Fitzpatrick, Natalie Davies
title: Hullraisers
summary: Hullraisers centres on three women; Toni, Rana, Paula and looks at their disheveled, messy and joyful lives. The series explores the hilarious and agonising reality of what it is to be a working-class woman juggling work, kids, demanding friends, family and frustrating parents from the school playground - all whilst trying to have some fun too.

lead_actors: Kim Woo Bin, Esom, Song Seung Hun, Kang You Suk
title: Black Knight
summary: In a dystopian 2071 devastated by air pollution, a refugee fights to join the ranks of the powerful delivery men for access to food and survival.

title: The Ghost Town Terror
summary: This one may frighten even the Duttons. On the outskirts of Anaconda, Montana, sits Gunslinger Gulch – a sprawling ghost town and guest ranch made up of various historic abandoned buildings salvaged from across the state. When the Broussard family answered the beckoning call of a new life in Big Sky Country and opportunity to own this unique 52-acre property, they got more than they bargained for. They soon discovered the ranch offered anything but the serene Montana lifestyle they were seeking. Relentless, menacing supernatural activity has plagued the family since day one, leaving them terrified and desperate for answers.

title: Build It Forward
summary: Sometimes people who put others first could use a little help themselves. HGTV's Matt Blashaw and Taniya Nayak join forces with Lowe's to surprise five amazing individuals who give their all to their community with life-changing home makeovers!

title: L'oeuf ou la poule?
summary: 8 spring-loaded celebrities, ready to do anything to win the coveted golden egg. Who will know how to get out of the game? Which competitor will become the big winner? Questions as improbable as offbeat, wacky happenings and guaranteed twists. Get ready for one of the craziest bounties in the PAF!

lead_actors: Huang Zi Tao, Zhao Yi, Yin Zheng, Liu Tian Zuo, Swan Wen
title: A Chinese Odyssey: Love You a Million Years
summary: Five hundred years ago, Zi Xia descends to the human realm to find Zhi Zun Bao. He is the man that she loves and the person who pulled out the Zi Qing Sword. However, the sword gets damaged along the way and she uses the time-travelling ability of the pandora's box in hopes of repairing it. She ends up five hundred years later and meets Zhi Zun Bao with no recollection of his past life. He is the leader of a gang of outlaws called the Ax Gang and has been spending time with Bai Jing Jing. The plot then takes on a whole new level of craziness that involves more time travelling and outrageous happenings.

lead_actors: Amanda Abbington, Warren Brown, Sunetra Sarker, Francis Magee
title: Desperate Measures
summary: Rowan's life spirals when Finn is coerced into a botched drug deal by a local gang. With Finn's life on the line and a violent gang leader encroaching on her life, Rowan is faced with recuperating the money that Finn lost. Desperate to save her son and having exhausted all options, Rowan commits to a dangerous heist at the bank she works in

lead_actors: Shirley Henderson, Craig Parkinson, Ian Lloyd Anderson, Lisa Hogg
title: The House Across the Street
summary: Claudia, a lonely single mother and school nurse, is longing for connection. Her opportunity to be a hero comes when a young child in her community – Emily Winter – goes missing. Claudia becomes embroiled in the case and fixated on uncovering the truth. However, her fascination quickly begins to turn to obsession, not only with what happened to Emily, but also with the Winter family at the heart of the case - Emily's grief-stricken father, Owen; her cold mother, Sabine, and her twelve-year-old brother.

title: The Change
summary: Linda, a 50-year-old working class married mother of two, is having an existential crisis. Who is she? What is she? Is this it? Convinced she's got early onset dementia after forgetting what a shoe is called, Linda's GP informs her it is, in fact, the menopause. Feeling invigorated and empowered by this information, Linda decides to claw back some of the time she's spent doing ‘invisible work' over the years (not all 3.5 million minutes, just 131,500 of them) to do something for herself… for a change.

title: Flipping Down South
summary: Flipping Down South follows three young entrepreneurs who are heading up Birmingham, Alabama's fastest growing flipping business. They see dollar signs where others see dumps, focusing on houses most people wouldn't touch. Buying many of their flips for under $10,000, they turn eyesores into dream homes. But their mission is about more than making money—all three investors come from working class roots, and they aim to keep their flips affordable, while still building a booming business.

lead_actors: Jo Hyuk Joon, Kang Eun Bin
title: Blueming
summary: Siwon Cha is popular among people where ever he goes. In his childhood, Siwon was teased by his younger sister that he's ugly. Since then, Siwon put a great deal of effort to become handsome, and he has succeeded. Being in college now, Siwon did not doubt that he will be the most beloved person on the campus. However, there is a guy called Daun Hyeong, who has a perfect look, gets straight A's, comes from a rich family, and even has a great personality.

title: As Seguidoras
summary: When Liv, a vegan social media influencer, goes live in celebration of her 100k followers, she is ambushed by a past enemy who threatens her with something worse than death: cancellation. Afraid of losing all of her followers, she ends up impulsively taking the man's life, becoming entangled in a series of murders that consolidate her modus operandi as a serial killer. However, she doesn't know she's being followed by a podcaster who might ruin everything.

lead_actors: Jaden Michael, Constance Zimmer, Adrian Greensmith, Abby Corrigan, Sage Linder
title: Harlan Coben's Shelter
summary: Harlan Coben's Shelter follows the story of Mickey Bolitar after the sudden death of his father leads him to start a new life in Kasselton, New Jersey. Mickey quickly finds himself tangled in the mysterious disappearance of a new student at his school, Ashley Kent, which leads to uncovering unimaginable secrets within their quiet suburban community. With the help of his friends - the inventive Spoon and the secretive Ema - Mickey pulls back the sleepy façade of Kasselton to reveal a dark underground that may hold the answers to decades of disappearances, deaths, and legends... and perhaps even his own complex family history.

lead_actors: Lilly Singh, Bill Barretta, Dave Goelz, Eric Jacobson, Peter Linz
creators: Adam F. Goldberg, Bill Barretta, Jeff Yorkes
title: The Muppets Mayhem
summary: The Muppets Mayhem follows Dr. Teeth and the band as they attempt to record their first proper album under the guidance of Norah, a young A&R executive.

creators: Dean Lorey, Patrick Schumacker, Justin Halpern
title: Kite Man: Hell Yeah!
summary: This Harley Quinn spinoff follows Kite Man and Golden Glider, who level up their relationship by purchasing Noonan's -- Gotham's seediest dive bar.

lead_actors: Yunus Emre Yıldırımer, Gizem Güneş, Fatih Al, Nihan Büyükağaç, Mehtap Bayri
title: Adı Sevgi
summary: The arrival of young high school teacher Elif Türkkan, who is passionate about her profession, to Sarpça becomes a turning point in the lives of everyone living in this small town. When Elif meets Zeynep's desperation, in the prime of her life, she takes her in her wing. Thus, he enters into a war on his own with this family, which has fallen like a nightmare on Volkan and Sarpça, the heirs of the powerful Baykara family that Zeynep is forced to marry. In time, Elif will realize that someone other than herself is trying to change the unfortunate fortune of the district. It is confusing for Elif when she encounters the mysterious Emir Baykara, who has turned her back on her own family.However, there is something that comes first for Elif. Thanks to her unremitting struggle for her students, she will start with Zeynep and make Esma, Doğukan, Arda, Cem, Gülendam, Fidan and many others look to the future with hope. Her name is Sevgi, about the change that a young woman, who would risk everything for her students, created with determination, love and self-sacrifice in students, families and the whole district.

lead_actors: Eddie Marsan, Monica Dolan, Mark Stanley, Dominic Applewhite, David Fynn
title: The Thief, His Wife and the Canoe
summary: The extraordinary and compelling story of how John Darwin faked his own death to claim life insurance and avoid bankruptcy will be told in The Thief, His Wife and the Canoe. The drama relates how Anne Darwin's husband, a prison officer, came up with the hare-brained scheme to defraud insurance companies, unbeknownst to their two sons.

lead_actors: Claudia Martín, Sebastian Rulli, Fabiola Guajardo, Azela Robinson, Alejandra Barros
title: Los ricos también lloran
summary: It tells the story of Mariana, a humble and brave young woman who, after being left alone and helpless, comes by fate into the life of Don Alberto Salvatierra, played by Guillermo García Cantú, a business magnate and one of the wealthiest and most powerful men in the world. country. There, Mariana will meet Luis Alberto Salvatierra, one of the most sought-after bachelors, who experiences his own pain and who, seduced by Mariana's charisma, beauty and authenticity, will find true and most honest love. A romance alien to socioeconomic levels, social prejudice and cataloged as one of the most iconic of all time, but marked by tragedy, intrigue, jealousy, lies and even death.

title: Tartan Around with Lawrence Chaney
summary: Join Drag Race UK Season 2 winner Lawrence Chaney on their adventure to California, where they travel all around Tinseltown. Lawrence and their crew of celebrity friends, drag queens, and other Angelinos take a deep dive, asking the question, "What makes Los Angeles so special?' and "Where can I find a taco?"

title: Doppelhaushälfte
summary: A semi-detached house in the countryside - that's where a Berlin family ends up in this comedy series. The residents of the other half are skeptical as to whether the newcomers will be able to integrate properly.

title: Ce que Pauline ne vous dit pas
summary: Her ex-husband has just died, having fallen in his garden from the top of a makeshift scaffolding. Pauline was there. She was the one who called the emergency services, but just a little too late and so clumsily... Everything accuses her. And each time she tries to justify herself, she sinks a little deeper.

lead_actors: Maria Nash, Thom Allison, Chase W. Dillon, Alicia Richardson, Andy Hull
title: Pinecone & Pony
summary: As a warrior in training, Pinecone fears no challenge. Thankfully, Pony always makes sure Pinecone never gets in over her head. Together they learn life can be a fun-filled adventure.

lead_actors: Jack Black, Rita Ora, Rahnuma Panthaky, James Hong, Della Saba
title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
summary: In this animated kids series, playful Po pairs with a no-nonsense English knight on an epic quest to find four powerful weapons and save the world.

lead_actors: Richard Armitage, Charlie Murphy, Indira Varma, Rish Shah
title: Obsession
summary: Obsession — a contemporary four-part adaptation of the 1991 novella from late author Josephine Hart — is described as a "thrilling and seductive limited series about erotic obsession and forbidden desire". The story centers around a dangerous love triangle that emerges when the enigmatic Anna Barton embarks on a passionate affair with her fiancé's father, William. While Anna fights to sustain both relationships, William is drawn into an obsessive spiral. But, how long can they keep their secret hidden before someone gets hurt?

lead_actors: Wunmi Mosaku, David Threlfall, Daniel Ryan, Rowan Robinson, Barry Sloane
title: Passenger
summary: In the small Northern village of Chadder Vale, a close-knit community is sent spinning on its axis following a series of strange and unnatural crimes. After arriving there five years ago, Former Met Police Detective Riya Ajunwa has been searching for that ‘one big crime', that one challenge that will make her feel alive again.Then one night local girl, Katie Wells is mysteriously abducted. Her car is found abandoned and there are traces of blood on the seats. But the village barely has time to register Katie's disappearance before she reappears the next day, safe and sound.

title: The Misinvestigations of Romesh Ranganathan
summary: Romesh tries get to the bottom of some of the most mysterious celebrity deaths that shocked a generation. Will his curiosity and sub-optimal investigation skills find the truth?

lead_actors: Katarzyna Wajda, Bartłomiej Kotschedoff, Juliusz Chrząstowski, Bogusław Linda, Andrzej Grabowski
title: Odwilż
summary: Set in Szczecin, Poland, the series begins after the body of a young woman is discovered under the melting ice. It asks ‘Who was she? Why did she die? Who did she leave behind? Did people who are now mourning know who she really was? These questions and the search for answers will provide the main female character with a powerful, although initially unconscious incentive to confront her own circumstances: of a single mother playing the role of a perfect police officer, and above all, a woman in crisis.

title: Wrong – Unzensiert
summary: Wrong is about a group of people in their late twenties who are all struggling to grow up. The fact that, when in doubt, the roommates primarily have their own advantage in mind does not make it any easier. And what is the least you need? A penetrating camera team that also – or especially then – sticks to it when it gets really "wrong"! The team was actually only supposed to accompany the blogger Melisa and shoot a short portrait of her life. But after an extravagant party night with a "wrong" ending, the other residents have no choice but to sign the editor's gag contract. From now on, the WG will be accompanied at every turn. With all their problems, embarrassments and outrages. The quota-fixed camera team sticks to it, no matter what happens. Tears, casualties, illegal activities - the camera's pause button is not an option, even if it could harm someone.

title: Himitsu no Ai-chan
summary: Kasumi "Ai" Aiko is an athletic, tomboyish member of her school's basketball club. She is very popular among the girls and can even outplay the boys' team, with the exception of one person—Amano Reo. His skills on the court are only matched by one thing: his popularity. Envious, Ai proclaims him as her rival, and every day after practice, they compare the number of love letters they each received, which always results in her loss. In need of workers, Ai's brother employs her at his maid café called "Spica." Since she does not appear girlish enough, her appearance is changed with a wig and some makeup. One day, Reo visits the café with other members of the boys' team. Worried that they will see through her disguise, she tries to hide, inadvertently spilling drinks on Reo. As she is cleaning up after her mistake, suddenly, Reo asks to go on a date with her. After thinking about it, she eagerly comes up with a plan for revenge—she will make him fall in love with her and then dump him.

title: Sous le soleil de Saint-Tropez
summary: In Saint-Tropez, the years have passed and our heroes have grown up... The children are old enough to love and even to marry, some have made a fortune, others have lost everything, couples have broken up, Others were built... Supposed dead, Caroline Drancourt returns to Saint-Tropez to prevent her son from avenging her on his alleged assassin... Four years earlier, she had had to flee before the threat of a mafia group which threatened his children and his own existence. Then exfiltrated by the police, she was then betrayed by a crooked cop and languished in a prison in South America, far from her family and her village. Today, Caroline finds her son Tom and her sister Emilie, who runs a cabaret... With everything to rebuild. And a revenge to accomplish?

title: Fix My Flip
summary: Real estate broker Page Turner helps flippers who are stuck, losing money and in over their heads. In exchange for a partnership and profit-share, she'll bring her own team, money and tough love to get their wayward flip back on track to make top dollar.

lead_actors: Светлана Иванова, Алла Михеева, Анна Снаткина, Анастасия Стоцкая, Андрей Козлов
title: Обоюдное согласие
summary: A young teacher of Russian language and literature, Anna Fedorova, comes to a party with old friends on a yacht. In the morning, Anna jumps into the sea, while the others are still sleeping. In a wet dress, barefoot, with bruises and abrasions on her body, the girl gets to the police station and writes a statement about rape. She accuses her friends, influential people of the city, of the crime. The case causes a huge resonance, and the investigation sheds light on the events from the past of all the defendants in the case. Under the fire of public condemnation are not so much the alleged rapists as Anna herself.

title: Shining Na Ra
summary: A sixth grader named Nara no longer wants to be a child. One day, she found a makeup kit that disguised and turned her older (under the name Bitna) to approach her crush.

title: Ngao Asoke
summary: This is a story about Bpeeyachat a young orphan that meets Monthai, the son from a rich family, during her childhood and befriends him. A car accident takes her grandmother, her last living family member, away from her and she starts living with Viyada and her family. Monthai, who is engaged to Viyada, goes abroad for studies because he can´t stand living at home anymore because of his mother´s insane jealousy and the terrible things that happened because of it. During his time abroad, he sends many letters to his fiancee, which are not answered by her, but instead by Bpeeyachat. Viyada is more interested in getting to know other men than corresponding with or waiting for him. Monthai´s mother gets really sick and asks for Viyada to take care of her. This is the last thing she wants to do and so Bpeeyachat goes in her place. Monthai comes back from abroad and thinks that Bpeeyachat is pretending to be Viyada, because of the money. He starts to treat her badly, but slowly starts to care for her. Shortly after, Viyada comes to his home and trouble ensures...

title: Oh Hell
summary: The German dramedy series Oh Hell focuses on Helene (Mala Emde), who is in her mid-twenties and who is not nicknamed "Hell" for nothing. Her life is anything but relaxed, Helen jumps from one job to the next and privately she keeps stumbling into big and small blunders. For example, she helped her parents get divorced. Sometimes she wishes she were like her best friend Maike (Salka Weber), who travels the world and has already had some successes professionally. When she meets the cello teacher Oskar (Edin Hasanović), something like consistency seems to develop for the first time. But can "Hell" lead a quiet and happy life - and does she even want it?

title: The Craftsman
summary: Master craftsman and woodworker Eric Hollenbeck is in the restoration business, taking historic homes and forgotten treasures around his hometown of Eureka, California, and giving them new life.

lead_actors: Mai Ezz Eldin, Kinda Alloush, Reem Elbaroudy, Mohamed Emam, Nedal El shafey
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Girls' Indulgence
summary: About class differences in society through the story of two friends, one of whom belongs to the popular class, while the other belongs to the bourgeois class, and this difference between them generates many paradoxes and comic situations.

lead_actors: Shea Brady, Julia Dillon, Elijah Idemudia
creators: Colin Williams, Stephen Coulter, Katie Lyons
title: Odo
summary: Although he is one of the littlest campers at the Forest Camp for Young Birds, Odo knows he can do anything he sets his mind to. Forest Camp is a wonderful leafy playground where birds of all shapes and sizes can play games, learn skills, and have fun side-by-side with the most amazingly diverse group of feathered creatures – silly chickens, cheeky toucans, harmonious canaries, a vain peacock, and many others. And all the fun takes place under the loving watchful eye of Camp Leader, a supremely capable and good-natured Eagle.With the help of his best friend Doodle (a thoughtful little bird of unknown species) Odo positively tackles every challenge no matter how big. When asked if he thinks he can do something, Odo will always confidently reply, 'I know I can!'Because in the forest, as in life, the most important thing you can do is to believe in yourself.The series teaches young children self-efficacy and to believe in themselves to help combat the troubling rise in anxiety and depression levels in today's children. Comedic and warm, with a genuine gender-neutral hero, the stories also deal with important themes such as immigration, racism and respect for others.

title: Michael Fassbender: Road to Le Mans
summary: Michael Fassbender's journey from novice racer to Le Mans competitor.

lead_actors: Sun Yi, Qin Jun Jie, Tu Song Yan, Xi Mei Juan
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Hengshan Hospital
summary: The drama takes place in republican era China in Hengshan Hospital, centered primarily on the conflict between the Communist Party and the KMT in 1930s Shanghai. Ma Tian Ming is a faithless, greedy, and selfish man who makes his living by cheating and lying. A coincidental accident drags Ma Tian Ming into a case in which he becomes the suspect. Trying to escape, he impersonated the chief doctor of Hengshan Hospital, Cai Li Kun. However, Ma Tian Ming soon found out that Cai Li Kun is a member of the underground Communist Party.

title: Turbia
summary: Located in the Cauca Valley, near the Pacific coast, Cali receives almost twice as much rain a year as Paris. But what would happen if the dry season dragged on agonizingly, and when it rained, the consequences were an ecological and humanitarian catastrophe?

lead_actors: Rochelle Neil, Yazmin Belo, Saffron Coomber, Javone Prince, Bobby Gordon
title: Three Little Birds
summary: Spirited, moving, funny and utterly heartfelt Three Little Birds is a triumphant celebration of immigration, community and the strength of Black womanhood inspired by the life-affirming stories of Sir Lenny Henry's mother and all those who have travelled to make Britain their home.Set in 1957, post-Windrush, and amidst the booming decade set alight by promise, the rhythm of rock and roll, swing, Hollywood starlets and fabulous fashion Three Little Birds will introduce Dudley and the rest of the world to gregarious sisters Leah and Chantrelle and their virtuous, bible-loving acquaintance, Hosanna, as they board a cruise ship from Jamaica bound for a new life in Blighty.

creators: William M. Finkelstein, Walter F. Parkes
title: Justice: Qalb Al Adala
summary: Defying pressure to join her father's firm, a determined young lawyer strikes out on her own and fights to maintain faith in Abu Dhabi's justice system.

lead_actors: Richard Hammond, Zach Umperovitch, Dr. Shini Somara
title: Richard Hammond's Crazy Contraptions
summary: Engineering enthusiasts from around the UK must battle to create the most ingenious contraptions using everyday objects in Richard Hammond's Crazy Contraptions. Teams of contestants will go head-to-head to build their own Chain Reaction Machines. With contestants having access to a workshop and purpose-built home environment to test their invention, they will be given the challenge each week of designing, creating and showcasing a new construction, before being judged based on their ingenuity, design and build-quality.

title: Skruk
summary: When Nana, in a drunken state, inseminates herself with a really special portion of sperm – namely her ex-boyfriend's – she starts a chain reaction of catastrophes, both big and small. This rash move leads to a pregnancy and Nana now has to figure out how to explain her condition – which one can't hide forever – and win back her ex-boyfriend and long-lost love. The problem is just that he doesn't seem particularly interested in getting back with Nana.The secret pregnancy allows Nana to see her clients in a different light, but as her lies grow bigger, it gets harder and harder for her to navigate in them and for the first time in her life, Nana has to tell the truth – and maybe reveal a secret that could ultimately cost her everything.

lead_actors: Rodrigo Sant'Anna, Rafael Zulu, Lidi Lisboa
title: A Sogra Que Te Pariu
summary: Living with her family since the pandemic struck, the meddling Isadir does her best to disrupt the lives of her bumbling son and rival daughter-in-law.

title: Marry Me Now
summary: Marry Me Now gives women the chance to take charge of their own fate. Each week we follow one determined woman, who has had enough of waiting for a ring. She will take the lead in her life and relationship, and prepare her own wedding in just a few days and all without the groom-to-be's knowledge. On the 3rd day she will surprise her partner in her wedding dress with an ambush proposal! If he says no, it's all over, but if he says yes, they will tie the knot on the spot.

title: The Real Love Boat
summary: The Real Love Boat brings singles together to cruise the Mediterranean on a luxury cruise ship while looking for love. Destination dates, challenges and surprise singles will test the couples' compatibility and chemistry. Like the beloved original scripted series, the indispensable crew members including "captain" and "cruise director" will play pivotal roles in the matchmaking and navigation of the romantic (and sometimes turbulent) waters ahead.After almost a month at sea, only one winning couple will make it to the final port and take home a cash prize plus a once-in-a-lifetime trip courtesy of Princess Cruises, the series' exclusive cruise line partner.

title: Inside Eats with Rhett & Link
summary: Rhett & Link are meeting the people who create everything we love to eat, tasting their way to the truth while infusing their unique and delicious investigations over four, 30-minute episodes. As founders of Mythical, an internet-first entertainment and digital comedy studio whose content across channels has drawn over 75 million subscribers, Rhett & Link use their trademark humor, unending inquisitiveness, and contagious energy and enthusiasm to feed viewers' hungry minds.

lead_actors: Darren McMullen, Hannah Ferrier, Daniel Doody, Paolo Arrigo
title: The Real Love Boat
summary: Set sail through the Mediterranean alongside a group of Australia's most eligible singles on The Real Love Boat, as their love stories begin.Host Darren McMullen, Cruise Director Hannah Ferrier, Head of Entertainment Daniel Doody, and Princess Cruises' Captain Paolo Arrigo, will be onboard to guide the way.Only one couple can make it to the final port. Who will drop anchor and who will abandon ship?

lead_actors: Goo Gyo Hwan, Shin Hyun Bin
title: Monstrous
summary: Jung Gi Hoon is an archaeologist who has always been interested in all sorts of mystical phenomena. But one day a strange incident completely changed his life. Now he publishes the occult magazine "Monthly Strange Stories" and runs a Youtube channel. Because of his ex-wife Lee Soo Jin, he goes to Jinyang County to investigate a Buddhist statue that is said to be possessed by an evil spirit. Lee Soo Jin is an archaeologist specializing in deciphering symbols. She does her job well, but after the death of her only child, she moved to Jinyang County, where she met with mystical and mysterious events.

lead_actors: Никита Ефремов, Денис Шведов, Полина Максимова, Риналь Мухаметов
title: Оффлайн
summary: "Offline" is a psychological drama about people living a double life. In their first public life, they are beautiful, bright and successful. They have families, loved ones, prestigious jobs and an impeccable reputation. But all these are just masks of those who have earned millions from drug trafficking on the web. They know that if the truth becomes known to the world, they will lose everything. And they are ready for anything so that no one will ever see their real face. But there is a man who knows their secret and who intends to make their life hell.

title: Claim to Fame
summary: Claim to Fame will challenge 12 celebrity relatives to step outside their famous family member's shadow and live together under one roof, concealing their identity and lineage in the quest for their own fame and fortune. They will compete in challenges, form alliances and play DNA detective in hopes of avoiding elimination and winning the coveted $100,000 prize, and staking their own Claim to Fame.

lead_actors: Zoe Lister-Jones, Tymika Tafari, Amar Chadha-Patel, Whitmer Thomas, Emily Hampshire
title: Slip
summary: Slip tells the story of Mae Cannon, a 30-something that finds herself restless inside a marriage that totally works. The series will follow Mae through a fantastical journey of parallel universes, as she enters new relationships, trying to find her way back to her partner, and ultimately, herself.

title: Die Pflegionärin
summary: Caro's tasks as a mobile nurse go beyond wound care and intimate washing. With time pressure and a lack of material on her back, the "nurse" rushes to bizarre, funny, tragic and exciting assignments.

title: Les moments parfaits
summary: The Thomas family: three generations facing the price to pay to achieve their dreams. A chain of events makes everyone in the family wonder if they're on their X, if their life is still what they want.

lead_actors: Zoltán Schneider, Zsombor Jéger, Ádám Farkas, Anna Laura Kiss, Titanilla Bogdányi
title: A Séf meg a többiek
summary: The restaurant called Monet is one of the best fine dining places in Budapest, but according to Győző, the alcoholic and sports addict Chef, it is definitely the best restaurant on earth. The kitchen is full of special monks: a fish cook with an underworld history, a knife virtuoso stealing from the kitchen, a stuttering chef, a French-born, warm confectioner and a Russian omnipotent. Milan drops into this eccentric team as a green-eared chef, and although the Chef is not happy about him at first, he takes it under his wings and tries to carve a chef and man out of his cheeky and immature Milan in his own raw and rhapsodic way.

title: Love After World Domination
summary: In the eyes of the public, Fudou Aikawa and Desumi Magahara are sworn enemies who have nothing in common. Fudou, also known as "Red Gelato," is the leader of the hero squadron "Gelato 5," whose mission is to bring about world peace. On the other hand, Desumi is the minion leader of "Gecko," a villainous organization seeking world domination. However, despite these differences, their relationship is not quite what it seems. When they are not making a show of being at each other's throats, Desumi and Fudou continue to pursue a forbidden love.Going on dates, baking sweets for one another, and meeting up as often as they can despite their hectic schedules, the two inexperienced lovebirds pave the way for their own unique relationship.
