summary: Summertime is the best time of year – the sun, the fun and especially the food! From fish tacos to lobster rolls and funnel cakes to elote, Beachside Brawl aims to find out which coast does summer food the best! Representing the west, acclaimed chef Brooke Williamson handpicks four premier beach chefs to put their skills to the test, while elite chef Tiffani Faison lines up her top picks to join the brawl and represent the eastern coast.  In this highly anticipated return to battle for these two TOC champs, both captains will cook alongside their teams and mentor them throughout the competition with one goal – prove that their coast does it best! Overseeing this beachside showdown, Antonia Lofaso, who was born in Long Island, NY and now lives in Venice, California, is the perfect host to preside over this battle for the best beach eats. Get ready for this delicious new competition just in time for summer!

title: Cam Boy
summary: An out of work Broadway chorus boy considers trying online sex work as a cam model during the global pandemic.

title: Bachelorette Sverige
summary: A woman gets to know a group of single men to find her great love.

title: Challenge Anneka
summary: Challenge Anneka will shine the light on everyday heroes and deserving communities at a time when they've never needed help more. Across the series the team will meet a wide range of inspirational people who will help Anneka move heaven and earth to achieve these challenges.  True to form we'll see Anneka pulling up at secret locations to meet the individuals at the heart of the challenge and be briefed on the task at hand.  With a mountain to climb, her trusty mobile, buggy, lorry and Dave the Soundman in tow - Anneka will be calling in big favours from big brands, big names and big groups of volunteers all keen to lend a hand. 30 years on from the original series the challenges of course will be new and reflect Britain in 2022, but at its heart the series will still be about incredible people who really want to make a difference to the world they live in.

lead_actors: Youhei Tadano, Keisuke Chiba, Akiha Matsui, Manabu Muraji, Takako Fuji
title: Rick and Morty: The Anime
summary: The series revolves around the adventures of members of the Smith Family, particularly mad scientist and samurai Rick Sanchez and his grandchildren, Morty Smith, 14 and Summer Smith, 17, whose parents, Jerry Smith and Beth Smith, disapprove of his adventures. Different versions of the characters inhabit other dimensions throughout the series' multiverse, with their personal characteristics varying from one reality to another.

lead_actors: Lee Jong Suk, YoonA, Kim Joo Hun
title: Big Mouth
summary: Big Mouth tells the story of an underperforming lawyer who gets caught up in a murder case. In order to survive and protect his family, he digs into a huge conspiracy among the privileged upper classes.

title: Sea of Love
summary: Sea animal friends Bruda, Bobbi, Wayu and Puri go on mini adventures in the ocean, where relatable, everyday moments come with a splash of magic!

title: Surviving Summer
summary: Expelled from school and exiled to Australia, a rebel New York teen makes waves among a young surfer's inner circle — and leaves a mess in her wake.

title: LEGO Masters
summary: Teams of Kiwi master brick builders are put through their paces in the local version of the hugely popular reality challenge. Who will dream, create it, and win it?!

title: Five Dates a Week
summary: Dating show in which one person shares a house with five potential partners for a week, with one being eliminated from the contest at the end of each day.

lead_actors: Bárbara Mori, Ximena Sariñana, Natalia Téllez, Amorita Rasgado
title: Las Azules
summary: Set in 1970 and inspired by true events, Las Azules tells the story of four women who defy the ultra-conservative norms of the time and join Mexico's first female police force, only to discover that their squad is a publicity stunt to distract the media from a brutal serial killer. As the body count grows, María, whose determination to catch the killer becomes an obsession, Gabina, an aspiring officer, Ángeles, a brilliant fingerprint analyst, and Valentina, a young rebel, set up a secret investigation to achieve what no other male officer has been able to do and bring the serial killer to justice.

title: Sarah Beeny's Little House, Big Plans
summary: The property expert and co-presenter, architect Damion Burrows, visit small homes across the Uniked Kingdom whose owners have elaborate plans for expansion. The duo follow some incredible renovations, showing how, even on a tight budget, it is possible to utilise a small space to the absolute max.

lead_actors: Susan Calman, Natasha Raskin Sharp, Danny Sebastian, Paul Martin
title: Big Antique Adventure with Susan Calman
summary: The comedian immerses herself in the world of antiques, with experts Natasha Raskin Sharp, Danny Sebastian and Paul Martin advising and guiding her along the way.

lead_actors: Lee Jae-wook, Hwang Min Hyun, Yoo Joon Sang, Oh Na Ra, Jo Jae Yoon
title: Alchemy of Souls
summary: Set in a fictional country called Daeho that does not exist in history or on maps, it is about the love and growth of young mages as they overcome their twisted fates due to a magic spell known as the "alchemy of souls", which allows souls to switch bodies. It follows the story of an elite assassin named Naksu, whose soul is accidentally trapped inside the weak body of Moo Duk—Jang Wook's servant from a powerful and noble family in the country. The young master of the Jang Family, Jang Wook, holds a dark secret about his scandalous birth. He wants the formidable assassin to help change his destiny.

lead_actors: Cemre Baysel, Burak Çelik, Ebru Cündübeyoğlu, Sevinç Erbulak, Berat Yenilmez
title: Senden Daha Güzel
summary: Efsun and Emir become partners in a plastic surgery clinic in Istanbul. Together they are tested both in professional and personal life.

title: Cafe Minamdang
summary: A mystery drama that follows a former profiler who became a shaman, his collogues, and the interesting stories of the clients that visit the mysterious "Minamdang" café.

title: Onipan!
summary: Over the centuries, oni (AKA demons of Japanese folklore) got a pretty bad reputation. Now it's up to three plucky oni kids — sunny Tsutsuji, cool Tsuyukusa and boisterous Himawari — to improve human-oni relations through love, friendship and superpowered underpants!

title: Canım Annem
summary: Zeynep is a beautiful little girl with a dangerous heart defect, so when her mother Cemre dies in a car crash, no one tells her. Instead, her father Murat hires a lookalike to pretend to be Cemre until Zeynep is old enough for heart surgery. But who is this lookalike, and how does she come to resemble Cemre so closely? And why does Murat hate his dead wife so much? Who is pulling the strings from behind the scenes?

lead_actors: Uliks Fehmiu, Jelena Djokic, Nikola Kojo, Anastasija Djurovic, Jelena Stupljanin
title: црна свадба
summary: Investigating the bloody massacre in the far away village, inspector Petar finds himself at the centre of a conflict with the forces of darkness.

lead_actors: Itziar Ituño, Patricia López, Verónica Echegui
title: Intimidad
summary: A rising politician's career is threatened when a surreptitiously recorded video of her sex life is leaked to the public.

lead_actors: Jude Law, Ravi Cabot-Conyers, Kyriana Kratter, Robert Timothy Smith, Ryan Kiera Armstrong
title: Star Wars: Skeleton Crew
summary: Star Wars: Skeleton Crew is about the journey of four kids who make a mysterious discovery on their seemingly safe home planet, then get lost in a strange and dangerous galaxy. Finding their way home — and meeting unlikely allies and enemies — will be a greater adventure than they ever imagined.

title: Baby Drivers
summary: In the cutthroat world of motorsports, nothing is more intense than competitive go-karting. The parents of young racers know that if anyone can get their kid to the top, it's Troy Adams, but they must give it their all both on and off the track.

title: Królowa
summary: After a decades-long absence, a renowned Parisian tailor and drag queen returns to his hometown in Poland to make amends with his daughter.

lead_actors: Karim Mahmoud Abdelaziz, Mostafa Khater, Mirna Gamil
title: El Beit Beity
summary: After accepting an invitation to a hotel, Bino and Karakiri embark on another terrifying journey, filled with supernatural encounters unlike anything they have ever witnessed.

title: Kiyma
summary: After spending 3 years in prison, Ömer, Poyraz and Tufan come to Istanbul from Adana and open a kebab shop. Now they are done with the illegal world. However, reality does not go as they planned. When they are defrauded while renting a shop in Istanbul, they encounter a new world on their way to get their money back. They gain the trust of Uncle, a big and respected mafia boss. Uncle's son, Yiğit, has been hostile to Ömer, Poyraz and Tufan since the first day, and he will confront them.

lead_actors: Gabriella Saraivah, Miá Mello, Kiko Pissolato, Einat Falbel, Ana Jeckel
title: Tudo Igual... SQN
summary: A 16 year old Carol is going through a period of major changes in her life. On the one hand, Carol has to deal with her mother's marriage to her new boyfriend and the impending relationship with her future stepbrother. On the other hand, a new school year begins in high school, in which Carol starts her first real relationship and experiences various situations with her long-time friends that also put their friendship to the test. Carol faces the typical challenges of being a teenager and experiences feelings that she has never felt in this form before and learns that the first step to happiness is to know yourself and also to respect your own feelings, even if you are makes one or two mistakes on the way there.

title: The Real Housewives of Lagos
summary: The show focuses on the luxurious lives in the Lagos socialites, from shopping sprees, parties, traveling, and competition within their social circles. The Real Housewives of Lagos is a spin-off from The Real Housewives series franchise and produced by Livespot 360.

lead_actors: Kaya Coleman, Sagine Sémajuste, Lisa Berry, Gina O. James, Mark Taylor
title: Beyond Black Beauty
summary: Inspired by the beloved novel, Beyond Black Beauty is a coming-of-age dramedy that follows Jolie Dumont, an equestrian with Olympic aspirations whose journey is suddenly halted when her mother, Janelle, moves them from their posh Belgium life to Janelle's childhood home in Baltimore. Jolie struggles to find roots, but as she bonds with an equally spirited horse named Black Beauty, she learns to embrace the family's ranch, where Black cowboys have been entrenched in their DNA for more than a century. In this multigenerational tale of adversity, humility, and love, Jolie finally discovers the value of family and home.

lead_actors: Ben J. Pierce, Kim Cattrall, Zane Phillips, Jade Payton, Graham Parkhurst
title: Glamorous
summary: From selling makeup at the mall to working at a luxury cosmetics brand for a high-powered model-turned-mogul: Marco Mejia's glow-up is just beginning.

lead_actors: Radha Mitchell, Jesse Spencer, Linh-Dan Pham, Vico Thai, George Mason
title: Last Days of the Space Age
summary: Last Days of the Space Age is an eight-part dramedy series set in 1979 Western Australia, when Perth was at the centre of the world's headlines. A power strike threatens to plunge the region into darkness, while the city hosts the iconic Miss Universe pageant and the US space station, Skylab, crashes just beyond the city's suburbs. Against this backdrop of international cultural and political shifts, three families in a tight-knit coastal community find their marriages, friendships, and futures put to the test.

lead_actors: Ray Romano, Lisa Kudrow, Denis Leary, O.T. Fagbenle, Linda Cardellini
title: No Good Deed
summary: When Lydia and Paul decide to move on from their empty nest to forge a new life, they list their gorgeous 1920s Spanish-style villa located in one the most desirable neighborhoods in Los Angeles - and the real estate frenzy begins. Multiple families all race to buy what they believe to be their dream house, convinced it will fix all of their very different problems. But as Lydia and Paul know all too well, sometimes the home of your dreams can be a true nightmare. As they struggle to hide the dark and dangerous secrets that linger inside their longtime home, Paul and Lydia begin to realize that the only way they'll escape the past is to finally face it.

lead_actors: JeCobi Swain, Jamaal Avery Jr., Dee Bradley Baker, Juliet Donenfeld, Emma Berman
creators: Shellie Kvilvang, Lamont Magee, Michael Olson, James Waugh, Josh Rimes
title: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures
summary: Set 200 years before The Phantom Menace, during the High Republic era, Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures follows Jedi younglings as they study the ways of the Force, explore the galaxy, help citizens and creatures in need and learn valuable skills needed to become Jedi along the way.

title: Rainbow High
summary: Legend says at the end of the rainbow, there's a pot of gold. But the truth is, it's something even more amazing. Only a chosen few with an eye for bold fashions can follow the rainbow to Rainbow High, the colorful fashion school where everyone learns to flaunt their true color.

title: Marion
summary: Freshly arrived from Lyon with her adopted daughter, Edwige Marion joined the Gare du Nord team as divisional commissioner of the railway brigade. In this dark and violent universe, she investigates the darkest criminal cases with her own style, while trying to reconcile her responsibilities as a mother and her role as a cop.

title: Word of Honor
summary: Four teenagers, studying at a martial arts school. Soon they will have to enter the arena to show their skills in real combat. And then leave the walls of the school and go on a dangerous journey around the world. Friends have made an oath to each other and, even separated, continue to follow it.

lead_actors: Paula Hartmann, Simon Fabian, Andrew Porfitz, Samuel Benito
title: Almost Fly
summary: 1990 - Walter, nicknamed "W", Ben and Nik, three 17-year-old nerds from provincial West Germany, are certain: "Nothing works for us." Until a Chevy carrying black GIs from the nearby U.S. base turns the corner and a hip-hop beat booming from the speakers changes their lives forever. The three of them only want one thing: to rap. Because their school English is not good enough for brilliant rhymes, they end up in German rap in a roundabout way and thus find their own language. While they confront outdated traditions and long-kept family secrets, they come closer not only to themselves, but also to the big stage piece by piece.

lead_actors: Alberto Ammann, Luis Callejo, Bárbara Goenaga, José Luis García-Pérez, Roberto Álamo
title: La noche más larga
summary: Armed men surround a psychiatric prison and cut off all communications. Their purpose: to capture serial killer Simón Lago. Six episodes. One night.

title: I3P
summary: In Paris, if you have amnesia, if you have visions or if you show signs of delirium in the street, you are taken to the Paris Police Psychiatric Unit. A discreet address, the 3PU is headed by Professor Mathias Bernardt, a psychiatrist who has the power to let his patients return to their normal life, to hospitalize them but also to hand them over to the police.

lead_actors: Deniz Işın, İlhan Şen, Serenay Aktaş, Nimet İyigün Nalbant, Çağdaş Onur Öztürk
title: Sevmek Zamanı

lead_actors: Clive Owen, Cara Bossom, Denis Ménochet, Louise Bourgoin, Chiara Mastroianni
title: Monsieur Spade
summary: Monsieur Spade centers around the infamous protagonist of American writer Dashiell Hammett's 1930 classic novel The Maltese Falcon. The year is 1963, and the legendary Detective Sam Spade is enjoying his retirement in the South of France. By contrast to his days as a private eye in San Francisco, Spade's life in Bozouls is peaceful and quiet. But the rumored return of his old adversary will change everything. Six beloved nuns have been brutally murdered at the local convent. As the town grieves, secrets emerge, and new leads are established. Spade learns that the murders are somehow connected to a mysterious child who is believed to possess great powers.

lead_actors: Kevin McKidd, Vinette Robinson, James Cosmo, Andrew Whipp, Brian McCardie
title: Six Four
summary: Six Four is a dark and compelling story of kidnap, corruption, betrayal and an uncompromising search for the truth, when Chris and Michelle O'Neill's teenage daughter goes missing.Serving police detective, Chris is provided with a startling revelation about an infamous, unsolved case that once divided the police when a local girl called Julie Mackie disappeared. Now, reeling from the news that his own daughter has gone missing, Chris is approached by a journalist who tells him that fatal mistakes were covered-up in Julie's disappearance. Revisiting the case, Chris uncovers a series of undeniable errors, corruption and unbridled ambition.

title: Женщина в состоянии развода
summary: Vera is in her early thirties. She is beautiful, smart and no longer married. It would seem that it's time to enjoy this moment, look around and not rush anywhere. But, here's the problem. The verdict from medicine sounds: "If you want to give birth to a child, you need to hurry up. Nature has given you very little time for this." Why with her? Should it be like this?

title: Handcrafted Hotels
summary: Hoteliers across America uniquely capture the character, history, nostalgia and charm of their hometowns. Tour these custom stays and meet the artists, craftspeople and designers that provide guests with a one-of-a-kind experience.

title: Nouvelle École
summary: French rappers freestyle, battle and write their way to a game-changing 100,000 euro prize in a music competition series judged by Niska, Shay and SCH.

title: Snowflake Mountain
summary: Hopelessly entitled or simply in need of tough love? Ten spoiled young adults experience nature without a parental safety net in this reality series.

lead_actors: Sinem Ünsal, Halit Özgür Sarı, Tardu Flordun, Bülent Emrah Parlak, Ece Dizdar
title: Gizli Saklı
summary: Naz lives with her mother and uncle, she is newly graduated from the police academy and is a protective character. The police force, after a mafia boss named Tarık Koşuoğlu, decides to use Naz and the crazy police officer Pamir together for a secret mission. Like a newly married couple, Pamir and Naz will move across the mafia family's house and gain Tarık Kosuoglu's trust and bring him to justice...

lead_actors: Dominique Moore, Nick Kellington, Joel Fry, Jeremiah Krage, Levi Howden
creators: Maddy Darrall, Catherine Williams, Billy Macqueen
title: Lovely Little Farm
summary: Nestled in lavender fields is a lovely little farm where sisters Jill and Jacky nurture and love all their animals—including the talking ones. Being a young farmer isn't easy, but every day brings adventure and a chance to grow.

lead_actors: Karine Vanasse, Patrick J. Adams, François Arnaud, Joshua Close, Vinessa Antoine
title: Plan B
summary: The day when Philip discovers the possibility of going back in time, he does not hesitate. Since Evelyn, the love of his life and companion for the past six years, has left him, his life has lost its meaning. With the tremendous power he wields thanks to Plan B, he attempts to save his relationship, his law firm and his dysfunctional family. But Philip soon realizes that even the smallest choice has repercussions - as uncontrollable as they are unexpected - on his life and the lives of others. And even though he can stop tragic events before they happen, Philip cannot erase the memories and the emotions associated with them. Nothing will ever be without consequence again.

lead_actors: Park Eun Bin, Kang Tae Oh, Kang Ki Young
title: Extraordinary Attorney Woo
summary: The story of 27-year-old lawyer Woo Young Woo, who has Asperger's syndrome and graduated at the top of her class at Seoul National University for both college and law school.However, she still finds herself struggling when it comes to social interactions.

title: Generation Drag
summary: Teen drag performers from across the USA prepare for Dragutante, a first-of-its-kind drag ball event for teens and tweens. Amidst the glitz, glam and nerve-rattling stakes, their parents and "drag moms" guide them on the journey to the ultimate stage.

lead_actors: Елизавета Боярская, Гоша Куценко, Александр Робак
title: Без правил
summary: Olga Lebedeva's company buys vehicles and gets an old pioneer camp. The discovery of mineral waters on the land leads to a price surge, pulling her into criminal conflicts.

title: More Power
summary: Tim Allen and Richard Karn are back in the shop to continue their quest for More Power. With the help of DIY Expert April Wilkerson, they're putting all kinds of tools to the test. The trio will tackle one tool-centric theme per episode and celebrate the coolest, most powerful and iconic examples of each tool—testing their limits in a way that only Tim can. Along the way, they'll open the doors to Tim's workshop and invite some of the most skilled makers from around the country to show off their creations before then heading out on field trips to play with the biggest machines that keep our world working.

title: The Transporter
summary: A woman, chosen to be the driver for one of the biggest drug operations in the world, must outdrive and outshoot enemies, in fabulous, exotic locales.

lead_actors: Suzy, Park Ye Young, Kim Joon Han, Jeong Eun Chae
title: Anna
summary: It all started with a little lie. Yu Mi is living a different life now. At some point, she began to believe in her lies and lost a part of herself. As a result, only Ji Hong's ambitious husband and Ji Won are left with her, the only friend Yoo Mi can trust. Hyun Joo is a woman who lives her life putting herself above everyone, not treating them with kindness or malice. She has a slightly strained relationship with Yu Mi.

lead_actors: Joyful Drake, Caryn Ward, Erica Mena, Candiace Dillard, Ts Madison
title: Hush
summary: Dr. Logan has built a successful practice discreetly catering to the between-the-sheets lives of her rich and famous clientele and publishing the definitive works on modern relationships and sexuality. With an A-list rolodex, this "relationship fixer" juggles midnight house calls for trysts gone wrong, destroys salacious content before it hits the gossip columns and hosts therapeutic couples' retreats for those in dire straits. Dr. Logan is the gatekeeper of everyone's secrets, but after she launches her "Penthouse Project", the deadly secrets of three women threaten her career and her life when a dead body is found, and the police identify her as the primary suspect.

title: La Entrega
summary: Raquel is a fugitive single mother whose teen daughter disappears. Pato is a TV reporter obsessed with sex trafficking cases. Jorge is an alcoholic ex soccer star whose son is ill. Desperate for money for the cure, Jorge kidnaps and sells Raquel's daughter to a human trafficking network. After his son dies, Jorge will do anything to get the girl back.

lead_actors: Isabel Castro, Chase de Moor, Fabio De Pasqual, Guilherme Evaristo, Marnie Simpson
title: All Star Shore
summary: From MTV Entertainment Studios, the original series features 14 of the world's biggest reality superstars from some of television's most iconic series - "Jersey Shore," "Love Is Blind," "RuPaul's Drag Race," "Geordie Shore," "Acapulco Shore," "Rio Shore," and "Bachelor in Paradise" - as they come together for an epic vacation at the ultimate shore house in the Canary Islands, to battle it out for a cash prize and global bragging rights.

lead_actors: Izabella Scorupco, Alva Bratt, Tea Stjärne, Sarah Gustafsson, Sandra Strandberg Zubovic
title: Barracuda Queens
summary: When a group of young women discovers how easy it is to steal from their rich neighbors, all morals fall to the wayside in favor of champagne-fueled fun.

title: The Magic Chef of Ice and Fire
summary: Nian Bing is the son of a fire mage and an ice mage. After both of his parents were killed by the Ice Lord, Nian Bing received both of his parents' magic gems. When Nian Bing was trying to escape from the Ice Lord's followers, he managed to cast both fire and ice magic at the same time. An impossible feat for a mage. He fell from the cliff, unconscious, and was saved by an oldman. After he woke up, the oldman gave him a food so delicious he never tasted before. It turned out that the oldman was a genius chef, once called a spirit chef. And he wants Nian Bing to be his disciple no matter what! Is Nian Bing able to seek vengeance while aiming to become the greatest chef?

title: Home Shanti
summary: The Joshi family slowly find out that there's nothing shanti (peaceful) about building your dream home.

lead_actors: Liu Yi Fei, Chen Xiao, Lin Yun, Liu Yan
title: A Dream of Splendor
summary: The story set in Song Dynasty focuses on a woman called Zhao Pan'er who struggles making a living in the world of men.

title: Salon Zahra
summary: Zahra's beauty parlor is a haven for women wanting to pamper themselves or seek refuge. A clumsy act will connect Zahra and a young man's paths and hearts.

lead_actors: Neil Sandilands, Kai Luke Brummer, Christia Visser, Ben Voss, Brendon Daniels
title: Desert Rose
summary: The Greyling siblings reunite at their family home in the Namaqualand desert in the Northern Cape after one of them reneges on a decade-long deal to settle the debts they took on when their father abandoned them and disappeared.

title: Great Doctor Miss Nine
summary: The animation tells the story of the modern, glamorous, genius doctor Jun Jiu who accidentally fell to her death in an elixir auction and ends up in the body of Miss Jiu from the past. Miss Jiu was originally the direct daughter of the Jun family, one of the two great families in the imperial city. Because of the death of both parents, the family sent her to the Jun family in Fengluo City. Jun Jiu inherited all the memories of Miss Jiu and vowed revenge. In this world of immortal cultivation, she first cleansed her muscles and marrow through her amazing medical skills to improve her cultivation talent, and then made good friends and paved the way carefully. Watch how Jun Jiu kills her enemies, cleanses the Feng Luo family, and begins her legendary story of a generation of heavenly daughters.

lead_actors: Birce Akalay, Olgun Toker, Şehsuvar Aktaş, Hakan Meriçliler, Sezgin Uzunbekiroglu
title: Mezarlık
summary: Mezarlık is a dark basement, where a special unit works to solve unsolved murders of women. Commissioner Önem, will have to fight masculine prejudices that support male violence.

title: Da Mood
summary: A series that takes us to the world of music, more specifically to the dream of a boy band and all that this represents in the musical world Rui is a music teacher who is dissatisfied with his life. One day, when he sees a t-shirt with a picture of the Backstreet Boys, he has the idea of creating a Boy Band as a solution to his financial problems. For that, he asks Mario, artistic agent and longtime friend, to help him find four more elements to join him to form a Boy Band. They carry out a casting and choose Cláudio, a dance teacher, who is in love with Rui's aunt and dreams of writing song lyrics; Ruben, a womanizer, partner in a car transformation company, who sees in the Boy Band a chance to win more women; Gonçalo, a trainee lawyer, unhappy with his life and with a passion for music production; And Tiago, an employee of a fast food company, with an angelic voice, but a look not in keeping with a Boy Band.

title: Yameru Toki mo, Sukoyaka Naru Toki mo
summary: Sudo Issei is a furniture maker. Although he works earnestly, he has not been able to produce a new piece that surpasses his teacher and has made little progress as a craftsman. One day, Sudo encounters Motohashi Sakurako who works for an advertising firm. She is able to support herself with her job but has been less than successful in love. The two of them are drawn to each other and seem to connect. But they still keep their emotional scars secret. Sudo is unable to forget the death of a loved one. Whenever December comes around, he would lose his ability to speak for almost a week – a symptom in reaction to the memorial day. On the other hand, Sakurako has had to support the family ever since her father's company went bankrupt, and struggles to be freed from this reality quickly. She believes the present can be changed if she gets married. They do not have innocent feelings for each other. The love that they begin is for their own sakes but…

lead_actors: Kay Lertsittichai, Panisara Rikulsurakan, Nutchapan Paramacharenroj, Jennis Oprasert, Siwat Jumlongkul
title: School Tales The Series
summary: Based on hit comics, School Tales The Series is a new Thai horror anthology of eight terrifying ghost stories set in schools, crafted by six Thai directors skilled in the art of scaring audiences.  The series takes audiences through haunted schools that will bring back their own nostalgic memories of chilling schoolyard stories.  School Tales The Series promises plenty of thrills and excitement as the unfortunate students face off against mysterious, inescapable terrors. What will they do to survive their haunted schools?

title: LEGO Masters
summary: A talent show, presented by Roberto Leal, in which 8 couples of LEGO game fans face each other in a series of tests in which they have to execute ambitious constructions with the pieces of that brand. The protagonists have to demonstrate their skill and creativity under the watchful eye of an expert LEGO jury, Eva Hache and Pablo González, who will decide who continues in the competition.

lead_actors: Casper Van Dien, Armand Assante, Peter Shinkoda, Gianni Capaldi
creators: Rafael Jordan, Sean-Michael Argo, Jamie R. Thompson
title: Salvage Marines
summary: Salvage Marines is a dystopian futuristic series that follows Samuel Hyst, who works as a factory laborer on planet Baen 6. When Samuel learns his wife is pregnant, he does the only thing he can to ensure his child will avoid the same societal debt he has - enlist in the planet's military ranks as a salvage marine.

title: Dear My Loneliness and Darkness
summary: One day, 29-year-old manga artist assistant, Mio Imai, attended a junior high school reunion and reunited with her friends and her first love, Shuichi Amemiya after 14 years. They decided to dig out the time capsules and found a message left by a classmate who transferred out a year before the time capsules were buried. After that day, mysterious incidents occurred when each of the friends suddenly died one after another. As it continues, everybody starts to reveal the "true side" of themselves with unstoppable loves and hates.

title: Shining for One Thing
summary: Lin Beixing, who has been giving up herself in order to follow love, is extremely sad because of her boyfriend's cheating. When packing up items related to her ex-boyfriend, she accidentally deletes text messages in her old mobile phone and frequently travels back to high school, but she is always dragged back to the real world whenever she is in the best moment. After several explorations, Lin Beixing found that the key to crossing was related to Zhang Wansen, so she decided to save Zhang Wansen and started a wonderful story of time-space redemption and mutual growth.

title: Modern Love Mumbai
summary: Modern Love Mumbai explores 6 unique yet universal stories of human connection and love in its varied forms – romantic, platonic, parental, sexual, familial, marital, self love. Inspired by the beloved New York Times column, this edition of the hugely popular original version of the same name, explores love in all of its complicated and beautiful forms against the city of dreams, Mumbai.

lead_actors: Kathryn Hahn, Sarah Pidgeon, Quentin Plair, Tanzyn Crawford
title: Tiny Beautiful Things
summary: Based on the best-selling collection by Cheryl Strayed, Tiny Beautiful Things follows Clare a floundering writer who becomes a revered advice columnist while her own life is falling apart. When we first meet Clare, her marriage to her husband Danny is barely limping along; her teenage daughter, Rae, is pushing her away; and her once-promising writing career is non-existent. So when an old writing pal asks her to take over as the advice columnist Dear Sugar, she thinks she has no business giving anyone advice. After reluctantly taking on the mantle of Sugar however, Clare's life unfurls in a complex fabric of memory, exploring her most pivotal moments from childhood through present day, and excavating the beauty, struggle, and humor in her unhealed wounds. Through Sugar, Clare forms a salve for her readers - and for herself - to show us that we are not beyond rescue, that our stories can ultimately save us. And, perhaps, bring us back home.

title: Calles gale verden
summary: Calles gale verden documents the life of Calle Hellevang-Larsen, "Norway's most hidden cameraman", the country's lauded and crowned king of the TV art of hidden camera. He is at the top of the pyramid and lives a life of hustle and bustle, surrounded by parties and glamour, loose friends and his faithful French-speaking best friend. But there is a cost to keeping the place on the throne, and in order to preserve the people's hunger for hidden cameras, it is important to constantly come up with new and ground-breaking ideas.

title: Alltid beredt
summary: Steinar Sagen dusts off old scout badges and invites six well-known Norwegians to go out into nature to live like real scout aspirants.

title: Khaas
summary: The plot revolves around Saba Faraz (Sanam Baloch), an ambitious and confident girl and Ammar Saud (Ali Rehman Khan), a charming and handsome businessman who is actually a narcissist.

title: Ishq Zahe Naseeb
summary: The series talks about split personality disorder. Samir is a successful businessman suffering from Dissociative identity disorder, and hallucinations.

title: Deedan
summary: Deedan tells the story of two friends from a rural village: One girl serendipitously finds fortune in the big city while under the thumb of her husband; The other is forced to remain in the mountains in a warped family situation.

title: Herr Talman
summary: Herr Talman takes a disrespectful comedy approach to politics with twisted puppet versions of our party leaders. In sketches and songs, the program runs with the political theater, the party leaders' shortcomings and current topics.

title: Proud Swordsman
summary: Li Fuyao, a mysteriously young storyteller, wins over the villagers with his fantastic original tales in a peaceful and secluded town. Actually, born in Luoyang City, he used to be a prestigiously selected child, who should have been cultivating in the holy palace. However, life has treated him otherwise. He was expelled to this remote town, unattended. Notwithstanding, like a hidden leopard, he is always lurking around to get himself back on the road of cultivation and seek revenge when he becomes strong enough. One day, a masterly cultivator and an injured snake demon paid him an unexpected visit, breaking the peace of his life from then on. To his surprise, the snake demon offered him a demonic core for cultivation, which granted him the chance he has been yearning for. Is it really a turning point in his life or will it just put him into inconceivable danger?

title: Me'ila
summary: A seven-part crime thriller based on the unbelievable true story of Eti Alon, an employee at a family-owned bank who embezzled its clients' entire savings and capital, stealing more than 100 million dollars and funneling them to her gambling-addicted brother to save him from debt collectors. When Alon surrendered in 2002, she unraveled a case which transformed Israeli society.

title: SisterS
summary: SisterS is a dark comedy-drama about two women, born continents apart, in Canada and in Ireland, who discover they are half-sisters and embark on a road trip to find their alcoholic father. Real-life best friends Goldberg and Stanley make their writing debuts and star.

title: Grachi
summary: Grachi arrives in a new town with her recently widowed father. She makes her place in high school, in part thanks to her magical powers as a witch.

lead_actors: Colin Farrell, Kirby Howell-Baptiste, Amy Ryan, James Cromwell, Jin Ha
title: Sugar
summary: John Sugar is an American private investigator on the heels of the mysterious disappearance of Olivia Siegel, the beloved granddaughter of legendary Hollywood producer Jonathan Siegel. As Sugar tries to determine what happened to Olivia, he will also unearth Siegel family secrets; some very recent, others long-buried.

lead_actors: Brooke Lynn Hytes, Brad Goreski, Traci Melchor
title: Canada's Drag Race: Canada vs the World
summary: In Canada's Drag Race: Canada vs the World, Canada acts as host nation when nine queens from the international Drag Race family compete to become the Queen of the Mother Pucking World. Fan-favourites and top talent from across the world battle it out in an elite competition, with a thirst for victory, and one queen left standing.

title: One Question
summary: Claudia Winkleman invites pairs of contestants to answer a single question to win a £100,000 prize. The contenders are faced with 20 possible answers, but only one answer is correct. Eliminate the incorrect answers and they are on the path to victory, but remove the one correct answer and it's game over.

lead_actors: Michael Cimino, Beck Bennett, Meli Povenmire, Joey King, Carolina Ravassa
title: Hamster & Gretel
summary: The music-filled Hamster & Gretel introduces Kevin and younger sister Gretel, who are about to be bestowed super powers by space aliens. But something goes awry, and it's Gretel and her pet hamster (named Hamster) who suddenly have new abilities. Now, protective older brother Kevin must figure out how to work with both Gretel and her pet Hamster to protect their city from mysterious dangers.

title: Ernest and Célestine: The Collection
summary: Ernest is a Bear who marches to the beat of his own drum. He earns his living playing the accordion and performing in the streets. In his run-down house, he took in Célestine, a little orphan Mouse. Célestine is as generous with Ernest as she is with her friends. She is always cheerful, optimistic, and determined.

title: Pirate Gold of Adak Island
summary: Will this expert team unearth legendary pirate treasure? Follow the hunt for buried gold amid the harsh Alaskan wilderness in this documentary series.

title: Uncle From Another World
summary: Seventeen years ago, Takafumi's uncle fell into a coma, but now he's back like a man risen from his grave. Soon, Takafumi discovers two bizarre things: His uncle treasures video games above all else, and, while comatose, he was actually transported to another world as some heroic guardian! Now, not only does Takafumi have to room with an uncle who is literally magical, he also has to catch the guy up on two decades of history—smartphones, high-speed internet, modern anime tropes…and the traumatic outcome of the '90s console war!

lead_actors: Edward Bluemel, Pixie Davies, Thuso Mbedu, Zahn McClarnon, Aaron Neil
title: Castlevania: Nocturne
summary: As revolution sweeps France, Richter Belmont fights to uphold his family's legacy and prevent the rise of a ruthless, power-hungry vampire ruler.

title: Johnny and the Knights of Galilee
summary: Reunion of childhood friends leads to a succeeding gigilo business in the north of Israel.

lead_actors: Yang Ze, Lu Yan Qi, Ni Han Jin, Guo Jia Yu, An Qin Fu
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Destined to Meet You
summary: Jin Rong Rong, the resolute general manager of Jinchao Group, met Gu Cong Bei, a singer of a bar, on the way to secretly inspect the operation of the business district. After a drunken night Jin Rong Rong learned that Gu Cong Bei was still a college student, and with zero love experience, she pretended to be calm and claimed to be responsible for him. Coincidentally when Jin Rong Rong went to the blind date bureau she unexpectedly found out that Gu Cong Bei was the third son of the Gu family, and was also in need of marriage, so she decided to choose him as her marriage partner. What she didn't know was that Gu Cong Bei was purposely trying to get close to her. Now living under the same roof after marriage, Gu Cong Bei noticed that Jin Rong Rong was different, unique, but Jin Rong Rong was also very secretive and refused to open up to her new husband about why she was afraid of the cold. As truths and motives begin to emerge, will these two be able to overcome the trials headed their way?Adapted from the web novel "Ba Hun, Xu Mo Yi Jiu" (霸婚,蓄谋已久) by Yu Ge (鱼歌).

title: Tod von Freunden
summary: A German and a Danish family, whose previous idyllic life together goes upside down with the disappearance of one of the children.

title: Kaçış
summary: War photographer Mehmet and a group of journalists from different countries; It starts with a visit to a Ezidi village to do research. In the series, the group, who secretly crossed the border, fell into the hands of a radical terrorist organization as a result of a raid, and then the dramas, changes and escape stories are told with an exciting language.

title: I dina händer
summary: Snow falls softly over a desolate playground. A fourteen-year-old boy lays face down in front of a swing-set as his life drains out of the gaping wound in his head. Behind him stands his best friend, a warm gun in his trembling hand. When children commit horrible crimes, who bears responsibility? And what does it do to us all when we allow ourselves to view children as monsters? At the center of this gut-wrenching story are the lost children: those we fail to catch before they fall between the cracks – whether due to negligence, poverty, or social alienation. The single mothers, the grocer in the town square, the local cop – no one is left untouched in a society where the escalating violence is taking over struggling fringe communities.

lead_actors: Nicholas Hamilton, Jacob Lee Weiss, Haleigh Hekking, Sean Maguire, Kim Coates
title: Action Royale
summary: A teenager starts an underground esports gambling ring to pay off his father's debts, but he and his best friend soon find themselves in over their heads in a dangerous high-stakes world.

lead_actors: Александр Устюгов, Карина Андоленко, Дмитрий Ульянов, Анна Котова, Евгений Антропов
title: Киллер
summary: Former policeman Ivan meets his sworn enemy in the courtroom, who killed his partner six years ago and then sent him to jail. Togo is once again accused of contract murder, but the dodgy criminal is released again. All these years spent in prison, the thirst for revenge devours Ivan from the inside. But, embarking on the path of revenge, he encounters very dangerous and influential people. Now he is forced to make a deal "with the devil": in order to save his own life, he must fulfill an "order" for them. Ivan gives his consent and becomes a hired killer - a killer. But fate makes its own adjustments to his plans: Ivan gets into a terrible accident. For several weeks, doctors fight for his life, the main character survives, but loses his memory: he does not remember who he is, who hired him and whom he must kill. He does not remember anything and thus gets an unexpected chance at a new life.

title: Non mi lasciare
summary: The lifeless body of a child is found in the Venice Lagoon. To shed light on the case is the assistant commissioner Elena Zonin, an expert in computer crimes and pedophilia on the net, who for the occasion returns to her hometown. There she finds Daniele, her childhood love, now a policeman, and his wife Giulia, once a great friend of hers. Between dense mysteries and memories of the past, Elena ends up uncovering a network involving influential and unsuspected people.

title: Squid Game: The Challenge
summary: In this reality competition show inspired by Squid Game, 456 players put their skills to the ultimate test for a life-changing $4.56 million prize.

title: River Cottage Reunited
summary: Hugh Fearnley-Whittingstall returns with grow-your-own ideas - the very ethos he has championed since the first River Cottage shows more than two decades ago.

title: Kangaroo Beach
summary: Four young animal friends spend an action-packed summer at the spectacular Kangaroo Beach, training as junior cadets with their lifeguard heroes. When an emergency breaks out, the cadets step up to help keep the water safe.

title: Streams
summary: The always equally enterprising Little Al-Fadji wants to return to the hip-hop world, but this time as manager of the kind and blonde townhouse guy Robin (Pontus Bjernekull). When they start their collaboration, they have no idea what adventure they have embarked on.

title: The Broken News
summary: News channels Awaaz Bharati News and Josh 24/7 have opposing principles that lead to a fierce rivalry. The dynamic journalists attempt to balance their lives while facing an uncertain future.

lead_actors: Sunita Mani, Wunmi Mosaku, Bob Stephenson, Alia Shawkat, Ted Travelstead
title: Scavengers Reign
summary: When a deep space freighter is damaged by a solar flare its surviving crew are stranded on a beautiful and unforgiving planet. They begin to learn the true nature of this planet as they try to survive long enough to escape or be rescued.

lead_actors: Peyton List, Milo Manheim, Spencer MacPherson, Kiara Pichardo, Sarah Yarkin
title: School Spirits
summary: When Maddie finds herself trapped in afterlife limbo at her high school, she decides to investigate her own mysterious disappearance.

lead_actors: Deng Jia Jia, Zhang Xin Cheng, Gong Zheng Ye, Liang Ai Qi, Wang Yan
title: The Murder in Kairoutei
summary: While sleeping, Tong Xiu Zhi's house caught fire. She wakes up and discovers that she is in the hospital and learns that her beloved boyfriend died in the fire. Unable to accept the truth, the girl committed suicide.The rest of her family gather in the gallery to decide how to divide the inheritance. But at this time, a beautiful girl appears, which makes others nervous and think.A series of murders continues to occur in the gallery. Visitors die one by one. What are the secrets behind these murder cases?Adaptation of the novel "The Murder in Kairotei" by Higashino Keigo (東野圭吾).

lead_actors: Юлия Снигирь, Полина Гухман, Таисья Калинина, Баястан Колдошалы, Александр Петров
title: Фишер
summary: The year is 1986. Teenagers are being killed one by one in the area of government dachas on Rublevsky Highway. Intelligent investigator Valery Kozyrev, his daring partner from Rostov Evgeny Bokov and a very young investigator Natalia Dobrovolskaya begin an investigation, not even suspecting how much it will change the fate of each of them. The only witness able to identify the maniac is Igor, a schoolboy, whose parents are not at all enthusiastic about their son's contacts with the police.

title: Amazing Cleans
summary: A variety of expert professionals are responsible for the modern world's cleanliness, even though many of their jobs and the hardships they face go unappreciated and unknown.

title: Bucketheads: A Star Wars Story
summary: A fan series, created by Transmute Pictures, two filmmakers out of Vancouver, B.C. who share a passion for Star Wars. In 2018 they created Bucketheads, an award-winning Star Wars Fan Film. This is a continuation of that story, a whole Bucketheads series that follows Nova Squad during the final days of the Empire leading up to the battle of Jakku. The series will feature five 20-30 minute episodes chronicling their original story as it unfolds during one of the most interesting backdrops in all of Star Wars.

lead_actors: Jenna Warren, JJ Gerber, Maitreyi Ramakrishnan, AJ Bridel, Ana Sani
title: My Little Pony: Tell Your Tale
summary: The series introduces My Little Pony‘s beloved next-generation characters in a sprightly 2D animation style and features upbeat, comedic stories that kids of all ages can enjoy. The slice-of-life series will showcase new sides of the Mane 5 and expand their universe in exciting new directions.

title: You Are My Destiny
summary: Satoh Aya, a temporary office worker who never bad-mouths about others no matter how much she is fooled, is conveniently used in her company as a 'sticky woman'. Such an ordinary office lady ends up meeting Ichijo Kei, the young successor of a large company, who was eager to marry early because of his grandmother, the chairman. The destiny plays with their fates and both meet each other in an unexpected situation which is going to change their destiny.

lead_actors: Karol Sevilla, Pipe Bueno, Christian Tappan
title: Siempre Fui Yo
summary: When Lupe is 22 years old, her life suddenly changes after she learns that her father, a famous Colombian singer-songwriter, has died. Upon arriving in Colombia, Lupe meets Noah, a mysterious character who turns out to be her father's assistant. Instead of returning to Mexico, Lupe decides to stay as she suspects that the musician's death was not an accident. Together with Noah, she will embark on a musical adventure full of danger, mystery and romance, in the Caribbean region of Colombia.

lead_actors: Melissa Kiplagat, Melvin Alusa, Nini Wacera, Blessing Lungaho
title: Country Queen
summary: A Nairobi event planner returns to her village after 10 years, where she confronts her past — and a mining company that threatens to destroy her home.

lead_actors: Jenna Coleman, Oliver Jackson-Cohen, Ashley Benson, Claire Rushbrook, Talia Balsam
title: Wilderness
summary: Wilderness revolves around British couple Liv and Will who seem to have it all: a rock-solid marriage; a glamorous new life in New York thousands of miles from their provincial hometown; and still young enough to feel that their whole lives are ahead of them. Until Liv learns about Will's affair. Heartbreak is swiftly followed by another emotion: fury. Revenge is her only option, and when Will proposes a trip around America's epic National Parks to give their relationship a fresh start, Liv knows just how to get it… Wilderness is a twisted love story, where a dream holiday and a supposedly "happily-ever-after" quickly turns into a living nightmare.

title: Sitiados: México
summary: Veracruz, year 1683. With the intention of restocking his ship, a mysterious and refined captain arrives to the Governor's house, introducing himself as Lorenzo. No one knows his ulterior motives, although they don't take long to surface.

lead_actors: Billy Crystal, Judith Light, Jacobi Jupe, Rosie Perez, Maria Dizzia
title: Before
summary: Before follows Eli, a child psychiatrist who, after recently losing his wife, Lynn, encounters a troubled young boy, Noah, who seems to have a haunting connection to Eli's past. As Eli attempts to help Noah, their mysterious bond deepens.

lead_actors: Will Forte, Siobhán Cullen, Robyn Cara, David Wilmot, Chris Walley
title: Bodkin
summary: Bodkin is a darkly comedic thriller about a motley crew of podcasters who set out to investigate the mysterious disappearance of three strangers in an idyllic, coastal Irish town. But once they start pulling at threads, they discover a story much bigger and weirder than they could have ever imagined. As our heroes try to discern fact from fiction - about the case, about their colleagues, and, most painfully, themselves - the series challenges our perception of truth and exposes the stories we tell ourselves to justify our beliefs or validate our fears.

lead_actors: Dan Abrams, Curtis Wilson, Tom Rizzo, Sean Larkin, Tom Morris, Jr.
title: On Patrol: Live
summary: Hosting and executive producing On Patrol: Live is Dan Abrams, CEO and Founder of Abrams Media, host of Dan Abrams Live on NewsNation, Chief Legal Analyst for ABC News, and former host of Live PD. Joining Abrams is Sgt. Sean "Sticks" Larkin, retired Tulsa Police Department lieutenant with nearly 25 years of service, and Deputy Sheriff Curtis Wilson, Division Commander with the Richland County Sheriff's Department in Columbia, SC.

title: Masoom
summary: Shattered by the sudden and strange demise of her mother, Sana Kapoor risks her relationship with her family to unravel the mystery.

lead_actors: Gülper Özdemir, Erdem Kaynarca, Sarp Can Köroğlu, Zehra Yılmaz
title: Gül Masalı
summary: Gül Masalı tells the story of Gonca, who encounters the mysterious secrets of the past thanks to the inheritance left to her after her mother's death, and Toprak, the son of Atabey family, one of the leading families of Isparta.

lead_actors: Mio Imada, Eguchi Noriko, Nobuyuki Suzuki, Fumiya Takahashi, Osamu Mukai
title: Bad Girl: Glass Ceiling Crushers
summary: Meet Tanaka Maririn, just graduated from college and beginning her life in the workforce… at the bottommost rung. She's not expected to know much (and she doesn't) and she's not expected to last long, but few at first are aware that not only does she have an upbeat attitude, but a sarcastic streak a mile long and a fearlessness to match with it. Sometimes she wears slacks instead of a skirt. She WILL succeed, and she WILL find that handsome man she saw only briefly on her first day of work after her orientation. Don't even think you can stop her...

title: Balkan Ninnisi
summary: Balkan Ninnisi tells the story of the struggle of two young people from different nationalities in Skopje for the sake of their love. The series will tell sections of the lives of Turkish and Macedonian families, whose lives intersect before and meeting in a historical mansion, and two young people who love each other very much.

lead_actors: Miguel Bernardeau, Renata Notni, Rodolfo Sancho, Paco Tous, Dalia Xiuhcoatl
title: Zorro
summary: Diego de la Vega returns to California to avenge his father's murder. After assuming the title of Zorro, he initiates his struggle against Nah-Lin, a Native American who he believes has stolen his inheritance. Diego will confront the Governor, the malevolent leader of the Chinese community and a secret society, placing the common good above all. In doing so, he will sacrifice his love for Lola.

lead_actors: Elena Leeve, Leo Sjöman, Markus Järvenpää, Petteri Summanen, Carl-Kristian Rundman
title: Maria Kallio
summary: Maria Kallio is a police officer who is a lawyer without a final exam. However, the blood draws Maria to the work of policing and, tired of her studies, she takes the place as the leader of the Western Uusimaa police murder team.

lead_actors: Helin Kandemir, Caner Topçu, Rabia Soytürk, Sümeyye Aydoğan, Meltem Akçöl
title: Duy Beni
summary: Ekim and Meltem are two young teenagers who are as close as sisters. They live a modest life in a humble neighbourhood but they always envied the rich kids who attend Doğru High School, a secondary school exclusively for the children of wealthy families. One day a car hits Meltem and the culprit flees the crime scene, making his way towards the school and hides his car in the parking lot. When news spreads that a girl will spend the rest of her life in a wheelchair because of someone from the school, the principal decides to give scholarships to three students from Meltem's neighbourhood, to bury the bad news. Ekim, Bekir and Ayşe are chosen to start their fresh student life in the city's most prestigious school, but they soon understand that their life is actually about to get harder; they will have to fight to survive among the rich children and they will be surprised to see that the wealthy have very different lives to what they imagined...

title: Noor ul Ain
summary: Noor-Ul-Ain and Khizer's first accidental meeting change their lives completely when they fall in love with each other. They elope thinking they can make it work but to no avail, resulting in serious consequences.

title: Yeh Dil Mera
summary: A man and a woman have different personalities and are polar opposites of each other. However, they share some undeniable chemistry that brews the beginning of a romance.

title: Koi Chand Rakh
summary: Umair and Nishal are siblings and are Rabail's cousins. Grown up together but the three have completely different natures. Umair is in love with Rabail who is four years older than him. Zain's father fixes his marraige with Rabail but Zain and Nishal are in love. Umair's mother doesn't want him to marry Rabail. Rabail and Zain get married, but he doesn't accept this relationship and stays in touch with Nishal. Where will these complicated relationships lead to?

title: Ishqiya
summary: Hamna and Rumaisa are sisters raised by overprotective parents. Hamna is quiet, peaceful and reserved while Rumi is carefree, outgoing and talkative, but both love their father dearly. Hamna and her college classmate Hamza (Feroze Khan) are madly in love. Hamna is hesitant to tell her father that she is in love as he doesn't believe in love marriages.

lead_actors: Peter Capaldi, Cush Jumbo, Shaun Dooley, Stephen Campbell Moore, Charlie Creed-Miles
title: Criminal Record
summary: Criminal Record is a powerful, character-driven thriller set in the heart of contemporary London. An anonymous phone call draws two brilliant detectives into a confrontation over an old murder case – one a young woman in the early stages of her career, the other a well-connected man determined to protect his legacy. The series touches on issues of race, institutional failure, and the quest to find common ground in a polarized Britain.

title: Jedini Izlaz
summary: Lawyer Ana Kolar investigates the suspicious death of her husband. Inspector Strbac suspects that the death of his daughter's friend might not be a suicide. Their paths converge, but are they on the same side? And can they take the truth?

title: Baydardi
summary: The story of Shafay and Bia, two innocent AIDS victim who gain this illness simply due to their carelessness.

title: Waacha PriMagi
summary: The new series continues the Pretty Series' conceptual motifs of song, dance, and fashion, and it also adds the theme of magic. Middle-school girl Matsuri Hibino loves festivals, and she dreams of one day being able to star in "PriMagi," a magic-like form of stage entertainment borne from song, dance and fashion. That day arrives when the hyper-spirited, trouble-making magician Myamu arrives from the magical realm and scouts Matsuri for PriMagi. Together, the two compete with rivals to rise to the top of PriMagi.

title: Delicious Party Pretty Cure
summary: The mysterious, delicious world of CooKingdom, which rules over all the cuisine in this world. CooKingdom has closely guarded the Recipe-Bon, in which it's written how to prepare any dish. But, oh no! One day, it gets stolen by the Bundoru Gang! The Bundoru Gang plans to monopolize everything for themselves, and their next target is the Cuisine Fairy Recipeppi... The Energy Fairies have come to Oishi-Na Town in the human world in search of the Recipe-Bon. With their help, an unexpected turn of events leads to three young ordinary girls transforming into Pretty Cures! They stand up to the Bundoru Gang, to recover the Recipe-Bon, and to protect everyone's delicious smiles!

lead_actors: Shehzad Sheikh, Hania Aamir, Naimal Khawar, Usman Mukhtar
title: Anaa
summary: Anaa is a story of love, family, dispute and devotion and revolves around two Nawab families, knitted by kinship but divided by the conflicts and misunderstandings of the past.

title: Bholi Bano
summary: Soban is unable to stand up to his stepmother, who harasses Bano, his wife. Tajdar, who loves Bano, steps in to protect her from harm. However, she refuses, being faithful to her marriage.

lead_actors: Alberto Guerra, Diego Escalona, Camila Valero
title: El Refugio
summary: A family experiences unusual phenomena through their screens, caused by an unidentified force of nature. The parents must protect their children from an invisible enemy. Is their ranch a refuge? Is it the final stronghold of humanity?

title: The Higashino Keigo Mysteries
summary: 11 mysteries, 11 actors. Japan's favorite mystery author, the world of Higashino Keigo comes to life on screen through an assortment of short stories. For every episode, there will be a different lead actor and story, it's themes varying from mystery to comedy to horror to human drama. Nakai Kiichi is the navigator as he takes you on a journey through each episode, seasoned with Higashino's authentic spices, failing your assumptions with vivid story composition and an even bigger betrayal before the finale.

title: Thalu
summary: In Australia, a group of indigenous children undertake a journey to save their country from the advancing destruction of a mysterious dust cloud and its inhabitants, the Takers.

title: Make Some Noise
summary: A game show where talented contestants compete to bring to life silly prompts.

lead_actors: Saskia Rosendahl, Hanna Hilsdorf, Peter Kurth, Hadewych Minis, Sebastian Hülk
title: A Thin Line
summary: Young "hacktivist" twin sisters Anna and Benni are inseparable in their quest to expose environmental wrongdoing by any means necessary. But when their hack into a government server leads to a police raid, Anna is captured and Benni disappears into the underground. When it becomes apparent Benni is lending her skills to a radical new terrorist group that does not shy away from violent action against state and corporations, the sisters suddenly find themselves on opposite sides of the question: What line are you willing to cross for something you believe in?

title: Circeo
summary: Circeo tells the story of the aftermath of the crime that came to be known as "The Circeo Massacre", which upset Italy in the 1970s, after two teenage girls were found in the trunk of a car in Rome, naked, wrapped in blankets and drenched in blood. One was dead, the other one alive. Focusing on the trial that followed and centering on the lone surviving victim, Donatella, the series reflects on a watershed moment in the path of the emancipation of Italian women, demanding (and eventually obtaining) the wholesale revision of laws on sexual violence.

lead_actors: Kanoa Lloyd, Sean Brown, Natalie Jane
title: Sort Your Life Out NZ
summary: Host Kanoa Lloyd (The Project) is joined by carpenter Sean Brown and Organisational Expert Natalie Jane. Between them they will strip, sort and systemise the homes of eight lucky kiwi families.

title: Dating After College
summary: Dating After College follows two post-grads as they try to navigate dating in the real "adult" world. Their separate searches will put them in new situations, face-to-face with new people, that will force them re-examine everything they think they know about finding love.

title: O Cangaceiro do Futuro
summary: After being hit in the head, a man wakes up in 1927 to discover that he's the spitting image of a famous bandit — and decides to make the most of it.

lead_actors: Carolina Yuste, Camila Sodi, Leonardo Ortizgris, Álex Gadea, Pavel Anton
title: Sin huellas
summary: Desi and Cata are employees of a cleaning company. Well, they used to be. They were fired overnight. Stressed about money and barely scraping by, they receive a miracle in the form of a phone call: They have been asked to clean the mansion of the Rosellós, one of the most powerful families in Alicante. Everything is going well until they find a woman's dead body. Horror. Panic. Call the Police. But after the initial shock, Cata and Desi clean the crime scene, leaving it spotless - and making them the perfect suspects. Soon, the police are after them. But so are Russian hitmen, a family of millionaires, and an ex-husband with a mariachi band. We'll see how they get themselves out of this mess.

title: First Class
summary: Step into the lives of a group of friends in Barcelona who share a love of over-the-top fashion, luxurious parties and exclusive events.

title: When You Be Me
summary: An ordinary girl who is subjected to endless bullying and a cynical boy born with a silver spoon are from significantly different backgrounds. A soul swap incident makes them realize that they can easily live their lives like the other dreamed!

title: Tale of Tails
summary: Tails is not a white-collar gentlemen's club. It's a borderline-legal bar with topless dancers and a back room where anything goes for the right price. Nick, the owner, keeps Tails afloat by taking advantage of the desperate women who dance for money and the desperate men who pay for female attention. When a dead body shows up in the bathroom, Nick's control begins to unravel. Hunted by an ambitious, relentless cop, Nick's enemies begin to surround him. He must decide how many friends to sacrifice in order to save himself.

lead_actors: Burak Sevinç, Ceren Benderlioğlü, İpek Filiz Yazıcı, Atakan Hoşgören, Gizem Arikan
title: İçimizdeki Ateş
summary: Mert, Bahar, Hale, and Ege, young lawyer candidates who graduated from the faculty of law, go through a tough elimination process and end up scoring internship positions with famous Lawyer Doğan Yener and his wife Tülin Tan. As a requirement, they must stay out of trouble during the internship. As life tests them with all kinds of obstacles on this journey, we will follow their adventures as they strive to reach their goals under the guidance of Doğan and Tülin...

title: Live at the Moth Club
summary: Carefully curated by the long-running Moth Club cast of character comedians, Live at the Moth Club will celebrate comedy from some of the UK's most established comedians and emerging talent, all as you've never seen them before.

lead_actors: Jason Watkins, Aneurin Barnard, Poppy Gilbert, Cathy Belton, Brenda Fricker
title: The Catch
summary: Set against the hauntingly beautiful coastline of the west of England, The Catch introduces us to Ed Collier, a proud husband, father and local fisherman determined to do whatever it takes to keep his family together. But when a rich, handsome younger man enters daughter, Abbie's, life and threatens to take her away from him, Ed finds his life spiralling out of control. Secrets and lies are exposed with every twist and turn but will Ed discover the truth about his daughter's new boyfriend before it's too late?

lead_actors: Kristine Frøseth, Alisha Boe, Josie Totah, Imogen Waterhouse, Matthew Broome
title: The Buccaneers
summary: The Buccaneers are the daughters of America's new rich — beautiful and untameable, despite the best efforts of England's finest governesses, they are on their way to London to snare themselves an aristocrat, low in funds but high in class, to make a perfect match.

title: The Walkers
summary: Stan Walker navigates life as a brother, son, musician, friend and most recently, a husband and father. This is an unfiltered look at the Walkers as they see themselves - loud, proud and unashamedly eccentric.

title: Lycoris Recoil
summary: "LycoReco" is a café with a traditional Japanese twist located in downtown Tokyo. But the delicious coffee and sugary sweets are not the only orders this café takes! From delivering packages short distances, to pick-ups and drop-offs on the lonely streets at night, to zombies and giant monster extermination…?! Whatever your problem, we're here to help! We will solve any kind of "trouble" you may have!

title: Kranitz - Bei Trennung Geld zurück
summary: Klaus Kranitz considers "normal" couples therapy only to be expensive separation support. His self-made approach promises quick success. It brings stagnant togetherness back to life - in just a few sessions and with a money-back guarantee! For the unconventional couples therapist, no truth is too direct and no means too far-fetched to repair his clientele's relationships. Grimme Prize winner Jan Georg Schütte, director and co-author at the same time, brilliantly embodies the refined and cryptic title hero of the six-part series. The excellent cast used the playful freedom of the improv format to spontaneously develop the peculiarities and absurdities of their unusual characters in front of the camera. The successful ARD radio play "Couples therapist Klaus Kranitz - Money back in the event of separation" served as a template.

lead_actors: Alejandra Ramos, Tiffany Derry, Tim Hollingsworth, Francis Lam, Leah Cohen
title: The Great American Recipe
summary: Hosted by Alejandra Ramos, this eight-part cooking competition series celebrates the multiculturalism that makes American food unique and iconic, giving talented home cooks from different regions of the country the opportunity to showcase their beloved signature dishes and compete to win the national search for The Great American Recipe. Judges Leah Cohen, Tiffany Derry and Graham Elliot bring their professional insights and deep culinary knowledge to encourage and support the contestants along the way.

lead_actors: Freddie Flintoff, Mike Rogers, Kyle Hogg
title: Freddie Flintoff's Field of Dreams
summary: Sporting legend Freddie Flintoff takes on his toughest challenge yet, creating a cricket team from scratch. But can he inspire the next generation to give cricket a chance?

title: Hamishim
summary: The series tells the story of 49-year-old widowed screenwriter Alona, who is struggling to raise her three children—20-year-old Carmel, 17-year-old Yali and 11-year-old Shira—while also tending to her demented father. She has two important goals to achieve before she turns fifty: to sign a development deal for a comedy series she wants to write about 50-year-old women, and to have sex.

lead_actors: Oktay Çubuk, Nil Keser, Tarık Papuçcuoğlu, Ayşe Kökçü, Merve Nur Bengi
title: Ah Nerede
summary: Follows Ferit, son of a rich and traditional family with no major obligations other than partying. While Zehra is a young woman who dropped out of university and works in a pastry shop. Both will cross paths with her when she returns to college and Ferit has to turn her life around. But not only his but also that of his two brothers.

creators: Jan Albert de Weerd, Béatrice Fournera
title: Comme Des Gosses
summary: Between a clumsy and blundering director, an "old school" mistress, teachers with personal methods and parents of students ready to do anything for the apple of their eyes, the Paul Pédrault school is a giant playground. And the children in all this? They enjoy the show...

title: Adrian
summary: 2068: in a dystopic Milan, a simple watchmaker called Adrian takes on a corrupt regime, assuming various identities with the aim of awakening popular consciences.

title: Lords of the Ocean
summary: The deep-sea exploration continues with the premiere of Lords of the Ocean. This thrilling new series gives viewers a front row seat to the exciting world of professional diving. It's a deep sea submersion into the challenges of the most unusual jobs below sea level. Viewers will get a weekly dose of a day in the life of diving crews battling wicked weather, tight deadlines and technical difficulties to earn big bucks. Lords of the Ocean will have viewers both holding their breath and gasping for air.

lead_actors: Emre Kınay, Dolunay Soysert, Tayanç Ayaydın, Kaan Mirac Sezen, Ecem Çalhan
title: Tozluyaka
summary: Even luck would not pass by without getting lost in Tozluyaka, but it plunged headlong into those who chose each other as brothers… This time, the journey of hope began… It made them touch every street they passed, every person they named, those who were hungry for cruelty, injustice, love… This was everyone's story. They were just the lucky ones among us.

title: Harem in the Labyrinth of Another World
summary: High school student Michio Kaga was wandering aimlessly through life and the Internet, when he finds himself transported from a shady website to a fantasy world — reborn as a strong man who can use "cheat" powers. He uses his powers to become an adventurer, earn money, and get the right to claim girls that have idol-level beauty to form his very own harem.

lead_actors: Yûya Hirose, Maaya Uchida, Wakana Kuramochi, Kaori Ishihara, Yu Okano
title: Vermeil in Gold
summary: Alto, on the verge of failing the summoning magic class and having to repeat the year, stumbles upon a grimoire and draws a magic circle, summoning the sealed demon Vermeil and making her his familiar. She has been a feared "devil" since ancient times and possesses tremendous power to cause disasters.Vermeil, as a familiar, necessitates magical energy on a daily basis, which she obtains from Alto via passionate kisses. Lilia, Alto's childhood friend, grows envious of their relationship, while the students are also taken aback by the unprecedented familiar. The royal road fantasy of a magician on the edge of failure and an unhealthy devil sister begins!

title: Mental Tsuyome Bijo Shirakawa-san
summary: Women's self-esteem saves the society! Ms. Shirakawa, a beautiful woman with strong mentality, repels stresses that afflicts women, such as prejudice, harassment, and dominance.

title: Black Summoner
summary: Waking up in a strange new place with no memory of his past life, Kelvin learns that he's bartered away those very memories in exchange for powerful new abilities during his recent transmigration. Heading out into a whole new world as a Summoner — with his first Follower being the very goddess who brought him over! — Kelvin begins his new life as an adventurer, and it isn't long before he discovers his hidden disposition as a battle junkie. From the Black Knight of the Ancient Castle of Evil Spirits to the demon within the Hidden Cave of the Sage, he revels in the fight against one formidable foe after another. Join this OP adventurer in an exhilarating and epic saga as he and his allies carve their way into the annals of history!

lead_actors: Amir Eid, Malak El Husseiny, Tamer Hashem, Sedky Sakhr, Sarrah Abdelrahman
title: Rivo
summary: Maryam seeks to discover the truth about her great composer father's relationship with the music group Rivo, a band that was famous in the nineties, and discovers a secret he has hidden over the past years.

title: The Great Giveback with Melissa McCarthy and Jenna Perusich
summary: The fabulous Melissa McCarthy and design-savvy Jenna Perusich give back to those who give selflessly to others with surprise home makeovers. Together, they transform the homes and lives of deserving individuals who choose to lead with love and kindness.

title: Olivia Attwood: Getting Filthy Rich
summary: The reality star explores the world of selling sex online.

title: Kyouso no Musume
summary: A school psycho suspense that depicts classmates, students, and their families being involved in a whirlpool of suspicion and confusion when a mysterious and beautiful high school girl, Kiritani Sara, suddenly transfers to another school.

title: Yurei Deco
summary: The story begins when Berry, an average girl from an average home, meets Hack, a girl who looks like a boy. Charmed by Hack, Berry meets up with the team Hack leads, the Ghost Detectives Club. Members of this club are "socially dead," working invisibly within the digitally controlled society of Tom Sawyer. As she works with the group, Berry learns about Zero, a mysterious figure who lurks within Tom Sawyer's underground. She and Hack decide to chase down this figure, and in time, the truth behind the city is revealed...

lead_actors: Iris Berben, Milan Peschel, Nina Kunzendorf, Peter Kurth, Svenja Liesau
title: Altes Land
summary: Three women, three generations, a house like a ship and a kind of family. A farm in the Altes Land region becomes the setting for a story about the Germany of our mothers and grandmothers, about refugees, rootless city dwellers and how abandoned souls can suddenly find a home.

title: Cuisine interne
summary: Adriana is a young and ambitious Franco-Senegalese chef who dreams of Michelin stars, until the day she unwillingly gets mixed up with underground poker organizers, Jeff and Angele Rubens. The ruthless siblings have no qualms exploiting Adriana's talent and restaurant, the Ballast, which soon becomes the epicenter of their burgeoning business and empire.  At first a witness and slowly becoming an unwitting accomplice to her business partners' illegal activities, Adriana will fight tooth and nail to take back control of her life and restaurant.

lead_actors: Choi Ji Su, Steven Noh, Lee Se Jin, Ko Jae Hyun
title: 300 Year-Old Class of 2020
summary: The series is a fantasy comic web drama that tells a story of three students, who were studying in Seowon during the Joseon period accidently time travel and arrive at present-day Seowon in 2020.

lead_actors: Andie MacDowell, Chyler Leigh, Sadie Laflamme-Snow, Evan Williams
creators: Heather Conkie, Alexandra Clarke, Marly Reed
title: The Way Home
summary: The Way Home follows the lives of three generations of women within the Landry family that spans the years through a time travel twist.

title: Suzhal - The Vortex
summary: Created by Pushkar and Gayatri, Suzhal - The Vortex is a crime thriller that goes beyond the routine investigation and threatens to shake up the cultural societal fabric, when a crime hits a small town in India. Set against the backdrop of an unique micro-festival, ancient myths collide with the troubling present as we are drawn into the eye of the storm.

lead_actors: Tami Roman, DJ Envy, Ken Canion
title: Caught in the Act: Unfaithful
summary: Caught in the Act: Unfaithful tracks host Tami Roman as she sets out on a mission to empower suspicious lovers to catch their cheating partners in the act. Once the investigation is complete, the suspicious lover can choose to team up with their partner's other lover or take them both down in an undercover ambush.

title: High
summary: Miguel, a young teen from the province, was invited by his sister Gabby to go to Manila, only to find out that she already went to Paris as a prize from a game called High. In Manila he meets Mariel, his sister's neighbor, and discovers that Gabby never left for Paris and was kidnapped by a dark-web syndicate which is behind the underground game. Can Miguel find and save Gabby from danger?

lead_actors: Eric Bauza, Bob Bergen, Chandni Parekh
title: Bugs Bunny Builders
summary: In Bugs Bunny Builders, Bugs and Lola are managers of the Looney Builders construction crew comprised of Daffy, Porky, Tweety, and more familiar Looney faces. Together, the team helps their fellow citizens of Looneyburg with zany building projects. Whether building a thrilling new racetrack or creating an out-of-this-world ice cream sundae, no job is too big or wild for the Looney Builders when they work as a team and utilize their super-looney tools and souped-up vehicles.

title: Kami Kuzu☆Idol
summary: Yuuya, one half of the boy pop duo ZINGS, may be the laziest performer in the Japanese music industry. His partner is out there giving 110% every night (and, thankfully, he's quite popular), but Yuuya's half-assed, sloppy dancing, and his frankly hostile attitude toward the audience, has the fans hating him and his agent looking for any excuse to cut him loose. The career of a pop idol just isn't the path of easy leisure and adulation Yuuya expected...After a particularly lifeless concert appearance, Yuuya meets a girl backstage. She's dressed to the nines in a colorful outfit, she's full of vim and vigor, and all she wants from life is to perform. There's just one problem: She's been dead for a year.
