summary: A couple who have been married for 15 years and live in a 20-minute walk from Kichijoji recreate the leisurely daily life of the food that historical figures in the world tasted at home.

lead_actors: Júlia Lemmertz, Vanessa Giácomo, Rafael Primot, Marcos Pitombo, João Simões
title: Chuva Negra
summary: After the death of their parents, Zeca and Vitor focus on solving practical matters, including how to deal with Lucas, the younger brother, a boy with Down Syndrome.

title: Mahou no Rinobe
summary: Shingyoji Kome has recently begun work at Marufuku Komuten, which is a home renovation company. She is 30-years-old and single. The company where she works is owned and run by the Fukuyama family. Shingyoji Kome worked as a sales ace for a large construction company, but she made a mistake that led to her losing her job. Shingyoji Kome is now paired with Fukuyama Gennosuke, who has zero ability in his sales position. Fukuyama Gennosuke is a single parent and he is also the first son of the Fukuyama family that owns the company. Kome Shingyoji works with Gennosuke Fukuyama as her partner and she is responsible in training him. They work together and deal with problems brought by clients.

lead_actors: Jakob Schøyen Andersen, Elli Müller Osborne, Henrik Mestad, Kristine Grændsen, Charlotte Frogner
title: Dummedag
summary: Dummedag is a post-apocalyptic, dramatic comedy. When a new virus mutates and creates a deadly pandemic, six strangers are forced to work together to save the world from a virus that makes people stupid. Will they survive? And can these six people really be the future of the human race?

lead_actors: Kathrine Thorborg Johansen, Nader Khademi, Jan Gunnar Røise, Andrea Rudland Haave, Trond Espen Seim
title: Makta
summary: The year is 1974, but we are still in Oslo in 2023. The Labor Party is in crisis. The party is torn apart by a conflict between party leader Reiulf Steen and Prime Minister Odvar Nordli. The alcohol flows, so do the leaks. At the same time, the socially engaged doctor Gro Harlem Brundtland becomes entangled in the political power game. She gradually becomes a masterful player and outmaneuvers her opponents. In 1981 she becomes Norway's first female prime minister.

title: Orkestret
summary: Orkestret is a tragi-comical workplace drama set in and around a symphony orchestra.

title: Head 2 Head Drag Race
summary: Head 2 Head Drag Race is an adrenaline-fueled fusion of auto journalism and competitive entertainment, reviving MotorTrend's much-loved Head 2 Head series in a high-speed format with the newest and hottest cars, trucks, and SUVs. Head 2 Head Drag Race delivers gripping showdowns featuring a diverse range of vehicles-from exotic supercars and rugged off-roaders to opulent luxury vehicles and future-focused EVs- in an uncompromising quest for drag racing supremacy.

lead_actors: Beth Alsbury, Ross Kemp, Crystal Clarke, Sue Vincent, Michelle Bonnard
title: Blindspot
summary: A year after witnessing a traumatising attack in her neighbourhood, Hannah, a young wheelchair user, views a copycat attack on her area's CCTV system. The attacker enters the area with an unknown woman, but emerges alone, and Hannah believes she was murdered despite there being no evidence of a crime.

title: Gold Diggers
summary: It's 1853, and two ratbag sisters from Sydney travel to the Australian Gold Rush in search of their own treasure: newly rich idiots.

lead_actors: Максим Литовченко, Ekaterina Rednikova, Владимир Стержаков, Наталия Курдюбова, Ирина Апексимова
title: Судмедэксперты
summary: The judge, the lawyer, the prosecutor – these are the people who play the main role in a trial. It would seem that the defendant's fate depends on them. But that's not the case: there's someone "behind the scenes" without whom it's impossible to pass judgment. That person is the medical expert. It is their conclusion that often becomes decisive; it is on them that the outcome depends — whether the person will remain at large or end up behind bars.

title: Tareq Taylors Matresa
summary: Tareq Taylor embarks on an inspiring and personal food journey to his father's hometown of Jerusalem. Now Tareq wants to get to know the place he has never returned to since childhood, and the fantastic food from the Middle East that he grew up with.

title: Shaitan
summary: The narrative focuses on the plight of her children who battle demons of different kinds and ultimately choose violence. The story is narrated from the point of view of Baali who is cornered in a police encounter after he threatens the home minister of the State.

lead_actors: Andrzej Chyra, Natalia Jędruś, Ольга Голдыс, Jaśmina Polak, Konrad Kąkol
title: Sortownia
summary: The titular sorting plant is an emergency department in one of Warsaw's hospitals. The name has a rather cynical connotation. Here, patients are sorted into more or less in need of help by assigning them different codes: red, yellow and green. Working here is stressful, exhausting and morally questionable. The decision to give priority to a given person has something of divine judgment about it. The main character is an experienced doctor who has to play the role of the master of life and death during murderously long shifts. How does this position affect the human psyche? Does this type of power corrupt?

title: Inspector Avinash
summary: The story revolves around the super cop Avinash Mishra of Uttar Pradesh, India. Based on year 1997, the narrative takes us through his struggle of overcoming each hurdle in reaching to the head of the weapon cartrel. Revolving around the crimes of UP, this show compares the state of Uttar Pradesh to Mexico.

title: Project Bakeover
summary: Renowned pastry chef, master chocolatier and entrepreneur Steve Hodge works with beloved design guru Tiffany Pratt to reinvigorate North American bakeries on the brink of losing it all.

title: Hip Hop Treasures
summary: Hip Hop Treasures provides a behind the scenes look at the people and items that gave birth to the cultural phenomenon that is Hip Hop. With the help of LL COOL J, Ice T, field collectors Cipha Sounds and Yo-Yo along with Chief Museum Curator Paradise Gray and curator Pete Nice, some of these elusive items are brought back to the archive and will be put on display at The Universal Hip Hop Museum. The museum is poised to become "The Official Record of Hip Hop" and is currently in the process of building the world's largest Hip Hop memorabilia collection. The permanent home of the Universal Hip Hop Museum will open to visitors worldwide in 2024.

title: Nami yo Kiite Kure
summary: Koda Minare is a 26-year-old single woman working part-time at a curry restaurant. She's recently gone through a series of troubling events, including being dumped by her boyfriend and getting conned out of money. Because of this, she drinks alcohol at a bar. At that time, the chief director of a local radio station happens to be there and joins her. Koda Minare tells her story about the recent troubles she has experienced. The radio station chief director listens to her and realizes she has potential as a radio personality. Thanks to the chief director, Koda Minare is selected to host the late night radio program "Wave, Listen to Me."

title: Tanaav
summary: Kabir, a special task force veteran, is brought out of retirement to hunt down an enemy, Umar Riaz, he thought he had neutralised but is still alive. He, along with a reassembled special task force, decides to infiltrate Umar's brother's wedding after learning that Umar would be in attendance. However, when things do not go as planned, Kabir and his team must give their all to ensure the dangerous man is caught.

title: Draco
summary: The irresistible Draco plays with his toys and learns about the difference between big and small, high and low, up or down by investigating each concept in relation to himself. Is it bigger or smaller than Draco? Is it higher or lower than Draco? Join in and find out!

title: Mawdoo3 3a'ily
summary: Ibrahim reluctantly accepts becoming the legal guardian of his estranged daughter for six months, setting himself up for hilarious and lifechanging experiences.

title: Windy City Rehab: Alison's Dream Home
summary: Windy City Rehab: Alison's Dream Home will spotlight the riskiest and most personal project ever for popular designer and home renovation expert Alison Victoria. Now she is ready to share more of her journey as she transforms her current Chicago office—a 6,250-square foot warehouse built in 1930—into her very own "live-work" dream home.

title: Super Street Garage
summary: John "Nads" Naderi and Amir Bentatou live to celebrate that car tuning spirit as they transform Japanese performance cars into tuner icons with equal parts performance and style.

title: Empty Nest Refresh
summary: Liza Koshy & Orlando Soria team up with young adults leaving home in this touching home improvement series. Together, they transform childhood rooms into stunning spaces as gifts to the loving parents.

title: Familiegeheimen: Brahim en Jelle: onbreekbare vriendschap?

lead_actors: Zhang Ya Qin, Guo Jia Nan
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
title: An Ancient Love Song
summary: Professor Shen Buyan accidentally travels to the ancient era of Acacia, where he becomes obsessed with finding the ancient secret of this era. With the help of the warm girl, Lu Yuan, will he be able to unravel the mystery?

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: The Outsider
summary: The story of two completely different people from opposite walks of life--Wang Ju An and Su Mo--that work in the same company. When feelings start to develop, they slowly surrender to them. But when difficulties arise; will their love withstand the ultimate test of opposites attract?

title: Senda Prohibida
summary: Senda Prohibida tells the story of a provincial girl Nora, who destroys a happy family to achieve the lifestyle and luxury she's always dreamed of. Set in a time when women were merely decorative objects, Nora Lopez – or Corina, as she is known in the underworld of cabaret –, is determined to achieve the wealth she always dreamed of, and nothing will stop her. From manipulating men with her pristine beauty to pitting a father against his own son, she is willing to destroy the love of a family and bring them to an abyss where any one of them will have to risk their own life.

title: Cuccioli cerca amici - Nel regno di Pocketville
summary: Flo and Magic go to Pocketville and have many adventures. They help puppies, that are destined for certain children, come to the real world.

lead_actors: Jonathan Lawrence, Duncan Cox, Dakota Nickels, Keishon Joseph, Michael Lupu
title: Alter Boys
summary: A group of young men recover in a northern Manitoba hospital after being rescued from a forest fire that tore through an isolated conversion therapy camp that they attended, only to discover they haven't yet escaped as they must relive the summer's haunting interplay of hope and ruin when a camp casualty has authorities asking questions about the program.

lead_actors: Yang Yang, Wang Chu Ran, Wang Yan Lin, Wei Da Xun, Zhang Bin Bin
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Fireworks of My Heart
summary: Fire chief Song Yan and emergency doctor Xu Qin were separated by family opposition when they were younger. Now ten years later, they meet again due to their professions. After experiencing life and death together, they manage to find their way back, working together and encouraging each other. They acknowledge each other's individual growth after years apart, but will they be able to overcome the obstacles in their path this time to stay together?

title: Behind Bars: The World's Toughest Prisons
summary: Imagine prisons so tough that even the hardest gang bosses and murderers learn the meaning of fear. This extraordinary series offers intimate portraits of crime and punishment set within the gates, walls, barred windows, and cells of the world's toughest maximum-security prisons. From Bolivia to Bulgaria, Dallas to Arizona, viewers meet hardened criminals with stories that shake them to the core.

title: Bright Future
summary: A county party secretary Mei Xiaoge attempts to introduce reforms that he and his colleagues believe needs to be enacted to bring about much needed change and development to the lives of the people of Guangming county.

title: Calle y Poché: Sin Etiquetas
summary: At the peak of their successful careers as content creators, Calle and Poché return to Colombia to reunite with their families, their group of friends, and confront the challenges of their romantic relationship combined with their individual ambitions.

title: Jalas o Te Rajas
summary: Escorpión Dorado and Facundo end their rivalry and sign a contract committing to compete in ten extreme challenges designed by their celebrity friends, who want to see them suffer. Road tripping, competing, earning money, and being punished is the only way to prove who's the real god and who's the mere mortal.

title: Petronix Defenders
summary: Meet Matt, Jia, Emma and Tim. These four students at Edwin Doolittle Elementary School may look like ordinary kids, but these friends are anything but. That's because when animals around the world get into trouble, something incredible happens! Matt, Jia, Emma and Tim receive a special signal on their high-tech backpacks, alerting them to the trouble. Now the friends put their ordinary school life on hold and leap into action, transforming into an extraordinary rescue team known as the Petronix Defenders!

title: Six Zeros
summary: Winning the lottery is the ultimate dream come true. Everybody fantasizes about winning the big prize and living life without a worry in the world. It comes with all sorts of boons: a private jet, trips around the world, and your own soccer team. The problem is that there is the fantasy, and then there is reality, and "nary the twain shall meet." Actually, most lottery winners lose all their money within just a few years of when they first won it. Some of them become addicts – to gambling or drugs. Some get tangled up in the gray market, while some get into all sorts of fights with their families. The actual winners talk about a radical shift in their lives – one that is too much for them to handle. They say they would rather go back to the way things were, before they won all that money.

lead_actors: Dakota Laden, Chelsea Laden, Tanner Wiseman, Alex Schroeder
title: Project Fear
summary: After the devastating cancellation of their hit show, "Destination Fear", Dakota, Chelsea, Tanner, and Alex rule out the option of ending their terrifying road trips and continue their paranormal investigations by uncovering some of the most haunted places in all of America and the world.

title: Tie the Not
summary: Will they be able to Tie the Knot? or Not? Briggs is a simple guy who never got a chance to fall in love because of his responsibilities in their bridal car business, then love finally struck when he met Shao. The problem is Shao is set to be wed with Louise because of an arranged marriage. Tie The Not is a story of sexual awakening and acceptance. It will teach you that true love is how we define it. That it is never too late to fall in love, and that true love is worth fighting for.

lead_actors: Patrick Criado, Marcos Ruiz, Miquel Fernández, Israel Elejalde, Roberto Álamo
title: Las noches de Tefía
summary: Between 1954 and 1966, in a desert area of Fuerteventura, there was a Francoist concentration camp known by the euphemistic name of Colonia Agrícola Penitenciaria de Tefía, one of many places where the regime sent those condemned by the law as vagrants and thugs who, from 1954, it was implemented to also include homosexuals.

title: Ikaron HaHachlafa
summary: After solving the complex and brutal murder of a judge, Israeli Police forensics officer Atlas suffers a complete breakdown. Homeless, he lives rough on the streets of Tel Aviv, alone and cut off from friends, family and society… until the day his past catches up with him. Atlas begins a feverish re-examination of the circumstances surrounding his last case, and embarks on a hunt for the real murderer. Joined on his quest by young prosecutor Dita Hispin, he soon finds himself facing the harshest of dilemmas: is the truth worth the price of its revelation? And can the pursuit of justice make amends for the crimes of the past?

lead_actors: Malvino Salvador, Maria Manoella, Denise Weinberg, Emílio de Mello, Barbara Reis
title: Negociador
summary: Gabriel Menck, GATE's expert negotiator, returns to work after months away. In addition to dealing with the trauma of his wife's death and his son's silence, he will have to face professional challenges, a former vengeful superior and being the prime suspect in his wife's death.

lead_actors: Giray Altınok, Hüseyin Avni Danyal, Ceyda Düvenci, Aslı Tandoğan, Serdar Orçin
title: Prens
summary: Bongomia is a country that no one cares about, in a history that no one cares about. After the sudden and suspicious death of Thun, king of Bongomia, a complicated story begins when the Prince, whom no one takes seriously and whose family does not even bother to name, comes to the throne.

title: Dom pod Dwoma Orlami
summary: Marianna, an architecture student, returns from a scholarship in the USA to her family home in Wrocław. Marianna comes to Poland with her fiancé Paul, whose family has Polish roots and who decided to visit their homeland in the former Kresy.

title: Guilty Flag
summary: Sagara Ryosuke is an ordinary salaryman and he works for a mid-size shipping company. He is a good natured person. His family consists of his wife Maho, high school student daughter and elementary school student son. Maho works part-time at a supermarket. They are a happy family, but, Maho and their two children suddenly disappear. There are no clues about their disappearance. Ryosuke gets the attention of the media and public. He tries to find the truth behind his family's disappearance with the help of his subordinate Ninomiya Mizuho at work.

title: Kart postal
summary: The story revolves around Joseph, an introverted English archaeologist of Greek descent who returns to Greece to take a consulting position on an excavation. Only the foundations on which he has built his life prove to be shaky. He will wander in Crete on a fascinating and dynamic journey into the inner world of his soul.

title: Los Prisioneros
summary: Follows the life of the three members of "Los Prisioneros" during key moments of their careers. As they become an iconic band, and still today resonate.

title: One Cent Thief
summary: Follows a young, ambitious banker who desperately needed to cure his ailing father and restore his self-worth. He started stealing 1 cent from other people's bank accounts.

title: Mia nyhta tou Avgoustou
summary: Mia nyhta tou Avgoustou is a series that tells the tragic aftermath of a femicide. Prisons of all kinds that people build around them. But also the need for redemption, hope, love, which is inevitably always born from ashes.

title: Contado por Mulheres
summary: Ten books, ten municipalities, ten women directors, ten TV-movies. The same universe: Told by Women. Comedy, romance, adventure, historical dramas, narrative content by great Portuguese-speaking writers and the vision of ten women directors from different generations and different creative backgrounds who portray a country that, in the last 100 years, finds itself towards freedom.

title: Munkkivuori
summary: In early 1980s a young child disappears. The lack of police support pushes the concerned parents to take justice into their own hands and launch a desperate manhunt that is seen from the perspective of the local children.

title: Makeup X Breakup
summary: When Brooke blindsides Blake and ends their two year relationship, Blake doesn't hesitate before jumping back into the New York dating scene.

title: Burb Patrol
summary: Burb Patrol follows the workplace adventures of Randall, an uncompromising by-the-book security guard and his partner Alex, an unmotivated slacker as the duo keeps the members of a gated suburban community safe against a slew of first-world problems.

title: Sztárok a reptéren
summary: Reality show in which we can see well-known celebrities working at the airport.

title: A Match by Maid
summary: The most chaotic story of "servant gangs" from two high society houses that were hired to match their own masters. The obstacle is the fact that both houses have hated each other for generations.

title: Kerala Crime Files
summary: A team of six policemen led by Sub-Inspector Manoj is on a chase to solve a murder in a suburban lodge room, with just one clue - a fake address, Shiju, Parayil Veedu, Neendakara, from a lodge register.

lead_actors: Joe Daymond, Natalie Samy, Dre Mane
title: Bouncers
summary: A mockumentary series that follows a rag-tag trio of clueless security officers and their boisterous supervisor as they struggle to keep their jobs.

lead_actors: Annabel Scholey, Jack Farthing, Luke Treadaway, Julie Graham, Angela Griffin
title: The Serial Killer's Wife
summary: Set in an idyllic English town, Beth Fairchild has prepared a surprise birthday party for her husband Tom. With most of the village present as Tom is the beloved local doctor, Beth's world is turned upside down when the party is interrupted by the police and Tom is arrested for murder. Beth believes her husband has been wrongly accused but she soon makes some shocking discoveries that cast doubt on his innocence, and she confides her worries in Adam, Tom's best friend from childhood.

title: FBOY Island Australia
summary: Follows three women on their quest to find love as they attempt to uncover who are the "nice guys" looking for love, and who are the self-proclaimed "FBoys".

lead_actors: Mustafa Mert Koç, Nilsu Berfin Aktas, Efekan Can, Oya Başar, Yeşim Ceren Bozoğlu
title: Yaz Şarkısı
summary: Yaz Şarkısı tells the story of Yaz, who clings to her father's dream and tries to make it come true in Istanbul, where she came to study.

title: Agent
summary: Nikolaj Lie Kaas' comedy drama series about Joe, who works as an agent for stars in the entertainment industry. But it's not going quite as well as it could.

title: The Floor
summary: The Floor is a physical quiz show that sees 81 contestants face off in quiz duels on a giant LED floor divided into a 9×9 grid of squares, each representing its own field of knowledge.The first challenger, selected at random, must choose one of his or her neighboring opponents to go head-to-head in an epic quiz duel in the opponent's category. The winner takes over the loser's square, gaining valuable ground as they expand their territory, while the loser exits the game. The winner must then choose – do they continue on and attempt to secure another square? Or do they let The Floor choose a new challenger? The last contestant standing who gains full control over The Floor takes home a life-changing $250,000 cash prize.

title: Brocéliande
summary: Fanny Legoff returns to Brocéliande University from Paris after 15 years in Paris after leaving under suspicion she was involved in the disappearance of her friend Laura.

title: Rivière perdue
summary: On a winding road in the Pyrenees, a spectacular car accident turns out to be miraculous: the reappearance of Anna, a teenager who disappeared 5 years ago. Captain Alix Stern and Commissioner Balthus are deployed alongside Victor Ferrer, the head of the local gendarmerie, to embark on a race against time. Find the trace of Lucie, a young girl kidnapped at the same time as Anna and who has not reappeared...

title: Panda
summary: Relaxed pacifist, matcha'addict and convinced vegan, Panda runs a small hut in a remote corner of the Camargue. No laptop, no computer, no car, he lives with his 16-year-old teenager in this perfect cocoon of peace and serenity. Alas, even in paradise, there's no way to be quiet. The day his old life comes knocking at the door, Panda finds himself forced to return to service... But in his own way. Zen, what.

title: Dimitri
summary: Dimitri is a little bird who will fly south with his parents. When they get caught in a storm, Dimitri loses his parents and ends up in Ubuyu in Africa. While he is looking for his parents, he gets to know Makeba the giraffe, Oko the zebra and Pili the meerkat.

title: Raid the Cage
summary: Raid the Cage features two teams of two facing off to grab-and-go with prizes from the Cage before their time runs out and the doors close. Correctly answering questions adds seconds to the clock, giving teammates more time to grab prizes from the Cage. After three rounds, the team who banks the highest total dollar value in prizes wins the game, keeps what they have grabbed so far and plays the final round for even bigger prizes including a car.

title: Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence
summary: Dwelling in the small outskirts of a peaceful town, Lawrence works as a local pastor for the townsfolk. When in need, he is responsible for guiding people to the church to visit the "Saint"—a symbol of good morals who heeds each parishioner's struggles and grants them sincere advice. Cecilia, a kind young girl, is tasked to fulfill this role; however, this tiresome job quickly exhausts her. That, paired with her hidden somnolent nature, often causes her to laze around the church. This leaves Lawrence to care for the church all by himself. While Cecilia sleeps in anticipation for her next visitor, Lawrence caters to her needs alongside performing the church's numerous responsibilities.Slowly but surely, they begin to form a comfortable and trusting friendship with one another. Lawrence accepting Cecilia's lax nature elates her while she grows accustomed to Lawrence's overly-doting nature. However, as the adoring and absent-minded saint's feelings for the dense and overly protective pastor progress past friendship, how will he respond?

title: Okashi na Tensei
summary: A promising pâtissier meets his demise and leaves the world without ever having achieved his dream of making the world's greatest pastry. But when he is given another chance, he reincarnates as nine-year-old Pastry Mille Morteln, determined to be successful this second time. His life would not be as sweet as his treats, though, as he encounters unfamiliar hardships in the magical world. To get one step closer to his lifelong desire, Pastry must learn how to fight, utilizing his confectionary knowledge and discovering magic along the way.

title: Captain Biceps
summary: Captain Biceps is the strongest! Captain Biceps has fists like steel! Captain Biceps is a Super Hero! He's not afraid of anything or anybody, well … except his mom! What ?!… he didn't tell you about her? Captain Biceps still lives with his mother, Carmina! Some people say he's a bit of a simpleton. Bah! It just depends on how you look at it. In fact, Captain Biceps is just a big kid! Hmmm… and what if that actually explained the secret of his invincibility? Because Captain Biceps also has the colorful imagination of a little kid, overflowing with whacky and absurd ideas, that are actually pretty efficient! And that's why he always wins… in the end. Helped by his faithful sidekick, Genius Boy, Captain Biceps keeps the world safe from the terrible threats of a bunch of Super Bad Guys!

title: Bush Wreck Rescue
summary: Western Canadian motorheads obsessed with turning abandoned trucks into custom gems, hunt for old rust buckets, drag them out of the bush and go to great lengths to transform them into vintage classics.

lead_actors: Adjani Salmon, Demmy Ladipo, Rachel Adedeji, Babirye Bukilwa, Dani Moseley
creators: Adjani Salmon, Maximilian Evans, Natasha Jatania, Laura Seixas
title: Dreaming Whilst Black
summary: Loosely inspired by real life events, Dreaming Whilst Black tells the story of Kwabena, an aspiring filmmaker stuck in a dead-end recruitment job who takes the first step to achieving his dream. However, he is quickly confronted with the tribulations of balancing finances, love, and his own sense of reality.

title: Abadas
summary: In a busy corner of Ben's bedroom lies a well-thumbed, well cherished pop-up book. This is no ordinary pop-up book... this is where the Abadas live! Hari the hippo, Ela the fox and Seren the bat are the most curious, adventurous and funniest pop-up animals that any book could possibly have. Once the book is opened, the Abadas' world comes alive and it's playtime for the three adventurers.

title: Muhamiat Alshaytan
summary: In Kuwait City, a determined defense lawyer defies popular sentiment and takes on a polarizing client: a footballer accused of murdering his wife.

title: Dai Byouin Senkyo
summary: A prestigious hospital is suddenly seized by a violent armed group, throwing patients and staff into chaos. A determined detective must navigate the hostage crisis while uncovering the attackers' hidden motives and fighting to save lives.

title: Fit Check
summary: Much like the ukay (secondhand) clothes that she sells, Melanie was also "discarded," abandoned by her own mother when she was a baby. She dreams of making it big as a fashion designer, to prove her worth and show her mother that she should've never left her. She finds the opportunity of a lifetime when a handsome young fashion executive, Chris, takes notice of her talents. As Melanie steps into the fast-paced and cutthroat world of the Filipino fashion industry, she also finds herself on a journey towards self-awareness, empowerment, forgiveness, and the possibility of true love.

title: Divine Destiny
summary: A piece of bluestone beside the Tianhe River in the fairy world. Because of hearing the nine books of the heavenly book chanted by immortals in the world, he was able to get rid of the stone body and cultivate into a fairy womb. The bluestone, which had just turned into a human form, accidentally walked away a sky demon, and was convicted into the turbid world, and the patrolling immortal was also removed from the immortal class. Before falling into reincarnation, the two met for a hundred generations. In a blink of an eye, it is the last life of a hundred reincarnation after a thousand years. The birth of Xianxian caused a dispute between righteous and evil people and demons.

lead_actors: Jun Fukuyama, Yoshitsugu Matsuoka, Takuya Eguchi, Rie Takahashi, Hiro Shimono
title: Chibi Godzilla Raids Again
summary: One day, Chibi Godzilla, who lives on Monster Island, found Chibi Mechagodzilla washed up on the shore. The pair's meeting begins an everyday life beyond human understanding for these chibi monsters with abundant personalities! Don't miss the astonishing wars of words contained in these 160-second volumes! This is a story of encounters and counterattacks...

title: Survive the Raft
summary: Nine Americans from wildly diverse backgrounds and beliefs have arrived in Panama to test their ability to collaborate in a social experiment for a chance to win life-changing money. Will their differences cause conflict or lead to success?

title: Gemma & Gorka: Life Behind the Lens
summary: Gemma and Gorka: Life Behind the Lens is a series following the genuine emotional ups and downs that actor Gemma Atkinson and Strictly star Gorka Marquez go through, as a relatable - yet famous - couple with a young, growing family.

title: Fiasco
summary: Raphaël Valande is shooting his first feature film to pay tribute to the heroic life of his resistant grandmother. The shooting gradually turns into a nightmare due to a member of the team who does everything to sabotage it.

lead_actors: Darío Barassi, Consuelo Duval, Maryel Abrego, Santiago Torres, Patricio Alvarado
title: C.H.U.E.C.O.
summary: A man and his three children receive, as part of an inheritance, a pet chimpanzee named Chueco.

lead_actors: Rasika Dugal, Ishwak Singh, Shrenik Arora
title: Adhura
summary: A supernatural thriller set in an elite boarding school which hides a secret so dark and dreadful that it will shake up everything.

title: Soul Land 2: The Unrivaled Tang Sect
summary: The Tang Sect in a turbulent world. There is nothing but martial spirit here. Ten thousand years after the founding of the Tang Sect, it is in relative decline. An extremely talented man was born. Can the new Shrek Seven Monsters revive the Tang Sect and bring it back to glory? A soul beast of over one million years old; Electrolux who can pick stars; The new soul utensil system that led to the decline of the Tang Sect... A lot of secrets are to be revealed. Can the secret weapons of the Tang Sect be sharp again? Can the Tang Sect regain its former glory?

lead_actors: Chiaki Kobayashi, Ayumu Murase, Ai Fairouz, Rina Hidaka, Reina Ueda
title: Ragna Crimson
summary: Ever since the Dragons became a threat to the human race, hunters have been hunting them down for the rewards of killing them. But this is by no means an easy task. Only those able to transcend the limits of the human condition are able to stand up to the mighty winged creatures. Ragna, a relatively weak young man, teams up with Léonica, an exceptional hunter, who has already eliminated more Dragons than anyone. Only, following a tragic event, Ragna finds himself alone, driven by an insatiable thirst for revenge. Desperate to face and crush his enemies, he decides to team up with Crimson, a dark being who shares the same motivations as him: to eliminate the dragon monarchs for good.

title: New Leash on Life
summary: Comedian Joel Creasey and dog expert Laura V are on a mission to rescue pound dogs and pair them with a family in need of a hound.Across 6 different episodes, Joel and Laura work towards a mutual rescue, that sees a dog paired with a new owner. But these matches can be complex, and Laura must ensure the dog will work well in the prospective new home, and just as importantly, that the owner is the right fit for the dog.

title: Falso amor
summary: Five couples put their trust to the test in this steamy reality series, where deepfake technology blurs the line of truth and lies in a cash prize game.

title: Gangstars
summary: The series is set in the backdrop of the film industry and involves two movie stars, two ex-lovers, and one gangster. One incident sets up a chain of events in motion and interconnects the lives of all these characters, interspersed with a murder is the intriguing crux of the narrative.

title: Bibi & Tina
summary: Live-action series based on the adventures of a teenage witch named Bibi and her best friend, Tina.

lead_actors: Takuma Terashima, Sayumi Suzushiro, Natsumi Fujiwara, Asami Seto, Junji Majima
title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special
summary: The world is on the brink of destruction after a devastating ten-year war in the "shadow labyrinth." Desir Herrman is one of the last skilled magicians left standing, but even he is no match for the formidable foe threatening humanity's very existence. Just when he's certain the end has come, he is sent back in time to his early days of studying magic at the prestigious Hebrion Academy! With this rare second chance, Desir is determined to save not only himself but also the friends and comrades he once lost. Armed with the knowledge of what their future holds, can his efforts make a difference, or are they all doomed to relive the same terrible destiny? Based on the hit novel.

title: Hana Sugisaki's Filming Break
summary: Depicts how Hana Sugisaki spends her days off during breaks in shooting dramas and movies.

lead_actors: Marian Álvarez, Fernando Valdivielso, Victor Rivas, Carlos Santos, Álex Gadea
creators: Álex de la Iglesia, Jorge Guerricaechevarría
summary: Tragedy and addiction cost Richi his job as a cop, but a fatal blast compels him to join his late friend's widow in a frantic hunt for a serial killer.

title: 90 Day: The Last Resort
summary: 90 Day: The Last Resort couples have reached their breaking points. In a final attempt to salvage their relationships, each couple will participate in a couples retreat to determine whether or not they can heal old wounds. Alongside a team of professionals, they'll actively navigate issues with trust, sex, jealousy, anger, and intimacy. Explosive group therapies, intense couples' sessions, past life regressions, unique on-and-off-resort activities, and so much more ensue. At the end of the retreat, each couple must decide if they will stay together or move on, separately.

title: Red Skies
summary: Ali, a Palestinian, and Sa'ar, an Israeli, met at a peace camp as children, and grew up together in war-torn Jerusalem. Their own personal tragedies made them as close as brothers. When the second intifada strikes, the two best friends suddenly find themselves on opposite sides of the conflict: Ali must abandon his dream of becoming a surgeon to join an armed militia in Nablus, while Sa'ar is recruited to a secret Israeli intelligence unit leading the search for a mysterious commander of the Palestinian militia. Jenny, an American war journalist who loves them both, will have to pick a side.

title: You're My Hero
summary: This series is about a 20-something with cerebral palsy who navigates the pressures of adult life in a world not designed for wheels. Honest, insightful and daring, You're My Hero shakes up the prevailing views on what it means to be living with a disability.

title: Malenfant
summary: Malenfant plunges us into the heart of the life of a go-getter, working and dreaming for whom everything is possible, that of Raymond Malenfant. Starting from nothing and driven by the desire to build, he sets up an impressive empire. Supported by his wife, Colette, and four children, he becomes one of the most outstanding entrepreneurs in Quebec (Canada). The conflict of Manoir Richelieu explodes while Raymond is at the height of his glory. As the owner of the establishment, he is in the headlines while refusing to recognize the union. Follows for Raymond Malenfant bankruptcy, one of the largest in the history of the country. His hotel empire collapses like a house of cards. While it is believed annihilated, Raymond Malenfant has not yet said his last word.

title: Operação Fronteira Brasil
summary: On the borders of Brazil, people put into practice far-fetched schemes to try to enter the national territory with weapons, drugs and smuggled products.

title: Holden Bros. Restos
summary: In the hill country of Central Texas outside of San Antonio, two brothers set out to face a new challenge as far as car builders go. Willie and Stephen Holden are building cars on a budget, $25,000 to be exact. In each episode, they'll find a car for $5K and use the rest to transform it into a cool ride any gearhead would want.

lead_actors: Shane Cunningham, Jillian Smart, Isabella Campbell
creators: Shane Cunningham, Jonathan Popalis, Mike Veerman
title: The Dessert
summary: Bruce McCulloch of "The Kids in the Hall" presents the next generation of Canadian sketch comedy with an all-out, boundary pushing expedition to the edge of decency. The Dessert is an audacious and rapid-fire celebration of the absurd.

schedule_days: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: White Cat Legend
summary: The series is adapted from the ancient-style detective work of the comic artist RC, titled "White Cat Legend," and it tells the story of the mysterious new Assistant Minister of Dali Temple, Li Bing, leading the members of Dali Temple on thrilling investigations and adventures while safeguarding their inner sense of justice. The story takes place in the imperial capital under the rule of the empress. During a banquet at the Tang Palace, Li Bing (played by Ding Yuxi), who is highly regarded by the empress, is appointed as the Assistant Minister of Dali Temple. Within Dali Temple, Chen Shi (played by Zhou Qi), Wang Qi (played by Feng Man), Alibaba (played by Wa'er), Cui Bei (played by Ding Jiawen), and Sun Bao (played by Zhang Yicong) work together under the guidance of the newly appointed Assistant Minister, Li Bing, to unravel the layers of mist in the imperial capital. They support each other and defy their fate while upholding their inner sense of justice.

title: Naked and Afraid: Castaways
summary: Nine challengers are abandoned at a remote tropical island, with no maps or tools, miles away from civilization. In teams of three, they must swim to different ecosystems on the same island - sun-scorched beach, twisted mangrove swamp and dense jungle - to begin their distinct survival journeys. They must use only their navigational skills and fashion everything they need to survive from wreckage and debris strewn across the island, including a shipwreck, an abandoned military jeep and a crashed airplane. Without knives, pots, and fire starters, challengers will need to scavenge the area to find what they need to create those items from scratch, using only their ingenuity and will to survive.In a Naked and Afraid franchise first, remaining survivalists will need to travel to the same extraction point on Day 21 and signal a boat for rescue.

lead_actors: Şebnem Bozoklu, Tolga Tekin, Aras Şenol, Metin Coşkun, Uğur Demirpehlivan
title: Hayatımın Neşesi
summary: The colorful story of a woman named Neşe and her family, who dropped out of medical school, got married and had children, and returned to school after taking advantage of the amnesty after the children grew up.

title: Melody, la chica del metro
summary: The series tells Melody's story, an adolescent full of dreams that seem impossible. Accompanied by her best friends, she sings in the subway of a small city, dreaming of being able to make a living from her music, but without her family knowing, because they strictly forbid her from embracing her vocation, simply due to fear. Melody passionately admires Layla, a pop music star that lives in the United States and towards whom she feels an irrational attachment. Melody wants to be like her, although she knows that meeting her is impossible. Layla, on the other hand, understands that fame is not the most important thing in life and tries to reconnect with her deepest wish, to be herself again. Suddenly, a strange and magical connection occurs between them, joining their worlds over a great distance.

title: True Story Suomi
summary: The very first Finnish Max Original entertainment programme True Story Suomi brings the most hilarious and relatable Finnish true stories to the limelight. Consisting of six episodes, the show is hosted by radio personalities Viki and Köpi.

lead_actors: Şükrü Özyıldız, Burcu Özberk, Tuğrul Tülek, Aslı Sümen, Şehsuvar Aktaş
title: Ruhun Duymaz
summary: Onur Karasu is a successful intelligence agent who was promoted to head of the department at a young age and has been after Civan Koral, the owner of Turkey's largest jewelry company. Onur, who thinks that Civan keeps the documents related to his illegal business in the safe in his house, becomes lovers with Civan's sister Hilal in order to get in and out of the house. When he learns that Civan will move abroad, Onur makes a sudden decision to propose to Hilal in order to get the documents without letting her get away. He plans to open the safe on their engagement day and arrest Civan, who is there for his sister's engagement. What he doesn't take into account is Hilal's close friend Ece. While Ece is trying to figure out what Onur is up to, her plans are upset when Onur catches her. Onur and Ece, two poles as opposite as day and night, will have to work together in a way they never wanted to.

title: Wake Up
summary: Wake Up is the new international tool developed by the E.D.U. (Education Department Unit) that will revolutionize the global education system forever. The idea of learning using only one app, seems attractive enough to catch a group of young people who will become the pioneers of the experiment.

lead_actors: Mads Hansen, Martha Leivestad, Martin Beyer-Olsen
title: Folkets deltaker
summary: Now it's the common people's turn! Over 1,100 applied - who will be the "People's participant" in Mads Hansen's cabin? Take part in auditions and comedy competitions and see who wins a place on "Ikke lov å le på hytta"!

lead_actors: Didi Romero, Gabriel Tarantini, Ana Gabriela Wolfermann, Felipe Albors Riera
title: @Gina Yei: #ConTodoElCorazónYMás
summary: Gina, won a scholarship at the Instituto Musical del Caribe. Her ultimate dream is to compose songs for great artists and let everyone know her ideas and feelings, but she finds things seem immensely more complex than she expected.

lead_actors: Jing Boran, Zhou Yi Ran, Wang Yan Hui, Huang Jue, Zhang Yi Fan
title: Regeneration
summary: A memorial service for Fei Ke (Jing Boran) brings together female journalist He Shan (Zhou Yiran) and four strangers who are invited. They all share undisclosed pasts with Fei Ke, but they discover that the Fei Ke they knew is not the same person. Who is Fei Ke really? As they look back, the group gradually uncovers the truth about Fei Ke.

lead_actors: Hina Youmiya, Rin Tateishi, Hina Aoki, Mika Kohinata, Coco Hayashi
title: BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!

lead_actors: Guo Qi Lin, Wu Zhi Qiang, Qi Xi, You Yong, Wang Xun
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Escape from the Trilateral Slopes
summary: Trilateral Slopes, a tropical exotic melting pot teeming with all kinds of people, a place where prosperity and decay coexist. Shen Xing, a laborer who unexpectedly ends up here, crosses paths with Mr. Cai, a local wheeler-dealer navigating through the various forces at play. Together, they embark on an adventure, guided by a glimmer of kindness, as they face the struggle between staying and escaping. How will their story unfold in the midst of the disarray?

title: Pasteleros contra el tiempo
summary: Set in Mexico, this thrilling baking competition will capture your heart with super-sweet cakes — and even sweeter personal stories.

title: Emergency Interrogation Room
summary: Makabe Yukiko, the head of the Special Investigation Team's Third Section, prides herself on her superior negotiation skills. She tries to convince a criminal who is holding a bus hostage. However, an unanticipated situation arises and she fails. Yukiko is held fully responsible and is ordered to transfer to the Emergency Investigation Response Team, which goes by the name of Kintori. The director, Kajiyama Katsutoshi, whom she has always not got along well with, heads the Kintori. It is a professional team of outstanding interrogators put together to carry out interrogations, particularly for cases that are deemed important. Yukiko embarks on a new chapter at the Kintori surrounded by idiosyncratic veterans Hishimoto Susumu, Nakata Zenjiro, Koishikawa Haruo. She also determines the truth of an unsolved case deeply linked to her past.

lead_actors: Валерия Бурдужа, Антонина Дивина, Пётр Рыков, Евгений Шириков
title: Украденная жизнь
summary: Stepsisters Masha and Vasilisa did not suspect each other's existence until fate collided with them years later. Both have no idea that their new love will turn into disaster. And the sisters, deceived by one groom for two, will become bargaining chips in a men's game for a place in the sun.

lead_actors: Jonathan Meinert Pedersen, Jacob Spang Olsen
title: En af drengene
summary: Teenage Lau struggles with societal expectations of masculinity until a chance encounter with the fearless Aksel challenges his perceptions.

lead_actors: Алексей Бардуков, Татьяна Чердынцева, Кирилл Жандаров
title: Замаячный
summary: In their youth, investigator Ekaterina Mazurova and operative Sergei Polyakov witnessed tragic events that took place in their native village of Zamayachny, which then received the unflattering nickname Yama. In 1990, a maniac appeared there. His victims were several girls, including Valya - Katya's own sister and Sergei's fiancée. Then the murders stopped - as suddenly as they began. For a long eleven years. And all this time Sergei lived with a thirst for revenge, and Katya, in order not to go crazy, simply erased that terrible summer from her memory. But the maniac came back again. And now Katya and Sergei will have to meet again to once and for all deal with the past, which, as it turned out, never let them go.

lead_actors: Jitka Čvančarová, Petra Buckova, Michal Isteník, Jiří Dvořák, Jana Svandová
title: Hlava Medúzy
CMT Summer Sessions
summary: Country stars share new music and some of their biggest hits at a beautiful lake in Tennessee.

title: Choona
summary: When an unlikely group of misfits discovers a common enemy in the same ruthless yet superstitious politician, they plot a heist to exact revenge.

lead_actors: Elia Nuzzolo, Matteo Oscar Giuggioli, Alberto Astorri, Ludovica Barbarito, Davide Calgaro
title: Hanno ucciso L'Uomo Ragno - La leggendaria storia degli 883
summary: Pavia, late Eighties. Max loves comics and American music. He is a maverick in a city where there is nothing to rebel against. In addition, after having neglected high school to follow new friendships and punk evenings, the rejection inevitably arrives. This failure actually turns out to be a new, fatal opportunity: moving to a new school, he meets a new classmate, Mauro. Music makes them inseparable. Thanks to the driving force of Mauro, Max embraces his talent and together with him composes the first songs that will be produced by Claudio Cecchetto. But when success overwhelms them, will Max and Mauro, so different, be able to stay united?

title: Haus Kummerveldt
summary: Luise von Kummerveldt wants to live free from the compulsion and conventions of her noble family and the patriarchal society and work as an author. But as a women in the Wilhelmine kingdom her freedom of action is as tight as her corset. Resignation Suicid? Rebellion? Luise chooses the last one...

title: High Speed Chase
summary: Get in the driver's seat for some of the most extraordinary police chases ever captured on camera -- with never-before-seen footage, it's a fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled window into a world where criminals will do anything to escape.

title: Khloe
summary: Khloe Wong (Hanli Hoefer), a charismatic but ruthless influencer, engineers a social media scandal to nab a starring role in acclaimed local director Bob Chandra's (Ebi Shankara) highly-anticipated comeback movie. She murders her co-star, pop artist Chris Chan, in self-defense.

title: Meme Girls
summary: The aspiring influencer Liv (Josie Hermer) is sentenced to an offline life by her father because of poor school performance. From the private high school, she also goes back to the Normalo comprehensive school. But Liv has no intention of sacrificing her career for something as trivial as school.

title: Time Zone
summary: Outside its perimeter is desert and dust, inside,10 players will take on thrilling challenges and complete the levels to defeat the Master of Time. eSports presenter and streamer, Cristinini, will embody this role and monitor the players' progress as they race against the clock. Each level will require great mental and physical skill, and in this competition, time is everything, as at the end of each round, the player with the least amount of it remaining is eliminated.

title: Fight to Survive
summary: In Fight to Survive, Akbar Gbajabiamila hosts a social experiment in primitive survivalism—with a competitive twist. Seventeen competitors, including former "Survivor," "Alone," "Naked and Afraid," and "American Ninja Warrior" contestants, must survive 25 days on a remote tropical island combatting brutal conditions—and each other—to win $250,000. In one of the most intense survival-of-the-fittest competitions ever televised, the competitors battle one another for essential tools and resources in the fight to survive.

lead_actors: Eddie Jackson, Antonia Lofaso, Jonathan Bennett
title: Battle of the Decades
summary: In Battle of the Decades, three teams take on a series of challenges for the chance to make it to the final round. In round one it is all about nostalgia as host Jonathan Bennett reveals the contents of a time capsule which includes mandatory ingredients and a cooking gadget from a particular year that must be used in the first dish. The chefs will have to employ everything from an electric grill to a fondue pot to accomplish their missions. In round two, the remaining teams have to put their own spin on viral food trends like smiley fries and spicy vodka pasta. Then, in round three, the final team standing must face off against each other to create their version of a timeless dish like Chicken Kiev and Beef Wellington, for the ultimate test of the decades. In the end, only one chef will walk away with $10,000.

title: Dessert Masters
summary: This mouth-watering series will see 10 of Australia's most decorated pastry chefs, chocolate connoisseurs and baking experts whisk it all to be named Australia's first ever Dessert Master.Juggernaut judges Melissa Leong and Amaury Guichon are ready and raring to taste their way through what will be some of the most inventive and irresistible desserts Australia has ever seen.

lead_actors: Amr Youssef, Asser Yassin, Khaled El-Sawi, Fathy Abdel Wahab, Lebleba
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: El Kateeba 101
summary: Sinai, 2014. Battalion 101 in the Egyptian army wages a ruthless war against the most dangerous terrorist organizations, turning impossible odds into reality.

title: Popularity Papers
summary: Popularity Papers follows middle-school besties Julie and Lydia as they seek to demystify one of life's greatest questions: what makes someone popular? Every social experiment they test out comes with unexpected lessons about the value of friendship, kindness, and confidence, helping guide our characters through the struggles of middle school with humour and heart.

title: Ihesaldia
summary: In 1976 a group of prisoners from Basauri prison simulates their own escape. No one imagines that they are still inside the prison, digging a tunnel where to escape.

title: Hyakushou Kizoku
summary: The story follows Arakawa as she worked as a farmer in Hokkaido for seven years before she became a manga creator. The experience eventually informed her work on her Silver Spoon manga, which centers on students of an agricultural school

title: Dead Landes, Les escapés
summary: A team of journalists came to report on the departure of the vacationers at L'Escapade, a small campsite in the Landes. But suddenly, the end of the world seems to arrive, leaving the last vacationers in a total blur. Are they the last survivors of humanity? In front of journalists' cameras, they will try to survive, live together and understand what is happening to them...

title: MasterChef France
summary: A large number of amateur chefs compete in the MasterChef France kitchen to impress three judges in order to become the MasterChef France winner.

lead_actors: Marcelo Adnet, Leandro Hassum, Taís Araújo, Helena Fernandes, Otávio Augusto
title: O Dentista Mascarado
summary: Paladino is a dentist who fights cavities during the day and crime at night. For that, he will have the support of the clumsy Sérgio, who makes dental prostheses during the day, and of Sheila, his dubious secretary, owner of many facets, known in the square by her various names. The villain of the series is Detective Miller, who will do everything to discover the identity of the heroes. That's because the trio will end up committing crimes and breaking everything else that helps society. Because of this, the lawyer Vera will have to cut a corner to defend the anti-heroes. Also in the series is Eurico, a retired police officer and Paladino's sensationalist father. The hero had a tumultuous childhood relationship and tries to overcome his father, who worked as a police chief, in the fight against crime.

title: Cóndor Uno-Cero-Cinco
summary: A series inspired by real events that tells the story of "Operation Condor" and fictionally recounts one of the first claims to Argentine sovereignty over the Malvinas Islands. The operation carried out by some young Argentines who diverted an Aerolíneas Argentinas plane bound for Río Gallegos and made it land in the Malvinas Islands.

title: Command Z
summary: "This is historic — literally."At least, that's what a digital Michael Cera says at the start of the trailer for Steven Soderbergh's upcoming sci-fi comedy series, "Command Z." The "Ocean's 11″-through-"13" director has rounded up Cera, Roy Wood Jr., Chloe Radcliffe and Liev Schreiber for a post-apocalyptic look back at the year 2023, as they traverse into the past by putting a wormhole in a washing machine."Here's the funny part. Traversing our wormhole involves ingesting a synthetic substance related to psychedelics and playing the theme song from the movie ‘Mahogany,'" says the Ozian Cera. He leads Wood Jr., Radcliffe and Schreiber on a series of missions, hacking into the brains of people from 2023 to alter their thoughts and undo history, which in this universe in includes the NRA teaming with police unions and an Amazon-Walmart merger allowing for blood as payment."

title: ReuSSS
summary: It's the start of the holidays for Hanane, Maissa and Ambre, three inseparable friends who grew up in the same housing estate. The summer will be devoted to first love stories and the transition to adulthood. But when Djamel, Hanane's older brother, is found unconscious, the 3 friends decide to find the culprit of his attack. Between screwed up boyfriends, intrusive parents and threatening drug dealers, Hanana, Maissa and Ambre can only count on their REUSSS.

lead_actors: Аглая Тарасова, Кирилл Кяро, Пётр Безменов, Полина Гухман
title: Диагноз «Везучая»
summary: Sociopath Lika is endowed with an incredible gift to bring good luck in any scam, moonlighting as a kind of "talisman" in criminal circles. But when one of the criminal authorities decides to make Lika his personal talisman, she is forced to embark on an adventure along with Anton, an unfair accountant, who is unjustly accused of money laundering through a charitable foundation. The heroine will try to prove Anton's innocence, as well as restore his relationship with his daughter Stesha.

lead_actors: Claire McCollum, Katie Larmour, Una Rodden
title: A Stitch Through Time
summary: Aspiring fashion designers take on challenges inspired by the Ulster-Scots influence.

lead_actors: Allan Souza Lima, Thainá Duarte, Hermila Guedes, Alice Carvalho, Marcélia Cartaxo
title: Cangaço Novo
summary: The series tells the story of Ubaldo, an unhappy bank clerk in the urban area of São Paulo with no memory of his childhood. He discovers that he has an inheritance and two sisters in the backlands of Ceará: Dilvânia leads a group that adores her famous late father; and Dinorah is the only woman in a gang of bank robbers.

lead_actors: Jorge A. Jiménez, Juan Luis Medina, Armando Hernández, Leonardo Alonso, Marco Treviño
title: Pancho Villa: El Centauro del Norte
summary: This is the story of Doroteo Arango, Francisco Villa, from his beginnings in banditry when he was very young, until his death in an ambush, and portrays the dark Villa, since he was a vandal, his controversial personality that led him to be General Pancho Villa, the Centauro del Norte y sus Dorados, the anti-hero who redeems himself, partly a fiction that he himself paid for and his role in the history of the Revolution. Villa generated hate and love, contempt and respect.

lead_actors: Taiki Sato, Karen Miyama, Haruka Kudou, Koudai Matsuoka, Ryôsuke Sota
title: Around 1/4
summary: The story of a complicated relationship between five heroes who met on a side job in a diner back in their student years.

lead_actors: Катя Осадча, Юрий Горбунов, Тіна Кароль, Алексей Потапенко, Святослав Вакарчук
title: Голос країни
The Big Nailed It Baking Challenge
summary: Nicole and Jacques have eaten a lot of bad cake — and now they're teaching terrible bakers the errors of their ways. Will one of them finally nail it?

lead_actors: Atsumi Tanezaki, Kana Ichinose, Chiaki Kobayashi
title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
summary: The mage Frieren defeated the Demon King alongside the hero Himmel's party after a 10-year quest. Peace was restored to the kingdom. Because she is an elf, she is able to live over a thousand years. She promises Himmel and the others that she will be back to see them and then sets out on a journey by herself. Fifty years later, Frieren goes to visit Himmel and the others. She remained unchanged, but Himmel and the others have aged and only a little of their lives remain. Later, she witnesses Himmel's death. Frieren is pained by her desire to have spent more time getting to know people. With that regret in her heart, she then goes on a journey to do just that. On her journey, she meets many people and many events await her.

lead_actors: Makoto Koichi, Ai Fairouz, Lynn, Rie Takahashi, Shun Horie
title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince So I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
summary: Prince Lloyd wasn't always a prince...in fact, his previous life is one he remembers perfectly: he was a sorcerer, of sorts. So when he was forced to reincarnate, he decided to continue his studies, prince of the realm or no! But his new life has its own sets of challenges...including being a 10-year-old! What's the 7th prince/sorcerer to do?!

title: Şebeke
summary: A journalist who goes after a secret organization that has members from every unit of the state is executed while doing research. Upon this situation, Superintendent Ali investigates the organization while trying to find the perpetrators of the murder. However, in this process, Ali finds himself in a difficult struggle.

lead_actors: Тимур Родригез, Сергей Светлаков, Марина Кравец, Алексей Щербаков, Артём Калайджян
title: Лига городов
summary: «League of Cities» is a new humorous project of TNT TV channel and AMiK company, in which teams will compete for the title of Champion of the season and a prize of 10 million rubles. Mentors, humor gurus – Sergey Svetlakov, Marina Kravets, Alexey Shcherbakov and Artem Kalaijyan - will help the teams to win in a serious humorous battle. Each of them will select teams under his wing, with which he will «work» further.62 teams from 73 cities of Russia, Belarus and Kazakhstan will take part in the first qualifying round. Only half of them will make it to the second round. Next, a stage of battles will take place, in which the teams of each mentor will compete with each other until there are four finalists left in the project. The winner of the season will be determined among them.

title: Lost in Fuseta - Ein Krimi aus Portugal
summary: It tells the story of Leander Lost, an exceptional inspector who is autistic. Lost is transferred to the small fishing town of Fuseta. He has to try somehow to fit into the new team.

title: CrimeCam 24/7
summary: Today, cameras are everywhere. From phones to drones, to home security, to both dash and body cams, more crimes are caught on camera than ever before. And retired Tulsa PD LT. Sean 'Sticks' Larkin breaks them down from every angle. Criminals - you're being watched.

title: Toya & Reginae
summary: In Toya & Reginae, fans will get to peek behind the curtain and see who they truly are - what's happening in their love lives, how they balance those relationships along with their exciting and demanding careers, and of course their relationship with each other. As happy as they appear on social media, in reality, their lives are unpredictable and full of chaos as they navigate their complex family dynamic.

title: At Home with the Furys
summary: Undefeated heavyweight champion Tyson Fury retires from boxing to embrace the eccentricities of family life in this hilarious and heartfelt docusoap.

title: My Strange Addiction: Still Addicted?
summary: Unusual cravings and strange obsessions consume these addicts' lives. Hear brand new addiction stories and catch up with fan favorites from the past.

title: Além do Guarda-Roupa
summary: Carol is a 17-year-old teenager, the daughter of a Brazilian dancer and a South Korean, who lives a challenging journey of overcoming, acceptance and self-knowledge after the death of her mother and the abandonment of her father, who decides to return to South Korea. In a conflicting relationship with her ancestry, she denies knowing any topic better than South Korean culture, but her life changes after a unique discovery: her wardrobe is actually a magic portal that connects her room to a group of k-pop of great success at the moment, ACT.

title: Cang Yuan Tu
summary: The story tells the story of Meng Chuan, the protagonist, who has made a vow to avenge his mother's death since he was a child and takes the Mirror Lake Daoist College as his starting point. With his resolute and fearless heart and decisive sword skills, he punishes the evil, destroys the demons, ascends to the top of the four Daoist Colleges, becomes famous in the Dongning Province, pays homage to the Yuanchu Mountain, and achieves a generation of gods and demons.(DeepL)

title: Indubala Bhaater Hotel
summary: From being a little girl in rural Bangladesh to being an entrepreneur in Kolkata, Indubala's journey is laced with the desolation of separation from her roots and the consolation of every taste being a memory of someone she has lost.

title: Big RV Remix
summary: Big RV Remix brings the "wow!" factor to small spaces on wheels, transforming dull and drab into unique and luxurious. At Celebrity Trailers, co-owned by Big Boi (Outkast) and Janice Faison, the team creates one-of-a-kind builds, while under the pressure of looming deadlines and varied budgets. Whether it be an out of this world landing pad for a future astronaut, a cutting-edge mobile shop for an up-and-coming barber or a hot new bakery bus for kids, they've got it covered. Together, with their go-to contractor, David Vasquez, the crew transforms trailers, campers, sprinters, and anything on wheels into celebrity level mobile marvels.

title: Heat Eaters
summary: From the team that brought you Hot Ones comes HEAT EATERS, the ultimate spicy food adventure where our host, chef Esther Choi, hits the streets to eat her way through the world's spiciest cuisines.

title: Reptile Royalty
summary: Join social media maven Jay Brewer along with his team of dedicated animal aficionados, over 600 rare and exotic reptiles, and his three daughters, at the famous Reptile Zoo in Southern California.

lead_actors: Kevin Porter, Ciera Foster, David Gries, T.C. Stallings, Alfred Hsing
title: The Watchers
summary: The Watchers is a supernatural thriller about the archangel Michael's mission to protect the chosen voices of God that will lead a new spiritual revival from his brother, the devil. The mission of the Watchers is to pull back the curtain on the battle that is happening in the spiritual realm that runs parallel to our earthly realm.

title: Crash the System
summary: A man unwillingly becomes a pawn to the weapons tech industry and decides to fight against it.

lead_actors: Alexandra Lamy, Audrey Lamy, Chloé Jouannet
title: Killer Coaster
summary: Sandrine Laplace, a bumbling contract worker, thinks she's a CIA agent, and decides to investigate a mysterious accident at the local fairground. Incompetent and intolerant to glucose, she will have to infiltrate this very closed world rich in cotton candy. Between clan wars, fluff and bumper cars, she will be forced to team up with Yvanne and Carmen, two fairgrounds without faith or law. What if there was a killer in the carnival?

title: Babyproof
summary: When they become parents for the first time, Nora and Viggo soon find out they're not on a pink cloud. They are trying to find their way as new parents.

title: Top Dog Germany – Der beste Hund Deutschlands
summary: In the so-called "Physical Dog Show" extraordinary dogs and their owners are supposed to overcome a special obstacle course. In five preliminary rounds with final qualification, 15 different dogs and their masters and mistresses show that they form the perfect team and master the spectacular obstacles quickly and with flying colors. The fast-paced show will be moderated by the "Ninja Warrior Germany" trio Laura Wontorra, Jan Köppen and Frank Buschmann.

title: Top Dogs
summary: Homicide investigators, Patenaude and Detroit, are immature, but clever. Very clever. The more absurd the crimes, the more exciting the investigations for the real Top Dogs of the police.

lead_actors: Sara Garcia, Sadie Laflamme-Snow, Kamaia Fairburn, Gabriella Kosmidis, Kolton Stewart
title: Unicorn Academy
summary: In this fantasy adventure series, a teenage girl and her friends defend their magical riding academy from an evil queen.

title: Doce de Mãe
summary: Picucha may seem old-fashioned, but she has modern ideas and a great sense of humor. At 85 years old, she pushes the limits of her age and does everything she can for her family and friends. Sweet Mother illustrates the everyday life of the elderly with clarity and levity, and shows that youth actually starts at 80. In the role that earned her the 2013 International Emmy® Awards for Best Actress, Fernanda Montenegro adds another success to her list of characters, which includes an Oscar nomination for the film Central Station.

title: Barakamon
summary: As a punishment for punching a famous Calligrapher, young handsome Calligrapher Handa Seishu is exiled on a small island. As someone who has never lived outside of a city, Handa has to adapt to his new wacky neighbors, like people traveling on a tractor, unwanted visitors who never use the front door, annoying kids using his home as a playground, etc. Can this city guy handle all the crazy hardships? Find out in this wacky island comedy full of innocence and laughter!

title: Sabri Maranan
summary: The series follows Shay and Shani who go to Friday dinner. Shani's family is a Mizrahi Family, and Shay's family is an Ashkenazi family.

title: Honor
summary: Martin Romero is an upright and reputable judge whose life changes completely when his son Alex commits a hit-and-run. The victim is a member of a mafia family and Romero is aware that if Alex's guilt becomes known, he will be sentenced one way or another. He will then begin a risky plan to protect him, which will put all his moral and professional convictions to the test in order to save his son.

title: Love Transit
summary: Reunion? A new love? Which will you choose? Five pairs of ex-lovers live together in a luxury hotel for a month of Hocance. A realistic and mature love documentary.

title: Zorras
summary: Three women unintentionally launch a feminine revolution when they create a secret group to fulfill their sexual fantasies.

lead_actors: Mamoru Miyano, Hisako Kanemoto, Subaru Kimura, Yoshitsugu Matsuoka, Aki Toyosaki
title: Gamera -Rebirth-
summary: Gamera, the giant monster which has been beloved by Kaiju fans across the globe since the 1960s, faces off against five enemy creatures across six episodes in this new animated series.

lead_actors: Борис Галкин, Юлия Рудина, Елена Радевич
title: Отставник. Ближний бой
summary: During a combat mission, Dedov's unit is ambushed, and the soldiers miraculously survive. A fellow soldier of Dedov's recognizes one of the fallen enemy soldiers as his former neighbor: he has a tattoo of an underground fascist organization on his wrist. Looking at him, Dedov recalls how, in his youth, he himself nearly went to prison due to a fight he got into with a friend from his past, Vasily Tkachenko. He had been sentenced for murder, and the two friends had gone their separate ways.The colonel returns home and gets a job as an instructor at the Rodina military-patriotic club. Vova Gruzdev, a member of the club, tells him that his friend Vadim Linkov has gotten involved in criminal activity. Vadim's mother is an alcoholic, his father died in prison, and the young man earns his living by stealing cars. Dedov wants to rehabilitate the young man and suggests that Gruzdev invite Linkov to the club. Meanwhile, Vadim gets into a fight with his mother's drinking buddies, runs away from home, and steals another car. The next day, a police officer comes to the Rodina club with a wanted poster for Linkov. Dedov sees that the guy, according to the description, has a tattoo on his wrist identical to the one on the deceased enemy soldier...

title: The Demon Sword Master of Excalibur Academy
summary: Awakening from magical stasis after a thousand years, the Dark Lord Leonis suddenly finds himself in the body of a ten-year-old boy! He quickly meets Riselia, a girl confronting the Voids, creatures that have nearly exterminated humanity. Determined to uncover the mysteries of this strange new era, Leonis enrolls in Excalibur Academy, a school that trains students to fight back against these enigmatic monsters. Could the Voids hold some connection to Leonis's past?

title: Bad Boys Texas
summary: The Bad Boys are back and this season they are bringing serious heat with some new guys and a Texas roadtrip! Executive Produced by Natalie Nunn, the Bad Boys will be hosting and performing at some of the most lit clubs the state has to offer, all while bonding over drinks and flying fists

title: Catch! Teenieping
summary: Set free on Earth, fairies with magical powers begin influencing people's emotions. Now, it's up to a princess from a faraway kingdom to stop them!

title: Le 5e Cavalier
summary: After a police raid turns into a bloodbath, the corpses of pontifical Swiss guards are found in a basement. As evidence is being discretely disposed of, a night watchman sets the world on the path to hell. Four spectral horsemen start leaving a trail of terror and destruction in their wake. The horsemen of the apocalypse metaphor is a way for the creators to invite the audience to think about the necessity of a paradigm shift. In this story, the media, such as the radio and television, never speak of ghost-like monsters but focus instead on insane politicians and almighty bankers – in other words, demons of the collective imagination for the modern world.

title: Animals Up Close with Bertie Gregory
summary: Bertie Gregory travels the world to capture unique animals' daily lives like never before and shows all the epic moments he and his team face.

title: Paraíso Blanco
summary: The story, past and present, of the mastermind who changed drug trafficking forever when he decided to buy an island 340 kilometers off the coast of Florida in the 1970s. A half-Colombian, half-German, 100% rockstar man whose goal was to flood the world with cocaine, becoming the first Colombian drug trafficker to be extradited to the United States.

title: Chavorrucos
summary: Regina, a psychologist, decides to write a book in which she will talk about the different personalities of men, so she gathers five funny and very peculiar Chavorrucos, whom will become therapy partners and friends.

title: Campamento Desventura
summary: Disventure Camp is a comedy animated series that satirizes the characteristics typically found in reality shows and survival programs. The series is a non-canonical spin-off of the Total Drama franchise, created by fans from Odd Nation Cartoons.

title: Magarsus
summary: Sarıbahçe, a coastal town surrounded by citrus groves on all four sides, with its back to the ancient city of Magarsus... Halil Kurak, a despotic citrus merchant... And three possible heirs who aspire to rule this citrus kingdom in the future... Tansu, Turgut and Beton...

lead_actors: Sarah-Maxine Racicot, Mathéo Piccinin-Savard, Léokim Beaumier-Lépine
title: Le Pacte
summary: Aïna, Arnaud and Théo, three mismatched young people, vow to do everything possible to protect their dark secrets. In case of betrayal or failure, these secrets will be revealed on the most popular digital platform of the day. In addition to learning to trust each other, they will have to unite to deal with a mysterious vandal who is causing havoc at the school and threatening both their secrets and the trio's strength. As different as they are, our three heroes will realize that we all need each other to become better versions of ourselves.

title: Comme des têtes pas de poule
summary: The Babin-Bibeaus, a family of five, have a knack for making their daily lives completely surprising. Humor, emotions and reflections combine with the imperfect in this family.

title: Lou et Sophie
summary: Two girls for whom the suburbs have become too small. Flamboyant friendship, thirst for freedom, the languor of summer; Things are brewing for Lou and Sophie at this pivotal moment in their lives, between adolescence and adulthood, that famous moment when we think that everything is still possible.

title: Libre échange
summary: About a couple in the midst of an existential crisis. Each episode, we find François and Marie in a bar just before their weekly couples therapy session. Their honest, humorous and tender discussions reveal the pitfalls of long-term relationships and the heartbreaking choices they entail.

title: Fixer
summary: Shitara Kyoichi is a mysterious fixer who can resolve any disputes and problems in the political and corporate world which the law and the police cannot handle. The story begins from the point when Kyoichi has finished serving his prison sentence.

title: Claire et les vieux
summary: After a distress call to save her drug-addicted mother, Claire, 9 years old, is taken in charge by social services. She ends up with the only family she has left: her grandmother Pauline, who lives in a home for the elderly.

title: Outo kesä
summary: Two best friends reunite for the last summer in their old hometown. To fight the boredom and escape the fear of an unclear future, they come up with a strange hobby: they start to sneak into other people's houses while the residents sleep.

title: Les perles
summary: Stéphanie leads an ordinary life with her daughters in a village in the Haute Côte-Nord. Returning from a yoga retreat, she is surprised to be welcomed by her extended network, who have come to cheer her up. But this retreat was more of a getaway to the South with her lover... An accomplice to this lie, her best friend Cynthia saw fit to reinforce its credibility by telling anyone who would listen that Stéphanie is depressed.

title: Sunshine Eyes
summary: Berlin, spring 2020 confinement: two sisters, Leonie (14 years old) and Lea (16 years old), separated ten years earlier after the early death of their mother, have the possibility of going to live with their grandmother, Edda. Their joy is mixed following disturbing news from Wuhan. It doesn't take long for the virus to reach Edda's home and the sisters are then faced with dramatic upheaval.

title: Je voudrais qu'on m'efface
summary: The action is located in a building in a popular neighborhood of Montreal (Canada). Three teenagers, Melissa, Eddy and Karine, live in the same building, but are not friends. From an early age, they have to deal with an environment that is already eating adults.

title: Awake
summary: After 12 years of being in a coma, young Dana Nasser finds herself in a different world where everything has changed around her and she has to adapt to advanced technology and social networking sites.

title: Questionable Taste
summary: Actor Ray Galletti is not a chef, but he loves to cook and entertain. Join him as he welcomes celebrity guests to the QT kitchen in Peterborough, Ontario as they attempt to recreate one of the guest's favourite recipes using some local ingredients, great conversation and a few laughs along the way.

title: Sous contrôle
