summary: Marie Tessier, 45, director of an NGO, is appointed Minister of Foreign Affairs the day five Europeans, including two French, are taken hostage by terrorists in the Sahel. By making this crisis personal, Marie will quickly cross all the red lines, striving to give the impression that everything is under control.

title: Tengo que morir todas las noches
summary: Tengo que morir todas las noches is a snapshot of the sophisticated and exclusive gay nightlife of one of the most emblematic clubs in 1980s' Mexico City, where people living under the weight of a repressive society that marginalized them felt the need to express an exacerbated sense of freedom. Through the eyes of a young man eager to explore the world and live freely in the capital city, the series recreates a slice of life and a decade that shook the world.

title: Irrésistible
summary: Adèle, creator of a successful podcast, has a mutual love at first sight of Arthur, a mathematician. But as soon as she is in his presence, she is prone to violent panic attacks. She is so capsized that she risks discomfort. There is no doubt about the diagnosis: Adele has post-traumatic stress disorder, a direct consequence of her previous love story, painfully ended. Adèle then has no choice but to stay away from Arthur. But the attraction is too strong...

title: Keke Wyatt's World
summary: Keke Wyatt's World is larger than life! Or will life and their own emotional complexities get in the way? Honest, intimate, and surprisingly funny, Alice & Jack shows love in all its unexpected, technicolour, kaleidoscopic beauty.

title: Cicada Boy
summary: 7 day love story of a beautiful cicada prince and a post prime woman in her 30's.

title: No Gamble, No Future
summary: No Gamble, No Future is the newest cash game show from PokerGO that will see Eric Persson, Jean-Robert Bellande, Patrick Antonius, Sean Perry, Lynne Ji, Maria Ho, Eli Elezra, Jimmy D'Ambrosio, Dylan DeStefano, Nick Schulman, Krish Menon, David Williams, Alan Keating, and "Boston" Rob Mariano playing a variety of stakes up to $200/$400 No-Limit Hold'em with a $100,000 minimum buy-in.

title: Dayaa
summary: The story of Dayaa revolves around the titular character, a freezer van driver whose life takes an unexpected turn when he discovers a lifeless body inside his van. This shocking discovery sets off a series of tumultuous events that plunges him and his best friend into increasingly challenging circumstances.

title: The Inspired Unemployed (Impractical) Jokers
summary: The Inspired Unemployed (Impractical) Jokers features four lifelong mates competing to embarrass each other. They must do and say what they're told, if they refuse, they lose and face a humiliating punishment. Hidden cameras capture the chaos.

lead_actors: Wataru Katō, Miyu Tomita, Kaede Hondo, Maria Naganawa, Asami Seto
title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You
summary: Rentarou Aijou has confessed to (and been rejected by) 100 girls in his lifetime. On the last day of middle school, he visits a shrine and prays that he get a girlfriend during his time at high school. Suddenly, the God of Love appears and tells Rentarou that the reason for his non-existent love life is because everyone is only supposed to have one soulmate in their life, but due to an error on the God of Love's part, Rentarou is destined to have 100.

lead_actors: Hailey Romain, Margherita Barbieri, Abigail O'Regan, Etienne Moana, Sam Darius
title: Spellbound
summary: Cece Parker Jones' life is turned upside-down when she discovers she's a real witch. Magical mayhem ensues at the Paris Opera Ballet School when Cece begins to practice her spell work, making things harder to juggle as she balances new magical identity, dance, and simply being a teenager! Things get even more complicated when she accidentally summons her enemies, a group called the Mystics.

title: Jumping the Apex
summary: The Halifax Harbour Grudges face their toughest season yet as they get the chance to compete on the international track. But can they maintain their small-town charm while evolving into a world-class roller derby team?

title: Sjukt
summary: A coming-of-age comedy drama partly inspired by the experiences of writer Lisa Ambjörn, Sjukt stars Carla Sehn as Alice, who discovers she has cervical cancer, loses her job in London and is left by her boyfriend. She must return home to Sweden, facing up to old bullies and troublesome parents as she attempts to rebuild her life.

title: Romina Poderosa
summary: Romina is a brave young woman who is passionate about Urban Downhill, a sport recognized worldwide for its high dose of risk. A tragedy caused by violence took away those she loves the most, therefore she will change her life completely by posing as her twin sister, Laura, to investigate the truth about her past.

title: Dhindora
summary: It revolves around Bhuvan and his family's everyday lives, when an unexpected purchase leads to a series of events and depicts every common man's larger than life dreams.

title: Sandeep Bhaiya
summary: Traces Sandeep's own journey, from his childhood in Prayagraj to his own struggle with the UPSC entrance exam attempts and their preparation.

title: A Town Without Seasons
summary: Bereft of hope, Shinsuke Tanaka, aka Shorts Hansuke, comes with his cat Tora, to the temporary housing settlement that still remains twelve years after the great disaster known as The What. His job is to report to the shady Mikimoto on the lives of the residents, every last one of which is a quirky screwball: Roku-chan, the driver of an invisible train; a homeless father and son who daydream of someday building a mansion; a father who has many children after marrying a pop idol who came to visit the disaster victims; two drunken married couples who argue endlessly, and a young girl Ganmodoki, who labors away silently at home making masks.

title: Castle Farm
summary: Join Farm Girl, Piggy, Farmer and all the gang for fun and laughter!

lead_actors: Дмитрий Сыендук, Виктория Зайцева, Полина Авдеенко
title: Объяснялкины
summary: A family that shoots an educational show signs a streaming contract, and according to the contract, the characters cannot grow old and die, and must also live in the apartment of elderly parents. Batek, Mom, Grandfather and Grandmother in each episode answer the question that their Son asks them. Once the family considered this show to be a lamp show and enjoyed filming, but now they are sick of everything. They can't break the contract, change something in their lives and stop explaining, so the Explainers decide to sabotage the process and admit to everyone that they are far from an ideal family, so that the producer himself fired them.

title: Naiste sõda
summary: As the year 1941 dawns, a small Tallinn gentleman's club, ran by the ever vigorous Mrs Kukk, has to pull out all the stops to stay in business. Boudoirs have become the domain of espionage and intrigue and courtesans have become soldiers in war - the outcome of which could be decided in the bedroom.

title: Killjoy Comedy
summary: Get to know six comedians who are staging a stand-up laugh riot. Killjoy Comedy puts the mic in front of comics who are re-writing the old insult comedy playbook.

title: Volha
summary: Standa Pekárek has three wishes in life: to drive a volga, to drive for the Humour and Folk Entertainment editorial office and to drive Got'ák. The five-part miniseries Volha is an adaptation of the novel of the same name by Karel Hynia, written in an extraordinary, bizarre and precisely echoed language. It can be perceived as a peculiar history of Czechoslovak television with a number of incredible, albeit real, "stories from the set". At the same time, however, it is a portrait of its main character - a limited egocentric who excels in inventing small tricks and deceptions - how to steal petrol, fake mileage, cheat his wife, get rid of the competition. Logically, he then also becomes a StB collaborator (with the code name Volha) who informs on all his co-workers and passengers without any remorse.

title: Filles du feu
summary: 1609, Basque Country. Coming from a long line of abortionists-healers, three sisters see their lives endangered by the arrival of judge Pierre de Lancre in the region. Hostile and terrified of women's freedom and knowledge, he will lead what will be one of the deadliest witch hunts in France.Plunged into a nightmare, our three sisters find themselves having to fight, each in their own way, to try to survive...Inspired by a real story.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: All the Way to the Sun
summary: Li Mujia, a girl from Beidiao, entered the most famous law firm in Beijing after graduation, and relied on her own hard work to become an independent lawyer from an administrative assistant. Get acquainted with Li Guang, a shopping mall elite, and their relationship has experienced several twists and turns while growing rapidly; best friend Tian Rong failed to apply for a job after graduation, became a real estate agency by mistake, and married Li Wanbing, a Beijing boy, in a hurry. The test; the two encountered various setbacks but found what they wanted. From 2007 to 2019, the girls' pursuit and hope for life involuntarily changed their appearance in reality. Fortunately, after ten years of hard work, they finally found the sunny side of life and were able to face the sun all the way.

title: Honest Renovations
summary: Join Jessica Alba and Lizzy Mathis as they take on the ultimate renovation challenge: transforming family homes that just aren't cutting it into stunning spaces as functional as they are fabulous.

title: Legend of Xianwu
summary: Exiled from his sect and left homeless, Ye Chen, a discarded disciple, stumbles upon a fortuitous encounter: the acquisition of true fire. With this newfound power, he sets foot once again on the path of cultivation. In this world where gods, demons, immortals, and Buddhas coexist, and amidst the chaos of countless realms, Ye Chen embarks on an extraordinary journey defying the heavens. Through hardships and reincarnations, he ultimately ascends to the pinnacle of the Great Dao.

title: UFO Cowboys
summary: A team of cowboys uses ancient tracking techniques and modern technology to investigate mysterious extraterrestrial activity throughout the American West.

title: Canis Familiaris
summary: Max has everything to be happy: a luxurious house, a loving family, a group of loyal friends. But for many weeks, depression has taken a toll on him, and he is now questioning everything and looking for a meaning in his life. It is a midlife crisis. If Max were a man, he might go and see a psychologist. But the truth of the matter is that Max is a 7-year-old Labrador.

title: Septième ciel
summary: When Jacques' daughter places him in a residence for the elderly, he thinks he is being sent to the slaughterhouse. He is far from suspecting that he will meet Rose there, desire her and be desired like never before. This real physical passion upsets those around them, questions everyone's libido and causes chaos within the residence. Despite the reluctance and prohibitions against them, will Jacques and Rose manage to love each other?

title: Désobéir : le choix de Chantale Daigle
summary: Chantale Daigle, at the age of 21, falls in love and then pregnant with Jean-Guy Tremblay, a man who will prove to be manipulative and aggressive. After a stormy relationship, she leaves him, chooses to have an abortion... but Jean-Guy, wounded in his pride and eager to maintain their relationship, appeals to justice to prevent it. Against all odds, a judge agrees with Jean-Guy. Will she find the strength to assume her choice until the end?

title: La Fille au cœur de cochon
summary: Nina, a teenager with a heart condition and daughter of a hypermarket owner, sees her outlook on the world turned upside down when she learns that she has always lived thanks to a pig valve transplanted to her heart. Hugo, son of industrial pig breeders, is in love with Nina. So when she decides to save the life of Fleur, a sow destined for slaughter, Hugo does not hesitate and embarks with her on a crazy road trip, with the authorities on their heels, to save the life of this innocent pig.

title: Podezrení
summary: After a mysterious death in hospital, Nurse Hana becomes the first suspect. How far does the presumption of innocence go?

title: Ach Du Heilige Scheibe
summary: Mimo is supposed to become the leader of the village where the famous sky disc is kept. At least that's what his father, the current leader, wants. But Mimo prefers to dream that it would be fairer if everyone could have a say. His sister Leva, on the other hand, would much rather become a leader herself. The siblings and their goat are constantly experiencing new adventures that have to be faced with courage, understanding and humor.

title: Paris Paris
summary: In Paris, Ontario Philippe finds a tunnel that leads him to Paris, France where he creates a second, idealized French life away from his duties as a husband and father. But what happens when one life starts to impact the other?

title: Alison & Larry: Billlericay to Barry
summary: Alison Steadman and Larry Lamb take a journey down memory lane on a 210-mile road trip from Billericay in Essex to Barry Island in South Wales.

title: Say Yes to the Dress with Tan France
summary: Fashion superstar, Tan France, takes his expertise to the English countryside in order to help a lucky group of brides-to-be choose their dream wedding dress at a special bridal salon.

title: Legend of Wacken
summary: In Legend of Wacken, the story of how the legendary heavy metal festival came to be is fictionalized. The six-part series focuses on the two founders Thomas Jensen and Holger Hübner, who turned their dream into reality with a great deal of passion and dedication and brought the Wacken Open Air to life. The main roles of the two founders are played by Charly Hübner and Aurel Manthei.

title: Ready Jet Cook
summary: Jet Tila shares his favorite go-to recipes and shops at his family's grocery store.

title: Miami Dolls
summary: Go behind the scenes of Palace Bar, Miami's hottest drag venue. Packed with laughs, drama, and explosive performances from the countries top showgirls.

title: The Jengaburu Curse
summary: Follows London-based financial analyst, Priya Das. When her father goes missing, she is forced to come back to Odisha. As she starts to search him that unravel an unlikely connection between the Bondia tribe and the mining state of Odisha.

lead_actors: Kim Dong Joon, Choi Soo Jong, Ji Seung Hyun
title: Goryeo-Khitan War
summary: A story of King Hyeonjong of Goryeo and Commander-in-Chief Gang Gam Chan. They unite the people of Goryeo to one and lead a war against Khitan.

title: Tahir's House
summary: When a Saudi family learns that their fish shop is about to go broke, they harness their granny's green thumb to be first to a blossoming new market.

title: Kitty 911
summary: This docu-series follows the passionate group of volunteers who run the Vancouver Orphan Kitten Rescue Association or VOKRA, a no-kill, non-profit, registered charity dedicated to the rescue of cats and kittens.

lead_actors: Rob James Collier, Gaynor Faye, Jemima Rooper, Larry Lamb, Samantha Bond
title: The Inheritance
summary: The Inheritance follows siblings Daniel, Sian and Chloe who are part of a seemingly close and loving family. The trio are left reeling after the sudden death of their father, Dennis and are later devastated to discover they have not been left their expected inheritance in his will.This leads them to question whether he really did die in an accident, as they were told, or if he was murdered. Their investigation takes them down a dangerous path and sees secrets unravel, relationships ripped apart and lives lost.

title: LT-21
summary: The LT-21 virus hits France and begins to spread around the world. He will not make a single death. But are we still quite alive when we have forgotten everything? Because infected patients develop total retrograde amnesia. Asia and Gabriel, a couple of doctors, are doing everything to stop the epidemic and protect patients detained in a hospital under Army surveillance. By helping an infected young boy, Gabriel gets sick. Soon he will have forgotten everything about his identity and his love story with Asia. And when Asia is exfiltrated against her will on a mysterious island guarded by the military, she thinks she can never find the man she loves. On this island, the secret base of Operation Heredis, handpicked intellectuals were sheltered from the virus. The goal: to preserve their memory to prepare the World after. A World where nothing would change, dominated by the powerful. What if forgetting everything was an opportunity for a new start for humanity? This is the thesis defended by a group of resistance fighters, La Métanoïa, determined to let the virus run and do its work...

title: History of Grace
summary: In her beloved car, "Grace", a wife is on her way to Narita. Following a bus accident that kills her, her husband, Kikuo, gets access to her GPS which contains the history of all the places she travelled to without his knowledge. Suspecting infidelity, Kikuo embarks on a journey to trace the history of the cars GPS in order to solve the mystery.

title: The Cruise: Fun-Loving Brits at Sea
summary: Following groups of Brits as they cruise around the Mediterranean's most glamorous spots.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
title: Zehirli Sarmaşık
summary: Yakut and Sinem are two close friends. When Yakut's mother falls ill, Sinem and Yahut set out together. But Yahut's mother, Ms. Mesude, has already passed away. While Yakut is struggling with the pain of losing his mother, Sinem finds the letter left for Yakut. When Sinem sees what is written in the letter, she decides to destroy it. In the letter, it is written that Yakut's real mother is Ceyla Benderli, a well-known person in the country and a wealthy woman. Yakut, who is unaware of the existence of her real mother, is the girl that Ceyla's stepson Derin fell in love with at first sight. However, fate has other plans for Yakut. Sinem, who grew up in an orphanage, realizes that all these years she was jealous of Mesude Hanım, whom she thought was Yakut's mother. However, he cannot tell the truth to Yakut. Finally, he decides to get to know Ceyla Benderli and her surroundings better and makes a terrible plan for this. He decided to enter Benderli Farm once.

title: Te Quiero y Me Duele
summary: After sparking a rebellious romance, teens Juan Gris and Lola fight encroaching gentrification with the power of music.

title: Battle for Dream Island
summary: Twenty characters battle for a luxurious island in an elimination-centric monthly animated series.

title: MarkKim + Chef
summary: Thai superstars Kimberley Ann Woltemas and Mark Prin Suparat love food, but their cooking skills could use some sharpening. With their wedding fast approaching, the couple decides to tackle another commitment: learning to cook from professional chefs.

title: Psycho Kitty
summary: The world's #1 cat behaviorist Pam Johnson-Bennett shows cat owners how to do the previously unthinkable: TAME THEIR CATS!

title: Patterns
summary: We all navigate in multiple social circles - friendships, family, work - and often these groups do not mix. Patterns takes this concept and creates a universe of characters and narratives who move between these circles and finds the comedy within. The series touches on a range of topical issues including, LGBTQ matters; family problems; conspiracy theories; and reality television.

title: Popporn
summary: Comedians roasting gay porn movies. What's weird, what's strange, what's hilarious, what's gross, what's surprising, what's enticing? Nothing will escape their comedic wrath!

title: Ruckus in Dutchess
summary: A unique group of twenty-somethings living and working together at a Black-owned BBQ bistro in rural-conservative New York.

title: Taali
summary: Presenting the story of Shreegauri Sawant's fight for India's third gender.

lead_actors: Leon Chen, Gracen Newton, Dylan Alvarado, Callum Vinson, Arwen Monzon-Sanders
title: Me & Winnie the Pooh
summary: Winnie the Pooh stars in vlog-style shorts.

title: Sew Fierce
summary: Sew Fierce is a Canadian drag competition series showcasing the craft of drag, where designers and costumers compete in weekly challenges to create new looks, hosted by Barbada de Barbades and with design mentor Jaime Lujan aka Lucinda Miu. Eight of the world's top drag designers compete to win the first ever drag designer competition and a cash prize of $10,000.

title: Bathroom Stories
summary: Best friends Flo and Isa move in together. The twenty-somethings spend a lot of time in the bathroom, where they really get to know themselves and occasionally others.

lead_actors: VeeahBee, RaikooA, Joshua Barnette, Robert Cossyleon, Mark Lee
title: The Music Freaks
summary: The Music Freaks follows Jake, a popular high school student who hides his passion for singing out of fear of his judgmental friends. That is until one day, when his crush Daisy convinces him to join the music club to compete in a band competition. This series follows Jake and the music club as new friendships, romances and drama evolves leading up to the competition.

title: Kultus
summary: Syakilla, a Singaporean girl studying in New York, inadvertently gets herself embroiled in ELIXR, a cult based in Upstate New York. Her brother, Syafik, travels to Upstate New York and braves the frigid winter cold to help save his sister from the cult. But despite his best efforts, both Syafik and Syakilla will soon realise that there is no escaping ELIXR.

title: Encore vous ?
summary: Alex Ramirès welcomes on his sofa the greatest shots of series and cinema. A show like you've never seen before, with guests you've probably seen before. YOU AGAIN ? It's your fake talk show that invites and has fun with the clichés of cinema and series. In each episode, Alex Ramirès receives a character who embodies a "trope". It's very META as they say in the movies. It's like the recipe for French toast: take everything that remains in our avid brains for fiction and make a new gourmet/crunchy dish that assumes its references and revisits them without smelling of cinnamon.

lead_actors: Rebecca More, Fantasia Royale Gaga, Sophie Anderson
title: Slag Wars
summary: Slag Wars follows Rebecca and Sophie's search for the next LGBTQ+ icon. Slag Wars is back for season 2, with new slags and new challenges starting on September 17. Hosted by Rebecca More and Fantasia Royale Gaga this go around.

title: La Dernière Aventure du ComteLance Dur
summary: At the birthday party of an old King closer to the end of his life than the beginning, a mysterious witch interrupts the festivities and kidnaps several children, including the young princess of the Kingdom. Despite his advanced age, his tired bones and his apparent weakness, the King decides to take up arms one last time, to go and rescue the children. This is how he embarks on what will be his very last adventure, accompanied by his old comrades, also crumbling, but more than ever motivated to shine once again.

title: Moitié.e.s
summary: What if the perfect couple didn't exist? Short humorous program imagined by Pauline Clément, Moitié.e.s talks about love and has fun with the contemporary evolutions of the couple. In each episode, Pauline Clément embodies a different character within a singular couple: free, postpartum, toxic, remote... In the form of intimate interviews, the halves will share their daily life, their sentimental or sexual life and their way to love each other in their own way.

title: Mariés au premier regard
summary: Relationship experts pair off ideal couples who then go on to get married upon their first ever meeting. After six weeks together they have to decide whether to stay married

title: Des gens bien ordinaires
summary: Romain, 18, is a sociology student. In rebellion against his native environment and imprisoned in a toxic romantic relationship with a woman who has total control over his life, he thinks he can find in the pornographic adventure a way of emancipation. Instead he discovers a very ordinary environment.

title: Attraction
summary: Agathe likes to describe herself as a mother "like any other". In a charming house, with a talented husband and healthy children, everything seems perfect. However, after 15 years of marriage, the pretty postcard begins to crack... The day a murder is committed in the hotel where her husband was staying for work, an unbearable suspicion sets in... Is the man she shares her life with a murderer? Has she not been trapped in an abusive and toxic relationship for years? What does she really know about Fred? With the emergence of doubt, Agathe plunges into an obsession, and the family unit becomes the arena of a high-tension criminal investigation. Like the fears of our childhood, the monster is no longer in the cupboard, it is in the bed.

title: Lac-noir
summary: City cop Valerie, 42, transfers with her son Dave, 17, to Lac-Noir, a serene secluded village in the Laurentian forest.

title: Freiheit ist das Einzigste, was zählt
Draknästet
summary: Entrepreneurs from all over Sweden present their business idea and seek investment before a group of investors and venture capitalists – the Dragons.

title: Seeb wana Aseeb
summary: After getting engaged to a Lebanese actor, an Egyptian fashion designer rushes to Alexandria to cover up the lies she fed him. But unresolved family issues derail her plan

lead_actors: Michela De Rossi, Max McKenna, Phoebe Grainer, Matt Testro, Jana Zvedeniuk
creators: Alexandra Burke, Monica Zanetti, Kim Wilson
title: While the Men Are Away
summary: While the Men Are Away is a queer revisionist historical dramedy set in 1940s rural Australia. While the men are off fighting in WWII, the people who have been excluded from power suddenly find themselves running the show. Two Women's Land Army recruits from Sydney arrive in the country and undergo a heady course in race relations, rural politics, spirituality, sex, and personal growth - oh, and farming.

title: Dive, Olly, Dive!
summary: Dive Olly Dive! follows the adventures of two young submarines in training "Olly and Beth" under the guidance of Diver Doug at the Special Underwater Research Facility (S.U.R.F.)

lead_actors: Park Kyu Young, Cha Eun U, Lee Hyun Woo
title: A Good Day to Be a Dog
summary: Hana has made every effort to avoid her inevitable family curse of turning into a dog after her first kiss. The only way for her to break the curse is to get a second kiss. How will that work when Hana's first kiss is with a guy deathly afraid of dogs?!

lead_actors: Ed Skrein, Sofia Boutella, Michiel Huisman, Djimon Hounsou, Bae Doo Na
title: Rebel Moon
summary: When a peaceful colony on the edge of a galaxy finds itself threatened by the armies of a tyrannical ruling force, Kora, a mysterious stranger living among the villagers, becomes their best hope for survival. Tasked with finding trained fighters who will unite with her in making an impossible stand against the Mother World, Kora assembles a small band of warriors — outsiders, insurgents, peasants and orphans of war from different worlds who share a common need for redemption and revenge. As the shadow of an entire Realm bears down on the unlikeliest of moons, a battle over the fate of a galaxy is waged, and in the process, a new army of heroes is formed.

lead_actors: Babben Larsson, Erik Ekstrand, Ahmed Berhan
title: 1 mot Sverige
summary: Can one person beat all of Sweden? Live quiz with spectacular experiments. Everyone can participate and compete live via the DUO app and all of Sweden competes as a team. Who wins – the lone competitor in the studio or team Sweden? Program leader is Babben Larsson and by her side are Erik Ekstrand and Ahmed Berhan.

title: Club Soly
summary: In the form of short and punchy sketches, Arnaud Soly and his accomplices revisit the news and the major media trends of our time but also, and above all, our way of reacting to them and comment on them.

lead_actors: Анна Уколова, Екатерина Стулова, Екатерина Маликова, Людмила Артемьева, Александр Обласов
title: Первокурсницы
summary: A test comedy series starring Anna Ukolova and Ekaterina Stulova. Forty-year-old friends decide to return to the first year of university in order to correct the mistakes of youth and prove that it is never too late to start a new life. Zhanna and Nastya once studied together and lived in a dormitory, but left the institute after the first year. Nastya gave birth to twin sons and devoted herself to their upbringing, and Zhanna married a creative guy and had to work at several jobs to support her family. Years later, the friends meet, remember their unfulfilled dreams and decide to return to university to radically change their lives.

lead_actors: Александр Яценко, Юлия Снигирь, Михаил Тройник, Александр Ильин (младший), Ольга Озоллапиня
title: Я знаю, кто тебя убил
summary: A three-year-old girl is kidnapped in a Moscow circus. The kidnapper does not need a ransom, he is driven by a thirst for revenge. He will make his parents suffer the way he himself suffers, having lost his only loved one. They will never know who punished them. To understand what he is taking revenge for, you need to go to the past.

title: Love in Fairhope
summary: From Reese Witherspoon's Hello Sunshine and the producers of Vanderpump Rules, if you were given the chance to bring your fantasy love story to life on TV, how would it look? Would it be a picture-perfect fairy tale or something a bit messier? This uniquely unscripted romantic series follows five women at different stages in their lives as they experience reimagined romance in the picturesque small town of Fairhope, Alabama, a tight-knit community where everyone knows everyone else's business and matters of the heart matter most. In Love in Fairhope, real people star in a story inspired by their own where fantasy and reality collide.

title: Living for the Dead
summary: Five fabulous, queer ghost hunters criss-cross the country, helping the living by healing the dead. As they explore some of the world's most infamous haunted locations, they'll shed light on those not seen and illuminate untold stories. Together they'll push past boundaries to bring acceptance to the misunderstood - living and dead. This is Living For The Dead, Ghost Hunties!

lead_actors: Keita Machida, Hayato San, Shiraishi Mai, Kazuki Kitamura, Sato Kanta
title: Teppachi
summary: Hiroshi Kokusho was an ace of his high school's rugby club and used to receive attention all over the country. However, his aggressive play and selfishness got himself injured and he had no choice but to retire. Hiroshi got a job and lived alone after graduating from high school. However, a fight caused him to get fired from his job and he got kicked out from his apartment. A man then approached Hiroshi and said that he will introduce him to a perfect job which turned out to be the "Japan Ground Self-Defense Force" that protects the country's peace and security. Hiroshi, who used to be an immature man, got enlisted and became a full-fledged self-defense officer while wearing the combat helmet.

lead_actors: Im Si Wan, Jung Hae In
title: Actors on the Road
summary: Actors Jung Hae-in and Yim Si-wan embark on a journey of friendship against the beautiful landscapes of Scotland. They explore one of the largest producers of whiskey, where they follow the traces of history found in the different cities. As whiskey enthusiasts and same-age friends, the 2 actors showcase their real-life chemistry during their healing Scottish travels, which feature a variety of attractions such as vast nature and golf.

title: The Sherry Vine Variety Show
summary: The Sherry Vine Variety Show re-imagines the classic tv variety show standard. This fun-filled half-hour is packed with some of the best known drag superstars and queer entertainers on the scene.

lead_actors: Hande Erçel, Burak Deniz, Cem Davran, Muttalip Müjdeci, Gülçin Hatıhan
title: Bambaşka Biri
summary: The brutal murder of Hamdi Atilbay in the forest crosses the paths of young prosecutor Leyla, who wants to leave her messy past behind and now establish her new order, and Kenan, an ambitious journalist who has a regular and famous life. However, this murder heralds the destruction of not only their love, but also the truth they know about their lives.

lead_actors: Salih Bademci, Hazal Subaşı, Özge Özberk, Teoman Kumbaracıbaşı, Elif Doğan
title: Dilek Taşı
summary: Mustafa is a man in his early thirties trying to survive in the slum neighborhood of Istanbul with his wife Canan and daughter Cemre. His wife Canan is in the grip of a relentless disease. She urgently needs surgery for her recovery. Mustafa does not know how to find the money. The factory where he works has been closed for a long time due to a lockout. But Mustafa has to find the money for the surgery somehow. Until that day, Mustafa had never bowed down in front of anyone and lived for his honor and dignity. But now he has no choice but to ask for help. He sets out to find Mr. Yakup, the factory owner, and ask for his salaries that have not been paid for months. He will take the money and have his wife operated on. But what happens that day will change Mustafa's and his daughter Cemre's whole life.

title: The Jury: Murder Trial
summary: How much can we trust our justice system? As a real-life murder trial is restaged for a jury of 12 ordinary people, will the jury reach the same verdict as the original trial?

lead_actors: Ariana Madix, Iain Stirling, Maura Higgins, Maya Jama

summary: Raised to never settle for less by her traditional Caribbean parents, Jazzy is at a crossroads when her seemingly perfect boyfriend drops an unexpected bombshell.

lead_actors: Zhang Wan Yi, Guo Tao, Liu Lin

title: A Long Way Home
summary: The years from 1998 to 2015 marked a transformative era in China's forestry landscape. During this time, Gu Changshan adopted Xingjie, the son of his deceased partner. After much hesitation, the Gu family decided to send Xingjie abroad for further education. As the wave of layoffs struck, some young people chose to leave, while those who stayed, led by Gu Changshan, charted a new course of "family ecological forestry" to temporarily address the livelihood crisis. In 2007, as a new turning point approached, the project of relocating migrants from remote mountainous areas began, aiming to protect the environment and improve their quality of life. The 923 Work Team faced the challenge of venturing out again. Xingjie was also brought back to the mountains. After resolving the family crisis, he took on the task of mobilizing the migrants. In doing so, he found his own value and made the decision to stay, shouldering the mission of forestry reform. Against the backdrop of a comprehensive logging restriction in 2014 and 2015, Xingjie responded to the call of "clear waters and green mountains are as valuable as mountains of gold and silver". He, along with his family and more people from the forested areas, embarked on a journey toward a better life.

lead_actors: Özge Yagiz, İlhan Şen, Burak Berkay Akgül, İpek Tuzcuoğlu, Erkan Bektaş
title: Safir
summary: Gülsoys, one of the leading families of Cappadocia, came together after Ateş returned from America. Ateş did not bow to the overwhelming authority of his grandfather Ömer and left the house. After many years, at the request of his mother Gülfem, he returned to his home with his brothers Yaman and Okan to take over and expand the family business from his grandfather. Now is the time to unite for Ateş, Yaman and Okan. After his brother's return, Yaman decides to propose to his lover Feraye. When Yaman was a child, he secretly bought the family heirloom Sapphire ring from his mother and proposed to Feraye. While Feraye and Yaman are counting the days to get married, confessing their great love by risking everything, a tragedy upsets all the balances. Feraye and Yaman are about to get lost on dangerous roads full of love, passion, revenge and tyranny. Ateş will both win new enemies and confront his brothers with the radical decisions he takes to protect everyone he loves and his family.

lead_actors: Julia Kijowska, Piotr Pacek, Olaf Lubaszenko, Eryk Kulm jr, Krzysztof Wach
title: Lipowo. Zmowa milczenia
summary: Lipowo - a small, sleepy town in picturesque Kujawy. One day, in the middle of a close-knit community, Weronika Nowakowska - a writer looking for peace and escape from the life and troubles she left behind in the capital - comes to the town. Shortly after her arrival, tragic events take place in Lipowo - a sister from a local convent, in which vows of silence are in force, dies. The head of the local police, young and ambitious Daniel Podgórski, seeing the commitment of the new resident, decides on a very brave move - against all odds, he draws Weronika into the case. With each passing day, the woman begins to discover more secrets of the town. But in order to get to the truth, the writer must not only bring to light the deeply hidden secrets of the inhabitants of Lipowo, but also face her own. And above all, break the conspiracy of silence.

title: Compete to Eat

title: Battle in the Box
summary: Battle in the Box sees pairs of comics and some of the nation's favourite celebrities battle it out for pride, prizes and most importantly floorspace, in this comedy entertainment and reality hybrid. The eight-episode series comprises four tense double bills which sees eight pairs spend 24 hours in the box.When the clock starts two celebrity teams move into a completely empty box divided by a moveable wall with nothing but a toothbrush. Once inside, they will only have cameras and each other for company - no beds, tables, chairs or home comforts. Over the course of the day and night, they need to earn everything by winning a series of physical and mental challenges all set by the orchestrator of this chaos, Jimmy Carr. Winning a game means more space and luxuries for the lucky duo. But there's a catch: more room for one team means less for the losers, as the Box's sliding wall forces them into an ever-smaller space. And, with games set around the clock, the tide - and the wall - can turn at any time.

summary: Derya (Via Jikeli), Malik (Arsenij Walker), Chloë (Maja Bons) and Schröder (Luise von Stein) are all with psychotherapist Dr. Thomalla in treatment. On the day that Thomalla is found dead in front of her house, the four meet for the first time. Between police, ambulance and crisis intervention teams, Derya decides to continue the group's therapy under her guidance - with unexpected and sometimes fatal consequences.

Detective Ember Manning must work out how it connects to a podcast journalist investigating a missing persons cold case and an illicit ‘love' triangle between a man in his twenties and two underage girls.But as Ember gets close to the truth, it threatens to destroy her life – forcing her to re-evaluate everything she thought she knew about her past, present and the town she's always called home.

lead_actors: Natsumi Fujiwara, Taito Ban, Narumi Kaho, Miho Okasaki, Hitomi Nabatame

Both his physical strength and intelligence were mediocre in both worlds, but here he naturally possessed a skill called "Appraisal" that allowed him to see the potential of any person. By gathering talented people by his side, Ars uses this "Appraisal" skill to transform his weak territory into the strongest one! But the road ahead of him won't be so simple.

After learning the news, the 3 powers of the An He family took the opportunity to launch a rebellion. Su Muyu, as the leader of the Shadow Spider Guardian group, brought Bai Hehuai, the genius doctor of the Medicine King Valley, to heal the elders, while repelling the assassins and protecting the elder Zhouquan. At this time, his friend Su Changhe in An He, but on behalf of the Su Family joined the operation to kill the patriarch.

lead_actors: Deniz Can Aktaş, Esra Dermancıoğlu, Burak Sevinç, Asuman Dabak, Miray Daner
title: Hudutsuz Sevda
summary: When he was a little child, Halil İbrahim lost his father due to a blood feud and was exiled to Istanbul. Twenty years later, he returns to his homeland in the Karadeniz region as a handsome, powerful young man. He plans to marry the girl he loves, Yasemin, and start a new life. However, events do not allow this. Halil İbrahim embarks on a journey of revenge, and his life will change completely when he encounters Zeynep from the Leto family.

title: The Tranz Form
summary: Brielle, Xaria and Elle are three Black Trans womxn in South Florida navigating love, family, community, health and politics.

lead_actors: Miroslav Krobot, Tomás Bambusek, Zuzana Stivínová, Tereza Dočkalová, Marika Šoposká
title: Oktopus
summary: OKTOPUS is an abbreviation of "department for the control of deferred cases of department S". It was invented by the aging Captain Dítě mainly so that he could focus on the thirty-year-old Jordán case. He finds understanding in Lieutenant Colonel Schwarz, his superior, but when he assigns the young, ambitious Captain Fáberová to his hand, it soon becomes clear that he will not stick to just one case. The cases that OKTOPUS solves took place in the past, and it is up to the detectives to find new circumstances and clues that will help them finally solve the old cases. Their search will take us to the interesting surroundings of little-known Prague, among closed social groups, as well as to the players' dens and to the racetrack in Chuchli, where the bookmaker and bookie Dítě spends his free time.

title: A Clean Sweep

summary: Husband and wife design build team, Richie Morris and Georgia Ezra, create one-of-a-kind, modern designs and bespoke spaces for their clients in Melbourne, Australia while juggling their thriving businesses and family of four.

title: Vida the Vet
summary: Ten-year-old Vida, an animal doctor who nurtures the charming and silly woodland creatures who live outside her home. Is there a fox with a sprained paw? A turtle with an itchy toe? A tiger with an aching tooth? Then Vida is the vet for the job. With quick thinking, a doctor's intuition and the help of her closest friends, Vida helps adorable animals and makes sure they get the care they need.

summary: Adapted from Jin Yong's novel, this is the story of protagonist Yang Guo and his lover XiaoLongNü in their adventures in the jianghu (or wulin, the community of martial artists), which disapproves of the taboo love between master and apprentice.

summary: In the gilded enclave of the imperial court, Minamoto Hiromasa befriends the mystic Abe Seimei, solving tricky cases rising from the demonic realm.

title: As Luck Would Have It
summary: Recently retired criminology professor turned amateur sleuth Gabbi Luck uses her classroom smarts, charm and tenacity to get to the bottom of every crime she encounters.

title: Design Defined
summary: Designers and historians share the origins and hallmarks of some of the most beloved design styles, including midcentury modern, farmhouse, art deco and more. You'll learn the secrets behind each unique approach to design.

title: Firefighter Daigo: Rescuer in Orange
summary: Toake Daigo burns with remarkable talent and unparalleled determination. Onoda Shun struggles against the walls blocking his own path. Nakamura Yuki hopes to become one of the few female members of the special rescue corps known as "Orange." When these three young firefighters who share the goal of becoming members of Orange come together, the story of how Japan will one day be saved begins... and what looms before them is a crisis that endangers the entire country!

title: Is She the Wolf?
summary: They're all here to look for true romance — but hidden among the women is at least one "wolf" who's prohibited from falling in love.

lead_actors: Lisa Dwan, Rory Keenan, Aidan McArdle, Amy De Bhrún, Stanley Townsend
title: Blackshore
summary: Blackshore follows DI Fia Lucey, a laser- focused, ambitious detective who is haunted by her tragic past – a past she keeps locked away and unexplored.After a series of "undue force" allegations, Fia is banished from her high-octane position to a rural backwater – uncomfortably close to her hometown. While there, she is charged with investigating a missing person case: a woman from Blackshore who has disappeared in mysterious circumstances. The case brings a reluctant Fia face to face with her traumatic past and back into the fold of a community who are still processing the unwelcome attention that her historical case brought to the town: a town that remains steeped in its own secrets and lies.Blackshore is a dark thriller that explores the DNA of one town's relationship with shame, guilt and the price of success.

title: Trivial Pursuit
summary: The all-time classic trivia game Trivial Pursuit is reimagined in a question-packed entertainment format. Gameplay takes place on a giant version of the iconic Trivial Pursuit game board, as contestants battle it out over a range of play-along question categories to win wedges and beat each other to the center. The victor then takes on a dramatic finale against the clock to claim the big money jackpot.

lead_actors: Sofie Gråbøl, David Dencik, Youssef Wayne Hvidtfeldt, Charlotte Fich
title: Huset
summary: Sammi, Henrik, Miriam, and Gert are prison officers and colleagues in an old, worn-down Danish prison. Their work environment is raw and hostile, and their respective lives outside the prison walls are filled with conflict, secrets, and loneliness for very different reasons. Secrets, that will soon resurface and have great consequences not only for the four prison officers, but for everyone inside and outside the walls.

title: Pinches Momias
summary: A group of troubled teens become their town's only hope for survival when their notorious mummies rise from the dead during the busiest week of the year.

lead_actors: Борис Галкин, Юлия Рудина, Юрий Орлов, Александр Рязанцев
title: Отставник. Защита Дедова
summary: During surgery for a combat wound, Dedov's heart stops, but doctors manage to literally bring him back from the brink. Doctors soon discharge the retired soldier, who plans to recuperate and spend time with his recently born great-grandson.Dedov's friends, General Rastorguev and Colonel Nakhabtsev, are searching for the dangerous terrorist Burkhan. According to intelligence, he is plotting a terrorist attack in St. Petersburg. To prevent tragedy, Nakhabtsev suggests Rastorguev conduct an operation codenamed "Old Friend"—inserting a former comrade of Burkhan's into his group. The agent is Nikitin, Dedov's son-in-law, who, in turn, is not warned of his relative's involvement in the dangerous scheme. According to the cover story, Nikitin became involved in drug trafficking, killed a fellow soldier, deserted, and is now wanted. At some point, the operation begins to go awry...To save Nikitin's life and restore his reputation, Dedov is forced to act independently, without relying on the support of the army and police.

title: The Whole Package
summary: Amateur male underwear models compete in stripped-down photoshoot challenges for the chance to become Dirt Squirrel Company's newest brand ambassador, $5000 cash and to be crowned "The Whole Package".

title: Kobushi
summary: Every night, after closing hours, a very strange phenomenon occurs in a Japanese restaurant. All the sushis, makis, temakis, come to life: they are the Kobushis.

title: Alien: Isolation - The Digital Series
summary: It's been fifteen years since Amanda Ripley's mother disappeared aboard the deep space towing ship Nostromo. And for fifteen years, Amanda has suspected there was more to her mother's story than meets the eye.

title: The Freelancer
summary: Based on the book 'A Ticket To Syria', Avinash Kamath, an ex-cop turned mercenary, takes up the daunting task of rescuing Aliya, a newly married girl trapped in war-torn Syria against the backdrop of growing ISIS terrorism.

lead_actors: Kenjiro Tsuda, Atsushi Ono, Yurika Hino, Tatsumaru Tachibana, Kazuhiro Yamaji
title: Ninja Kamui
summary: A team of assassins exact a bloody retribution on Joe Higan – a former ninja who escaped his clan – and his family for betraying their ancient code. Rising from his seeming "death," Joe will re-emerge as his former self – Ninja Kamui – to avenge his family and friends. and bring down the very clan that made him.

title: Sovietska
summary: The life of a family who left the former USSR and moved to the outskirts of Israel. 30 years later, the family experiences an identity crisis when the daughter becomes a social media star and the voice of the young generation.

lead_actors: Pedro Paulo Vicentini, Priscilla Avila, Bruno Bebianno
title: 171: Negócio de Família
summary: The crook Moreira, missing for ten years, returns home for his wife's funeral. His return is not well accepted by his son, Diógenes, who fears that his grandfather's influence on his grandson, Chicão, could be negative.

title: Scam 2003: The Telgi Story
summary: 'Scam 2003' is based on true events and traces Abdul Karim Telgi's rise from fruit seller to the kingpin of the stamp paper scam. Fueled by greed, Telgi dominates the stamp paper market through corruption, while carefully maintaining a low profile. But for how long can he evade the clutches of the law? The biographical financial thriller is helmed by Hansal Mehta and stars Gagan Dev Riar in the titular role.

lead_actors: Cassandra Ciangherotti, Pablo Cruz, Omar Chaparro, Alfonso Bassave, Irene Azuela

summary: Teresa finds her husband and his two best friends dead in the lavish community where they live. As the truth comes to light, so will dark secrets.

summary: Keep your friends close, and your frenemies closer. In this chaotic clique, the line between supporter and saboteur is awfully blurry.

title: Underdeveloped
summary: Mockumentary about a group of failed and inexperienced producers forced to work together at a production company.

lead_actors: Денис Румянцев, Татьяна Берендеева, Артём Ткаченко

summary: Three students of an online school — Nikita, Vika, and Riley — want to break into the world of great art. Nikita is a natural leader, Vika is a talented designer and coder, and Riley is a brilliant artist. But Nikita is in too much of a hurry and doesn't listen to her friends, Vika is preparing for exams and can hardly find time for creativity, and Riley is afraid to show her paintings because of online bullying. To become a real team, prove themselves, and not quarrel, they will have to overcome their inner demons and understand what is truly important to them.

title: Under Ninja
summary: A high school loner is given the part-time job of a lifetime as a modern day ninja tasked to perform international assassinations.After World War II, Allied Command in Japan developed a new agency to help manage terrorism and violence within the Pacific region. The agency was staffed with ninja and they were initially tasked to handle domestic affairs. Eventually that program grew to its current form, managing 20,000 ninja across a range of domestic and international affairs. One of those ninjas happens to be Kudo. The seventeen-year-old high school loser is now poised to be the next line of defense against a potential surge in foreign assassins invading Tokyo.

title: Bakugan
summary: When Bakugan brawls are banned and driven underground, Dan Kouzo and his friends decide to form their own clan and fight for what they believe is right!

lead_actors: Austin Lin, Terrance Lau, Ruby Lin, Dee Hsu, Esther Liu

title: Two Brothers
summary: Brothers Aiden and Aaron move to a small town when Aaron gets a full scholarship to one of the best Music Theatre schools in Canada.

title: Buenos Chicos
summary: Six well-to-do youngsters join forces to break into the homes of families in their exclusive social circle. A mischievous prank that turns into a chaotic plot of swindles, robberies and death.

lead_actors: Денис Васильев, Мария Фефилова, Лидия Шевченко, Дмитрий Паламарчук, Сергей Жарков
title: Пилигрим

Due to the betrayal of the "mole", the agents' data was declassified, and almost all of Rubtsov's colleagues died. Oleg managed to survive and protect his wife, but now he has to constantly move and hide. Obsessed with finding a traitor, the Pilgrim tries to rediscover his place and purpose in life.

title: Talad Arom
summary: Trat is the heir to one of the richest companies in Thailand. He lives in America with his girlfriend and comes back to Thailand after years of self-impose exile from his father who married a woman he disapproved of. After years away, he returns to Thailand for his father's funeral and his stepmother wants him to take over the family business; he doesn't want to because of his prejudice towards her. While in Thailand, he meets a young woman by the name of Gang and starts to have a relationship with her. When he learns that Gang is actually his stepmother's niece, he mistakenly thought his stepmother deceived him and was scheming something. After that he decides to start working for the company but with one condition: Gang has to work with him.

title: L'amour (presque) parfait
summary: Julie, 36, dumped, childless, unemployed, ticks all the boxes of the perfect loser. But a phone call will change everything. At the end of the line, Max makes her a sublime marriage proposal. She is ecstatic until she realises that the phone she frantically clutches is not hers...

title: The Guards
summary: Series following the Guards in the dark and complex world of organised crime, as Ireland's criminal networks reach unprecedented levels of escalation.

title: The Good Stuff with Mary Berg
summary: A daily hour of fun, food, and laughs, featuring lifestyle trends, home hacks, audience games, and inspiring stories – all from top experts.

title: Dr. Nice
summary: Dr. Nice is a heartthrob and star surgeon, until an accident stiffens his right hand. An inheritance leads him to the Flensburg Fjord and to daughter Lea, of whom he knew nothing.

title: Detektyvai:209

They can solve people's problems, of course, while earning well from them. Who could refuse such an offer? Two professionals will take care of your troubles. It doesn't matter what troubles have attacked - testing the fidelity of a spouse, recovering a debt from a business partner, or pulling a friend out of a deep hole - Julius and Robke can handle anything. However, not all tasks are simple; they require dedication, skills, and quick thinking. These are character traits that detectives do not always rely on, but there are no unsolvable cases, their success rate is 100%. An unexpected, engaging, and always unpredictable detective series - a perfect blend of classic sitcom and modern genre experience: the viewer constantly stays on the edge of their seat, experiencing both laughter and tension.

title: 16 ukers helvete bootcamp
summary: Martin Johnsrud Sundby pushes six famous faces through six grueling bootcamps to get them in shape to carry out a grueling common goal at the end.

title: The Green Way Outdoors
summary: Kyle Green travels the world with his best friends hunting for wild game and dynamic conservation stories. Join Kyle on his extreme hunting and fishing adventures as he breaks the shackles of the modern world and gains a deeper understanding of where our food comes from. Learn about the conservation of exciting species like Buffalo, Moose, and Alligator—but also learn about the damaging effects of non-native invasive species like Asian Carp, Snakehead, and Pythons. Just know, every species Kyle targets will be prepared in his studio kitchen with a tasty recipe!

lead_actors: Taner Ölmez, Erkan Kolçak Köstendil, Engin Benli, Şifanur Gül, Sema Çeyrekbaşı

When the police fail to find her, the family takes matters into their own hands, obtaining surveillance devices with the help of their tech-savvy son Ole. Disguising themselves as employees of an electrical company, they bug first their neighborhood and then half their suburb, finding out that behind closed doors none of their neighbors are who they pretend to be.

lead_actors: Christian Corrao, Kai Harris, Meadow Kingfisher, Desmond Zavier Sivan, Naomi Snieckus
title: Builder Brothers' Dream Factory
summary: 10-year-old twins, Drew and Jonathan. A pair of regular kids whose extraordinary imagination, creativity, grit and heart help solve problems in their neighborhood by dreaming big and sometimes too big.

lead_actors: Tan Song Yun, Xu Kai, He Rui Xian, Gao Han, Shi Shi
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: As Beautiful As You

Saimon Hirayasu transfers Jin Daiba to his special investigation team. Because of his secret, Jin Daiba must follow Saimon Hirayasu's orders to get rid of criminals secretly who the police are unable to punish. While digging into an unsolved case, they face off against a powerful organization.

It is a universal story of Child Vs Man.

title: The Whole Truth
summary: Late one night, in the old town of a coastal city, a mysterious murder took place. Guan Jingtang, a locally well-known and respected elder, was brutally killed in his villa. Detective Captain An Ping was urgently assigned to the case, while Shang Jie, a top graduate from the provincial police academy, volunteered to assist. The two worked together closely, conducting a meticulous investigation. However, as they delved deeper, they encountered numerous contradictory clues, along with a missing large sum of cash, a familiar woman in a red dress, blood-red floral patterns, and the complex relationships within the Guan family, all of which made the case increasingly baffling. To make matters worse, more murders followed, with the victims all having close ties to Guan Jingtang. Under immense pressure, An Ping and Shang Jie began investigating from the very beginning, uncovering an old, unresolved case. It turns out that An Ping's mentor, who was also Shang Jie's father, had died because of that very case. Eventually, An Ping painstakingly pieced together the truth, unmasking the twisted mind behind the crimes and bringing the culprit to justice. Shang Jie, too, overcame the shadows of her past, resolving long-standing personal conflicts. She decided to continue on her father's legacy and fight alongside An Ping.

No one had broken rules all the time, until the most honest third-generation Li Yijin suddenly broke the tradition to go to her boyfriend's home for the New Year, causing family contradiction. Qiao Haiyun has three daughters. The eldest, Meng Mingwei is not her biological daughter. Because of lame inferiority, Meng Mingwei had great ambitions for her daughter, Li Yijin, but had a very tense relationship with her. In the end, they understood each other's difficulties and finally knew that keeping a proper distance was the best way to maintain a mother-daughter relationship; Meng Wanqing, the second one, and Tao Shuna were perfect mother and daughter, but the two accidentally discovered each other's secret. The process of rediscovering each other is also that of rediscovering oneself. The two finally understood that the perfect mother-daughter relationship was not to cover up the shortcomings but to support each other; The third one, Meng Yian, is the most like Qiao Haiyun, strong and independent. Not wanting to be a strong woman like her mother, but by chance, Meng Yian took the same path as her mother. The difficulty of balancing her career and family led her to understand her mother. The three generations of women in the Meng family were like a flock of birds. Although they watched each other from the distance, they supported each other and coexisted.

Their mission is to draw images to match a word or phrase from a specific category and the teammates will have to guess correctly to score. The show proves you don't have to be an artist to draw and in fact, if you can't draw, it makes it even funnier! With the chance to win an incredible prize, the stakes are high…

Because of that choice, Dong-soo is cornered and caught in a trap set by a gangster, Do-young, and becomes the designer of an internet gambling site. Dong-soo, a lawyer who was despised and treated coldly as the lowest class in the legal profession, discovers his unexpected talent in the world of crime and begins to awaken to his hidden desires. And colluding with Do-young, they continue their dangerous and strange friendship.

In this psychological adventure will the traitors be unmasked in time?

However, she soon discovers that instead of inheriting vast fortunes, she has been left with massive debts. At her wit's end, several individuals meet at the Li residence: the noble young creditor Shangguan Guchuan, the scholar Fan Zhongju who's in the capital to take the imperial exams and looking for accommodation, and the young man Liu Lang who comes to repay his debt of gratitude to Li Tiandi. With her father gone and the debts outstanding, Xie Quanjia, while dealing with the pressing creditor, decides to let these men settle in the mansion and rent empty rooms to a princess from the Western Regions and her servant fleeing from an arranged marriage, along with Guo Dongli, a restaurant manager, to alleviate the debt burden. From then on, while living together, each individual dedicates their energy to carving out their own success in Changle. Amidst the chaotic pursuit of their dreams and handling the constant flow of visitors to the mansion, they lead lives filled with unrest yet are ultimately joyful.

Alongside Detective David Burkely, the two work together to find Amy. Their investigation takes them around Ireland, as more girls go missing. As they follow every lead, some end up dead ends, but all the while, the killer plays psychological torture games with Lisa, putting her in compromising situations. As they get closer to finding the killer, David and Lisa learn more about the long-rooted corruption in the Gardaí system. To cover their tracks, high-ranking Gardaí members blackmail David with his own secrets. The investigative trail finally leads Lisa to the killer, where they face off again after all these years. In the end, she must confront her childhood trauma in order to save the missing girls.

summary: Ten years have passed, and he thought he'd forgotten about his first love. One day, he comes across his first love. Kang Hu-young is tall, handsome, and intelligent, and has lived a carefree life. When he came back to Korea from the US after ten years, he coincidentally ran into his first love. It brought back the memory from the past, making his heart race again... But unlike Hu-young, Lee Hong-ju is living an ordinary life. She believes a romantic relationship is a luxury and love is a waste of energy. She tries to stay away from him, but somehow, her heart starts to flutter as well. Is it just a serendipitous encounter? Or is it fate?

Together with her business partner Dong Ki Joon she punishes bad spouses and provides help for those that finds themselves in similar situations as to her.

summary: Fake follows Birdie Bell, a beautiful, smart and brilliant magazine features writer who thinks she has found "the one" when she meets successful grazier Joe Burt on a dating app.Convinced by her well-meaning friends and family that this could be her very own happily ever after, Birdie begins to believe that it is finally her chance to live the fairy-tale. As cracks start to form in Joe's stories, Birdie soon discovers her boyfriend isn't all he has led her to believe.

title: The Amazing Race Australia
summary: From an Olympic sporting legend to a comedian, a former Wiggle and an international reality heartthrob, 11 celebrity racers and their loved ones will trade in their luxe lives for a life on the run.Our celebrities and their race partners will be met at the starting line by loveable larrikin and host Beau Ryan, who will be sure to throw twists and turns their way as they race across the globe.From culture shock, meagre budgets and the pressure of a non-stop race, our star racers will be tested in ways we've never seen before.The Amazing Race Australia is hosted by Beau Ryan and filled with amazing places and amazing people.

lead_actors: Jodie Whittaker, Grayson Davies, Sanna Kurihara, Imran Shebani

title: San Snova
summary: A young football player has to start all over again once he has to part from his football career after suffering an injury.

summary: It takes us to Zaglav, the road to the remote area divides Zaglav into two opposing camps, on one side is the Macan family, newly rich and guest workers, and two opposing camps. All three families are connected by a godfather and interest will clash in the race for money and decide the fate of the place.

title: Bambai Meri Jaan
summary: Bambai Meri Jaan chronicles the life of gangster Dara Kadri through the eyes of his father, an ex-cop, Ismail Kadri. In this season, we see how Dara puts everything on the line, including his family. He goes on to become a cold-blooded, fearless gangster who uses his business acumen to fight not only the police and his rivals but also his own demons along the way.

title: John Carpenter's Suburban Screams
summary: John Carpenter's Suburban Screams is a genre-busting unscripted horror anthology series from the mind of legendary director, writer, and producer, John Carpenter. The series explores the dark secrets and unspeakable evil that sometimes lurks beneath the surface of the sun-drenched streets, manicured lawns and friendly neighbors of suburbia. Each episode focuses on one true tale of terror, told by the real people who lived through it. Their firsthand accounts are brought to life through premium cinematic scene-work, news clips, home photos, and archival footage, combining the visual language of horror films with the tools and techniques of documentaries, creating a uniquely frightening experience for viewers.

title: Match nas Estrelas
summary: Match nas Estrelas is an astrological dating show. There are twelve episodes in which a single person, who represents one of the zodiac signs, is introduced to four bachelors or bachelorettes with whom they have different astral compatibilities. Chatting and chemistry: everything can be a sign of what the stars want. After the dates, it's time to make a decision: listen to or ignore the stars?

title: Sweet Moratorium
summary: Kashiwagi Kokoro is a university student. He enjoys his campus life and has begun dating Kamijo Sayo. One day, his ex-girlfriend Omori Ringo, who is the one that decided to end their relationship, visits his home and begins to live there. Kashiwagi Kokoro doesn't tell his new girlfriend Kamijo Sayo about Omori Ringo moving in with him.

lead_actors: Jussi Nikkilä, Claes Hartelius, Kaspar Velberg, Pertti Sveholm, Anders Mossling
title: Estonia

The eight-part series explores, through the touching personal stories of victims, survivors, loved ones and researchers, how it is possible that 852 people lost their lives, and no one is responsible for it.

title: The Railway Men: The Untold Story of Bhopal 1984
summary: After a deadly gas leaks from a factory in Bhopal, brave railway workers risk their lives to save others in the face of an unspeakable disaster.

The main story is anchored by two men with different intentions in navigating the streets to seek dominance. The series showcases a cast of compelling characters that amplify the will to survive. The question is who will survive in the streets of McGraw Ave?

title: Voltes V: Legacy

The armed forces of the nations of the planet were unprepared for an alien invasion and quickly fell to the power of the invading Boazan force. It was humanity's darkest hour until Voltes V launched himself from Camp Big Falcon and fought back, giving humanity one last hope of living free.

title: The Silence
summary: Since the beginning of creation, there has been a forged and inexhaustible attraction in the human race toward forbidden things. It makes them on the one hand excessively ambitious, on the other hand, indifferent to all social norms. And it is the emotion that pushes them to unintended and unpleasant consequences just like in the legendary story of Adam, Eve, and the Serpent.

lead_actors: Péter Dániel Katona, Barna Bokor, Abigél Szőke, Péter Kálloy Molnár, Móni Balsai
title: Tündérkert

The young Báthory is daring handsome and the idol of women, and triumphantly acquires the throne of Transylvania. The young ruler is the hope of the Transylvanian people, who have long suffered from wars. However, the ambitious Báthory pursues glory. He turns into a deranged tyrant, his best friend, the wise Gábor Bethlen, also becomes his mortal enemy and infuriates the neighboring great powers. Huge armies of the Ottomans, Wallachians, Poles, Hungarians and Cossacks attack Transylvania because of Báthory's adventurism.

title: Reina Roja
summary: With an IQ of 242, Antonia Scott is officially the smartest person on Earth. Her intelligence made her the "Red Queen" of a secret and experimental police project, but what seemed like a gift became a curse, and she ended up losing everything. When the son of a powerful tycoon is found gruesomely murdered and the daughter of Spain's wealthiest man is kidnapped, the Red Queen organization is set in motion. Mentor, Antonia's former boss, turns to Jon Gutiérrez, a hot-tempered Basque cop on the verge of being expelled from the force, to reactivate Antonia. The twisted cat-and-mouse game in which Jon and Antonia become entangled in during the investigation helps them discover that they admire and complement each other almost as much as they irritate each other. Reina Roja is a haunting thriller set in Madrid, a city that plays a central role to the story, that combines the urgency and action of the investigation with the juicy and witty chemistry between its two main characters.

title: Compro Likes
summary: Wagner is a failed actor, who does everything to appear, but can't pass any test. He is induced by his guru, Johnny, to buy followers, in order to get fake likes to look like a popular artist.

title: You Are Mine

He's happy about his chance to join the great company, but he doesn't realize that Shang-Zhou Xia will tease him endlessly. Despite tough work and a grumpy boss, Shun-Yu believes he can handle it for a better life. But dealing with a blind date with the boss and sharing a bed turns out to be more than he bargained for!

Thinking that he couldn't just leave it, he took it home and raised it until his age approached forty.His now grown-up daughter had also wanted to become an adventurer, likely from growing up watching her father. Although her father had taught her the sword since she was young for self-defense, her talent at it was quite impressive. Thinking that it would be better for her not to be stuck out in the country for the rest of her life, our protagonist sent her to the adventurer's guild in the Capital.After another five years, the protagonist now in his forties is still acting as a pseudo-adventurer in the countryside, however, his daughter—now a distinguished S-Class adventurer—hasn't returned home even once yet...

The catch? They have to work together, with each using their unique skills to solve crimes. For Ellis, that means hard-boiled shoe leather police work; for Max, it means accents, schemes and generally befriending everyone in sight, while driving Ellis absolutely nuts. Reluctant to accept help, Tess uses an assistance app and connects with Sunny Patel, a professional seeing-eye guide and agoraphobe living 3,000 miles away. Haunted by the unsolved cases she left behind, Tess uses a hidden camera and earpiece, while Sunny remotely steers Tess through life's obstacles -- and crimes -- as the two challenge preconceptions about ability, trust and where to draw the line.

title: Les Revoltes
summary: Éléonore St-Laurent is a lawyer of convictions and arguments. Jacob Gravel-Duquette is an investigative journalist and follows his instincts no matter where they lead him. Each in their own way, sometimes by joining forces, they denounce the flaws of the system, supporting individuals revolted by the slowness or rigidity of institutions. Through their fight against institutional absurdities, Éléonore and Jacob help these desperate individuals obtain a semblance of justice.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Animanimals
summary: Animanimals is a multi award winning series without dialogue where, in each episode, a different animal has an absurd adventure that can only happen to him.

lead_actors: Thomas Saddler, Alberta Brudan, Audrey Salinas, Lennox Lee
title: Spooky Files
summary: When supernatural creatures – nicknamed ‘Spookies' - start appearing in the small Australian town of Sunny Valley, long-time Spookyphile Bert is thrilled. He assembles the ‘Spooky Crew,' consisting of his best bud and gadget queen Xena, his super-cool sorta step-sis Billie, and Derek, their school's sports captain - an ‘undercover agent' who keeps his Spooky beliefs a secret. Their mission: to capture the ‘Spookies,' figure out where they're coming from, and safely return them ‘home' – wherever that may be!The series blends contemporary characters and retro delights from the 80s and 90s with mystery, humour, nostalgia and just the right amount of scary. Each episode features a new Spooky surprise, from a humungous flying clown head to a punk rock truth fairy and even a Fart Blob.

title: Le Temps Des Framboises
summary: Elizabeth inherits the family farm following her husband's death, who had concealed that he was gravely ill. Taking on the immense task of a novice now running the whole operation, she plunges headlong into this new and unpredictable life.

title: Street Outlaws: Farmtruck and AZN Down Under
summary: What would a trip to Australia be like without the antics and fishin' of Farmtruck and AZN? It would be a lot less fun, that's what. Farmtruck and AZN head to the land down under as well and find their own races and fun antics in a complete fish out of water racing series.

lead_actors: Joakim Ingvardsen, Stephania Potalivo, Mads Steffensen, Anne Sofie Skovlund Nielsen
title: Alle mod 1
summary: Weekly competition/game-show where contesters are competing to win up to 100'000dkr, in a series of experiments, where it's all about who can be nearest in their guess, the one vs the many?

title: Shi Cha Hai
summary: On three generations of the Zhuang family who live in a Shicha Hai Hutong in central Beijing.
