The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse
summary: As a prophecy of doom unfolds on the peaceful land of Britannia, a purehearted boy sets out on a journey of discovery — and revenge.

lead_actors: Tibor Kasza, Sydney van den Bosch
title: Szerencsekerék VIP

lead_actors: Chantal Janzen, Lykele Muus, Jeroen van Koningsbrugge, Moos Hofstra, Josephine Arendsen
title: Een Grote Familie
summary: Mother Julia moves into her new boyfriend Taco's house together with her 2 daughters Mies and Kees and son Guus. Taco also has 2 daughters (Zimbini and Lotus) from his previous marriage with Moon, and a son (Max) from a relationship before his first marriage. That is a big change for everybody in this newly "put toghether" family. How do you handle different parenting styles, different norms and vallues, frustration, sadness over a divorce and the new bonus family members ?And to make matters even worse for Julia, her ex husband Dennis who was absent most of the marriage because he chose his work over his family, now decides he has to be there for the kids, and buys the houseboat directly opposite the street from Taco's house.

title: La caza: nada es lo que parece
Sálvese quien pueda
summary: After 14 successful years of "Sálvame" on Spanish TV, Belén Esteban, Lydia Lozano, Terelu Campos, Kiko Hernández, María Patiño, Kiko Matamoros, Chelo García-Cortés and Víctor Sandoval look for new job opportunities across America in this reality series.

lead_actors: Lin Yi, Li Lan Di, Sun Tianyu, Li Xin Ran, Chen Ze
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Angels Fall Sometimes
summary: Lin Tuo, in the prime of his youth, crossed paths with An Zhique during a summer internship recruiting event in their junior year. Love blossomed at first sight. As they got to know each other better, they committed to a relationship. With graduation season approaching, the two embarked on their journey from the ivory tower into the real world, taking on part-time jobs, job hunting, and planning their future together. While life didn't unfold as smoothly as they had hoped, their mutual support helped them stay on track. However, just when everything seemed to be going well, Lin Tuo received a diagnosis that changed their lives forever. He was diagnosed with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), which brought an untimely end to his seemingly ordinary but promising life. Though his lifespan was shortened, Lin Tuo faced the disease bravely, with the warm love and companionship of his family, his devoted partner, friends, and colleagues. Giving up the idea of yielding to his fate, he learned to coexist with the terminal illness and ultimately challenged it courageously. Lin Tuo's journey inspired those around him, including his friends and patients who had the same suffering as him. He prompted them to reevaluate their outlook on life, cherish the present moment, and strive to live each day with hope and no regrets.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Hu Tong
D'argent et de sang
summary: The scam of the century, which occurred in France and Europe between 2008 and 2009. Billions went up in smoke on the new financial market of "carbon quotas" invented to fight against global warming. The association of crooks from Belleville with a trader from the upscale neighborhoods, tracked by an obsessive investigator. When human passions are unleashed beyond simple interest.

title: Pluto
summary: Ai-oon is the disappointing twin of successful and beloved Ob-oom. They aren't close. On Ob-oom's wedding night, she takes Ai-oon aside and makes a request of her. Ob-oon and her husband Paul will be going away for their honeymoon and she'll be leaving something important behind: a lover, May, she hasn't broken up with—and she wants Ai-oon to do it for her. In the early morning following the wedding, Ai-oon learns that the newlyweds got into an accident. Paul has passed away and Ob-oom is in a coma. When Ai-oon decides to fullfil her sister's request, she's shocked to learn that May is both blind and a woman. She finds herself unprepared to complete the task.

lead_actors: Tawan Vihokratana, Thitipoom Techa-apaikhun, Ployshompoo Supasap, Worranit Thawornwong
title: Peaceful Property
summary: They're here to prove that haunted houses aren't all that scary… or are they? Some shenanigans are underway, but so are friendships, dreams, and love.Home is the heir of a very wealthy old money family, and he's been living his best life up until the moment his grandfather passed away. He's now back in Thailand to inherit everything, only there's a big fat catch: all the properties his grandfather left him are infested with persistent evil spirits, and nobody would buy them. Peach is a talented chef whose life has turned upside down ever since a near-death accident that makes him see ghosts. He becomes a shut-in so much so that his younger sister Pangpang, a wannabe TikToker, begins to worry. One day, Peach is invited to a homecoming party at an allegedly haunted house which turns out to be legit. Pangpang films the whole haunting scene, posts it online, and it instantly becomes viral.Seeing that video for the first time, Home starts shaking with anger. He and Kan, the family's attorney, make it their mission to seek Peach out and demand responsibility by making him bust the ghosts in all the properties. Two men looking for home are now joining hands in this ghostbusting business, and it seems that the most messy party of four very different people is about to get started.Heartwarming friendships, haunting stories, and a whole lot of smiles are waiting for them somewhere along the way. Redefine the definition of "home" with them.

title: Kidnap
summary: In order to raise money for his medical expenses, Min takes on the task of kidnapping Q. However, the plan suddenly changes and Min chooses to spare Q's life, and the two of them begin to live together and overcome the difficulties together.

title: Wandee Goodday
summary: Heartbreak and alcohol drive Dr. Wandee away from his righteous path! The transformation from a good guy to a wild spirit leads him to share an intimate night with a boxer named Yoryak Padejsuek. Then their one-night stand evolves into an unexpected "boyfriends with benefits" arrangement!Initially intended as merely fake boyfriends, they quickly find themselves swept away by their emotions! However, with both nursing secret desires for others, they're hesitant to acknowledge their true feelings.

title: Don't Hate Your House with the Property Brothers
summary: Home renovation and real estate experts Drew and Jonathan Scott as they find a way to fix problematic homes for frustrated families who desperately want to love their house.

title: Backed by the Bros
summary: The Property Brothers offer their invaluable insight and resources to help inexperienced entrepreneurs find success with their high-stakes investment properties.

lead_actors: Rosa Brass, Sammy Cosgrove, Jim Johnson, Lu Corfield, John Wark
title: Mojo Swoptops
summary: Pre-schoolers will also get to meet Mojo Swoptops, the little truck that can SWOP her TOP! A vehicle with a difference using her ‘cardrobe' of swoptops, Mojo finds creative solutions to the problems facing her local community, the town of Swopsea.

lead_actors: Diaana Babnicova, Elliott Rose, Kit Rakusen, Flora Jacoby Richardson
title: The Famous Five
summary: Children and parents alike will enjoy the reimaging of the much-loved children's books; The Famous Five in three feature-length episodes. The first, directed by Tim Kirby will be aired in during the festive period bringing families together to watch the classic stories retold for a new generation. The series follows five daring young explorers as they encounter treacherous, action-packed adventures.

lead_actors: Justin Fletcher, Kassidi Roberts, Inel Tomlinson, Cadence Williams, Donna Preston
creators: Dan Gaster, Will Ing, Paul Powell
title: Pickle Storm
summary: The adventures of a nine-year-old girl with uncontrollable magical powers and who has fled her home in the fantasy land of Kleftania and ended up in a small UK town.

title: Hayabusa
summary: Mima Taro is a writer who has hit a slump. Tired of city life, he moves into the house he inherited from his father in the mountainous Hayabusa. When he joins the fire brigade, he becomes involved in a series of arson cases and suspicious incidents. As Taro searches for the truth, a huge conspiracy comes to the surface.

lead_actors: Cassandra Sánchez Navarro, Eugenio Siller, Fabrizio Santini, Dalilah Polanco, Erika Buenfil
title: Candy Cruz
summary: When her family secretly signs her up for a TV cooking competition, aspiring chef Candy must find the courage to chase her dreams.

title: Beijo Adolescente: O Futuro Está Morto
summary: Set in dystopian Brazil, this sci-fi drama follows a group of teens who seek to protect themselves from an evil that targets adults.

lead_actors: Natalie Nunn, Gia Mayham, Scotlynd Ryan, Chrisean Rock, Damerlin Baez
title: Baddies East
summary: Executive Producer Natalie Nunn, Chrisean Rock, Rollie and more of the OG Baddies are back to show up and show out with newbies like Sukihana and Sky — to take over the East Coast!

lead_actors: Akari Kitō, Shōya Chiba, Daiki Kobayashi, Kenjiro Tsuda, Minako Satō
title: After-school Hanako-kun
summary: The spirit Hanako-kun and his human assistant, first-year student Nene Yashiro, keep the peace between supernatural forces and the students of Kamome Academy. When they're not fighting to maintain balance between the living and spirit worlds, how do they spend their time? Join Hanako-kun and Nene on their adventures after school!

title: Aufgestaut
summary: A group of climate stickers has taken to the streets and is blocking traffic. Full commitment to the climate on one side, angry people on the other. Is this form of protest appropriate?

title: Börje - The Journey of a Legend
summary: From a small town in Sweden to an NHL icon - the inspiring story of hockey legend Börje Salming and his road to international stardom and passionate love.

title: Bump Up Business
summary: Bump Up Business is about a Kpop idol named Eden who's about to debut, he encounters an idol under the same agency as him named Ji Hoon. Not long after seeing Ji Hoon, Eden is told that he can only make his debut by doing a Business Gay Performance with Ji Hoon. Eden wants to reject such a reality but he follows what his agency wants him to do. Eden and Ji Hoon still squabble but over time they start to get closer. Misunderstandings between Ji Hoon and Eden begin to build up, will they be able to clear up the misunderstandings and find their true feelings for each other?

title: Lincoln Log Masters
summary: Inspired by Hasbro's iconic childhood toy, "Lincoln Log Masters" follows Cody, Wilson and the Knaughty Log Homes crew -- the only log home building company with the Lincoln Log stamp of approval -- as they design, build, break down, and rebuild epic log homes and structures across Oregon. Challenges abound for the KLH crew as they battle tight budgets, short timelines and the worst Mother Nature can throw at them. However, this team handles setbacks and successes with healthy doses of laughter and fun.

title: Near or Far
summary: Sisters Lauren and Sadie Mostafa are closer than most siblings. Not only because they're twins, but also because they belong to one of the only immigrant families in their bucolic lakefront Ontario town, necessitating a hive mind for code-switching, managing their high-strung parents, and keeping a lid on the details of their teenage lives. But for the first time in 18 years, the twins are going their separate ways, though vow to remain as close as ever as they venture down opposite paths. However, their time apart begins to reveal cracks in their family tree and realizations that their memories of shared moments bear no resemblance to one another, igniting a match that sees the twins keeping secrets, hiding truths, and careening towards an irreparable betrayal.

lead_actors: Lewis Gribben, Buket Kömür, Jay Lycurgo, Viola Prettejohn, Paul Bentall
title: Generation Z
summary: Set in the fictional town of Dambury, the kind of place with stark opportunities and not much to do. Grey, unassuming, forgotten. It's the last place you'd expect the apocalypse to begin… But when an army convoy overturns outside a care home, a chemical leak starts to have an adverse effect on the residents there. The OAPs, led by Cecily and Frank, escape the grasp of the army looking to contain their angry, violent, insatiable hunger for raw flesh.On the night of the outbreak, teenagers – Charlie, Kelly, Steff and Finn, are living normal teenage lives: tinnies, messy feelings, complex relationships and ignoring their A-Level prep. But the gang abruptly find themselves at the centre of the virus when Kelly's nan Janine, becomes infected and attacks her.Just because it's the end of the world, it doesn't mean your home life and relationship problems comes to a halt, as the gang come up against the zombie horde, battling with their parents, friendship betrayals and old family secrets rearing their ugly heads. And life is just as complicated for the zombies, with the virus fuelling single-minded desires, bringing a whole new dimension to their zombie rampage. Meanwhile, Finn worries for grandad-figure Morgan, when she comes to the realisation that there might be more behind the chemical spill. Just what exactly was being transported? Generation Z is about intergeneration justice and community breakdown that boldly satirizes a world where truth is stranger than fiction, exploring not just the political fault lines in our society but also the very real issues facing teenagers today.

lead_actors: Jason Watkins, Claire Skinner, David Bradley, Jonas Armstrong
title: Coma
summary: In Coma, Simon, a devoted family man, finds himself at a breaking point as his neighbourhood falls victim to the terrorising antics of a group of teenagers, led by the menacing 17-year-old Jordan Franklin, and his questionable companions. Simon and his wife, Beth, are desperate to move their young daughter to a safer area away from the threatening atmosphere. When Simon's frustration reaches its peak and he confronts Jordan outside his own home, a split-second decision changes everything.

title: Banged Up
summary: Six celebrities are participating in a four-part constructed documentary series where they will be locked up as prisoners for eight days, in decommissioned HMP Shrewsbury, to investigate what life is really like behind bars.The six well-known inmates will be incarcerated with a variety of real ex-criminals, including those who have served long sentences for serious crimes - although all are now reformed and have agreed to re-enter prison for this series. The well-known inmates will have the opportunity to interrogate their cellmates on their prison experiences and former crimes - as well as examine the impact of the system on them – for better or worse.Run by a former prison governor, with 20 years' experience in some of the UK's toughest prisons, and former prison officers, the inmates will live by current UK prison rules.

title: El gallo de oro
summary: Chance will play an important role in this series when a shy town crier, Dionisio Pinzón crosses paths with Bernarda, a famous fairground singer known as "La Caponera", causing both of their fortunes to change forever.

lead_actors: Ali Yasin Özegemen, Türkü Su Demirel, Hilal Yıldız, Kadir Polatçı, Cansın Özyosun
title: Kader Oyunları
summary: This is the story of a young girl who fights with all her might to maintain her innate goodness despite the darkness around her. When Bahar witnesses her father's murder, she decides to prove that Aysun, her stepmother, is the killer. At the same time, the love between Bahar and Demir, who met just a few days before the tragic event, grows stronger. However, Aysun's obsessive attachment to Demir and her determination to win him at any cost make this love increasingly impossible.

lead_actors: Ikumi Hasegawa, Nobunaga Shimazaki, Shunichi Toki, Mariya Ise, Daisuke Ono
title: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy!
summary: Rishe Irmgard Weitzner, a duke's daughter, has a secret: she died at the age of 20 and returned to the moment five years prior when her engagement was called off. She has already experienced this time loop six times and lived out those five years a different way each time, as a merchant, a doctor, a maid, a knight, and more. Now, on her seventh go-around, she's determined to live to a ripe old age and spend it relaxing. But the moment she flees the castle with that decision in her heart, she runs into the infamously cruel crown prince of a rival kingdom, Arnold Hein. He happens to be the one who killed her during her life as a knight, but now, he seems to have taken a bizarre liking to her... and begs her to become his wife. Thus, in order to stay alive and prevent a war, Rishe utilizes her previous experiences to kick off her seventh life as the bride of an enemy nation's crown prince.

title: Bye Bye, Earth
summary: In a world of anthropomorphic animals, Belle Lablac was born as the only human being. Having no fangs, fur, or scales, she was called "Faceless," and she lived a lonely life with no one else she could identify with. "I want to be part of the world..." With such longing in her heart, she decides to set out on a journey to find her roots, carrying the Runding, a great sword as tall as she is. She doesn't know how many adversities await her along the way...

lead_actors: Дарья Балабанова, Антон Рогачев, Антон Артемьев, Ульяна Пылаева, Карина Александрова
title: Жвачка
summary: Galya is counting the days until she can leave the walls of the orphanage and enter the script department of VGIK. On the Internet, she meets a self-confident and well-off guy Roma. A relationship is formed between them, but the guy does not take Galya seriously: for him, she is another victory, and the girl sticks to him like gum. Roma is ready to do anything to get rid of the obsessive persecution, and comes up with a story of his murder. This frivolous lie turns Gali's life into a nightmare, who is determined to find the killer.…

title: Trillion Game
summary: Two old friends go into business together - one's a master communicator, and the other's a great engineer. Their goal? To make a trillion dollars.

title: Codex 632
summary: Follows Tomás de Noronha, a History professor and a cryptoanalysis and ancient languages expert, who is hired to decipher an enigmatic message, but ends up on the trail of the true identity and mission of Christopher Columbus.

title: Space Nova
summary: It's the year 2162, and life is a blast for space adventuring siblings, Jet and Adelaide Nova and their parents, Josie and Hugo.During a routine research mission, these intrepid Aussie astronauts stumble across an abandoned alien space craft that appears to be powered by a rainbow substance that's so powerful it sends the craft zipping away at speeds humanity never dreamed possible.

lead_actors: Minami Hamabe, Emoto Tasuku, Miori Takimoto, Fumiya Takahashi, Ryo Katsuji
title: Dr. White
summary: A collapsed woman, wearing white clothes, is found at a park in the early morning hours. The woman introduces herself as Byakuya. Except for her name, she doesn't remember anything else about herself. She doesn't know general stuff either, but she holds extensive medical knowledge and has a genius-like diagnostic ability. With just the smallest amount of information, she is able to diagnose any disease. She begins to work with a diagnosis team at a hospital.

lead_actors: Uğur Güneş, Mehmet Ali Nuroglu, Kaan Çakır, Hakan Vanlı, Alou Traore
title: Kudüs Fatihi Selahaddin Eyyubi
summary: The television series centers on the life of Salahudddin, a 12th-century Muslim ruler, and his conquest of Jerusalem. It also delves into his challenges and conflicts against the Crusaders, as well as his ambition to unify the Muslim territories of Syria, northern Mesopotamia, Palestine, and Egypt under his leadership.

lead_actors: Marie Leuenberger, Mina-Giselle Rüffer, Paul Ahrens, Peter Jordan, Alessandro Schuster
title: Was wir fürchten
summary: Together with her mother Franka, Lisa moves to the remote town of Großstetten in the Black Forest. Above all, Franka, the town's new police chief, hopes the move will be a fresh start for her daughter. At her old school, the 17-year-old was bullied because of her panic attacks. Whilst Lisa cautiously gets in touch with her new classmates, she witnesses a gruesome suicide at the memorial service for the victims of a rampage at her school. Simon, another student at Großstetten, is confronted by his parents: They have found out that he is gay. Simon's father Karl, pastor of a strict free church community, convinces his son to undergo conversion therapy. While Franka's investigation brings to light some unresolved questions about the suicide, the realm of the dead seems to reach out to Lisa. With her super-sensory gift, Lisa gets closer and closer to the mystery of the creepy apparitions.

title: De Poli
summary: Esther was trained by her father, but believes that certain things at De Poli need to be changed. That is why she is trying to set up her own Sexology department. To her great frustration, her father finds her vision 'nonsense' and only causes delays without generating any money.

lead_actors: Jakob Ulrik Lohmann, Ellen Hillingsø, Josephine Park, Birgitte Hjort Sørensen
title: Oxen
summary: Niels Oxen is Denmark's most decorated hunting soldier. During battle in Mali, he loses his best friend because his superior, Major Hannibal Frederiksen, lets them down. Oxen succeeds in persuading the chairman of the defense committee, Johnny Gregersen, to set up a commission of inquiry to uncover the process. At the same time, the head of PET, Frigg Mossman, is conducting an unofficial investigation into a secret power network in Denmark.

lead_actors: Lizzie Freeman, Alex Rochon, Michael Kovach, Sean Chiplock, Amanda Hufford
title: The Amazing Digital Circus
summary: The Amazing Digital Circus is a psychological dark comedy. It follows a cast of humans—Pomni, Jax, Ragatha, Gangle, Kinger, and Zooble—who have become trapped in the titular circus, a virtual reality game. Under the direction of the circus's ringmaster, an artificial intelligence named Caine, they engage in nonsensical adventures to distract themselves from their situation, all while at risk of losing their sanity and "abstracting" into digital monstrosities.

title: Rachael Ray's Rebuild
summary: Rachael Ray knows firsthand that when disaster strikes your home, rebuilding your life is the toughest task of all. Rachael and her team are now using their experience and resources to help families rebuild their homes and their lives, better than before.

title: Deal or No Deal
summary: Deal or No Deal, the exhilarating hit game show where contestants must beat the Banker to win a huge cash prize of $100,000, is making a triumphant return to 10 and 10 Play.Hosted by TV Week Gold Logie award winner Grant Denyer, every episode is a high-pressure, high-stakes game of risk versus reward in which contestants face a series of potentially life-altering decisions.

title: Trixie Motel: Drag Me Home
summary: After months of sweat, tears, and lash glue, Trixie Motel has officially been open for almost a year and Trixie Mattel and her partner David look to do something some might say is even scarier: moving in together and designing a dream home fit for two.

lead_actors: Charles Fricks, Eliane Giardini, Barbara Reis, Ângelo Antônio, Tatá Werneck
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
title: Terra e Paixão
summary: Brave Aline sets off on a journey to defend her legacy and build a better future for herself and her family. After her husband's murder during an attempted invasion of the land where they live, the teacher becomes an agricultural producer, without ever having planted a seed, facing everything and everyone to make her new dream come true.

lead_actors: Manu Ríos, Blanca Suárez, Najwa Nimri, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, Borja Luna
title: Respira
summary: Biel is one of the residents who has been working in a public hospital for several months. Hundreds of shifts, thousands of hours, which barely leave him time for his life. But it is his vocation and he is willing to do whatever it takes to become the best doctor. What he does not imagine is that a total strike will break out in the hospital, with no minimum services. The doctors are forced to do this to try to raise public awareness of their essential work and to protest against all the intolerable cuts that the public health system is suffering. But Biel and the other residents do not know whether to go along with this strike that could have fatal consequences for patients. And from this conflict we will get to know each of them in their day to day life: who are these young people who go out of their way in the hospital, assuming excessive responsibility, and who are these adults willing to lose everything in order to fight for what they believe in?

title: Fermat no Ryori
summary: Kitada Gaku is gifted in mathematics. He dreamed of becoming a mathematician, but he gave up on his dream. He now spends his days without purpose. One day, he happens to meet a genius chef named Asakura Kai. Asakura Kai leads Kitada Gaku into the culinary world. Kitada Gaku soon joins Asakura Kai's two star restaurant K, where talented chefs from all around the world work together and learn together. There, Kitada Gaku also learns about cooking and develops his own recipes derived from mathematical thought. (Source: AsianWiki)

title: Anderson Spider Silva
summary: Anderson Spider Silva is a fictional biographical series about the life of the MMA fighter.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: The Ghosts of Adly Allam

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Ostaz Wa Ra'ees Kesm
Extraktoři
summary: The story focuses on a special unit of Czech intelligence, known as the Extraktoři (Extractors). The unit operates in secret and its main mission is to ensure the safe return of endangered Czechs from abroad. Extraktoři offers insight into the world of espionage and international covert operations. It provides a behind-the-scenes look at negotiations with terrorists, a topic that is often kept quiet by the world's governments, although they participate unofficially. Extraktoři are concerned with ensuring the safety of Czech citizens across borders, even at the cost of complex negotiations and solutions outside of traditional diplomatic channels.

lead_actors: Cem Yiğit Üzümoğlu, Buse Meral, Nazan Kesal, Merve Nur Bengi, Esra Ruşan️️️️
title: Aşka Düşman
summary: This story is the difficult journey of Inci and Uygar who forbid love to themselves for different reasons. As human beings run away from their greatest need, they become coldhearted, cruel, and even distant from themselves.

title: Сокровища императора
summary: As part of the new show, pairs of participants embark on a Great Chinese Adventure. During the month, they will have to travel around the region and complete various tasks at speed, which they will receive in each episode of the show. The winner will be the one who comes to the final point first.Participants will be tested for time, intelligence and endurance. However, the main condition is to show maximum human qualities in the pursuit of Treasure, making the right choice and making the right decisions. 13 couples will participate in the project. In each episode, one will leave the show.

lead_actors: Игорь Петренко, Александр Устюгов, Павел Трубинер, Дмитрий Куличков, Константин Гацалов
title: Банда ЗИГ ЗАГ
summary: The series is based on real events of the winter of 1941. Food supplies have dried up and supplies have been blocked. The besieged city was dying of hunger: employees, dependents and children were given 125 grams of bread per day. It was then that a gang appeared in Leningrad, engaged in fraud and robbery. The criminals were mainly involved in counterfeiting food cards.

lead_actors: Alexis Arroyo, Kike Vázquez, Verónica Merchant, Alejandro Calva, Paola Fernández
title: Ojitos de huevo
summary: When an aspiring blind comedian goes after his dreams, it's him and his best friend against the world, no matter what – or who – runs them over.

lead_actors: Martha Kelly, Kimberly Hébert Gregory, Mel Rodriguez, Beth Grant, Lawrence Pressman
title: Carol & The End of the World
summary: As a planetary apocalypse looms, a woman struggling to embrace end-times chaos searches for meaning in her last months on Earth.

title: Verified Stand-Up
summary: 10 comics. 10 sets. 1 show. Introducing: Verified Stand-Up, a new stand-up comedy series. Filmed at Webster Hall in New York City, the series features 10 of the best comedians in the game: Asif Ali, Dulcé Sloan, Gianmarco Soresi, Isiah Kelly, Leslie Liao, Nimesh Patel, Robby Hoffman, Rosebud Baker, Sabrina Wu, and Vanessa Gonzalez. Over the course of two-episodes, discover your new favorite comedian.

Is her marriage as good as it seems or is it about to end? Unsure whether to believe what she sees or hears or what she feels, Ezgi finds herself in a police station as she continues to question. Could her husband have killed a woman?

summary: To impress Serena during an evening at the disco, Lele, a student of humble origins in an elite high school in Bologna, takes a pill. It is the beginning of his ordeal.

Tom and Jerry

Also, Amy and Eric also have another friend named Harry, who is very smart. They are three new friends to go on adventures with! summary: Cristóbal Balenciaga makes his debut as a designer in Paris, but the designs that set a trend in Spain don't work well in the sophisticated empire of fashion where Chanel, Dior, and Givenchy set the trends. summary: Cata, an art expert originally from Mexico, is in a personal and professional rut. By chance he meets Iago, who sells trinkets to inexperienced collectors.

But so far none of them has not been able to take a worthy place in his heart.Several thousand applications were submitted for casting in the new project. But to get acquainted with Konstantin Getsati will be able only 26 girls. After the first meeting Konstantin will choose 16 applicants, among whom he will look for his second half in hot and mystical Morocco. Unbelievable locations, beautiful dates and, of course, the magic of love await the audience.What qualities should a psychic bride possess? Should she also have mystical abilities? How can you melt the heart of an Alanian psychic? And will Konstantin Getsati be able to discern his other half?

title: Black Santiago Club
summary: This Afrobeat thriller tells the story of a club in Cotonou where the great orchestra Black Santiago performs every night. When a developer covets the land to build a marina, a family of eccentric musicians persists in thwarting his plans: the owner Antoine, fighting against his brilliant saxophonist son Theo, and Sika, a young singer whose outstanding talent will bring a new meaning to her life as well as second wind to the band.

title: Az Árulók - Gyilkosság a kastélyban
summary: Contestants in the game move into a majestic castle and work as a team to complete a series of dramatic and challenging missions to earn money for the prize pot. Some contestants are traitors some are loyal.

Heated discussion erupts about her father's political career in the Videla regime – a discussion she never faced in her own circles. What allows this Argentine to finally thrive at an old European court? And how can Máxima stay true to herself without giving up her family – or do these things not go together?

And while the mothers are trying to reconcile the families, the elder Skvortsov is doing everything so that the son refuses the bride with suspicious relatives.

summary: A healing melodrama about the fate of Cha Jin Woo, a deaf person who is used to express emotions through pictures instead of words, and Jung Moo Eun, who expresses her heart with her voice.

summary: Eternal buddies Frakke and Jempie try to build their own garage... with lots of problems, surprises, ambushes and nonsense.

title: House of Laughs
summary: Enjoy an evening of the funniest and fiercest LGBTQ+ comedians and drag queens delivering half-hour stand-up specials filled with hilarious and irreverent jokes, stories, impressions and so much more!

title: Faster with Newbern and Cotten
summary: Everyone wants their car to be better, faster, stronger, but can a difference be made on a small budget in a few days? David Newbern and Mike Cotten may not have all the answers, but they're will to give it a run by mixing affordable upgrades with sweat equity. They show the ideology, technology and work it takes to add speed in a matter of days without breaking the bank.

title: Jin Zhan Fashi
summary: He is a great fighter in real life, but he is mistakenly assigned a "Mage" job class in a virtual reality game. He is someone who uses power to conquer power, so he makes the most out of the mistake and transforms into a fierce Mage, versed in close combat, in the blink of an eye. By perfectly combining strength and spells, he uncovers a new path of gaming. Fireball? Chain Lightning? Frost Mirror... Wait just a minute; I've come to practice kung fu. Spells have nothing to do with me. What's that? I'm a Mage? Oh, right. I am a Mage indeed. But... Are you certain I'm one? Alright... Feel the might of my saber. My sword. My hidden weapons. What? You're saying I'm no Mage now? Let me prove it to you if you don't believe me. But even if you believe me, I will still show you just how unstoppable a Mage who knows kung fu can be. — Webnovel

lead_actors: Adrian Lester, Simon Pegg, Alison Steadman, Nina Sosanya

An international bestseller for seven decades, 89-year-old Quentin Blake has written or illustrated over 500 books and his memorable works are loved across the world for their unique illustrations and joyful, captivating stories.From Jack and Nancy's exhilarating island adventure to Zagazoo's hilariously off-beat antics, Loveykins' extraordinary transformation to the zany inventions of Mrs Armitage, these beautifully crafted and engaging stories of fun, friendship and adventure will deliver family entertainment at its very best and provide an exclusive treat for audiences.

lead_actors: Kat Sadler, Lizzie Davidson, Louise Brealey, Paul Bazely, Freddie Meredith
title: Such Brave Girls
summary: Such Brave Girls explores life and love in all its ugly chaos. Join Josie, Billie and their mum, Deb as they attempt to claw their way towards a better life. Armed only with an ability to see the line and boldly step over it, these very brave girls finally have a chance to explore themselves - but should they?

title: Analog Squad
summary: After learning of his estranged father's sickness, a scheming middle-aged man assembles a fake family to reunite with him for one last time.

title: Eddie's Lil' Homies
summary: Eddie's Lil' Homies, a new animation inspired by the popular book series of the same name by former AFL star Eddie Betts.

title: The Streets Hong Kong
summary: Embark on a culinary adventure with Dan Hong through Hong Kong's bustling streets. Experience the city's diverse food culture, from Western-inspired cha chaan teng to smoky claypot rice served at outdoor eateries.

An existential link to her troubled past and the mother of the dead man grab Meenakshi into investigating the accident. The world tries to brush it under a thick carpet. But when the accident points to an incredible bio-terror plot, the young PI must fight.

lead_actors: Jess Schafer, Nihal Arthanayake, Jan Blake
title: Musical Storyland
summary: CBeebies and BBC Education have commissioned Musical Storyland, a major new ten-part series featuring the BBC Philharmonic that brings famous stories from around the world to life using the power of music.The series follows the success of the BBC Philharmonic's film The Musical Story of the Gingerbread Man and is the first time an orchestra has ever been commissioned to make a series of films for network television.The stories are narrated by a host of stars and the series features a number of internationally renowned guest musicians, all accompanied by brand new teaching resources on the BBC Teach website available for schools to utilise.Using live action and animation alongside original compositions, stories featured in the series include The Baobab Tree, Jack and the Beanstalk, Ananse and the Monkeys and The Hare and the Tortoise.

lead_actors: Arthur Lowe, John Le Mesurier, Clive Dunn
title: Dad's Army: The Animations
summary: Brand-new animated episodes of Dad's Army, created using archive audio recordings of early episodes.

title: Top 5 Beatdown
summary: Ryan and Shane compare asinine top 5 lists with a topical expert, inspiring surprisingly heated debate.

title: The Investigator
summary: A story about risk management follows a team of investigators who work together to eliminate fraud.Xia Dong who works as an investigator for a global company that specializes in risk management has always considered professional ethics to be his life's mission. In order to complete a job that was assigned to him and to uncover the truth behind an incident that got him framed while studying abroad, Xia Dong transfers from US headquarters to the Shanghai branch. In his new office, he encounters Jian Yan, his junior at school who now works as an investigator. In the following days and nights, Xia Dong's righteousness and kindness shines through and easily helps in resolving the misunderstandings from the past. Soon after, Xia Dong and Jian Yan are conducting a background check on a company and find themselves facing repeated threats on their life after they helped Lin Jun Wen, an old classmate.

title: Histoire de l'antisémitisme
summary: Why has hatred of the Jews continued to reappear over the ages? From anti-Judaism to modern anti-Semitism, this great documentary story explores the many facets of the phenomenon, from its origins to the present day, with the help of some thirty international experts, drawing on both on a body of archives and on historical 3D images originally developed by Ubisoft for its Assassin's Creed series.

lead_actors: Doug Hadders, Annick Obonsawin, Julie Sype
title: 3 Amigonauts
summary: Set in Earth's far-flung future, 3 Amigonauts is a rocket-paced comedy about three bumbling buds who attend the solar system's most prestigious space academy. Life is one big party for these delightful ding-dongs as they super-size the smallest tasks into madcap intergalactic adventures!

title: Studio Battaglia
summary: Studio Battaglia is the most prestigious divorce law firm in Milan. Anna, daughter of Marina and sister of Nina and Viola, works there and decides to accept a new job at the Zander studio where she meets Massimo again, who had made her heart beat during her university days. Was accepting this job the right choice? But the women of the Battaglia family are united by a very deep love and an invincible irony that has always saved them, even when everything seemed to be collapsing.

lead_actors: Birce Akalay, Mert Fırat, Engin Hepileri, Erdem Şenocak, Başak Gümülcinelioğlu
title: Bir Derdim Var
summary: In this innovative series aiming to shine a ray of hope on teenagers and families grappling with adolescence issues, we will witness the discovery of the secrets of the human mind while walking on shards of glass alongside Doctor Nilüfer Toska (Birce Akalay), who is always one step ahead of her colleagues, and we will see that hope is always hidden in life. Dr. Nilüfer's relentless pursuit of a secret that could endanger her profession will turn into a major conflict with the uncompromising Prosecutor Ömer (Mert Firat), creating a massive fire.

lead_actors: Lee Young Ae, Lee Moo Saeng, Hwang Bo Reum Byul, Kim Young Jae, Park Ho San
title: Maestra: Strings of Truth
summary: Cha Se Eum used to be a violinist, but she is now a conductor of an orchestra. She has pursued her career boldly and with passion. She is now in a position where others are envious. What others don't know is that Cha Se Eum carries a secret. That secret will shake her life. Meanwhile, mysterious cases take place within her orchestra. Cha Se Eum looks into the cases and approaches the truth surrounding her.

lead_actors: Ji Chang Wook, Shin Hye Sun
title: Welcome to Samdal-ri
summary: After losing his mother—who worked as a haenyeo —at a young age due to a mistaken weather report, Jo Yong Pil makes up his mind to become a weather forecaster and protect the elders of his hometown. However, his passion and refusal to let misinformation slide earns him a reputation at work as a stubborn troublemaker who isn't afraid to argue with his boss.

lead_actors: Tayah Callender, Isabella Mai Jones, Sonny Shaw, Gillian Dean

Judges Gordon Ramsay, his daughter Tilly Ramsay, Aarón Sánchez and Daphne Oz will crown a winner, who takes home the ultimate holiday gift: a $25,000 grand prize, a Viking Kitchen package and one-of-a kind MasterChef snow globe trophy. And this holiday season, each junior chef will leave with a kitchen-related prize, including a Viking Kitchen package for the runner-up.

lead_actors: Lee Jae In, Kim Woo Suk, Choi Ye Bin, An Ji Ho, Jeong So Ri

title: Allegiance
summary: Allegiance follows on identity and belonging, policing and politics, and finding truth within the heart of a flawed justice system. Sabrina Sohal is a star rookie police officer who must grapple with the limits of the justice system as she fights to exonerate her politician father Ajeet Sohal. Sohal serves her diverse hometown of Surrey alongside Vince Brambilla, a veteran training officer who sees her potential but doesn't always agree with her forward-thinking methods. Allegiance is the story of a young woman caught between her allegiance to her flag, to her badge, and to her family.

lead_actors: Danielle Vitalis, Jon Pointing, Aisling Bea, Blair Underwood
title: Smothered
summary: Will they? Won't they? Should they? Shouldn't they?Smothered, is a not so typical rom-com. A tale of two worlds colliding, where romance blossoms but the pressures of modern dating linger.

lead_actors: Chrissy Teigen, David Chang, Joel Kim Booster
title: Chrissy & Dave Dine Out
summary: Chrissy & Dave Dine Out will take viewers to must-try restaurants in Los Angeles that are unexpected and, at times, off the beaten path. While David gets his hands dirty in the back of house with the restaurant's chef, Chrissy and Joel will hold court in the front of house, hosting an always loose, unexpected and entertaining dinner party with undeniably delicious food and great conversation. Celebrity guests handpicked by Chrissy, David and Joel will bring laughs and unfiltered conversations, where no topic is off limits.

title: Top Combat Pilot
summary: Dennis Quaid takes us inside the most elite aviation program in America. Known as WTI, the Marine's version of Top Gun invites the best of the best combat pilots from every squadron in the country to prove their mettle. All are out to perfect their specialty, operating an unrivaled air fleet including F-18 Hornets, Huey, and Cobra Combat helicopters. The pilots who distinguish themselves earn a coveted invitation to return as an instructor…while those who slip up might not graduate at all.

title: Qi Hou Bilu
summary: When the Epang Palace was burned to the ground two thousand years ago, the School of Naturalists' ancestors lamented that Qin Shihuang had degraded Confucians and burned books, saying that "if you don't teach the world, all the talents will be wasted." When the literati died, he started to concentrate their souls. To ensure that his skills are passed down to future generations, finish the Chinese brush. A normal college student named Luo Zhongxia accidently acquired Li Bai's Qinglian posthumous Chinese brush two thousand years later, and ever then, he has held the superpowers provided by the brush spirit. The happy times did not endure, however, as other forces were drawn to the potent influence of Qinglian's works, which frequently put Luo Zhongxia in danger. Luo Zhongxia dedicated himself to finding a way to retract his essay in order to prevent conflicts, but he kept running across roadblocks. He instead developed a strong bond with the "Seven Lords in charge of the city".

lead_actors: Fleur Geffrier, Vincent Elbaz, Pierre Perrier, Louis-Do de Lencquesaing, Olivier Faliez
title: Les Espions de la terreur
summary: The hunt for those responsible for the November 2015 attacks is putting the French secret services under great strain. Among them, Lucie, an experienced and determined DGSI anti-terrorist agent, fights to advance the investigation. She joins forces with Malika, a seasoned analyst from the DGSE. The limitless commitment of these anonymous heroes, ready to do anything to protect France from new attacks, will undermine their private lives and awaken deep scars.

title: Here Comes Your Man
summary: Two very different young men come together in a show that follows their relationship, from beginning to end.

title: Oshi ga Joshi ni Narimashite
summary: Nakajo Hitomi works as an OL and she is huge fan of stage actor Kiryu Toma. Her big joy in life is to watch him perform in stage plays, but she has been recently feeling down because of Toma's sudden retirement from acting. One day, she meets her new boss Takagi Shuichi. Surprisingly, her new boss is the retired stage actor Kiryu Toma, but using his birth name. After his retirement, he began to work at the company in which his father runs and where Hitomi works. He becomes popular with the female employees at the company and he behaves sweetly to all of them. Hitomi wants to talk to him like the other female employees, but, when she gets the chance, she panics and gives him a cold reaction. Shuichi becomes interested in Hitomi, who seems different from the other female employees.Season 2 doesn't continue on season 1 but instead does a parallel scenario.

lead_actors: Kim Hyang Gi, Shin Hyun Seung, Yeon Oh
title: Secret Playlist

When popular boy group member Levi takes notice of PLII and requests to collaborate, Han Joo will do anything to hide her secret identity. But as the two grow closer working on a class project, Han Joo's cover begins to unravel. Will Levi discover her secret?

lead_actors: Belsheber Rusape, Michael Kovach, Lisa Reimold, Benni Latham, Malcolm Ray
title: Lackadaisy

lead_actors: Shayla McCormack, Jessica Brown Findlay, Rasmus Hardiker
title: Isadora Moon
summary: Isadora Moon, adapted from author and illustrator Harriet Muncaster's international best-selling book series, is a series full of humour, heart and magical adventures. Enchanted and human worlds collide as 8-year-old half-fairy half-vampire, Isadora Moon, chooses to go to human school, navigating all sorts of adventures with her friends.

lead_actors: Filipe Bragança, Julianna Gerais, João Oliveira, Lara Tremouroux, Luana Nastas
title: Últimas Férias
summary: At the end of a year full of competitions, a group of young athletes decides to spend their last vacation together on an island paradise. Far from their families and isolated from the world, it seemed like the perfect trip. But when the body of one of them is found lifeless in the sea, friendships are tested and secrets come to light in a breathtaking thriller where each and every one is a suspect.

lead_actors: Marie Colomb, Philypa Phoenix, Marilyne Canto, Vincent Heneine
title: Follow
summary: The Paris judicial police are investigating a serial killer who drugs his victims before cutting off their thumbs, and who steals their phones to post a final photo on social media after the fact.Léna, a young intern who works in the communications department of the Paris police headquarters, alerts the judicial police officers after noticing that the account of Capucine de Warren, the most followed influencer in France, has just posted a photo that had already been posted a year earlier. The police rush to the young influencer's home and find her drugged and mutilated like the other victims but still alive.In order to catch the culprit as quickly as possible, Commissioner Agathe Ruffin takes the risk of integrating Léna into her team in order to benefit from her knowledge of social media. Léna manages to communicate with the killer and get a clue about his next victim, but the ensuing police operation turns into a fiasco and leads to the humiliation of the police on social media.From being a valuable collaborator, Léna becomes a suspect in the eyes of the commissioner and her police officers.

title: Australian Epic
summary: A musical extravaganza that breathes new life into some of the country's most defining stories, by giving them the full musical treatment they've always deserved.

title: Me Contro Te — La Famiglia Reale
IXE-13 et la course à l'uranium
summary: IXE-13 – code name of agent Jean Thibault (Marc-André Grondin) – returns to service to face a double threat: that of the Russians who are looking for uranium to create a bomb and that of a Nazi group seeking the same thing to conquer the world.

title: Mercato
summary: Thomas Chevalier, an office cop with an exemplary career to date, happens to be at the airport at the time of the historic arrival of OM's new star recruit to France, when he is forced to intervene to neutralize a madman who is about to attack the footballer. Unwittingly, he injures the player, putting an end to the Marseille dream before it has even begun...

lead_actors: Marin Judas, Antoine Simony, Namory Bakayoko
title: Culte
summary: Season 1: In 2001, Isabelle, Raphaël, Karim, and their teams had less than four months to get a new show on the air: Loft Story, a French remake of the Big Brother format. In France, they are the first ones to produce a ‘reality TV' show and have to invent everything from scratch. Culte is a fictional series inspired by real events.Season 2: Longjumeau, 1996. Filip, Adel, and Frank, lifelong best friends, dream of breaking through the walls of their suburban town. Will they manage to survive their dream and remain faithful to their friendship?

lead_actors: Chen Jianbin, Hu Jun, Deng Jia Jia, Shi Ce, Lu Hong
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Frozen Surface
summary: Guan Yu, who was a soldier, has a meticulous mind, rigorous style, and extremely hard physical and mental quality. He has solved numerous major and small cases. From a simple and fierce little white criminal policeman, he has grown all the way to a wise and experienced Lanhe County Criminal Police Team Captain. Guan Yu's physical condition went from bad to worse after being promoted to captain of the criminal police. After the 1223 major case, Guan Yu was faced with danger. Under the pressure of time, pressure from superiors, and the loss of relatives and comrades in arms, the black hand of evil is still hidden under the glacier. In the face of this case with many intertwined and implicated cases, can Guan Yu hold high the light of justice and the fire of hope in his hands?

lead_actors: Anna Samson, Tai Hara, Catherine McClements, Lloyd Griffith, Aaron L. McGrath
creators: Robert Thorogood, Peter Mattessi, James Hall
title: Return to Paradise
summary: DI Mackenzie Clarke was meant to be back in the UK, living the life she's always wanted. Instead, she's still in Dolphin Cove. Lucky for Mack, her compulsion to solve impossible cases serves as a great distraction.

title: Radiradirah
summary: An all-star team of Kiwi talent contributed to this sketch comedy — including Taika Waititi, Rhys Darby, the bro'Town team, and 'special guest stars' Jemaine Clement and John Clarke. In-between one-off and ongoing sketches, there were regular appearances by Taika Waititi as an oddball alien character with plans for planet Earth. There were also animated inserts like laconic sheep tale The Pen, FOT (Funny Orange Thing) and the Kiwi accents of Beached Az. Eight episodes screened on TV3. Bro'Town creator Elizabeth Mitchell was producer and lead director.

lead_actors: Ben Miller, Sally Phillips, Michael Theo, Roy Billing, Gia Carides
creators: Ben Miller, Lloyd Woolf, Joe Tucker, Darren Ashton
title: Austin
summary: When much-loved children's author Julian Hartswood inadvertently causes a social media storm, his career and that of his illustrator wife Ingrid appears to be over. That is until Austin, the neurodivergent son that Julian never knew existed, turns up out of the blue. Could embracing this modern nuclear family be Julian's route back from cancellation? Will Ingrid forgive him for being such a pompous shit? One thing is for certain: if Julian thinks Austin is going to be a push over, he's in for a rude awakening.

lead_actors: Derek Xiao, Jordan Lloyd, Tiffany Mitchell
title: Big Brother Reindeer Games
summary: A holly jolly showdown of Big Brother Legends is coming to CBS in the hit reality show's first holiday special.

title: Føkkings Fladseth
summary: Life is smiling for stand-up comedian Henrik Fladseth, but everything is in danger of unraveling when he is accused of having "blackfaced" himself at a nachspiel.

title: The Drive
summary: A makeshift family of five roommates struggle to carve their own path while living on Vancouver's eclectic, diverse and unpredictable Commercial Drive.

title: Bae Beyond Borders
summary: Four single South African ladies are on a quest to find love in Nigeria. During the first round of dating, Southie babes jump on online dates with 12 Nigerian bachelors.

lead_actors: Serkan Şenalp, Gizem Arikan, Korhan Herduran, Zeynep Kankonde, Eray Kaman
title: Kod Adı Kırlangıç
summary: The common curiosity of children living in the same neighborhood is technology. There are both those who help the children who come together to design drones and the bad guys who try to prevent them... The series will bring the exciting stories of technology-savvy children to the screen

title: Deca zla
summary: A masked perpetrator murders a prominent politician and leaves an old, golden coin in his hand. Nikola Bobic, a defence attorney, reluctantly takes a case and plunges into a dangerous game that will change his life forever.

lead_actors: Marcus Bentley, AJ Odudu, Will Best
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Sunday
title: Celebrity Big Brother: Late & Live
summary: Celebrity Big Brother: Late & Live will once again be the only place to watch the famous evictees first live interview alongside an array of unmissable exclusive features including access to the camera runs, special guest commentary and debate.

lead_actors: Dominique Devenport, Jeanette Hain, David Kross
title: Davos 1917
summary: The First World War is ravaging Europe. By contrast, Davos, the noble spa town in the Swiss Alps, seems like an oasis of peace. But behind the scenes, neutral Switzerland takes centre stage in a relentless battle between the secret agents of the world powers. The young nurse Johanna Gabathuler unexpectedly gets caught between the fronts of the spies: to win back her daughter, she gets involved in a deadly game with the German Secret Service – and suddenly becomes the tip of the scales in a risky plan that decides between war and peace.

lead_actors: Georgina Leeming, Sand Van Roy, Claire Olivier, Pierre-Benoist Varoclier
title: Virgin
summary: When 22-year-old virgin Ellie falls in love with Olivier, her roommates Kira and Veronique convince her to gain some sexual experience before sleeping with him for the first time. Under their guidance, Ellie soon masters the art of seduction in the age of Tinder, free porn and sexual fluidity. But will it all backfire?

title: Capitalisme américain, le culte de la richesse
summary: Over the course of a gripping story that goes from 1870 to today, "American Capitalism – The Cult of Wealth" tells how a small elite has always justified its hyper-wealth in America. From the powerful philanthropic alibi to the constantly renewed promise of trickle-down, from the myth of the self-made man to the heroic figure of the visionary genius of Silicon Valley, this documentary reveals a grand capitalist narrative that is both immutable and unalterable, and at the same time the shadow of which 722 billionaires and 22 million American millionaires continue to enrich themselves without limit and in complete discretion.

lead_actors: Ra Chapman, Greg Stone, Roz Hammond, Harvey Zielinski, Chris Pang
title: White Fever
summary: Jane is a cocky Korean-Australian adoptee with a love of hairy white guys – the hairier and whiter the better. When her friends call her out for having a white man fetish she sets out to try and reprogram her libido, reignites a connection with childhood friend, Yu Chang and stumbles into the process of finding out who she really is. From hens' nights to country weddings, moon crystals, "gotcha" days and adoptee dinners, it's a K-Pop-infused, action-packed, wild ride filled with revelations, surprises and a large helping of Asian pop culture.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Our Interpreter
summary: Lin Xi who's known as the "witch" in the translation industry reunites with ex-boyfriend Xia Yicheng. Eight years ago, she broke up with him for the sake of fulfilling her mother's wish for her to become a professional interpreter for the United Nations.Eight years later, Lin Xi has become the youngest chief interpreter at Huasheng while her ex Xiao Yicheng has become the chief technology officer of a communications company, which also makes him her potential client.In order to land a contract with Xiao Yicheng, Lin Xi has no choice but to keep dealing with him. She helps his company go public and even though it seems that Xiao Yicheng is out to get revenge on Lin Xi, he actually doesn't have the heart to be mean to her. Work rekindles their passionate relationship and Xiao Yicheng gradually comes to understand that reason she broke up with him.

lead_actors: Bartłomiej Topa, Katarzyna Herman, Martyna Byczkowska, Michal Sikorski, Kirył Pietruczuk
summary: In this satirical comedy, a zany nobleman navigates through family feuds and clashes with peasants in his quest to become Poland's most famous figure.

Anh Does Vietnam
