title: Renovation Aloha

The show will follow the couple, who were born and raised on the island, as they tackle substantial renos in one of the most expensive states in the country. Luckily, Tristyn and Kamohai can rely on a helping hand from their large family, which includes 87 first cousins, many of whom are in the construction industry.

lead_actors: Jax Taylor, Brittany Cartwright, Kristen Doute, Janet Caperna, Luke Broderick

title: Claude

title: Hot Yachts Miami

lead_actors: Yūma Uchida, Shōya Chiba, Nobunaga Shimazaki, Yuichi Nakamura, Ryōta Suzuki

He's just started at Furin High School, a school of degenerates known only for their brawling strength—strength they use to protect their town from anyone who wishes it ill. But Haruka's not interested in being a hero or being part of any sort of team—he just wants to fight his way to the top !

As men become rarer, they're hailed as "national treasures," and women must win their affections in a government-sponsored competition called "Ready, Set, Love." When Day is unexpectedly accepted into the competition, she meets the most popular guy, Son. Their burgeoning love and the world as they know it are threatened when they uncover a conspiracy operating beneath the surface.

title: Santiago
summary: A family of pilgrims, in disintegration, begins the Camino, towards Santiago. A bumpy path, where they meet pilgrims from around the world and face an unexpected danger: a serial killer. Which one will be the next victim?

lead_actors: Julia Reilly, Riley Hough, Tim Perez-Ross, Percy Bell, Brett Varvel
title: County Rescue
summary: Dani and the other EMTs in training are courageous, everyday heroes. But with only one opening for three trainees, Dani's faith in herself is tested each and every call. Dani believes her calling is to save lives. Now, she has to prove it.

lead_actors: Александра Куликова, Лидия Шевченко, Мария Поликарпова, Ульяна Плащевская, Игорь Иванов
title: Четвёртый
summary: An evil spirit lives in an apartment building, where one floor once completely burned down. After the tragedy, local residents begin to feel the presence of an evil force, which becomes the source of more and more troubles. The burnt floor was closed, the button in the elevator was pressed out. It is impossible to get on it unless the spirit wants it. Three friends decide to take a ride on the elevator as a bet - so a simple prank turns into a nightmare when one of them gets stuck on that ill-fated floor.

title: Haru wa Mijikashi Koiseyo Danshi
summary: Follow the lives and romantic pursuits of four high school boys, who all have no experience with romance.

title: Kesenai "Watashi": Fukushu no Rensa
summary: An entertaining revenge drama follows Haibara Shoko, an ordinary high school girl who vows revenge after all of her family and friends are taken from her. Shoko, an ordinary high school girl, became an internet celebrity after she appeared in beauty streamer Tokumichi Hitoshi's video. However, her classmates, who are jealous of her success, lure her into a trap and film her being assaulted. As a result, the video goes viral and is spread across the internet - making her a target of hate.

title: Italian Food Safari
summary: Join Melbourne chef Guy Grossi and Maeve O'Meara on an Australia-wide journey to discover more about Italian food and culture, as well as how traditional recipes and techniques are still used worldwide.

lead_actors: Sofie Gråbøl, Pål Sverre Hagen, Marijana Jankovic, Sara Hjort Ditlevsen, Afshin Firouzi
title: Dag & Nat
summary: Departmental midwife Ella and her staff fight a daily battle to give mothers, newborns and relatives the best possible treatment despite strong understaffing. At the same time, she is doing everything she can to suppress her growing feelings for the married pediatrician Jerry.

title: Saiko no Seito: Yomei Ichinen no Last Dance
DreamTeam, la relève des Stars
summary: 6 French artists and their teams, made up of young singers, compete in an exceptional show. Each of these teams will be made up of talented children who are fans of an artist. These singers will compete in breathtaking duels, surrounded by children who will all wear the same outfit as their mentor, like "mini-them". And, at the end, only one team and its Mentor will be declared the winner!

title: Qui veut être mon associé ?
summary: They come from all over France with different backgrounds and ages. They have all had an idea that will perhaps change the daily life of the French, but they all lack crucial elements: support, advice and funding. They will have the unique opportunity to meet six well-known French investors, and will have to convince them to commit to their side.

title: The Inside Man
summary: What is The Inside Man?The Inside Man series started out as a challenge: ‘is it possible to create a drama about information security that rivals anything seen on Netflix?'The result was The Inside Man, Season 1, a twelve episode storyline, featuring Mark, a relatable anti-hero hacker who has been tasked by a sinister ‘controller' to infiltrate a company and help bring it down. Like all the best-loved TV dramas, the key to success was a binge-worthy, gripping storyline with a cast of funny, heroic, resourceful, colorful and skilled characters, whose exploits just had to be reprised for a second and third season. The rest, as they say, is history. The Inside Man ‘family' have now reunited for a fifth season that sees them taking on cyber threats in far-flung parts of the globe. All the adventure, drama and action show no signs of slowing anytime soon. Join us!

title: RIMBA Racer
summary: RIMBA Racer is an action-packed animation series revolving around Tag, a talented rookie racer and newcomer to the prestigious RIMBA Grand Prix, a racing competition full of tough rivals, dangerous challenges and hidden agendas.

title: Koža
summary: Koža is a Serbian television series filmed in 2023 based on a script by Nikola Pejaković and directed by Saša Hajduković. It represents the third and final part of the trilogy about the city of Banja Luka, which comes after the great regional success of the film and the series Meat and Bones.

lead_actors: Sinem Ünsal, Alp Navruz, Nilperi Sahinkaya, Tansel Öngel, Uğur Uzunel
title: Senden Önce
summary: The battle of two female characters who challenge each other and are ready to fight. What binds them together in their past?

title: A Culpa é do Cabral
summary: Five great names from the Brazilian stand up, from different regions of the country, come together to share everyday matters and the particular characteristics of Brazilians in a comical, acidic and fun way.

title: Love Deadline
summary: Looking for true love, women meet potential husbands while traveling to scenic locales. The catch? Only women can propose, while men are on the clock.

title: Super Rich in Korea
summary: Super Rich in Korea unveils a realm where luxury cars and haute couture are everyday sights, and exclusive parties are the norm. It's a deep dive into a lifestyle where wealth meets Korean cultural flair.

title: Hand aufs Herz
summary: Follow the lives of a group of students and teachers of an imaginary high school. It shows the rivalries between the volleyball club and the song-and-dance group. It deals with important subjects like forbidden student/teacher affairs, coming out, and drug abuse, with help from songs that can be affronted and overtaken.

creators: Anne Wood, Steve Roberts, Joel Stewart
title: B.O.T. and the Beasties
summary: B.O.T. (Beastie Observation Transmitter) is a small robot who travels around 5 different worlds collecting sound and picture data from the various Beasties who inhabit them.

lead_actors: Annabel Scholey, Colin Morgan, Kerri Quinn, Waj Ali, Michael Hanna
title: Dead and Buried
summary: Outside the supermarket with her young son, Cathy encounters Michael - the man convicted of the brutal murder of her brother, 20 years earlier. Ignoring the advice of her best friend, Cathy takes to social media, uncovering the successful career and family life Michael has forged for himself since early release from prison, while she grieved for her brother.Re-traumatised by her past, Cathy instigates a clandestine relationship with the man she despises, embarking on a campaign of harassment and deceit. As Cathy's obsession grows, dark fantasies of revenge and reality blur as she sets out on a campaign of psychological warfare to destroy Michael's life.

lead_actors: George Turner, Kane Surry, Janak Nirmal
title: Peckham Mix
summary: When Josh's fiancé leaves him for a new guy he finds himself shattered – and in need of a new place to live. He ends up moving in with Rex and Connor, a mysterious pair. He quickly becomes intrigued by their late-night excursions. Encouraged to live a little, he joins them on an outing – and the night proves more exciting that he could have imagined. Crime doesn't pay… but revenge does.

lead_actors: Demet Evgar, Buğra Gülsoy, Hatice Aslan, Ecem Özkaya, Mehmet Yılmaz Ak
title: Bahar
summary: When Bahar comes face to face with death, she will encounter another face of her family, especially her husband Timur, who seems 'perfect' from the outside. With Bahar's sudden illness, all dynamics in the family will change. In this process, Evren will be Timur's rival in every sense. Bahar's reconstruction of her life will instill hope in the audience, often with tragicomic stories.

title: Tea Time
summary: Newly ascended to fame, young rock stars must not only go on a national tour, but also write new songs and be able to stay on the wave of popularity, otherwise the label will take away all rights to their music.

title: A Mensageira
summary: Mari is a seemingly ordinary girl who, while sleeping, incorporates spirits thirsty to resolve earthly issues. To try to deal with this situation, she hires a psychologist to... treat the spirits!

title: Valt the Wonder Deer
summary: As a descendant of the Deer King, it is Valt's duty to travel the Five Lands and obtain the magic elements in order to save his parents from evil.

title: Leo the Wildlife Ranger
summary: Leo the Wildlife Ranger features action-packed, animal-centric missions led by enthusiastic and resourceful Junior Wildlife Rangers - the brother-sister duo, Leo and Katie, and their loyal puppy, Hero. They travel around the world helping other Junior Wildlife Rangers with animal rescue and research missions, and uncovering fun and interesting animal facts!

title: Enterrement de Vie de Garçon
summary: Five friends spend the night together before a momentous event. What they don't know is that one of them has a big announcement to make to them...

title: Siukslyno Zmones
summary: Wrongly accused of killing another child and avoiding the colony, twelve-year-old Matas runs away from the orphanage. He is joined by ten-year-old Guste, who has become an accomplice in the escape. Pretending to be brother and sister Saukos, the children live in one of the biggest garbage dumps in Lithuania. In it, hunger, exploitation, violence and inevitable death await them. Matas creates a plan to escape, but fate prepares unpleasant surprises to stop them... The series are based on the motifs of the famous novel by E. Malukas "People of the Dump", which shocks from the first shots.

title: Mappy
summary: Mappy, a retired police mouse, takes a job as a security guard at Nyamco, only to discover it's a cover for a criminal gang led by Goro. He teams up with colleagues Dig Dug and Sky Kid to uncover the conspiracy.

lead_actors: Алексей Чумаков, Илья Сафронов, Сергей Сафронов, Андрей Сафронов
title: Империя иллюзий: братья Сафроновы

lead_actors: Полина Денисова, Анастасия Светлова, Анна Снаткина, Серафима Соловьёва, Сергей Ланбамин
title: Бедные смеются, богатые плачут
summary: Katya, hiding from the problems that her brother "threw" at her, gets a job living in a mansion on Rublevka. In a huge estate, behind a high fence, oligarch Sergei gathers the whole family under one roof — his real, third wife and their children together, as well as two ex-wives and children from previous marriages, to announce to them that he is terminally ill and "has not long to live."The ex-wives are already mentally dividing the inheritance, Katya gets closer to the eldest son of the owner of the mansion, Misha, who pretends to be an employee of the estate. His eldest daughter Olya, who is acutely worried about the forced return to Moscow from a warm country, finds support in the person of her new driver. And the numerous service staff not only watches the lives of amazingly rich people whose bags cost the same as their mortgages, but also does not stay away from a lot of intrigues.

lead_actors: Jiang Long, Shi Ce, You Yong, Qin Hai Lu, Jiang Yi
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: A Soldier's Story
summary: Gou Sheng, a village boy, vowed to live a stable life with "three big tile-roofed houses". But he had to go to the battlefield and narrowly escape death. The flames of war have reached the doorstep of his home, and Gou Sheng must once again run desperately to fight against the changes in destiny in the war years.

title: Metoda Markovič: Hojer
summary: The plot of the miniseries takes place in Prague at the turn of the 1970s and 1980s, when Prague did not have a very friendly impression at first glance: Gray crowds in front of half-empty shops, houses decorated with peeling posters commemorating famous anniversaries. Her night street is gripped by a completely new, terrifying phenomenon - young sexual rapists with sadistic tendencies. Elite criminal Jiří Markovič sets out on the trail of these very criminals.The miniseries not only follows the process of the investigation and capture of Ladislav Hojer, but above all offers an insight into the specific relationship between Hojer and Markovic. In each volume, he also provides insight into other closed cases that shaped Markovič's career as an elite investigator and illustrate the development of his method.

title: Dat zal ze Leren!
summary: 24 teenagers, boys and girls, who go back years in time to the Maritime Academy and who follow theoretical and practical lessons there for 3 weeks as they were given in the fifties.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: We Have a Date
summary: Two families: Hassan, a widower with four sons, and Nadia, a widow with four daughters. Initially facing individual challenges, the story unfolds as they come together, revealing how they collectively navigate life's adversities.

title: School of Champions
summary: School of Champions tells the story of a freshman class at Austria's most renowned and prestigious ski-academy. There is only a thin line between love and jealousy, loyalty and betrayal, ambition and frustration....

lead_actors: Kim Nam Joo, Cha Eun U, Kim Kang U, Im Se Mi
title: Wonderful World
summary: Eun Soo Hyun is a psychology professor and a famous writer, but her life has completely changed. Her young son dies unjustly. Making things worse, the person responsible for her son's death isn't punished by the law. Eun Soo Hyun loses hope in this world. She decides to punish the person responsible for her son's death by herself. Her life is still in pain and despair. Somehow, Eun Soo Hyun gets involved with other people who suffer from pain similar to hers and solves their mysterious cases. They slowly get healed in the process.

title: One Good Day
summary: Dale is living a good life on a farm. But one day, Lucky, an assistant who is almost a son to him, is murdered. In order to get justice for Lucky, Dale needs to go back to a life he already abandoned: a leader of an organized crime syndicate in Kingtown. But as he fights for justice, what he will uncover is the most painful truth: his enemies are the very people he considers family.

title: Simula sa Gitna
summary: A comedy-drama series that follows the (after)life of souls working as custodians of Middle and guardians to newly deceased people.

title: Roadkillers
summary: An act of desperation turns into a race for survival. Stacey kills a patient to make room for her dying father. Now, she has to pay for the consequences of her crime.

title: Anisava
summary: Welcome to the concrete jungle, where it's a struggle to survive among the animals of the city. Watch Jake the bear, Jenny the cat and their cast of slightly crazy friends as they live, love and try to stay sane in a wild world.

title: The Time Hotel
summary: The Time Hotel is a hotel survival survival where 10 guests try to survive as the last one in the 'Time Hotel', where you can buy everything with time instead of money, and check out as soon as you run out of time. In 'Time Hotel', you can use everything from restaurants to cafes and room service by paying for time instead of money. Prize money up to 300 million won will be given to the final winner, who succeeds in managing time until the end by using the prize money earned through the game. From alliances to lies, betrayals, and conspiracies, it seems that we can get a glimpse of the colorful human group through the appearances of those who carry out their own survival strategies.

title: Who's the Murderer
summary: Who's the Murderer is a Chinese variety program produced by Mango TV. In a prologue, the cast is introduced to the settings and suspects of a murder case for the new episode. The cast then chooses their role in the episode, as a particular suspect or the detective. Other than the detective, each person is given detailed information about the suspect they are portraying including their personalities, alibi, relationship to the victim and other suspects, history, criminal motive, etc. Every suspect can conceal information until explicitly questioned by other suspects or the detective, but only the criminal can lie.

title: Flair de famille
summary: Caroline and François come from a dynasty of cops. Although they're siblings, they form an unorthodox pair of detectives, with methods that complement each other quite well even though sometimes conflicting. She is on the "hyper" side, thinking and acting like a typical member of the anti-crime squad of Paris' notorious Seine-Saint-Denis suburb; he is the tortoise of the fable, moving slowly but steadily, using his knowledge of animals to decipher people's behavior. This "town and country mouse" tag team appears ruthless, tight, unshakable but as they go about their investigations, they can't help replaying their sibling quarrels, which reflect their respective emotional wounds, yet to be fully healed.

title: Tout pour Agnès
summary: Nice, France, 1970s: Renée Le Roux runs the historic Nice casino with an iron fist, the object of all desire. In the midst of the green carpet war, she stands alone against the mafia and refuses to give in to the intimidation of her main competitor, Jean-Dominique Fratoni. But at the heart of this fight, his daughter, Agnès, pushed by her lover, the sulphurous lawyer Maurice Agnelet, sells her shares in the family casino to Jean-Dominique Fratoni. A few months later, she mysteriously disappears. A forty-year fight begins until the truth about his disappearance comes to light!

title: Schnee
summary: The mountain village of Rotten has profited off of snow and the resulting winter sports for many years. Now the snow refuses to come, and the village loses its focus. On the glacier a body emerges from the melting snow. Who is this woman in 1980s clothes who apparently died a violent death up in the mountains?Lucia Salinger, the new doctor, has just moved to the village with her husband and children in an attempt to rescue their marriage. She has to examine the body and soon becomes drawn into the case against her will – especially when she realizes that her little daughter Alma has a mysterious affinity to Aurelia, an old woman from the village. When the girl suddenly vanishes Lucia resolves to get to the bottom of the mysteries that have been kept under lock and key in the village for decades.

title: Temps de chien
summary: Antoine Meilleur is a veterinarian and star of hit TV shows. He also owns a veterinary hospital and a veritable empire of pet products. But his whole world suddenly turns upside down the day he is plunged into a scandal against his will.

title: The Floor, à la conquête du sol
Tobie Lolness
summary: Toby is thirteen years old, one and a half millimetre tall and lives in the Tree with his parents. But today he must get away, alone. The awful Joe Mitch has launched a massive manhunt against him.

title: Dors avec moi
summary: Laurence is struggling to recover from the accidental death of Camille, her 6-year-old daughter. Her husband Daniel tries to help her, but he also has to grieve. As the anniversary of the death approaches, Laurence begins to experience strange phenomena in the family home, and she is convinced that her dead little girl is trying to communicate with her.

title: L'air d'aller
summary: A touching and luminous story of four friends in their twenties who are literally running out of air. They all have cystic fibrosis. In their urgency to live, they make each day memorable, for better or for worse.

title: L'Aréna
summary: The arena depicts daily life with humor and realism through characters living in this emblematic place. From the players' bench to the canteen, via the ice and the stands, each scene offers a self-deprecating satire on real life. Whether it's hockey, figure skating, greasy fries or zamboni, nothing escapes parody, featuring a gallery of endearing characters who resonate with each of us.

lead_actors: Ahmed El Sakka, Ashraf Abdel Baky, Asma Abulyazeid
title: The Last Round
summary: Yehya, post-divorce and diagnosed with Alzheimer's like his father, seizes an unexpected chance from Shabaka to pursue his dream of becoming a professional fighter. Motivated by redemption and a desire to connect with his daughter, he persuades Tambi, to train him for a final fight. Yehya struggles with memory loss striving to preserve recollections amid his challenging circumstances.

title: A Fallen Xian
summary: Against a backdrop of the Republic of China era, fraudster Master Kwan is good at disguising himself as a Taoist priest. He flees to Five Races Town as he gets into trouble. Meanwhile, Kwan's shenanigans – on the pretext of something to do with god Lu Dong-bin – have alarmed Great Master Luzu, who decides to go to the mortal realm to punish him. Through force of circumstance, Dong-bin is stranded in the mortal realm as he loses his mystical power. And then Dong-bin adopts Lui Shek as his new name while keeping Kwan company so as to help him get back on the straight and narrow. During the process, they solve bewildering cases in the village. A mortal and an immortal run into a prostitute called Pak Suet-fa, and they get entangled. Headman Sun Fu steps down. Kwan covertly prevents bully Kam Shi-ho from standing for election. Newly elected Headman Sun Ching-yee implements reforms as he deals with bad deeds committed by Shi-ho. A series of calamities is triggered in Five Races Town.

title: Heroes of Goo Jit Zu
summary: After a meteor crash, a group of zoo animals transforms into squishy, gooey and stretchy superheroes with special powers and soon takes on evildoers.

title: Totally Funny Kids
summary: Totally Funny Kids is a laugh-packed clip show featuring the funniest, most absurd, and sometimes most shocking videos you've ever seen from the youngest members of the family. Hosted by Tacarra Williams and featuring reactions from hysterically imperfect parents, each episode culminates with the winning clip reveal of the week's funniest moment.

title: Totally Funny Animals
summary: Totally Funny Animals features caught-on-camera videos that highlight the outrageous and wacky world of animals. Hosted by comedian Andy Woodhull, this clip show features everything from sneezing cats and calamitous canines to dumpster-diving bears and rascally racoons.

title: The Impossible Heir
summary: When the illegitimate son of a conglomerate owner partners with his ambitious childhood friend, the duo will stop at nothing to seize their place at the top of the societal food chain.

lead_actors: Pataradet Sa-nguankwamdee, Varitthisa Limthammahisorn, Maria Hoerschler
title: Twist of Fate
summary: Their family had been broken by a misunderstanding that caused the twin brothers' separation. However, they are brought back into each other's lives because of love. The two twins crossroad in Wimala's life at different times. One twin, Thiwa, comes from far away. The other, Tawan, comes into her life during chaos. Which one will she choose?

lead_actors: Fumika Baba, Shuhei Nomura, Riko Nagase, Ikkei Watanabe, Ryo Sato
title: 5 Ways to Socially Kill Your Husband
summary: Okuda Akane has been subjected to domestic violence and moral harassment by her husband, Okuda Daisuke. After experiencing a miscarriage due to domestic violence, Akane begins to reconsider her life and follow the instructions in a mysterious letter to punish her husband socially.

title: GARO: Heir to Steel Armor
summary: Ryuuga Dogai, the Golden Knight Garo, has regained his golden glow and destroyed the evil plots of Horror. An encounter with a mysterious knight clad in "steel" leads Ryuuga to the next test. Now, the story that approaches the origin of the protector begins!

lead_actors: Chanapol Sataya, Kessarin Noiphueng, Chap Varakorn Sawasakorn, Alice Thanutsaluk Hudson, Sun Wongsatorn Somsri
title: The Cheating Heist
summary: Daring action begins when they're forced to commit a robbery in the hunt for the truth.

title: The Opera of Love
summary: Phlengrak is the cherished son of the Phleng Phin Isan Lamsing mor lam troupe. Fate leads him to fall for Janphen, the daughter of the likay troupe Phet Jaras Fah's owner. He's faced with a serious obstacle, however, because Janphen's father Thuaithep loathes mor lam due to his painful history with mor lam singer Kesorn. As a result, he's completely forbidden everyone in the likay troupe from getting involved with mor lam artists.

title: My Love in the Countryside
summary: Saisamorn Suaisamoe, a top actor who comes from a wealthy family, is sent by the director of her new project to live in Lat Chado in Ayutthaya and learn about love. Here, she has to move into the house of Marasri, a sharp-mouthed woman and she's being followed around by someone called Mha. How will this end? Can she learn about love? Who will be the hero in this love movie?

lead_actors: Thitiwat Ritprasert, Charebelle Lanlalin, Chalita Suansane
title: Wiyan Phaesaya
summary: Faikham was finding a way to release her mother's soul from a "Phii Ka Phra-Nang", that had a strong grudge and waited for the day it could unleash its wrath.

title: Noi siamo leggenda
summary: Upon the death of the mother, Massimo discovers that he is able to set the palms of the hands, to the point of merged the metals. A secret that decides not to confess to anyone, at least until his other peers mysteriously begin to demonstrate similar 'superpowers'. In search of responses on the origin of that gift, the boys will discover that someone knows more than they imagine...

lead_actors: Nicolas Duvauchelle, Guillaume Gouix, Grégory Fitoussi, Blandine Bellavoir, Antoine Gouy
title: Fortune de France
summary: France, 1557. At Mespech Castle, the harmony between masters and servants is about to be broken by religious wars. Having embraced the new Protestant movement, Jean de Siorac, a well-respected humanist knight and head of his family, has no choice but to resort to violence to defend his community. His wife Isabelle, a fervent Catholic, is struggling to exist in a world ruled by men. Their sons, Pierre and François, are thrown into adulthood, torn asunder, just like their religiously divided country. Forced to contend with their adversaries, the Sioracs must remain close as they strive to overcome their differences and defend their ideal of tolerance.

title: 9.3 BB
summary: After the death of her boyfriend Bruno, a young police officer infiltrated in a far-right group, Leïla sees her world and her plans collapse. One evening, however, by a strange chance she finds herself at the theater in front of a rehearsal of Antigone by Bertolt Brecht. Upset, the young girl from 9.3, already passionate about poetry, leaves law school and takes her group of friends with her on a real theatrical adventure.

title: The Double Life of My Billionaire Husband
summary: Sebastian Klein, a renowned Klein family member, was rumored to be a loser after a prison stint. Natalie Quinn, unaware of the truth, married him, leading to a covert billionaire marriage.Sebastian Klein, known to most as the illegitimate son of the prestigious Klein family, has been plagued by rumors suggesting he's nothing more than a loser who recently emerged from a stint in prison. Society, guided by these harsh tales, deemed him an undesirable match for any sensible young woman. That was until Natalie Quinn defied expectations by marrying him. Little did she realize the astonishing truth concealed beneath the surface: she had, unknowingly, wed a covert billionaire.

title: La lunga notte - La caduta del Duce
summary: La Lunga Notte narrates the last seven days of the 24th and 25th year of 1943 in the last chapter of the Gran Consiglio, the supreme presiding body of Benito Mussolini, which sanctified the end of the fascist regime. Particolare risalto viene dato ai tormenti di Dino Grandi, Presidente della Camera dei fasci che decise di opporsi alle scelte di Mussolini in a legitimate manner, convening the Gran Consiglio, per rimettere il Paese in the mani dei Savoia.

lead_actors: Ben Feldman, Perry Mooney, Rick Donald, Katrina Milosevic, Emily Taheny
title: Population 11
summary: Inspired by true events, Population 11 is about a man who goes missing from a tiny outback town of only 12 residents, and his estranged son, who journeys from the U.S. to find him.When Andy Pruden, a suburban bank teller from Ohio USA, pulls into the tiny outback town to visit his long-lost father, he's alarmed to discover that Hugo has vanished. In his quest to find him, another outsider Cassie comes to Andy's aid and they find themselves in increasing danger as they delve into the secrets of this tiny outback town, where everyone is a suspect.

lead_actors: Ted McGinley, Roma Downey, Ali Cobrin, Masey McLain, Josh Plasse
title: The Baxters
summary: Based on the worldwide best-selling book series by Karen Kingsbury, The Baxters is a riveting family drama that follows Elizabeth and John Baxter and their five adult children. Season One of The Baxters centers on Elizabeth and John's daughter, Kari, who learns the shocking truth that her professor husband, Tim, has been secretly having an affair with one of his college students. As her relationship is tested, Kari must seek comfort in her faith and family to discover if love is truly a choice and if her marriage can be redeemed. In this deeply moving faith-based journey, The Baxters must come together as a family to work through the challenges of life.

lead_actors: Kim Ji Yun, Jang Da A, Ryu Da In
title: Pyramid Game
summary: Every Thursday afternoon, once a month, students at Sarang High School cast their votes in a popularity poll. The result? A brutal ranking system that determines the entire social hierarchy of the school. After starting at the bottom, can new transfer student Su Ji make her way to the top of the pyramid? Or will she topple the game altogether?

title: Ek Vivah Aisa Bhi
summary: The story revolves around the young widow Suman. Suman is a caring mother, a responsible daughter-in-law and a loving sister-in-law. She balances between the household chores and her work in a local parlour every day to keep her family financially stable. She then joins a university to pursue an MBA on her mother-in-law's insistence. There she meets the carefree Ranveer Mittal. Though they dislike each other initially, Ranveer later falls for Suman. Meanwhile, Antara's and Sanjana's (Suman's sister in laws) marriage gets fixed to the two brothers of Ranveer. Suman's mother-in-law accepts Ranveer's alliance to secure the future of her daughters. Suman, initially hesitant, later accepts Ranveer. Suman and Ranveer get married with Suman's son Veer tying the "gat-bandhan".There is a change in the behavior of Ranveer Mittal who becomes arrogant and refuses to accept Veer. Veer is thus kept back at his paternal home with his grandmother. It is later revealed that Suman's ex-husband, Ravi Parmar, who was assumed dead, is actually alive. Suman and Veer are both forced to move in with him.Ravi begins to physically abuse Suman. Ranveer arrives in time and saves Suman. Suman, Veer and Ranveer reconcile.In the last scene it is shown that the whole family, including the pregnant daughters-in-laws( Suman, Sanjana and Antara), gather for a family photo.

title: Fruit Ninja: Frenzy Force
summary: From humble beginnings rise four Fruit Ninjas to rediscover the long lost art of Juice Jitsu. Their mission – to unlock hidden powers through the slicing of fruit and to protect their neighbours from bizarre villains they never knew existed! Running a juice stand as a front for the messiest secret service in the world, our ninjas grow to learn that it is what makes you unique (and even a little bit weird) that ultimately makes you strong.

title: Pérusse Cité
summary: The colourful characters in this animated comedy series find themselves in all sorts of hilarious situations. Set in a Montreal-like city and suburban neighbourhood, the story features 30-something-year-old hero Ben Hardi, his girlfriend Sophie N'Guyen, his boss Minister Léopold Ouellet, his friend Guy Carneau, his neighbour Mrs. Allaire, newscaster Édith Viens and well-known reporter Tristan Direct.

lead_actors: Keith Ferguson, Josh Brener, Maya Tuttle, Laura Post, Adam Lambert
title: Megamind Rules!
summary: Megamind goes from being a supervillain and the scourge of Metro City to a superhero who's learning on the job. He'll be bringing the audience along for the ride, as Megamind's trusty brainbots will be recording everything, making him the world's first superhero influencer.

lead_actors: Bai Jing Ting, Ding Yong Dai, Jin Chen, Zuo Xiao Qing, Liu Jun
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Always on the Move
summary: In the late 1970s, on the steam train from Ningyang to Harbin, a young police officer Wang Xin is on duty and shuttling among crowds of passengers. He mistakes an old railway policeman Ma Kui as a fugitive, and their conflict gradually develops into a mentor-and-apprentice friendship. From disliking each other to sympathizing with each other, Wang Xin and Ma Kui fight side by side on the front line of railway public security. They crack down on theft, kidnappings, drug trafficking, and fraud, always prioritizing the safety of the passengers and selflessly safeguarding the trains traveling from the south to the north. From steam locomotives to electric locomotives to high-speed trains, the new and old-generation railway police officers Wang Xin and Ma Kui witness the development of China's railway system and China's rapid changes as they uphold the spirit of the police.

lead_actors: Lola Petticrew, Hazel Doupe, Maxine Peake, Anthony Boyle, Josh Finan
title: Say Nothing
summary: Spanning four decades, Say Nothing explores the tumultuous period in Northern Ireland known as The Troubles. The series launches with the shocking disappearance of Jean McConville, a single mother of ten who was abducted from her home in 1972 and never seen alive again. But McConville was only one of many others who became known collectively as The Disappeared.Through the eyes of various IRA members, including sisters Dolours and Marian Price—young women who transformed into magnetic symbols of radical politics, Brendan Hughes—a tight-lipped but conflicted military strategist, and Gerry Adams—a savvy political operator who would go on to negotiate peace but ultimately deny his involvement with the IRA, Say Nothing unpacks the extremes some people will go to within a civil rights movement as they pursue their ideals, the mystery surrounding The Disappeared, the cost of silence, and the way society mends – or doesn't – after a long and bloody conflict.

title: Trade War
summary: Revolves around the theme of business intrigues, portraying the complexities of human nature and negotiation strategies in the business world filled with sex, power, and struggle.

title: My Undercover Chef
summary: Brash detective Marwin goes undercover as a chef to bust a drug ring. Clashing with Youtuber Khing, they team up against the mafia boss, in an action-comedy.

title: Not a Murder Story
summary: Dong, an aspiring actor, awakens beside a lifeless woman, Meng, on the verge of a career-changing opportunity. Determined to clear his path to stardom, he orchestrates the scene to look like a failed robbery but unknowingly leaves behind traces. As the police investigate, they uncover the hidden secrets of all the apartment's residents.

lead_actors: Guo Shu Yao, Aviis Zhong, Sun Ke Fang, Ken Lin
title: The Accidental Influencer
summary: Follows the story of Red Ho, whose dreams of marrying her boyfriend and owning their own apartment on her 30th birthday were shattered into pieces as her boyfriend leaves her for another woman right on her birthday. With her newfound grief and unstable mental state, she resigns from her job. After finding herself both heartbroken and jobless, she goes on a tell-all rant on social media and is met with positive responses from people the world over. She then embarks on an unexpected journey to rediscover who she is and what independence is all about.

lead_actors: Warintorn Panhakarn, Pichukkana Wongsarattanasin, Pongsakorn Mettarikanon
title: The Invincible
summary: In a time of great famine and chaos after the World War II, there is an increase in robberies and looting, where police enforcement is futile against the bandits. Both the bandits and the police turn to magic for self-protection. Two brothers are separated as children and thrown into two different worlds – the dark, seedy world of the bandits and the other under the wing of the lawman, only to be reunited years later as enemies, where circumstances force them to fight each other, but for the same cause - to right the wrong and avenge the death of their father. Krathing, a vigilante in an officer's uniform, is the rival of Mai, a saint in bandit garb who steals from the rich and gives to the poor. They fight not only for their duty, but also for the heart of Kamlai, the woman they both desire. Only one can be victorious.

lead_actors: Phantira Pipityakorn, Oabnithi Wiwattanawarang, Yuranunt Pamornmontri
title: Blondie in an Ancient Time
summary: Transported back to the ninteteenth century by a strange cellphone, an entrepreneur is tricked into slavery and has to find a way back to the present day.

title: Dr. Lifesaver
summary: Dr. Du showed his remarkable talent for medicine but experienced the uncertainty of life in a disaster twenty years ago. After losing his beloved girlfriend and mentor in the same accident, Dr. Du left the disappointed healthcare system and became an EMT in a small clinic. However, he never gives up any life and makes up for his guilt in every service. With his frenemy Dr. Lee and associate Dr. Hsu all around his life in critical moments, he has to deal with patient-provider relationships and life value differences between colleagues. Dr. Du believes that the only way to reform the medical system is to be part of it again. However, the mysteries about the disaster twenty years ago will blow his life in more time.

title: Hotel Saltwater
summary: The Qiaotou youth LI Wen-hsin was arrested during the December 10, 1979, demonstration spearheaded by Formosa Magazine. After being thrown into prison, he learned a way to survive: mixing saltwater with white rice. He also recalled wonderful times with his girlfriend A-chun, the joys and suffering he shared with friends and family, and his longing for democracy. In this prison, referred to by inmates as the "Hotel Saltwater," Wen-hsin and his companions, though suffering greatly, never let their thirst for freedom be extinguished.

title: Flúgos futam
summary: Crazy race across the borders: The Wacky Run is starting on VIASAT3.Eight couples, exciting adventures and famous hitchhikers in this road reality on VIASAT3.

title: OMG Fashun
summary: Handcrafted is the new haute couture on OMG Fashun as Julia inspires pioneering fashion disruptors to upend traditional style convention, break the rules and redefine "cool." Each episode challenges three disruptors to create a boundary-breaking look born of Fox's beautifully bold brain. Using materials and techniques that would make fashion's so-called gatekeepers squirm, the contestants must race against the clock to compose and style their unconventional ensembles for the judging panel, consisting of Fox, Roach and a rotating expert guest judge. The disruptor with the most eye-catching, unexpected and cutting-edge look is crowned the winner of the competition. Each week's winner is awarded a $10,000 cash prize and gets their garment modeled by Fox.

title: Intern in My Heart
summary: Ray is an intern with a special ability to see the true identity of his boss, Rin, who everybody considers evil. However, he'll do everything to win her heart.

lead_actors: Ted Danson, Lilah Richcreek Estrada, Mary Elizabeth Ellis, Stephanie Beatriz, Mary Steenburgen
title: A Man on the Inside
summary: A retired man gets a new lease on life when he answers an ad from a PI and becomes a mole in a secret investigation.

lead_actors: Юрий Чурсин, Анастасия Сендык, Александр Дьяченко, Виктория Толстоганова, Владимир Гостюхин
title: Рваный ветер
summary: Large businessman Sergey Gradov has a conflict with his long-term business partner Aleksandr Rubtsov. The cause of the conflict is the Guryanovsky Machine-Building Plant. Rubtsov believes that it is necessary to get rid of the unprofitable enterprise, and Gradov is confident that the plant needs modernization. Gradov does not realize that the real reason for Rubtsov's refusal from the plant is a family drama twenty-five years ago.

title: Zokie of Planet Ruby
summary: Quirky vlogger Ruby discovers her only channel follower is a space alien from Planet Pudge named Zokie Sparkleby, and they quickly become BFFs. Filming daily adventures, Ruby teaches Zokie about her version of Earth and Zokie works to control his magic.

lead_actors: Joo Won, Kwon Na Ra, Yoo In Soo, Eum Moon Suk
title: Midnight Photo Studio
summary: Seo Ki Joo is a photographer and runs a small photo studio. He is the 7th owner of the photo studio and the shop is only for ghosts. Ki Joo takes portraits of the ghosts that come into the store. Han Bom is a lawyer who is passionate about her work and does not tolerate injustice. Somehow, she ends up in a partnership with Ki Joo's photo studio. The studio also has two employees: Assistant Manager Go and Baek Nam Gu. Assistant Manager Go is in charge of bringing in ghosts as customers, and Nam Gu is in charge of taking care of small chores around the store.

lead_actors: Kim Ha Neul, Yun Woo Jin, Jang Seung Jo
title: Nothing Uncovered
summary: Seo Jung Won is an investigative reporter and the host of the current affairs television program "Grabbed by the Collar." Thanks to her unique and straightforward way of exposing all kinds of torts committed by culprits—all whilst making sarcastic remarks—she gains great popularity and attracts the general public's attention. When Jung Won is accused of murder, she joins with detective Kim Tae Hyun, and sets out to find the truth. Also helping her are her husband Seol Woo Jae and Woo Jae, respectively.

lead_actors: Nimisha Sajayan, Roshan Mathew, Dibyendu Bhattacharya, Ankith Madhav, Kani Kusruti
title: Poacher
summary: A group of Indian Forest Service officers, NGO workers, police constables and Good Samaritans risk their lives trying to track down the biggest elephant ivory poachers in the history of India and bring them to justice.

title: Mees Kees
summary: He is the nicest teacher in the Netherlands, Mees Kees! Slightly lanky and clumsy, but also sweet and funny. His way of teaching is different than usual, but makes him a favourite with all his students. The young teacher mainly does fun things in the classroom, with the intention of teaching through play. The school director, Dreus, often disagrees with this and does not always appreciate it. Fortunately, Mees Kees can always count on his energetic students when faced with challenges, who know how to solve everything with their creativity, humour and enthusiasm!

title: Paranormal Solutions Inc.
summary: Paranormal Solutions Inc. is expanding! Armed with their new slogan, "We believe in EVERYTHING!" six hapless but passionate, semi-successful ghost hunters attempt to grow their business and become real players in the supernatural game. Paranormal Solutions Inc. is a single-camera, paranormal-adventure-comedy. Paranormal Solutions Inc. combines the high stakes, creature filled storylines and impressive visual effects of traditional sci-fi programming with the wit and dry humour of Prime Time comedy. Think Paranormal Reality TV show meets It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia meets Ghostbuster.

lead_actors: Michael Douglas, Noah Jupe, Daniel Mays, Ludivine Sagnier, Thibault de Montalembert
title: Franklin
summary: On a secret mission to France, Benjamin Franklin plays a sophisticated game of intrigue and seduction—with the fate of American independence hanging in the balance.

title: Les Traîtres
summary: 18 strangers move into a majestic mansion to complete group missions to win silver bars for their shared prize pool, which could reach up to $100,000. However, some of them are traitors who will try to manipulate the group and kill a faithful person every evening in order to be the only ones to get their hands on the loot. In an exhilarating reality show where lying rhymes with victory, will the traitors be unmasked in time by the faithful?

lead_actors: Kim Joon Myun, Hong Ye Ji, Kim Min Gyu
title: Missing Crown Prince
summary: Set in the Joseon era about a crown prince who is kidnapped by the woman who is set to become his wife. While on the run for their lives, romance winds up blossoming between them.

lead_actors: Kamel El Basha, Osamah Sami, Maia Abbas
title: House of Gods
summary: House of Gods follows the lives of an ambitious Iraqi Australian family grappling with newfound power and privilege when their charismatic patriarch is elected Head Cleric of their local mosque. This compelling series takes audiences behind the walls of an imam's family and the community he leads, exploring the personal cost of power and ambition.

lead_actors: Siobhán McSweeney, Bonnie O'Meara, Maura Foley
title: Maddie + Triggs
summary: Maddie is a 7-year-old girl who loves music and adventure, and just so happens to have a vision impairment. Triggs is her doggy best friend who loves doggy biscuits and mischief!They live together with their mum and dad in a colourful town of Higgledy-Piggledy, and here they find music and adventure in the sounds of the everyday by really listening to the world around them.

title: Only Child
summary: Richard's long overdue visit to recently-widowed Ken results in him realising that his dad may need a bit more full time help than he'd realised. Not that Ken would agree, but that statement is pretty much true about anything. Ken is an eccentric, strong-willed technophobe who is very much set in his ways, leaving Richard to worry about his dad growing old.

lead_actors: Nina He, Penelope Rawlins, Dominique Moore, Ben Bailey Smith, Phillip Sacramento
creators: Sean Carson, Sam Barlow, Mark Gordon
title: Yukee
summary: The show is a series about the sheer joy of making a noise with friends and reminds us that ‘music is for everyone', as well as having themes of community, friendship, and cooperation at its heart. Yukee offers young audiences a gentle, child-centred introduction to music education and exposes them to simple, yet fundamental musical concepts that will form a strong foundation for lifelong learning and enjoyment of music - beat, rhythm, pitch, tempo, timbre, form, dynamics, expression and style.Yukee herself is of Northern Ireland and Chinese heritage - and in every episode takes her own beloved red ukulele into a magical garden filled with instrument playing animal friends. Music adventures are never far away, and song ideas can come from anywhere in the garden - be it the rhythmic pitter patter of raindrops, or a gang of passing ants stomping their tiny feet to a steady beat.

title: 1000 Years Old
summary: The skinny, handsome Pun is hiding a big secret: he is a vampire who has been alive for a thousand years! He just wants to live a low-key life, but he coincidentally meets Yo, a cheerful college student, and together they have a supernatural love affair.

title: The Spirealm
summary: Ling Jiushi is a gaming expert; and a former game designer who once dreamt of creating a Chinese game that would change the world. However due to various difficulties, he has given up on his dream. One day, he discovers a game that has taken the international world by storm - "Ling Jing". It was originally created by a Chinese game designer, but due to the injection of foreign capital, gore and violence elements were added to the game. This caused players to develop depression, mental illnesses and even caused some to committ suicide. Now that this game has entered the Chinese market, Ling Jiushi wants to destroy it. In order to understand more about the game, Ling Jiushi was accidentally brought into the game. Inside the game exists 12 doors; and there he met Ruan Lanzhu whom quickly became his close friend. Together they experience the various possibilities of life. However, an inevitable final farewell looms over them as they slowly discover the secrets hidden behind these doors.Adapted from the web novel "Kaleidoscope of Death" (死亡万花筒) by Xi Zi Xu (西子绪). Two versions: 78 eps/20 min (Original broadcast) || 38 eps/42 min (Re-broadcast)

lead_actors: Kevin Hart, Don Cheadle, Taraji P. Henson, Samuel L. Jackson
title: Fight Night: The Million Dollar Heist
summary: Fight Night: The Million Dollar Heist, based on the acclaimed iHeart true-crime podcast, follows the infamous story of how an armed robbery on the night of Muhammad Ali's historic 1970 comeback fight changed not only one man's life but ultimately transformed Atlanta into the "Black Mecca." When a hustler named Chicken Man hosts an afterparty to celebrate the fight with a guest list of the country's wealthiest, the night ends with the most brazen criminal underworld heist in Atlanta's history. Suspected of masterminding the crime, Chicken Man is hellbent on clearing his name but must convince his old adversary, J.D. Hudson, one of the first Black detectives in the city's desegregated police force, who is tasked with bringing those responsible to justice.

lead_actors: Nadia Parkes, Julian Świeżewski, Christine Tremarco, Adrian Edmondson, Nigel Lindsay
title: Kidnapped: The Chloe Ayling Story
summary: Kidnapped: The Chloe Ayling Story follows the true story of Chloe Ayling's abduction in Italy in 2017, having travelled there for a photoshoot. The series follows her terrifying kidnap, her bravery and resilience in captivity, and the subsequent court case that put her kidnappers in jail. Yet despite their convictions, Chloe faced headlines accusing her of faking her own kidnapping, and found herself at the centre of a media storm.Kidnapped: The Chloe Ayling Story asks why Chloe was blamed for her kidnappers' crimes. How do we relate to survivors of crime who make the front pages? And how does it feel to be an ordinary person, caught up in events so extraordinary that you aren't believed?

title: Testo
summary: Testo is a short format series on Das Erste. 5 Prisoners, a bank robbery, 6 hostages, adrenaline, chaos, unfinished business. Fast, unpredictable, merciless.

title: Shane the Chef
summary: Shane the Chef follows the foody adventures of an energetic chef, Shane, and his young daughter Izzy as they run a restaurant in the town of Munchington.

title: Go Green with the Grimwades
summary: Ella and Tim Grimwade and their 6 children set themselves a challenge to go green.

lead_actors: Toni Braxton, Towanda C. Braxton, Trina E. Braxton, Tamar Braxton, Evelyn Braxton
title: The Braxtons
summary: In a new, not-to-be-missed reality series, The Braxtons, Toni, Towanda, Trina, Tamar and Ms. Evelyn will reunite to share new love, success, heartbreak, ongoing family dynamics and so much more.It's been more than three years since the Braxton family graced the screen with their hit series Braxton Family Values which ran for seven seasons and still remains one of TV's most beloved family docuseries. Now, the Braxton family is back with a new series, picking up where they left off: sharing their rollercoaster journey as a family from the last few years to the family's present triumphs. The series will feature never before seen private moments, from quarantine to the devastating loss of their sister Traci and taking viewers into their lives as the build this new chapter without her.

title: Ellis
summary: Ellis will follow DCI Ellis, a tenacious cop who is parachuted into failing investigations. Each two-hour episode sees Ellis – accompanied by her right-hand man DS Harper, arrive at a different police station, where she will have to win over the local detectives and immerse herself in the cases she has come to solve. As a black female cop, Ellis is used to being dismissed and overlooked, but she is a first-class murder detective, with a determination for justice and a deep well of compassion for those who need it.

title: Luz
summary: Raised by a kind Kaingang family, adventurous young schoolgirl Luz launches a quest with her firefly companion to learn the truth about her roots.

title: Дороже денег
summary: "More expensive than money" is a quiz, but an unusual one. In it, the participant tries to win a prize not for himself, but for his loved one, who, in his opinion, deserves it. The game is accompanied by emotional stories about the hero for whom the player is fighting: about what good deeds he did, how he helped the player himself, and other family members and friends. Throughout the entire program, secret surveillance is conducted of the person for whose sake they are trying to win. How surprised he will be when at the end the film crew reveals a secret to him: his close people told his story to TV viewers and won him a cash prize.

lead_actors: Lina El Arabi, Marina Foïs, Mathieu Kassovitz
title: Furies
summary: Seeking to avenge her father's death, a young woman becomes entangled in the web of the Fury, peacekeeper of the Paris criminal underworld.

title: Miss Perfect
summary: Obsessed with cleanliness, a young professional is mistaken for a maid. Her fixation on tidiness leads to chaos when she takes a new job.

title: Maamla Legal Hai
summary: Chaos collides with the letter of the law at District Court Patparganj, where quirky employees work to uphold justice — but not without a few objections.

title: The Quiz with Balls
summary: The Quiz with Balls pits brains against balls combining a high-stakes quiz show with a large-scale physical competition. Each episode features two families competing for $100,000 in a "battle of the balls".

lead_actors: Roi Fabito, Bethany Brown, Adrian Petriw
creators: Lienne Sawatsky, John Hazlett, Dan Williams
title: The Guava Juice Show
summary: The Guava Juice Show follows the wacky adventures of 14-year-old Roi and his best friends, plucky teenager Jenny and fretful, safety-first Guava, as they work at a mysterious curio shop and travel to parallel worlds and dimensions throughout the multiverse in a magical bathtub.

title: Love Mafia
summary: Young single men and women come to Love School in search of true love. However, two real-life couples are hiding among them. If single people become a couple, they receive 10,000 dollars as a gesture of the show supporting them. However, the real couples, also called the mafia couples, try to thwart the single people's effort to find love. If a single person and another person of the mafia couples get matched up, the person from the mafia gets the prize money of 10,000 dollars. Sung Si Kyung, known as a master of love and for his diverse careers and sharp wit, Shindong, Soyou, and Lee Hye Sung will host the show, making witty talks and exciting guesses. A real variety show about love, which is entirely different from everything you've seen so far, will give the audience the thrill and fun of a drama unfolded by real-life couples mixed with singles. Look forward to seeing which couple will get the prize money and fruit of love!

title: Hay algo en el bosque
summary: A group of strangers discovers the dangers lurking in a secluded retreat, and face their wildest nightmares as they struggle to survive and solve the mystery behind a stolen jewel and a dangerous spellbook.

lead_actors: Lee Bo Young, Lee Moo Saeng, Lee Cheong A, Lee Min Jae
title: Hide
summary: Hide follows the story of a woman, Na Moon Young, whose husband, Cha Sung Jae vanishes into thin air. As she traces the truth behind her husband's disappearance, she stumbles upon unbearable secrets.

title: Dead Hot
summary: 5 years ago, Elliot came home to find his soulmate Peter had vanished—with nothing left behind but his finger in a puddle of blood. Still living with Peter's twin Jess, they don't know if he ran away, was kidnapped or worse. Elliot tries moving on, and after a magical date with wonderful Will, that seems possible. But when shit hits the fan, Elliot and Jess know they need to find out the truth.

title: Wildcard Kitchen
summary: All bets are off as Food Network's test kitchen opens up its doors late night in the new eight-episode series Wildcard Kitchen, where fan-favorite chefs put their money where their mouth is during a high-stakes culinary card game. In each episode, host Eric Adjepong takes over the test kitchen after hours with an exclusive invitation for three chefs to bring $5,000 to play across three hands of his underground culinary poker game.  The competitors, who all know each other well, have scores to settle and personal stakes to lose as they battle to create dishes based on the cards they are dealt and bet using their own instincts and cold hard cash.  The luck of the draw determines the dishes and cooking time, while wildcards deal unpredictable challenges into the mix that test the chefs like never before. From surf-and-turf with peanut butter to live crab with kimchi, anything can happen in Wildcard Kitchen as mystery guest judges use blind taste tests to determine who walks away the high roller with bragging rights and cash from their fellow chefs.

lead_actors: Kara Tointon, Sara Powell, Allen Leech, Charlie Hodson-Prior, Taj Atwal
title: Too Good to Be True
summary: Rachel is a single mum with a young son, Liam. They're on the poverty line, and Rachel works all hours of the day as a cleaner to provide for her boy. One day, her boss is approached by a businesswoman, Simone, who acts for an extremely wealthy client called Elliot. Simone offers Rachel a new job: better pay, shorter hours. It sounds too good to be true…

lead_actors: Teeradon Supapunpinyo, Achiraya Nitibhon, Pachara Chirathivat
title: The Believers
summary: Three young entrepreneurs stumble upon a business opportunity to repay debt from their failed startup by exploiting people's religious beliefs.

title: Курьеры
summary: Gosha, 20, who was born into a wealthy Moscow family, is "sitting out" his pants in the 4th year of medical university, but really wants to become a director. One day, he tells his mother that he is quitting medical school and will go to film school. The mother is ready to let her son fulfill his dream, but only if he proves that he can live at least three months without guaranteed financial support. As a result, adult life falls on yesterday's teenager: he needs, at least, to find a place to live and earn at least some money for food.

lead_actors: Ansh Bagri, Zeeahan Khan, Aneri Vajani, Krrip Kapur Suri
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
title: Baghin
summary: A girl and a vengeful spirit share connection rooted in the past. The spirit selects the girl to seek revenge against those responsible for its demise. Fueled by justice she embodies revenge settling scores and unveiling intertwined fates.

title: Невский
summary: Since time immemorial, dark forces have been flattering themselves with the hope of conquering our beautiful planet. But every time they are opposed by heroes who stand up to defend their Motherland. Just such a hero lives in St. Petersburg. He is the most powerful and strong. He is so old that he himself has forgotten his name, so everyone simply calls him Nevsky. Once upon a time, it was he and several other heroes who stopped the countless armies of Pestilence, the conqueror of worlds. But the evil did not disappear, but hid in order to accumulate strength for a new invasion.

lead_actors: Laurence Fishburne, Ed O'Neill, Cleopatra Coleman, Jacki Weaver, Kelly AuCoin
title: Clipped
summary: Clipped takes you behind the scenes of a notorious NBA owner's racist remarks, captured on a tape heard around the world. Based on the hit ESPN 30 for 30 podcast The Sterling Affairs, this limited series charts the collision between a dysfunctional basketball organization and even less functional marriage, and the precipitating tape's impact on an ensemble of characters striving to win against the backdrop of the most cursed team in the league.

title: Gus, le chevalier minus
summary: Gus, there was a little boy who wanted to become The Greatest knight in the whole kingdom of Karamel. The problem is, Gus is - ITSY BITSY. Gus will prove to one and all that a brave heart can overcome everything .

title: Catch Me a Killer
summary: Based on the book of the same name, Catch Me A Killer tells the harrowing true story of former journalist-turned-psychological profiler Micki Pistorius, South Africa's first serial killer profiler.In 1994, against the backdrop of a country getting used to democracy, Micki joins a police task team on the hunt for a notorious serial killer the Station Strangler; a serial murderer who has left a trail of 22 dead boys in his wake.While finding her feet in a male-dominated arena, Micki battles with her status as an outsider in the police force and in the community she serves.In each episode of this brooding dramatic thriller, Micki deals with the looming spectre of her personal life and confronts increasing darkness in her quest to entrap and understand some of South Africa's most infamous serial killers.

lead_actors: Dionne Brown, Bellah, Sam Adewunmi, Tilly Keeper, Llewella Gideon
title: Queenie
summary: After a messy breakup with her long-term boyfriend, Queenie seeks comfort in all the wrong places and begins to realize she has to face the past head-on before she can rebuild.

title: Mysteries of the Unknown
summary: Don Wildman unearths extraordinary artifacts as he looks for answers to history's greatest mysteries.

title: In Her Car
summary: The series created by Eugen Tunik ('Early Birds') is based on true events lived by Ukrainians during the first days and weeks of the Russian war on Ukraine. The story centers around therapist Lydia who uses her car to get civilians to safer places. Each episode is one ride, each ride and each passenger has a very own and touching story to tell.

title: The Lair: OnlyFangs
summary: In this thrilling revival of Here TV's iconic series "The Lair," gay vampires and gay werewolves clash in an electrifying war for dominance in modern-day Hollywood. Prepare for a riveting saga of bloodlust and moonlit mayhem as these supernatural factions vie for control in the heart of Tinseltown.

title: Spare Me Your Mercy
summary: Do we have the right to determine our own death? The rising death rate in terminally ill patients raises a doubt in Police Major Wasan's heart he cannot shake. Recently, just before he could make it back to her, his mother has passed away. Given the circumstances, she may be one in a series of suspicious deaths. Dr. Kantaphat, the doctor who'd taken care of Wasan's mother in her final days, becomes important to his grieving heart. The deeper his feelings grow, however, the more the mystery seems to link back to his lover, bit by bit.

lead_actors: Freya McLaughlin, Alice Helenport, Kolby McDonald, Joy Tú Clarke, Marcus Power
title: Lu & The Bally Bunch
summary: Lu is a little ladybird who has just started preschool with her new friends. Together they explore their brand-new social lives through play, music, big feelings and even bigger fun.

title: Machine
summary: Created by Thomas Bidegain and Fred Grivois, directed by the latter with infectious jubilation, Machine appears like a UFO. Through the meeting between "Machine" and JP, an unlikely alliance is played out: that of kung fu and the communist struggle. If we add to the cocktail a dose of offbeat humor and a supercharged soundtrack (Anastacia, K. Maro, Menelik, etc.), we get an explosive series where narrow-minded unionists, a conspiracy influencer, a sentimental businessman, a former secret agent or a soldier with a fragile psychology cross paths, pell-mell... Between pop culture and social conscience, Machine walks a tightrope, and hits the mark - like its heroine. In this very physical role, Margot Bancilhon, who performed most of the stunts herself, impresses. In search of meaning, both relentless and tormented, this mysterious woman with no name finds salvation in the friendship she forms with the endearing JP, himself saved by reading Marx and cycling. How to upset the balance between the weak and the powerful? Here, the answer is clear: with punches!

title: Performer
summary: The day before the wedding, Tomoki loses his job and fiancée due to the false charge of molesting. He decides to die and witnesses a woman screaming and fleeing the moment he tries to jump off the roof of the building. Her woman was attacked by a man with her knife, and even Tomoki who was there was stabbed ... I thought, they were all directing, Aika and her client. Tomoki gets caught up and is told by Aika about the existence of a profession called a performer. So Tomoki hires Aika, a performer, to take revenge on the criminals who have falsely accused him of molesting himself.

lead_actors: Sebastien Dewaele, Koen De Bouw, Aimé Claeys, Loes Haverkort, Elena Missiaen
title: Styx
summary: Police officer Styx is shot dead but is resurrected. Without a heartbeat. He searches for an explanation but increasingly loses control of his instincts, putting his family in danger. Step by step he discovers the gruesome truth behind his condition.

lead_actors: Reiji Kawashima, Kaede Hondo, Katsuyuki Konishi, Kazuyuki Okitsu, Aoi Yūki
title: Mission: Yozakura Family
summary: High school student Taiyou Asano has been socially inept ever since his family died in a car crash. The only person he can properly interact with is his childhood friend, Mutsumi Yozakura—the head of the world's strongest family of spies. Mutsumi's eldest brother, Kyouichirou Yozakura, has been overprotective of her ever since he once rendered her severely injured. His love for Mutsumi is lethal, and Taiyou is his next target. To survive, Taiyou must marry Mutsumi and become a member of the Yozakura family. Thrown headfirst into chaos, Taiyou begins his journey to become a powerful spy in order to protect his wife and uncover the dark secrets of his past and the Yozakura family.

lead_actors: Kazuyuki Okitsu, Miyuki Sawashiro, Kana Hanazawa
title: The Fable
summary: Fable is a legendary hitman who has completed numerous jobs for a variety of clients. After concluding his latest assignment, the number of people he has recently killed becomes too high, and Fable is ordered by his boss to lay low for a year. He is suggested that having to adapt to life as an ordinary citizen might prove a valuable experience for his future work.Fable is to be accompanied by the woman who acts as his driver, and the two will assume new identities as siblings. However, their boss warns them that they will both face a deadly punishment if Fable kills anyone during his time off. Thus begins Akira and Youko Satou's joint one-year sabbatical from the underworld.

lead_actors: Pablo Cano Carciota, Felixe Forde, Martha Forde, Morgan Hartley, Shakira Riddell-Morales

summary: Animated series about a group of potatoes who sing songs in different genres.
