title: Ar y Ffin
summary: Ar y Ffin follows experienced Magistrate Claire Lewis Jones as she faces personal turmoil while presiding over cases at Newport Magistrates Court. When Ned Humphries, a childhood friend of Beca, Claire's daughter, faces arson charges, Claire's loyalty to her community is put to the test. Matters are made worse when local criminal kingpin Saint Pete appears on the scene. Claire and Saint Pete go back a long way – will her past come back to threaten her present? As she delves deeper into the case, and suspicions grow around her daughter's new bad-boy boyfriend, Sonny Higgins, Claire uncovers a web of criminal activity that could put her and her family at risk.As the truth emerges and consequences unfold, Claire must confront her own biases and decisions. The lines between right and wrong become blurred, as Claire's maternal instincts clash with her commitment to uphold the truth.

lead_actors: Chantavit Dhanasevi, Arachaporn Pokinpakorn, Chermawee Suwanpanuchoke, Tonhon Tantivejakul, Tob Chaiwat Thongsang
title: Doctor Climax
summary: In the 70's, Doctor Nat, a dermato-venereologist who once dreamt of writing adventure novels and becoming a published author, ends up as the columnist behind "The Climax Question" — a space for answering questions everyone wants to ask but dare not. From masturbation and premature ejaculation to foreplay, STDs, and more, the column discusses forbidden subjects while keeping the inquirers' identities anonymous. Through his work on the newspaper column, Doctor Nat grows closer to Linda, the publisher's art department head. Their budding connection threatens to jeopardize not only the doctor's marriage with his perfect wife, Tukta, but also his family's old-money status.

title: Денискины рассказы
summary: The boy listens to his grandfather's stories about the times of the USSR and finds himself in the 1950s. A nostalgic comedy series from producer Sarik Andreasyan based on the cycle of famous children's stories by Viktor Dragunsky. The film adaptation was directed by the writer's grandson, Artemy Dragunsky.  Denis Viktorovich has been living on Karetny for a long time and he always has something to tell. When he is assigned to look after his grandson Denis, his grandfather begins to entertain the six-year-old boy with stories about another era. Their main character is the same age as Denis, who lived in the 1950s in the USSR. The mischievous man was constantly getting into trouble, but he learned lessons from his adventures. Denis, listening to his grandfather, is transported back in time and realizes that he and the boy from the middle of the last century have much more in common than it might seem.

title: My Deer Friend Nokotan
summary: No one knows Torako used to be a delinquent. All of her classmates only know her as the perfect student. But everything changes when Nokotan, a transfer student with antlers, enters her life. Antlers aren't the only thing strange about Nokotan. Her deer nose can sniff out Torako's secret past! Whether it's at school or the zoo, chaos follows this doe-eyed girl's every step. Torako has so many questions! Is Nokotan a deer, a girl, or something in-between?

title: Billy Corgan‘s Adventures in Carnyland
summary: Billy Corgan's Adventures in Carnyland, a new, 8-episode unscripted series streaming only on The CW, drops the curtain for a look at how Corgan balances life as the driving force behind rock icons The Smashing Pumpkins (Pumpkinworld) with work as a wrestling promoter and owner of the National Wrestling Alliance (Carnyland) while being a dedicated father in the midst of planning an epic wedding to his longtime love, Chloé Mendel.

title: Sins of the South
summary: Sins of the South is a riveting new true crime series that illuminates the drama, the history and the crime stories found below the Mason-Dixon line. With a deliciously delightful Southern inflected narration, each of the 12-hour-long episodes unravel the twists and turns of a real-life murder, highlighting the disturbing crimes of the South and the wickedness that led to it. First-hand accounts from victims' loved ones and law enforcement, archival footage and cinematic recreations bring these sinful stories to life.

title: Arjen
summary: Arjen, one of the world's most dangerous assassins, is tested with his conscience in his last mission

title: Sueltos en Los Cabos
summary: Eight hot, young singles arrive to an amazing villa in Los Cabos, San Lucas for the vacation of a lifetime.

After 20 years of marriage, Nadya's husband left for his pregnant secretary. Lera got married right after school and gave birth to a child, but she has been raising her son on her own for a long time. Her lover Kostya is married and has no intention of leaving the family. Asya has never been married and has no children. With the appearance of Igor in her life, everyone thinks that they are a wonderful couple. But Igor doesn't think so.Tired of eternal problems with men, the friends take an oath to each other that from now on there will be no traitors in their lives. Girls no longer believe in relationships and will not allow men to ruin their lives. But even the strongest vows lose their power when true love comes...

title: Smartypants
summary: The greatest thinkers/comedians of our time ask the questions no one else will.

lead_actors: Hiroki Hasegawa, Takumi Kitamura, Mayu Hotta

summary: Japan has a conviction rate of 99.9% for criminal cases that goes to trial. A lawyer is able to defeat those odds and obtain an acquittal for his client, even though there's conclusive evidence that says otherwise. Sometimes, due to minor things, good and evil can switch sides and good people can become bad people.

title: Wheeler Dealers World Tour
summary: Mike and Elvis are going global! This time, the stakes are higher, the deadlines tighter and the motor transformations are more jaw-dropping than ever.

lead_actors: Kaori Maeda, Junya Enoki, M・A・O, Akari Kitō, Tomokazu Sugita
title: 2.5 Dimensional Seduction
summary: Okumura is a second-year high school student who serves as the president and only member of his school's manga club. An otaku, he claims he has no interest in real girls due to his obsession with a fictional character named Liliel. Suddenly, a first-year student named Lilysa Amano, who is passionate about cosplay, joins the club. When he agrees to be her photographer, Okumura discovers her favorite character is also Liliel. As a result, he finds himself conflicted about the situation.

lead_actors: Amaia Aberasturi, Yon González, Bea Segura, Jaime Olías, Melani Olivares
title: Beguinas
summary: Segovia, 1559. Lucía de Avellaneda celebrates her engagement party with the Marquis of Peñarrosa, a nobleman chosen by her brother. This marriage promises to reinforce the financial and social status of the family, but, in the middle of the celebration, the fiancée receives an unexpected letter from a woman who claims to be her mother and who claims her on her deathbed. Lucía shows up at the beguinage, where her mother has summoned her. In this place she lives with other women independently and outside the Church. The young woman opens up to a new world that will make her question everything she had known until now. And she, furthermore, will know love through a pure and uncontrollable, but forbidden, passion. She will risk everything for Telmo, a Jewish man who must hide his beliefs and his past.

title: MTV's Hip Hop POV
summary: The popularity of hip-hop is wholeheartedly acknowledged in this weekly late-night platform, which shines a spotlight on the culture's artists, celebrities and topics making headlines. It features no-holds-barred commentary and opinions from five of hip-hop's leading tastemakers -- radio personalities Charlamagne Tha God and Devi Dev, journalist Sowmya Krishnamurthy, record label executive Bu Thiam and DJ Amanda Seales -- exclusive artist interviews and insider access to the industry's biggest events. Also, each half-hour episode concludes with a performance by one of hip-hop's hottest artists.

lead_actors: Reba McEntire, Belissa Escobedo, Melissa Peterman, Tokala Black Elk, Rex Linn

title: Ida & Vegard: plan Baby
summary: Ida Fladen and Vegard Harm are both forever single, but they both want to have children of their own. They've come up with plan B: could having children together be a good idea? Now, they want to see if it could actually happen.

summary: At just 18 years old, Kevin Lorin has become a high-flying scammer, a potential Arsène Lupine. While the police intervene in one of his scams on the Basque coast, he gives up on fleeing and surrenders to everyone's surprise. This early retirement will take an unexpected turn when the commissioner recruits him for a very special infiltration into a homicide case. Following this "fun" experience, he will have only one idea in mind: to become a cop!

title: Best Bite Wins
summary: In celebration of entertaining, passing apps, and eating together, Best Bite Wins gamifies cocktail party culture, with professional chefs competing to present the best party food to hungry judges and clientele at real events from birthday parties to retirement celebrations and everything in between.

lead_actors: Emily Carey, Emmanuel Imani, Liam Woodrum, Tim Downie, Jemima Rooper
title: Geek Girl
summary: Harriet Manners' life is turned upside down when she's thrust into the world of fashion. Tightly wound agents, off-beat designers, impossibly high heels, a cute supermodel with a great smile, Harriet has no idea what she's in for.

lead_actors: Jeanine Mason, Gary Anthony Williams, Brad Garrett, D.C. Douglas, Alan Tudyk
title: WondLa
summary: WondLa centers around Eva, a curious, enthusiastic and spirited teenager being raised in a state-of-the-art underground bunker by Muthr, a robot caretaker. On her 16th birthday, an attack on Eva's bunker forces her onto the Earth's surface, which is now inhabited by aliens and covered with otherworldly fauna, and there are no other humans to be found. In fact, it's no longer called Earth, but Orbona. Otto, a lovable giant waterbear with whom Eva shares telepathic powers and Rovender, a cantankerous alien with a troubled past, join Eva as she leads the team on a dangerous quest to find humans, her home and her true destiny.

title: Destination Heaven
summary: A faith quandary when God encounters people who believe they're doing the right things, but discover their approach lacks of emotional or intellectual growth.

title: Hikaru Kimi E
summary: Depicting the life of the author of "The Tale of Genji", Murasaki Shikibu, during the Heian era. She uses her feelings for Fujiwara no Michinaga, her hidden passion and her unique imagination to craft her story while living her life with an unwavering heart in a changing world.

lead_actors: Sola Sobowale, Tobi Bakre, Rajniesh Duggal, Richard Mofe-Damijo, Rahama Sadau
title: Postcards
summary: When a Nigerian single mother travels to India for a medical checkup, her journey will end up touching the lives of everyone she meets.

title: Century of Love
summary: San accepts pain and suffering in exchange for eternal life, all for the sake of reuniting with his reincarnated former girlfriend. Just as the mysterious power is about to disappear, San meets Vee, a cheerful young man who seems connected to him.

summary: Participants attempt to descend the ramp and ring the bell in cars, boats, and other modes of transport. With the components Tobbedansen, Snel naar de bel, Op naar de top, and Met je as over de plas, they slide, splash, drive, pedal, push, and ring bells galore! The daredevils and thrill seekers descend the ramp with the most beautiful and fastest creations.

title: Dance+
summary: Contestants from different parts of India showcase their dancing skills and compete against each other to win the prestigious title.

title: Banlang Luk Thung
summary: When their famous father dies, two ambitious sisters vie for glory in the family folk band as they plot their way to solo stardom - one song at a time.

title: Marbella
summary: César is a successful lawyer based in Marbella, the mafia capital of the world. Handsome, rich, hedonistic, selfish, ambitious, obsessed with social networks... He knows that to maintain his status he has to be the best in court and the man that everyone knows at the wild Marbella parties, where the numerous criminal groups that do business do business. They operate on the Costa del Sol. César is very clear that, in order not to have problems in life, you have to be friends with everyone and never cross certain lines. But when he least expects it, he discovers that he is in the eye of the hurricane and who needs a lawyer to save him is precisely him.

lead_actors: Julio Torres, Martine Gutierrez, Joe Rumrill, Tomás Matos
title: Fantasmas
summary: In Fantasmas, Julio Torres tells the tale of when he lost a golden oyster. The people he encounters as he searches for it and the musings he has become points of departure for little films along the way, as Torres navigates weaving in and out of these introspective, often eerie comedic stories.

lead_actors: John Leguizamo, Irene Bedard, John Ortiz, Hani Furstenberg, Isabelle Poloner
title: The Green Veil
summary: Gordon Rogers attempts to save an unraveling secret mission that threatens to reveal an unthinkable conspiracy.

title: Kameleon
summary: Four childhood friends try to escape from the Antwerp neighborhood where they grew up. A neighborhood where opportunities are few and where many young people are tempted by the 'get rich fast' option of drug crime.

lead_actors: Nicolás Furtado, Delfina Chaves, Malena Sánchez, Paly Duval, Juan Sorini
title: Felices Los 6
summary: Carolina and Damián were made for each other, but they have different ideas about sex and love. If they want to be together, they will have to learn more than one thing about jealousy, prejudice and monogamy.

creators: Chuck Lorre, Steven Molaro, Steve Holland
title: Georgie & Mandy's First Marriage
summary: Georgie & Mandy's First Marriage follows Georgie and Mandy as they raise their young family in Texas while navigating the challenges of adulthood, parenting and marriage.

title: Deadly Waters with Captain Lee
summary: Deadly Waters with Captain Lee exposes the wicked intentions of those who thought committing crimes on the water would shield them from justice.

title: Lucky 13
summary: Lucky 13 poses 13 true-or-false questions to its contestants, but there's a twist: Just how well do they know what they know … and, just as importantly, how well do they know what they don't know? If they can accurately predict how successfully they've answered 13 questions, they could take home a $1 million cash jackpot.

title: Титаны
summary: Artificial intelligence challenges the strongest people in Russia. TNT TV channel is conducting an incredible sports experiment using the latest technologies. After analyzing a huge amount of data, the neural network has created a series of complex tests to test what the human body is capable of. In the special space of our experiment, the strongest people in Russia, real Titans, will compete for the title of the strongest winner of the show and a prize of 10 million rubles. Will people be able to withstand the power of artificial intelligence?

title: Ich bin Dagobert
summary: The six-part miniseries retells the largest blackmail case in Germany from different perspectives. In 1988 and from 1992 to 1994, Arno Funke committed bomb and arson attacks to extort department stores. In the latter case, a previously unknown media hype broke out around the hunt for the man behind the duck mask, who made history under the pseudonym "Dagobert". Arno Funke alias "Dagobert" is available as a consultant for the project.

title: Cash Cab Music
summary: Riders test their music knowledge for cash in this fun trivia show!

title: RU
summary: A story that begins when you think it's over... An extraordinary love affair despite all odds in a coastal town in the Aegean... A 38-year-old woman and an 18-year-old man: Reyan and Uzer

title: Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister
summary: Uryu Kamihate is a high school student hoping to enroll in Kyoto University's medical school. After being taken in by the chief priest at Amagami Shrine, he is told he must marry one of three maiden sisters—Yae, Yuna, or Asahi—to live at, and one day inherit, the Amagami Shrine. Kamihate will need to sweep one of the maidens off her feet in this story of romance, friendship, and fun.

title: Jukkakukan no Satsujin
summary: In 1986, Tsunojima Island was home to the Decagonal House, a strange mansion with a decagonal appearance. The genius architect who built the mansion, Nakamura Seiji, died mysteriously in the burnt-down main building, Aoyashiki. Six months later, seven members of the University Mystery Research Club visit Tsunojima, which has become a deserted island, for a training camp. Meanwhile, on the mainland across the sea, Kawaminami Takaaki, a former member of the Mystery Research Club, receives a letter from Nakamura Seiji, who was supposed to be dead. As he continues his investigation, Konan meets a man named Shimada Kiyoshi, and they start working together. Meanwhile, in the Decagonal House, one of the members of the Mystery Research Club is murdered by someone. "Who on earth is the culprit?" The members become suspicious and start to suspect each other... It will be a week before they can leave the isolated island of Tsunoshima. What is the shocking conclusion beyond imagination that arises from these two stories?

lead_actors: Павел Мамонов, Риналь Мухаметов, Анна Халилулина, Nikita Kukushkin, Наталья Бардо
title: Погружение
summary: How could an innocent and slightly illegal trip to a classified career end up? Igor, a black digger, diver and just an adventure lover, comes here with his brother and a group of friends in search of an ancient settlement. Diving into a quarry turns into a surprise... Divers find themselves prisoners of the anomalous zone. The zone was classified due to secret experiments, and... people were left to live in their cocoons. Will they be able to get out of a parallel world that exists according to their own laws? ..

lead_actors: Ramzy Bedia, Jamel Debbouze, Camille Chamoux, Bérangère McNeese
title: Terminal
summary: Jack, a captain who manages his personal life as poorly as his plane, and Charlie his co-pilot, relegated from a prestigious company to Flywingz, are forced to collaborate. To do this, they will be supported by an astonishing team of cabin crew: the naive Nelly, Nabil, the most unpredictable steward the sky has ever known, Tristan the arriviste, and Armelle, an activist in all battles. An inspection visit that turns into a fiasco, a child who takes the controls of the plane or a safety training session that goes awry: our (almost) always united team of broken arms will try as best they can to manage these absurd situations. And too bad if the methods adopted do not always respect security procedures. Good flight !

title: Las Largas Sombras
summary: The lives of a group of women are suddenly turned upside down by the discovery of the human remains of one of their classmates, who disappeared during a school trip to Majorca twenty-five years earlier.

title: The Village Green
summary: The town of St. Maurice is in an economic crisis until an unlikely cash crop saves the day.

title: Boonie Bears
summary: In a lovely wooded wonderland in rural Northeast China. Though the surroundings might seem idyllic, the peace has been disrupted by the dastardly Logger Vick, who schemes to transform the majestic forest into his own personal lumberyard! Too bad for Vick-two strapping brown-bear brothers are determined to thwart his plans and send him packing.

title: Dariba Diaries
summary: Set in 19th century Delhi, our story takes place at a time when technology and science are still in their infancy and modern tools of investigation haven't yet been invented. While Bahadur Shah Zafar II reigns ostensibly, the British might and influence increase each day, and with it, a spate of crimes. As crime multiplies, the police grapple to keep up with the mounting unsolved cases. Under these circumstances, when the Kotwal finds himself in the midst of a felonious mystery, he seeks the help of the only man who can come to his aid, Mirza Jaan Nawaz. Though eccentric in his methods of investigation, Mirza proves himself time and again, unraveling a new mystery with every case. Without the aid of technology, Mirza relies on the most potent tool of all his brains! With an equal measure of intelligence and looks, Mirza Jaan Nawaz knows how to maneuver every situation. But Mirza only has eyes for his love, Zeenat, from whom he often seeks counsel.

title: Klimawechsel
summary: Four women, all teachers at Munich's Novalis high school, feel the sword of Damocles of the menopause threateningly hover above them - Angelika has hot flashes, Beate uncontrolled emotional outbursts, Cornelia gets panic attacks and Desiree is suffering from nervous exhaustion. However, all four realize that life also continues in this stage of life - albeit on winding paths.

lead_actors: Gaten Matarazzo, Tony Revolori, Bobby Moynihan, Marsai Martin, Michael Cusack
creators: Dan Hernandez, Benji Samit, Jason Cosler, James Waugh, Josh Rimes
title: LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy
summary: The entire Star Wars Galaxy gets completely mixed up when an ordinary nerf-herder, Sig Greebling, unearths a powerful artifact from a hidden Jedi temple. He finds himself thrust into adventure in a new, wondrously wild and twisted version of the galaxy where good guys are bad, bad guys are good and the fate of all depends on Sig becoming the hero who can put all the pieces back together.

When the doctor warns that he really needs to take it easy, permanent employees Esmee, Kay and Mike have to take over the management of the Costa. But then a neighbor and the municipality turn against the club and the team is once again faced with the big challenge of saving club Costa.

lead_actors: Pyo Ye Jin, Lee Jun Young, Kim Hyun Jin, Song Ji Woo
title: Dreaming of a Freaking Fairytale
summary: In this 21st century hybrid fairy tale, a woman is determined to become a Cinderella, so she gets a job at an exclusive club and sets her sights on her future Prince Charming. He might be handsome and wealthy, but he's also an arrogant jerk with trust issues, and no interest in wom

title: Gummibär and Friends: The Gummy Bear Show
summary: Gummibär and Friends: The Gummy Bear Show is a brand new animated web series that follows the silly adventures of everyone's favorite gummy bear character and his friends Kala the cat and Harry the chameleon.

lead_actors: Ana María Orozco, Jorge Enrique Abello
title: Betty La Fea, La Historia Continúa
summary: Betty has not lived with Armando for two years after having found him in a compromising situation with Marcela. Excited about her daughter's return to Colombia, she tries to strengthen her bond with her, but pressure on Ecomoda and enemies from the past will do everything possible to keep her from both Mila and Armando.

title: Shrimad Ramayan
summary: Shrimad Ramayan brings to life the timeless Hindu epic, the Ramayana, with a deep commitment to authenticity, cultural reverence and contemporary sensibility. The epic narrative of the Ramayana is rooted in the two words, 'Ram' and 'Ayana.' 'Ram' represents the human incarnation of Lord Vishnu, while 'Ayana' signifies a journey. Thus, the Ramayana unfolds through the voyage of Ram, a mortal who ascended to become Purushottam, the paragon among men, transcending his own inherent limitations.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
title: Wagle Ki Duniya
summary: Three generations of the family live together, who share all their happiness and sorrows. Follow the story of this family as they bring laughter to each other's lives and will make your heart melt. A new generation of the old critically acclaimed show is here to take you on a roller coaster ride of emotions.

title: Kavya - Ek Jazbaa, Ek Junoon
summary: An ambitious young woman strives for the perfect balance between her dream career and a loving relationship. However, when these worlds collide, she grapples with the conflict between her roles as a daughter, a wife and an IAS officer. How will she tackle this challenging dilemma?

title: Barsatein - Mausam Pyar Ka
summary: A sensible and ambitious journalist joins a media company run by a suave maverick man. While united in their passion for honest and ground-breaking journalism, their contrasting characters immediately puts them at loggerheads. What will happen when she starts falling in love with him despite the red flags?

title: Wilde Ride
summary: A young girl's dreams of being a show jumping champion are dashed when her parents are killed. She goes to live with her dirt-bike-riding extended family in West Auckland. Made with the support of NZ on Air.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
title: Dhruv Tara - Samay Sadi Se Pare
summary: Love transcends time when a princess with a secret passion for healing people journeys 400 years in the future in search of a someone who can save her terminal brother. Amidst the wonderous modern world, the princess finds a talented neurosurgeon and, in the process discovers an unlikely bond of love. But will love be enough to compel him to travel to the past and help her and her brother?

lead_actors: Ayushi Khurana, Samar Vermani, Mahesh Thakur, Aditi Rathore, Neetha Shetty
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
title: Aangan Aapno Kaa
summary: After raising three children alone, doting father Jaidev Sharma weathers the storms of seeing his adult daughters marry. Though Pallavi defies society's conventions and norms, she still seeks to be a dutiful daughter.

title: Concordia
summary: Powered by AI surveillance, CONCORDIA is the town of the future and on the verge of expansion when twin catastrophes strike: the first ever murder and a hack of its AI tech. A team race to solve both crimes but, in doing so, uncover a shocking original sin that could bring everything crumbling down.Concordia is the municipality of the future: a town built on surveillance and data collection not for nefarious self-serving purposes but for the greater good of society and its citizens. Its leadership's sole goal is to create a freer, fairer, and more humane society for today and tomorrow. By its 20th anniversary, Concordia is thriving an indisputable success. It's on the verge of expansion when twin catastrophes strike: the first ever murder and a hack of the town's impenetrable AI. Together, these events compromise the very foundation of the Concordia project and undermine any possibility of expansion. As the town's investigation unfolds, the story becomes a race against time to fix the hack, solve the murder, and get the expansion over the line. However, the team soon find themselves staring down a deeply disturbing original sin, a sin that undermines the promise of Concordia far more than any of these threats ever could…

title: Kard Chuek

No one dares to fight him; even authorities are scared of him. However, one day a young and fearless stranger called Thanu appeared. He has the kind of Kard Chuek skills that have never been seen before. He becomes a threat to Thongkam. Lamai and Lamian are sisters. They inherited a big market in Pho after their parents died. Although sisters, the two girls have extremely different personalities. Lamai, the oldest, is arrogant and values money over everything, but deep down she's a good person. Lamian has a strong personality with a bad temper and constantly pesters her sister to break up with her boyfriend Thongdee, son of Thongkam. Lamian knows they're not good people but Lamai refuses to believe her. Boonsom is a hot headed and aggressive young man. He's one of the most skillful Kard Chuek fighters in Pho, which makes both Thongkam and Thongdee see him as a threat. Thongkam frames him for murder and Boonsom's mother falls ill after seeing her son getting arrested. Lamai takes care of her despite her dislike for Boonsom. Thanu is interested in Lamai, but she doesn't hide her hatred for him. She only has eyes for Thongdee. Everyone thinks that her parents' death was an accident, but they were actually murdered by Thongdee. This is because he learned the parents were upset at Lamai's relationship with him. Boonsom is released from jail and works hard to become a police officer. His relationship with Lamian changes over time. Thanu and Boonsom join forces to fight against Thongdee and Thongkam.

Set in the early 2000s, the series includes excerpts from the film as flashbacks to reconstruct the protagonists' memories.
