Faced with a personal crisis and with power structures, he will have to choose between loyalty and justice. The crime drama 12 Reči is a series about lawyers in the network of organized crime and the judiciary, where everything has a price except trust.

title: Frozen Gold
summary: This weekly adventure series follows six Americans who embark on a dangerous quest to uncover wealth on an Arctic journey through uncharted land. Frozen Gold highlights one of the many impacts of global warming, as the resulting melting ice sheets have exposed land in Greenland believed to be filled with large pockets of untouched gold.

lead_actors: Debi Mazar, Miranda Otto, Jessica De Gouw, Clare Hughes, Azizi Donnelly
title: Ladies in Black
summary: Sydney, 1961. The women who work in Goodes ladieswear face tumultuous lives navigating societal shifts and personal challenges amidst the fashion transformation of the sixties.

title: Secret Ingredient
summary: A Korean man who gives up his entire luxurious life in Seoul in search of his childhood girlfriend, someone he's never forgotten all these years, in the hopes that she would fall in love with him, not for who they were back then or who they are now, but for what they can aspire to be: happy, fulfilled and blissfully in love with one another.

title: Yakshini
summary: During a quest to undo a curse, a supernatural being comes across a hopeless romantic and forms an unlikely relationship.

title: Twilight Out of Focus
summary: In front of a camera, roommates Mao Tsuchiya and Hisashi Ootomo make three promises: Mao must not tell anyone Hisashi is gay and in a relationship with another man; Hisashi must never fall in love or make any advances on Mao; and one must not disturb the other's "personal time." Thus begins their second year of cohabitation.However, everything starts to crumble when the film club—of which Mao is a member—wants to cast Hisashi in the lead role for their upcoming movie. The problem arises with the movie's plot, as it is about boys' love—a romance between a delinquent and the class president. Mao is adamant to dissuade Hisashi from becoming the protagonist due to their first promise; but, to his surprise, Hisashi is easily convinced by the director.After imagining Hisashi as the delinquent he is playing, Mao becomes overly conscious of his presence. He knows Hisashi is just a friend and out of his reach, but Mao cannot keep lying to himself anymore—his feelings toward his roommate may no longer be purely platonic.

title: Kilos Mortales México
summary: The struggle of individuals with extreme obesity who must undergo surgery to save their lives.

lead_actors: Sul Kyung Goo, Kim Hee Ae
title: The Whirlwind
summary: A whirlwind clash ensues when a deputy prime minister of economy stands against the prime minister who aims to uproot the corrupt powers that be.

title: B&B: Bujji and Bhairava
summary: It's the year 2896, in future city of Kasi, Bhairava is a bounty hunter with dreams of getting into the Complex, and BU-JZ1, an AI pilot of a Cargo ship, waiting for her promotion. At their lowest point, these two unlikely souls, find each other to set off a crackling story of ambition, adventure, partnership and mainly friendship.

lead_actors: Teerapong Leowrakwong, Narilya Gulmongkolpech, Chatayodom Hiranyatithi, Nussaba Punnakanta, Thanavate Siriwattanakul
title: Master of the House
summary: Following a diamond tycoon's mysterious death, a cutthroat battle over his estate erupts between his heirs and the housekeeper their father recently married.

title: Brewster the Rooster
summary: Brewster the Rooster and his best pal Maggie are both super inquisitive. They wear tap shoes but it's their inimitable style of imagining possible answers to questions that makes them such a good team!Whenever one of them ponders a question like "If fish live in water, what do they drink?", Brewster and Maggie hold hands, do a little tap dance and open their imaginations. Through creative thinking, they come up with many possible solutions, always building on each other's ideas. They will take young viewers on a journey of discovery, and delve into a colourful and exciting world to find out the answers to those curious questions.

lead_actors: Paula Pell, Richard Ayoade, Amy Poehler, Maya Rudolph, Ally Maki
title: Dream Productions
summary: At the studio inside Riley's mind, a dream director faces a nightmare: creating the next hit dream.

title: Bad Cop
summary: Twin brothers on the opposite sides of the law get caught in a complex web of deceit, loyalty and betrayal.

title: 36 Days
summary: An enigmatic woman's arrival in a seemingly idyllic housing estate in Goa threatens to expose the residents' darkest secrets. As they clamour to unravel her mysteries, all their lies and hidden identities begin destroying them, culminating in absolute horror.

title: Música Boa Ao Vivo
summary: The program welcomes big names in Brazilian music for an incredible meeting, full of hits, surprises and unprecedented musical partnerships.

title: Bachelorette
summary: Romance, drama and lots of dates! Everything is on the line when Danish single women search for true love among a group of hopeful men. Each season offers new adventures for the 'Bachelorette' contestants.

title: Er der nogen?
summary: Mikkel Egelund, Trine Gadeberg and Kasper Le Fevre is trying to find evidence that manor houses and castles are haunted. The ghost hunters investigate legends, myths and history, as well as spend a night at the location to document whether there is anyone in the dark.

title: Kinnikuman Perfect Origin Arc
summary: Kinnikuman returns to the ring in an epic three-way battle between the Justice, Devil and Perfect Chojin factions, and reveals the roots of the Chojin.

lead_actors: Tara Lee, Staz Nair, Ugo Onwughalu, Ned Dennehy, Daisy Jelley
title: The Faceless Lady
summary: Step inside Kilolc castle, a magnificent stone fortress deep in the Irish countryside and home to the infamous 'Faceless Lady', a tragic spirit doomed to walk the crumbling manor for eternity. But her story is far from over, as three young couples are about to discover. Drawn to the castle by its mysterious owner, they have come to compete in historic Games. The winner shall inherit Kilolc Castle, and all that lies within it… both the living, and the dead.

title: Gunaah
summary: Betrayed by loved ones, the world around Shiva shattered! Taking a new identity as Abhimanyu, he endures many trials for a bloody vengeance, carved with love.

title: Gyaarah Gyaarah
summary: Three cops defy the rules of time to investigate and deliver justice in a series of cold cases. How far will they go as they work from within the corrupt system to bring the criminals to book?

lead_actors: Jo Yeo Jung, DEX, Go Kyu Pil
title: Tarot
summary: A brutal fate mystery series that tells the story of being trapped in the curse of tarot cards twisted by a moment's choice.

lead_actors: Han Chae Young, Han Bo Reum
title: Scandal
summary: A fierce, passionate battle begins between a woman who wants it all and a woman who risks it all for revenge.

lead_actors: Kōhei Amasaki, Sumire Uesaka, Wakana Maruoka, Yukiyo Fujii, Kaito Ishikawa
title: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian
summary: Alisa Mikhailovna Kujou is considered the idol of her institute. She has conquered the hearts of countless male students and is admired by everyone else, but everyone distrusts this almost perfect girl.

lead_actors: Ryoma Takeuchi, Kento Kaku, Kawai Yuumi, Nakayama Hinano
title: Like a Dragon: Yakuza
summary: Set in the fictional town of Kamurocho, the story unfolds across two intersecting timelines—1995 and 2005. In 1995, four friends eager to escape their restrictive lives in an orphanage dive into the yakuza-controlled underworld of 1995 Kamurocho. Meanwhile, in 2005, their friendship is deteriorated, as tensions between the Tojo Clan and the Omi Alliance are at a boiling point.

title: Shaka iLembe
summary: Explores the story of the making of the iconic African king, from his childhood through to adulthood, during the 1700s.

title: 1122: For a Happy Marriage
summary: Wife: Ichiko Aihara. Husband: Otoya Aihara. Married for seven years, they get along well, but sexless and without children, they agree to see other people. Otoya has an affair with Mitsuki, and Ichiko is aware of it. Looking at Otoya in a state of bliss with Mitsuki, Ichiko begins to change, too.

title: Yuzuki-san Chi no Yon-Kyodai
summary: Family is everything. The four Yuzuki brothers lost their parents two years ago, and now work to raise themselves. Hayato, the eldest, then Mikoto, Minato, and young Gakuto. Hayato works and provides for the family. Mikoto is relaxed and calm. Minato is full of energy, and Gakuto is wise beyond his years. Together they live, learn, fight, and forgive as brothers should. Meet the Yuzuki family!

lead_actors: Engfa Waraha, Arachaporn Pokinpakorn, Wasita Hermenau
title: Bangkok Khanika
summary: Three women, a sex worker with big dreams, a girl seeking love, and another sold into the trade, fight to liberate themselves and reclaim their dignity.

title: Disko 76
summary: In 1976, the disco wave spread to Bochum: an overwhelming desire for freedom meets stuffy conventions, disco beats meet solid hits, glamor meets coal dust. Disco fever is also rampant among Doro and her siblings, who want more from life than to live up to their parents' expectations: in the light of the disco ball they can be young, rebellious and wild, live in the moment, turn night into day, fly high and fall low.

title: ROCHE PE
summary: ROCHE PE is a non-profit University Project, born from a group of university students and fans of the original SKAM series who decided that Peru needs a real and honest representation of youth in the XXI century.

lead_actors: Laure Calamy, Arieh Worthalter, Ava Baya, Anne Benoît, Annabelle Lengronne
creators: Jean-Baptiste Delafon, Fanny Burdino, Samuel Doux, Alexandre Kauffmann
title: Une Amie Dévouée
summary: Inspired by true events, this psychological thriller follows Christelle "Chris" Blandin, a rock music-obsessed Parisian, who, after witnessing the harrowing November 13, 2015 terrorist attacks, quickly latches onto a community of survivors. Claiming that her best friend Vincent was one of dozens critically injured at the Bataclan Theatre, Chris becomes an indispensable resource for the group, working her way into a prominent role in a survivors' association. Though her commitment seems relentless, discrepancies begin to pepper her story – raising serious doubts among the true victims of the tragedy.

title: The Creep Tapes
summary: The Creep Tapes is a collection of video tapes from the secret vault of the world's deadliest and most socially uncomfortable serial killer. Unravel a twisted mind as he lures victims to film his life, only to reveal his deadly intentions.

title: The Boyfriend
summary: Single men from diverse backgrounds gather in a sunny ocean-side house to live and work together for one summer – will romance brew or end bittersweet?

title: J'adore le jus
summary: "J'adore le jus" tells the scandalous story between Mathieu Mailloux, a teenage entrepreneur, and ZOOP organic energy drinks. Under a backdrop of caffeine, this epic plunges us into the most terrible secrets of a large Quebec company.

title: Tell Me Everything
summary: A brutal sexual assault in a locked hotel room leaves one woman and her husband, Kobi, broken and forced to move on with their lives without any answers. The two police investigators – Avi Avraham and Orna Denis – have few leads to go on – and completely different theories about how to pursue the investigation.Kobi cannot accept the fact that they'll likely never know who attacked his wife. When the police tell him yet again to "be patient", he decides to take matters into his own hands, going rogue and conducting his own private inquiries in parallel to the official investigation.When another woman is assaulted in the same hotel chain, the race to catch the perpetrator heats up, with both Kobi and the investigators in pursuit of the truth and justice – with tragic results.

lead_actors: Natalie Nunn, Gia Mayham, Scotlynd Ryan, Jelaminah Lanier, Damerlin Baez
title: Baddies Caribbean
summary: The Baddies head to the Caribbean where they plan on creating more of a storm than a Hurricane.

title: Top Chef: The Dish with Kish
summary: Kristen Kish hosts Top Chef: The Dish with Kish, a weekly show discussing Top Chef episodes, featuring guest chefs creating unique dishes inspired by challenges. Together, Kristen and her guests have fun cooking, eating, and revealing everything there is to know about Top Chef.

title: Segunda muerte
summary: 'Segunda Muerte' is a thriller starring a police assistant, whose father is a recently retired UCO legend, who finds herself involved in a criminal investigation in a quiet Pasiego town.In a small town in Cantabria, a young auxiliary police officer finds the body of an elderly lady who has recently passed away. The mystery lies in the fact that it is the body of Juliana Cobián, who had passed away seven years ago. Who was buried in her place, then? When Juliana's coffin is exhumed, another woman's body is found inside: it is Soledad's, Juliana's daughter that, according to all the neighbours, had left the town twenty years before. What lies behind this second death?

title: Only in Iola
summary: Newcomers and city slickers Perry, Shanalee, and Braydon Sharboneau have discovered the warmth of small-town living among the wonderful people in Iola, Texas. Most people have no clue about this tight-knit community, where 300 residents and 39 businesses call home. Join this family as they navigate their new way of living. Witness the power of faith, family and the strength of community as this extraordinary family trades, their lavish lifestyle for a simpler, more meaningful existence. Don't miss this heartwarming premiere of Only in Iola that will touch your soul.

title: My Name is Gabriel
summary: A program where you live 'the real life of that person' for 72 hours under the name of one of the world's 8 billion people in a place where no one knows you.

title: Dawaay El Safar
summary: Ibrahim lives in a world of his imagination; however, when he finds himself in a difficult situation, he decides to change his life with the help of his young neighbor, Ali.

lead_actors: Madeleine Adams, Lindsay Daniels, Dylan Poihipi, Fasitua Amosa, Xavier Horan
title: Alibi
summary: In the rural New Zealand community of Awatahi, a 17-year-old girl has been murdered. Now six suspects share their whereabouts on August 24th. Watch their interviews and delve into the world of Awatahi to figure out what really happened the day Jodie Hunter was killed.

lead_actors: Denisse Peña, Marta Hazas, Álex González, Gabriel Guevara
title: Desde el Mañana
summary: Gabriela and Andrés, a doctor and a detective, must face a series of supernatural phenomena that disrupt their lives and those of their loved ones. Together, they have the opportunity to change their destinies.

title: O Jogo que Mudou a História
summary: Rio de Janeiro, late 1970s. A new agent starts working at the Ilha Grande prison, at the same time that a convict arrives at the institution on the coast of Rio. This is a time of effervescence for relationships within prison. Inspired by real events from the last 40 years, the story delves into the emergence of drug trafficking factions, based on events between the "Falange Jacaré" and "Turma do Fundão" wings of the prison. What happens inside has repercussions on the lives of Padre Nosso, Parada Geral and Morro da Promessa, communities inspired by real favelas.

title: Candis Cayne's Secret Garden
summary: Candis Cayne's Secret Garden is a gardening show unlike any other. Trailblazing actress and style icon Candis Cayne welcomes us into her "Secret Garden": a backyard paradise filled with plants, flowers, and magical friends. From her playful and imaginative world, Candis inspires us to create our own enchanted gardens with DIY projects, backyard makeovers, gardening tips and tricks, and inventive botanical cocktails. Each episode of Candis Cayne's Secret Garden is designed to make gardening accessible to all... even those of us with green thumbs.

title: L'Agent Jean!
summary: At the heart of the First Continent, an ultra-giga-secret organization called the Agency is responsible for protecting Earth A and its population of super villains with ideas and ambitions, each more demonic than the last! The Agency counts among its ranks the famous Agent Jean. The latter, who succeeds in everything without always knowing why, must constantly save Earth A from an imminent catastrophe!

title: Naked Attraction España
summary: A dating show that begins where some dates may end: naked. Singles get up close and personal as they meet for the first time.

title: Grendizer U
summary: Duke Fleed is a survivor of the Fleed Planet who is escaped to the Earth, onboard a mysterious "spaceship", where is raised by Dr. Umon as his adoptive son, and known as Daisuke Umon. Years after his arrival, he's faced with the threat of King Vega and his army, who want to conquer the Earth. With his friends Koji and Hikaru (and later his younger sister Maria Grace), Duke decides to fight back using his best weapon - the almighty Grendizer.

title: SolarBalls
summary: What if we could see the universe from a different perspective? If we weren't limited by Earth's gravity and could just fly through space and see planets up close? Well... we'll probably freak out when we notice they have a face!

title: L'armure de Jade
summary: Jade is a legendary superhero. And now it's up to Lan Jun to wear her armor... hard to believe it's her turn to don the famous Jade armor and use her kung fu skills to fight evil! With the help of her friends, Theo and Alisha, as well as the Beasticons, the legendary servants of the armor, Lan Jun must fight against super villains and manage her teenage life.

creators: Daphna Levin, Dror Mishani, Idit Avrahami, Aurit Zamir
title: The Truth
summary: On the day the most controversial murder case in Israel is to be given a highly anticipated final verdict, 10 years later, another identical murder takes place. A copycat killer? A hit ordered by the man convicted for the first case, from prison? The original murderer who was actually never caught?With only two weeks for the police to present its findings to the judges while the first verdict is on hold, young detective Racheli Zabatani must revisit the past, the events that changed her life and the old case her own father investigated, in order to figure out the mysteries of the present: this new murder case, as well as her own personal quest.Partly inspired by true events.

title: Badi Dooooor Se Aaye Hai
summary: Badi Dooooor Se Aaye Hai is a story of 5 extra-terrestrial people, from a different galaxy. They have come to earth in search of their lost son. These 5 aliens consist of a father, mother and their 3 children. Few years back they had lost their youngest son while travelling through our galaxy. Since then they have been searching for him from planet to planet.This hunt of theirs had got them to our planet earth.

title: Au Pairs
summary: Four young people leave for the adventure of a lifetime: they work as an au pair for three months. In addition to the daily care of children, they all pursue their own dreams and desires. How do they survive far from their familiar environment?

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
title: Alto Astral
summary: Two doctor brothers compete for the love of the same woman. The plot involving this love triangle is full of evil, betrayal, past lives, adoption and love.

title: Yuan Zun
summary: A young man with his brush plunges into a chaotic world and lights up the heavens. In a world where cultivators are paramount, will the vermilion bird swallow the dragon, or will the dragon transcend beyond all else?

title: Заезжий молодец
summary: Larisa is a strong woman who has long been accustomed to dealing with any problems on her own. She alone raises a difficult teenage son, earns her living through hard work, and has long despaired of finding personal happiness.Larisa's neighbor, wanting to take possession of her house, brings the heroine together with her nephew Oleg, a narrow-minded martinet. Tired of endless loneliness, Larisa tries to build a relationship with him, but the conspiracy is soon revealed...Suddenly, Larisa witnesses how the police detain an undocumented man on the street. Having warmed up to the stranger, the heroine helps him free and pays a fine for him. The next day, the rescued man appears at her house, but not at all to repay the debt - he asks Larisa for an overnight stay. In anger, the heroine drives him away, but subsequent events radically change the woman's attitude towards this man, who appeared so strangely in her life...

title: AYAKA is in LOVE with HIROKO
summary: Soft and bubbly office lady Ayaka is madly in love with her senior at work, Hiroko! Two lovestruck coworkers who both think the other is straight totally crush on each other.

title: Make Mate 1
summary: Make Mate 1 is a program that contains the meaning of "Time to become one with MAKE friends (MATE) to create the stage you dreamed of," and it is a program that depicts the process of 36 multinational participants running toward their dream of becoming an idol. It is not a survival program involving trainees belonging to an entertainment agency but a survival program performed by ordinary boys who do not have an agency. The final debut group will debut as Makestar's new boy group.

lead_actors: Lucien-River Chauhan, Abigail Pniowsky, Dilshad Vadsaria, Amanda Reid, Jessy Yates
title: Me
summary: Me follows a 12-year-old kid named Ben who is in the throes of middle school (complete with bullies, crushes and school dances!) as he adjusts to a newly blended family AND the realization that he has super powers.

title: Jezabel
summary: Set in Israel, Jezabel tells the story of a Phoenician princess who uses her beauty and seduction power to achieve all she wants. She marries King Ahab to become queen, but she suffers strong opposition from the Israelite people in attempting to impose on everyone the worship of the pagan gods Baal and Asherah.Stubborn and unwavering in her convictions, Jezabel is a woman capable of anything to achieve her goals and destroy her enemies.She has Elijah as the greatest adversary, a powerful prophet whose sole mission is to spread the word of the One God and to defend the Israelis.

lead_actors: Juliana Paes, Vladimir Brichta, Felipe Abib, Paloma Duarte, Martha Nowill
title: Pedaço de Mim
summary: Due to a rare phenomenon, a woman finds herself pregnant with twins by two men. Over time, she strives to keep her family united — and her secrets hidden.

lead_actors: Barbie Forteza, Sanya Lopez, David Licauco, Alden Richards, Dennis Trillo
title: Pulang Araw
summary: Pulang Araw is a family drama that tells stories of courage, sacrifice, and hardships that every Filipino family has. These stories were inspired by the tales of the unsung heroes who defied the odds of World War II and the Japanese occupation of the Philippines.

title: Tokyo Swindlers
summary: Can a group of real estate scammers pull off a 10-billion-yen scam without getting caught? This is the intriguing premise of Tokyo Swindlers, a masterful crime thriller about realty fraudsters driven by greed.

lead_actors: Brett Varvel, Ashley Elaine, Allan Newsome, Rik Roberts
title: Mayberry Man: The Series
summary: Small town Americana and modern life collide when movie star Chris Stone falls in love with Mayberry's sweetheart. Meanwhile, Mayberry's quirky citizens confront a nefarious plot to wipe their antiquated town off the map.

title: Heavenly Brick Hero
summary: The aloof and proud architectural genius Li Ji was kidnapped by a creature from another world, the Dark Qilin, and taken to a secret realm called the Soul Mind Space. In this secret realm lies the ruins of an ancient heavenly court. The Dark Qilin told him that if he wants to return, he must pass the trial set by the Heavenly Dao, which is to rebuild the heavenly court...

lead_actors: Kim Byung Chul, Yoon Se Ah, Park Joo Hyun, Yoon Sang Hyun, Lee Si Woo
title: Perfect Family
summary: A story of the family of Choi Sun Hee, who seems to be happy and perfect to anyone, going through the death of her friend Gyeong Ho one day.

lead_actors: Ирина Горячева, Андрей Соколов, Анна Самохина, Сергей Юшкевич, Анна Банщикова
title: Дом без выхода
summary: Architects Tina and Stas Kirillov acquire a cozy country house. The family is doing well - both in personal aspect and at work. Tina's friend since their student years Maryana has always been in love with Stas and tries not to lose sight of the couple. Maryana is married to Alexei, but her heart still belongs to the former fellow student. Gradually, envy of the personal and professional success of Tina and Stas gets stronger and stronger, and now the ill-wisher is ready to step over a lot in order to steal the husband from her ""sworn"" girlfriend.

lead_actors: Марат Башаров, Егор Бероев, Юрий Назаров, Ekaterina Rednikova, Агния Кузнецова
title: Индус
summary: Anton Ponomaryov (Marat Basharov) devotes all his time and efforts to developing a conceptually new implant with the ability to speed up bone healing and help even in hopeless cases. However, scientific community does not appreciate Anton's piece of work which causes Vedernikov (Alexander Samoilenko), head of Scientific Research Institute, to put Ponomarev's laboratory under threat of being shut down. Fortunately, the situation is being resolved thanks to Anton's old friend Leonid Lazarev (Egor Beroev), a successful businessman, who possesses broad connections in political and business circles. Childhood friends establish a joint venture to finish the implant development and perform its market launch. Leonid finds an Indian investor who is ready to support the venture. But the invention is to be tested earlier than planned. Anton's tutor's granddaughter suffers a terrible spinal cord injury. In order to save her Ponomarev at his own risk inserts the implant that has not been certified yet. The surgery goes well. Anton places a similar implant into his own arm in order to experience the same as his patient and be able to help her. Being full of hopes Anton flies to India to conduct negotiations but the plane crashes. Anton found miraculously alive but disfigured is taken to a local hospital where he is found out to suffer full memory loss. Sergei recognizes his friend but decides to conceal it in order to get his hands on the entire implant manufacturing business. Having protection of an influential Indian friend Sergei starts to perform implant surgeries. Many of them result in patients' deaths... and only Anton who bears a clue to the puzzle in his arm can explain why... Anton's way to happiness will be long and winding. Undergoing a plastic surgery, regaining memory and realizing who he is are in store for him. He will have to make a hard choice between his family left in Moscow who believes he is dead and his new Indian love, Maya. But the most complicated challenge he is to solve is to stop a succession of medical errors which he could partly be blamed for.

title: Beat the Clock
summary: Unlike previous versions, this version had kids playing the game along with adults.

title: The Einstein Challenge
summary: The world is complicated, and sometimes we need things explained to us like we're kids. Today's greatest minds will do just that! In each episode of The Einstein Challenge, two world-class experts in science, history and engineering will see who can best explain complicated concepts to kids.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
title: Anupama: Namaste America
summary: Seventeen years ago, Anupama gets an opportunity of a lifetime to live her dreams. Now she has to make a tough choice between her career and her family.

title: Pseudo Harem
summary: Eiji Kitahama joins the drama club with dreams of having a harem like the ones from his favorite manga. Rin Nanakura, an underclassman, finds herself crushing hard on Eiji, and tries on different personas in his presence to win him over. No matter how she acts, one thing is certain—her feelings for Eiji continue to grow stronger. Will she ever be able to tell him the truth and be herself?

title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
summary: Tom Kerridge hits the road in his 1950s food truck to discover wonderful produce, cooking with the ingredients he finds along the way.

title: The Loyal Pin
summary: Her Serene Highness Aninlaphat, or Princess Anil, and Mom Rajawongse Pilanthita, or Khunying Pin, have been close since they were young. When Princess Anil is fifteen, she must travel to England for her studies, separating the princess from her close friend Khunying Pin by a great distance. The distance, however, allows Anil to come to know herself, to know deep down how she's felt about Khunying Pin without question. Once she returns to Thailand, Princess Anil tries everything to get near to Khunying Pin where she can find the opportunity to confess her love. However, it seems to be an impossible task as Khunying Pin has been engaged to marry Khun Chai Kueakiat.

title: Accidental Farmer & Co.
summary: Inheriting a debt-ridden farming estate is hardly a dream come true, especially for a man with no direction in life. Just about having given up on the barren land, the man stumbles upon a mysterious medicinal herb. He decides to cultivate it so he can pay off the debt but ends up attracting wanted as well as some unwanted attention.

lead_actors: Kim Ha Neul, Rain, Yoon Je Moon, Ki Eun Se, Seo Yi Sook
title: Red Swan
summary: Oh Wan Soo, a former world-class golfer married into the powerful Hwain Group, finds herself targeted by death threats. She crosses paths with Seo Do Yoon, a bodyguard investigation a friend's death that is tied to the Hwain Group. Together, they unravel Hwain Group's secrets tainted with desire.

title: Место силы
summary: A bold experiment from the TNT channel, in which magicians, mediums, parapsychologists, psychics and other people with extraordinary abilities will try to prove that magic exists. 13 heroes of the project will gather in the most mystical city of Russia - St. Petersburg, to unravel the famous mysteries of the past, touch centuries-old legends and help celebrities who find themselves in paranormal and mystical situations. Our team of superheroes, using their unusual talents, will work together to unravel the most unexpected and mysterious stories. And all in order to, together with the viewer, test reality for strength and separate fantasies from incredible reality, expose some myths and confirm others. During the project, the heroes live together, and this will help both the viewer and the participants to immerse themselves as deeply as possible into the otherworldly world, not only in completing tasks, but also in unpacking themselves. At the end of the project, the winner will receive a cash prize.

title: Sakuna: Of Rice and Ruin
summary: Spoiled harvest goddess Sakuna finds herself banished from her opulent celestial home to an island overrun with demons. In the untamed wilderness, she must rediscover her birthright as the daughter of a warrior god and harvest goddess by weathering the elements, fighting monsters, and cultivating rice, the source of her power. By her side in this forbidding place is her guardian Tama and a group of outcast humans. Together, these unlikely companions must join hands to tame both the soil and the demons of Hinoe Island.

title: Mayonaka Punch
summary: Meet Masaki, the now former member of the popular NewTuber group, Harikiri Sisters. After a career setback, aka getting fired unexpectedly via a live stream, she joins forces with Live, a partner with superhuman abilities. Together, they aim to create sensational content and reach 1 million subscribers. Will they reach their content dreams or be hit with the block button?

title: The Bahatis Empire
summary: Hitmaker Bahati and his singer wife, Diana, navigate infidelity rumors, parenthood and the weight of fame while living the high life in Nairobi.

title: The Elusive Samurai
summary: In the year 1333, the Kamakura shogunate government comes crumbling down. A trusted vassal, Ashikaga Takauji, betrays the shogunate and organizes a rebellion. Hojo Tokiyuki, the rightful heir, escapes the massacre with a Shinto priest named Suwa Yorishige to Kamakura. On the run and fighting to stay alive, Tokiyuki sets in motion his plan to reclaim his birthright.

title: SHOSHIMIN: How to become Ordinary
summary: Kobato, who once had a bitter experience through deduction activities known as "wisdom work," was determined to become an honest and humble citizen. He secretly formed a reciprocal relationship with his classmate, Osanai, who shared the same aspiration, planning to make their high school debut as ordinary citizens and lead peaceful days. However, for some reason, mysterious incidents and misfortunes keep coming one after another into their school lives. Will Kobato and Osanai be able to achieve peaceful days as ordinary citizens?

title: Elf-san wa Yaserarenai
summary: Naoe-kun, a massage therapist, is about to head home for the day when he's saddled with a rather strange patient. This lovely lady has emerald eyes, pointy ears, and grew up in the forest—everything about her screams "elf," except for one thing: her bodacious body. It turns out she left her world but loves junk food in this one, and now her obsession has caught up with her. Can Naoe-kun help this loveable elf girl lose the weight—and keep it off?

title: Profe Infiltrado
summary: The "sports teacher" Julián seeks to obtain as much evidence as possible to arrest the father of a student, who is a criminal. However, the story will take an important turn when Julián falls in love with Miss Sofia.

title: The Magical Girl and the Evil Lieutenant Used to Be Archenemies
summary: The story centers on Mira, the clever brains behind an evil organization that invades and destroys everything in its path. One day, a magical girl named Byakuya Mimori decides to stand up to the organization, and Mira falls in love with her at first sight.

title: Catch 21
summary: Catch 21 hosted by Alfonso Ribeiro and Witney Carson. You might recognize the duo from Dancing with the Stars. Catch 21 is a Vegas style Game Show where three contestants are each given a card to start a blackjack hand from a standard 52-card deck and must answer trivia questions. Can they catch three blackjack 21s?

title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines!
summary: Meet the girls on the losing side of romance! First is Anna Yanami, the girl-next-door type who can't say no to delicious food. Then there's Lemon Yakishio, a beautiful and spirited athlete. Last but not least is Chika Komari, the cute yet shy heroine with gentle charm. Together, they navigate awkward setbacks hoping to finally find love!

title: Delico's Nursery
summary: Hailing from a prestigious noble house, Dali Delico is an elite member of the Blood Pact Council, the highest governing body of the Vamps. Yet, Dali flatly refuses a mission the Vamps assign him. As Dali's motives and possible connection to mysterious murders begin to mount, council members Gerhard, Dino, and Henrique visit him in hopes he'll reconsider, but find him soothing an infant child!

title: VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral after Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream
summary: Yuki Tanaka is a VTuber at Live-On, one of Japan's largest VTuber companies, as the polite and ladylike Awayuki Kokorone. One day, she forgets to end the stream, and viewers see her real personality—irreverent, improper, and prone to imbibing after a long day. Yuki is surprised to find that her accident caused her rankings to multiply, so she doubles down and gets to work. She'll be a star yet!

lead_actors: Ana Petta, Caco Ciocler, Vinícius de Oliveira, Bianca Müller
title: Unidade Básica
summary: Inspired by real cases, the series takes place in a Basic Health Unit, and brings stories of overcoming and challenges faced by two physicians who have different views on the performance in the UBS.

lead_actors: Ma Ka Pa Anand, Devadarshini, Gopinath Chandran, Aranthangi Nisha, Archana Chandhoke
title: Mr & Mrs Chinnathirai
summary: Your favourite celebrity couples put their relationship to test through a series of fun, challenging and hilarious tasks! Whom will you root for this season?...

title: Outrageous Homes
summary: From the unusual and unconventional to the eccentric and eclectic, Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen visits some of the UK's most outrageous homes and celebrates their proud-to-be-different owners and designers

lead_actors: Christendeo Szabo, Saige McMillan, Naomi Tan, Jazlyn Onaba, Sebastian Billingsley-Rodriguez
creators: Artur Spigel, Alexandra Schwartz, Hannah Kole
title: Wonderoos
summary: Join animal pals Kiki, Dewey, Hazzy, Luly and Teshi as they learn how to make friends, try new foods and face other big firsts in colorful Roo City!

lead_actors: Maggie Civantos, Ilker Kaleli, Ainhoa Santamaría, Fernando Andina, Laura Pamplona
title: La pasión turca
summary: Olivia, a Spanish Fine Arts professor with a brilliant professional career, wakes up from a coma in an Istanbul hospital after having attempted suicide. There she answers the questions of an inspector who investigates Olivia's collaboration in an art smuggling network with Yaman, her Turkish lover.The protagonist's story reconstructs in two stages the overwhelming passion that she experienced with Yaman and that made him abandon her life project in Spain. A story full of lights and shadows about which Olivia does not always tell the truth, which fuels the mystery that surrounds her stay in Turkey and her participation in the man's dangerous businesses.To escape from jail and gain protection from the authorities, Olivia must return to Yaman and inform the police of her movements. An act as brave as it is desperate: is Olivia acting to save herself or to save Yamam and her love story?

title: Òlòtūré: The Journey
summary: Working undercover as a sex worker in Nigeria, a young journalist out to expose corruption fights for her life as she forges a path to Europe.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Her Disguise
summary: A promising female doctor embarks on a journey of vengeance for her sister, infiltrating a wealthy family to confront the Lu brothers and risking her own future. Living a double life, she uses herself as bait and her heart as a pawn. A tale of strategic love between a cunning female doctor and a scheming young master is about to unfold.

title: Getting Lost with Erin French
summary: Chef Erin French heads out on a cross-country road trip to find new ingredients and inspiration for another season of cooking at The Lost Kitchen.

title: Resurrected Rides
summary: A charming host works with skilled car experts to transform beat-up vehicles into outlandish rides that exceed their unsuspecting owners' wildest dreams.

title: Badanamu Cadets
summary: Follow Bada and his fellow cadets as they battle against the forces of darkness and keep the world of Badanamu safe. New antagonists devoted to mischief and destruction emerge from the dark forests beyond Wonderwood, and it will take all the cadets' bravery and careful thinking to stop them.

title: Три богатыря. Ни дня без подвига
summary: The heroes will accomplish many feats: they will revive the unfortunate Koshchey, find the missing crown of the Prince, deal with the cruel khan - they can do everything. They can even cope with evil spirits. The horse Julius, the Serpent Gorynych and many others are always ready to come to the aid of the three heroes.

title: Judged by Matt Walsh
summary: All rise for the Honorable Judge Walsh, court is now in session. Watch Matt Walsh bring his iconic deadpan delivery of common sense solutions to real life litigants with actual petty grievances. Find humor in the judiciary process in this fresh take on the reality courtroom genre.

lead_actors: Chris Rock, Terry Crews, Tichina Arnold, Tim Johnson Jr., Ozioma Akagha
title: Everybody Still Hates Chris
summary: Everybody Still Hates Chris will feature Chris Rock as "Adult Chris," narrating stories inspired by his experience growing up as a skinny nerd in a large working-class family in Bed-Stuy, Brooklyn, during the late 1980s.

title: Kerma
summary: Kerma tells the story of Riku – a young man who seeks revenge by infiltrating a group of the young finnish- elite. He plans to steal from the upper- echelons of society and settle his debt with the local drug-lord. However, to Riku's surprise he finds himself feeling a genuine connection with the rich heiress, Linda and soon he falls hard in love with her despite everything. This leaves Riku at a crossroads; his double life has left him feeling torn between the loyalty for his depressed brother and the newfound love he feels for Linda. But what happens when the mask is ripped off, when the truth is exposed and the lies brought to light?Are you ready for a series that will keep you on the edge of your seat? Kerma is a suspense-driven series set in a jet-set environment, exploring themes as pride, love and loyalty. Through the eyes of the main character, Riku, we see how people can hide their dark sides behind a false facade, and the brutal contrast between the privileged and the poor. So, if you are looking for a thrilling series, do not miss out on DECEPTION.

title: Narenare -Cheer for You!-
summary: Six high school girls with diverse hobbies, skills, and personalities. Each carrying their own worries, they run, shout, collide, daydream... When the pure desire to support aligns, their cheers resonate in the hearts of those involved. The support of these six high school girls from Gunma might just change the world a little bit?

lead_actors: Jo Yoon Soo, Cha Seung Won, Kim Seon Ho, Kim Kang U
title: The Tyrant
summary: A secret project in Korea is exposed to the U.S. The U.S. demands the termination of the project, but a delivery accident occurs during the NIS's attempt to hand over the sample. Paul, a U.S. Agent, harshly pressures the NIS after the incident and confronts the leader of the project, Director Choe. Meanwhile, Jagyeong, a key character in this case, and Lim Sang, a retired veteran, begin chasing Director Choe's subordinate, Moyong, for different reasons. Everyone gathers in the end, and an unexpected turn of events takes place as ownership of the last sample is at stake.

title: Outrageous Love with NeNe Leakes
summary: Outrageous Love with NeNe Leakes captures the trials, triumphs, and tribulations of real couples. The new series showcases wild clips of real people caught up in love as NeNe reacts and gives her personal insight alongside the action.

title: Maine Cabin Masters: Building Italy
summary: The Maine Cabin Masters have set out to test their skills in a whole new country -- Italy! Chase, Sarah and the kids head to a remote village to renovate their own dream home and along the way, they get a little help from their friends!

lead_actors: Angelique Boyer, Sebastian Rulli, Arap Bethke, Cassandra Sánchez Navarro, Lore Graniewicz
title: El extraño retorno de Diana Salazar
summary: With a plot elaborated over time, this story about the forbidden love of Leonor and Eduardo in the 17th century had a tragic ending as she was sentenced to death for witchcraft. However, the mysterious fate brought them together several centuries later as Diana and Mario. This time, she is a doctor and he is a renowned scientist. Will they succumb to an inexplicable attraction and open their arms to eternal love 400 years later?

title: Dropout Presents
summary: A new series of live recorded comedy specials, including stand-up, improv, and solo performances!

title: Pulling with My Parents
summary: Pulling with My Parents follows young singletons from across the country who are stuck in a merry-go-round of bad dates and dating apps. Jaded with swiping left or right, ghosting and disastrous dates, these singletons are taking drastic action and handing over the reins to their parents to give their dating profiles a full make-over to crack the cupid conundrum.

title: Cris Miró (Ella)
summary: The story of Cris Miró, the first successful Argentine trans star, an icon of the 90s and a revolutionary whose legacy still lives on.

title: How Dare You!?
summary: Yu Wanyin transmigrated into a novel about palace fighting. The female protagonist of the novel was also transmigrated into the novel. In order to reverse her fate as a villain, Yu Wanyin chose to join forces with a tyrant. Unexpectedly, the tyrant was also a transmigrant into the novel. Yu Wanyin hopes that the three modern people can put aside their palace fights and sit together to fight landlords and eat hot pot. However, the female protagonist believes that she is the chosen one, and still chooses to stand against the male protagonist Duan Wang's team. Yu Wanyin has to carry out a series of actions in order to survive and help Daxia avoid the drought crisis...

lead_actors: Yuuya Hozumi, Azumi Waki, Kana Hanazawa, Mayu Sagara, Yoshino Aoyama
title: A Nobody's Way Up to an Exploration Hero
summary: Kaito is a high school student working as an ordinary explorer in the dungeons of Japan. He earns a modest living hunting slimes despite his low stats. During a typical trek underground, he finds a golden slime he's never seen before. It drops a rare servant card that summons a legendary creature: a powerful valkyrie of otherworldly beauty!

lead_actors: Mateusz Damięcki, Piotr Adamczyk, Magdalena Wieczorek, Mateusz Więcławek, Mateusz Kmiecik
title: Prosta sprawa
summary: The heroes fight in the seemingly idyllic setting of the Karkonosze Mountains, against which the international drug trade takes place. Who will support the nameless avenger and who will stand behind the demonic boss of the local mafia? It's only a seemingly simple matter.

lead_actors: Светлана Иванова, Семён Серзин, Мариана Ангилери, Нил Бугаев, Борис Каморзин
title: Эль Русо
Docent
summary: Associate Professor Stehlík transfers from the police academy to the homicide department due to a near-administrative error. He joins the team right after the detectives begin investigating the brutal murder of a young woman in a forest near Prague.

title: Vanina - Un vicequestore a Catania
summary: The deputy commissioner Vanina Guarrasi, after a brilliant career in the anti-mafia, left Palermo in an attempt to escape the past and the bond with the two men she loved most: her policeman father and her ex-boyfriend Paolo Malfitano, a magistrate operating in the anti-mafia. The crazy fear of reliving certain traumas has taken over: and so here is Vanina in Catania, in the new role in the Homicide Section, supported by the esteem of a new team of policemen. And by the affection of her friends.

title: Astro-Mano
summary: Pedro and Astro-Mano are separated by a galaxy. Pedro leads a monotonous and meaningless life and Astro-Mano lives on a planet where his value is not recognized. Pedro is fired from his job and Astro Mano, by accident, crashes to Earth. Their meeting gives rise to an unlikely friendship that will change both their lives. Astro-Mano wants to help Pedro find meaning in his life and Pedro wants to help him return home, but there is someone who will do everything to prevent this from happening. And only the two of them, together, can defeat him. A journey sharing two worlds where the adventures that await them will make them discover their own value. Life is a journey, join us.

lead_actors: Shin Ha Kyun, Lee Jung Ha, Jin Goo, Jo Ah Ram, Jung Moon Sung
title: The Auditors
summary: At JU Construction Company, notorious for countless corruption cases, the audit team is busy at work. The team comprises a polar opposite duo: a cold team leader and a generous Gen Z employee. Together, they navigate through turbulent teamwork at first. Yet, as they collectively tackle diverse cases, they harmonize into an unstoppable investigative pair.

lead_actors: Виктория Исакова, Вячеслав Копейкин, Макар Хлебников, Хетаг Хинчагов
title: Дети перемен
summary: Keeping a Family Together When the Country Is Falling Apart. A Crime Saga at the Turn of the Epochs

title: East Harbour Heroes
summary: East Harbour Heroes is a saltwater-soaked journey to St. John's, N.L., where a vibrant community of tough individuals battle the rugged coast and the North Atlantic Ocean to live and work on the edge of the world. From brutal storms, high winds, and changing fish populations, each day brings a new challenge to commercial fishers, stevedores, crane operators, welders, and tugboat operators, and these warriors are determined to thrive – no matter what Mother Nature throws at them.

lead_actors: Jang Na Ra, Nam Ji Hyeon, Kim Joon Han, Pyo Ji Hoon
title: Good Partner
summary: Facing her own divorce, seasoned divorce lawyer Cha Eun Kyung has grown jaded with the concept of Justice, instead opting for the path with the most monetary gain. This changes after she begins working with passionate rookie lawyer Han Yoo Ri, who believes in helping people regardless of the money.

lead_actors: Robert Glenister, Sean Pertwee, Suzanne Packer, Stephen Walters
title: The Night Caller
summary: Tony, in his 50s, drives a black cab, doing the night shift in the city. He used to be a popular and respected teacher but after losing his job, his confidence plummeted, his marriage collapsed, and he's become increasingly isolated. Now his only lifelines are cafe-worker Rosa, whom he forms a growing attachment to, and a radio DJ called Lawrence whom he spends his nights listening to.One night Tony plucks up the courage and rings NightTalk to speak to Lawrence, and soon becomes a ‘friend of the show'. For the first time in years, he feels listened to. But as time passes, his developing bond with the late-night DJ begins to turn into an unhealthy obsession as he starts interpreting Lawrence's ‘world view' in dangerous ways that have devastating impacts on Tony's life.One night, by chance, Lawrence gets into Tony's cab. The initial excitement at meeting takes a turn when Tony realises this DJ isn't the man he purports to be. Lawrence is a fake and Tony feels betrayed.The Night Caller is a claustrophobic tale about the power of influence those with the loudest voice have over the most vulnerable people.

title: Hasta el Fin del Mundo Te Amare
summary: Sofia lives a life of success. She falls in love with her personal driver Salvador and they struggle to keep their relationship together.

title: Graverne
summary: How much will you sacrifice for the truth? And must the truth emerge at all costs? New journalistic crime series with Mille Dinesen in the lead role focuses on investigative journalism and what the investigative journalists have to go through as democracy's watchdogs.

title: Дино
summary: In the 90s, Dino worked for tough gangster Montana and was Moscow's most ruthless debt collector. Now he lives as a hermit in the province. But events unfold in such a way that Dino returns to the capital and starts his old job in order to pay off his debt from the past, which has tormented him all these years and return the woman of his dreams. During Dino's adventures, he will have to face both modern realities and the relict 90s, which have adapted somewhere, withered somewhere, but still deeply rooted in our reality. And Dino, as a guide between two worlds, will once again have to undergo a test of his life principles.

title: Chastity High
summary: When an ultra-elite high school enforces a strict "No Romance" rule that expels anyone caught dating, a student secretly helps her classmates for cash.

lead_actors: Samuel Le Bihan, Barbara Schulz, Jisca Kalvanda, Maya Rose
title: Carpe Diem
summary: At 48, Tom Villeneuve is finally free. Wrongly accused of murdering his wife, Tom has just spent 17 years in prison. Combative, he studies law in prison and when he is released, he becomes a lawyer. Back in his hometown, Nice, he is determined to find out who the real murderer is. He opens his own practice as a "young" lawyer and defends those he believes to be unjustly accused of crime, like him.

lead_actors: Piotr Witkowski, Konrad Eleryk, Marcin Kowalczyk, Aleksandra Adamska, Anastasiia Pustovit
title: Idź Przodem, Bracie
summary: After inheriting a hefty debt, an ex-special ops officer — now guarding a shopping mall — spots an opportunity to solve his financial predicament.

title: Watashi no kiraina tantei
summary: Akemi Ninomiya is a hardcore mystery fan. Although she is only a college student, she is wealthy and owns a building. Private Detective Morio Ukai prefers tracking down lost pets for wealthy clients rather than murder cases which brings in little money. The duo join forces to solve various suspicious cases.

title: Night Therapy
summary: Arab psychologist, Louie Mansur, is left to raise his two children on his own following the crushing suicide of his wife, who long-suffered a battle with depression. Louie's 13-year-old son, Amir, begins to fail his studies and is on the cusp of dropping out, whilst Louie's daughter, Nur, suffers from agonizing abandonment issues and refuses to leave Louie's side. Louie is left with no time to mourn, as his fatherly duties become all consuming.In an unconventional turn of events, after yet another sleepless night, Louie decides to transfer his clinic hours to the wee hours of the night, accepting patients from dusk till dawn. An eclectic mix of Tel Aviv's nocturnal creatures attends his clinic, along with their compelling stories throughout the series.

title: The Chairman of Class 9
summary: A delinquent 2nd-year student becomes the chairman of the board of a prestigious high school left behind by his father. Na Yi Soo may have grown up in an environment that others would envy, but he harbors hatred for his father and heads to Balhae High School, which his father cherished, in order to seek revenge. The process of change between Yi Soo, who has lived a rougher life than anyone else, and the nation's most elite students who have lived upright lives, as they get to know each other, and the love that blooms in the process, will be dynamically unfolded.

lead_actors: Stephen Mangan, Alan Carr, Daisy May Cooper
title: Password
summary: A hilarious word association game hosted by the multi-talented Stephen Mangan. Featuring Alan Carr and Daisy May Cooper as resident Team Captains, each episode sees Alan and Daisy pair up with contestants to give one-word clues that aim to help their teammate guess a mystery ‘password'.The teams must try to get on each other's wavelengths as they take it in turns to guess the all-important password across multiple rounds - hilarious clues and even funnier guesses are all that stand in the way of lucky contestants being in with a chance to win a big cash prize.

title: You Are Ms. Servant
summary: This is the story of a maid who is all alone in the world, but who finally finds a family. Told from young that her only worth is as a killer, Yuki had known nothing else except cold efficiency and following orders. Now that she has a chance to leave her past behind, she arrives at the doorstep of Hitoyoshi Yokoya, asking to be employed… as a maid?! Thus begins the journey of a former assassin learning what it means to be ‘normal'!

lead_actors: Jun Jung Kook, Park Ji Min
title: Are You Sure?
summary: Follow the unpredictable and exciting journey of BTS's Jimin and Jung Kook!

title: Een moord kost meer levens
summary: When his father is arrested for murdering two children, Paul Spruit is still an adolescent. From that moment on, normal life is no longer possible for the Spruit family. Then they have to deal with the violent ex-husband of Paul's mother. Because reports do nothing, Paul takes the law into his own hands: in a blind rage he stabs his stepfather to death.

lead_actors: Yasser Galal, Nour, Yasmin Raeis, Wafaa Amer, Ahmed Beder
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Gawdar
summary: A merchant has three children; Salem, Salim, and Gawdar. However, the life of the last son, Gawdar, becomes complicated, and he comes into conflict with the enemy Shimoun to reach the four treasures of the wiseman Shamardal.

title: The Secret of Us
summary: Doctor Lada, whose alias is angel doctor, was left with a scar on her heart by old love, causing her to be unable to open up for someone anymore. She must reunite with Earn, that ex-girlfrend who hurt her heart the worst, when she becomes a new presenter for the hospital where she works.

lead_actors: Dai Gao Zheng, Tu Zhi Ying
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Lost You, Found You
summary: Yun Feifei, a detective from Liushanmen, and Gu Linyuan, a high-ranking member of the Qiankun Gang, are sworn enemies. However, after uncovering each other's true identities, they realize they are long-lost lovers with deep emotional ties. As they rekindle their romance, the mysteries of the past gradually unravel.

lead_actors: Варвара Володина, Кузьма Котрелёв, Виталий Андреев, Регина Тодоренко, Кирилл Кяро
title: Ненормальная
summary: Because of her bandaged face, she is called Mummy in the children's ward. In two months, disfigured Anya had to seriously grow up. Before the accident, she was a beautiful, confident schoolgirl. Afterwards - a closed, cynical creature, ready to attack even those who are trying to help her. Every day Anya looks for new reasons to live on and new tricks to stay in the hospital. After all, she recently had a goal - to kill the culprit who was lying in a coma in the very accident in which her parents died. To carry out her plan, Anya gathers a team of loser patients, but in the process of preparation she realizes that revenge is not a cure.

title: True Beauty
summary: Tired of being looked down upon for her unattractive appearance, middle schooler Lim Jugyeong turns to the transformative powers of makeup. First, she experiments with BB cream, lip tint, and eyeliner; then she begins using mascara, double eyelid glue, and colored contacts. Before she knows it, Jugyeong goes from being a girl who is bullied for her ugliness to being praised as a high-class beauty. Constantly surrounded by those who adore her goddess-like appearance, Jugyeong can now live a more than comfortable life at school—she simply has to keep her bare face a secret.However, everything changes when the new transfer student, Lee Suho, enters her life. Not only does the handsome Suho become immediately popular among their peers, but in a chance encounter, he also becomes the only classmate of Jugyeong's to see her face beneath the makeup. With her reputation on the line, Jugyeong must do whatever it takes to hide the truth about her appearance from the rest of her classmates. But the more time she spends with Suho, the more Jugyeong finds herself questioning whether one's true beauty lies solely in their looks.

title: Bodies in the Water
summary: When a missing high school student is found shackled in chains off the shore of Cape May, investigators are baffled by what kind of monster could commit such a heinous murder. Their investigation leads them to uncover jealous boyfriends and turmoil within the victim's foster family that sends shockwaves throughout the tightknit community.

lead_actors: Natasha Rothwell, Jocko Sims, Conrad Ricamora, KeiLyn Durrel Jones
title: How to Die Alone
summary: How to Die Alone follows Melissa, a fat, Black neurotic who's never been in love. After a comical brush with death, she refuses to settle for anything less than the life she wants, catapulting her on a journey to becoming "100% that bitch" in real life by any means necessary.

title: Shang suo de fang jian
summary: Mu Xia is a talented locksmith. While dealing with a strange murder case within a locked room, Qin Zuo Man inadvertently discovers that Mu Xia is the new security consultant hired by the police academy. As more locked room cases arise, the simple-minded Qin Zuo Man, the monotonous Mu Xia and celebrity cop Tan You join hands to form an investigative team that seeks to uncover the truth through every door.

title: Toda Família Tem
summary: Pê was living his best years but gets frustrated when his family decides to move to his grandmother's house in Rio de Janeiro, his hometown. He's forced to give up his comfort to live in a house full of relatives while trying to find his place in the world. Let's follow Pê's journey to find out that it's impossible to escape the comical demands of the family.

title: Kake kara Hajimaru Sayonara no Koi
Ano Ko no Kodomo
summary: Sachi and her boyfriend Takara are your average high school couple. They go to school together, hang out, and even engage in the more intimate side of dating. However, as time passes, Sachi starts to get the feeling that something isn't right and decides to buy a pregnancy test. Later, in the bathroom of a family restaurant far from her home, she sees the two red lines that will change both her and Takara's life forever.

title: Только не отпускай меня
summary: Natasha Konopliova works as nurse at a hospital. She lives together with her mother, modestly but with dignity. Meanwhile, in another part of the city lives Lera Kuzina, the daughter of wealthy parents. One day, when a delirious and desperate Lera is about to jump from her balcony, Natasha saves her life. Fate has thrown our two heroines together, giving them an opportunity to help each other.

title: The Influencer
summary: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram — 77 elite influencers flaunt their skills to strategically draw the most attention in this high-stakes social survival show.

title: Music Mayhem
summary: The most unsettling scandals, secrets and shocking moments in Rock N Roll! These dynamic and dramatic true stories will be re-examined, proving there's always more to uncover.

title: Tribhuvan Mishra CA Topper
summary: A banking crisis forces CA topper Tribhuvan Mishra to take up sex work. Will this dual existence alleviate his troubles — or create entirely new ones?

lead_actors: Emily Cox, Jens Albinus, Paula Kober
title: 37 Sekunden
summary: The young lawyer Clara Andersen goes beyond all moral limits to have her father, the famous singer Carsten Andersen, declared innocent of raping her best friend Leonie Novak. The situation of the night of the crime seems to be ambiguous, because on the one hand Leonie and Carsten actually had a passionate love affair, but on the other hand the decisive word was "no".

lead_actors: Juliana Paes, Osmar Prado, Antônio Fagundes, Rodrigo Lombardi, Bruna Linzmeyer
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
title: Meu Pedacinho de Chão
summary: The colourful village of Santa Fé often has its peace shaken by the conflicts between Colonel Epa and Pedro Falcão, an honest man involved in city politics.

lead_actors: Griffin Cork, Jordan Wright, Emma Houghton
title: Abracadavers
summary: After the death of his Mom, Chris developed an unhealthy obsession with the hair salon chair that killed her. In order to help him through the grieving process, his best friend Gabriel kidnaps Chris in hopes that a road trip with those closest to him (including the chair) will help him move on. Things get weird when they discover that the salon chair gives those close to it superhuman powers. They then find themselves at a camp for super-powered youth, where they learn how to control their powers.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: The Silicon Waves
summary: The show tells that since the beginning of the 21st century, under the inspiration of the "Notice of the State Council on Printing and Distributing Several Policies for Encouraging the Development of the Software Industry and Integrated Circuit Industry", a group of ideal and technically minded people The story of overseas students returning from the waves and joining the Chinese chip industry.

title: Made in Korea: The K-Pop Experience
summary: Made in Korea: The K-Pop Experience is a music experiment like no other. The series follows five boys from across the UK as they are put through the K-pop training process with the goal of launching a new boy band on the global stage.Cameras go behind closed doors at SM Entertainment for the first time to witness the band working with the world's greatest choreographers, singing songs from the best songwriters, and being tutored by some of the most revered experts in the K-pop business.

title: Meet the Rees-Moggs
summary: Unprecedented access to the notorious Sir Jacob Rees-Mogg, and his extraordinary family as he fights for his political life and fails to keep his seat. Can the Rees-Moggs cope with life in the political wilderness?

title: American MC
summary: Follows a group of 17 motorcycle enthusiasts from across the Southwest, who come together in hopes of forming a real Motorcycle Club

title: Rintje
summary: Rusty is a puppy dog who discovers the world the same way a child does, which makes him recognizable, sweet and touching. Rusty has a good feeling for adventure and he can be quite naughty at times. He goes to school for the first time, celebrates his birthday, has a loose tooth, stays over at granny's and gets his first injection.

At the end of the 72 hours they had together, the women and their partners need to decide whether they would like to stay together for another 72 hours or would rather break up. Using cameras that network the compound, experts will watch the events and monitor the women, they chose the men for each woman, and they will support them during the process and advise them when needed, giving them the emotional tools to avoid relationships mistakes that they might have done in the past. The two polar opposites form a secret buddy team, solving problems in thrilling ways. Eventually, they will face off against a great evil…

title: Dance Moms: A New Era
summary: Dance Moms: A New Era is a reboot of the ever so popular Dance Moms. This time, with a new coach, new dancers and new mama drama. Introducing beloved dance coach, Glo Hampton, who wants to take her students and prestigious dance school Studio Bleu to the next level - competing nationally every week. But the road to glory won't be an easy one. Coach Glo must juggle her tiny but mighty dancers, their scheming moms, and ensuing meltdowns, all while ruling with a tender but tough iron fist. Will Glo and her dance team persevere amidst the dramatics?

title: Finding Love in Quarantine
summary: Amid a crisis that has forced everyone into quarantine, Rick Baldwin is seeking sanity – and maybe even…. love?

title: Going Home
summary: It's a race against time as a dedicated Hospice nurse with her own complicated past, leads her new clients and their loved ones to wrap up loose ends with compassion and dignity before they go "home".

title: Saved By Grace
summary: Angels are amongst us and God has sent them on a mission to intercede on behalf of whispered prayers. Every encounter presents a new opportunity to change your approach to life.

lead_actors: Денис Никифоров, Татьяна Арнтгольц, Пётр Баранчеев, Нелли Уварова, Юрий Батурин
title: Ангел мести
summary: Many years later, he returns to his hometown - the city of his losses - under a false name. Andrey built a tough plan for revenge on everyone responsible for the ruin of his fate. Former friends do not suspect that soon their prosperous, carefree life will come to an end and they will have to pay bills.

title: Shitsuren Hoken
summary: Ayumu Kazuki works as an assistant professor in the zoo ecology department for a university. He also has a secret side job. Ayumu works at night as an insurance investigator for a broken-heart insurance company. The company, run by effeminate Shinto priest Eitarou Tokura, charges approved customers 100 million yen to insure their love life after confessing their love to an appointed person (receiving ten times that amount in case they suffer heartbreak). Ayumu must use various psychological dating techniques to uncover customer's feelings.

lead_actors: Ryo Narita, Ai Yoshikawa, Riku Hagiwara, Meisa Kuroki, Fumiyo Kohinata
title: Furitsumore Kodokuna Shi yo
summary: The skeletal remains of 13 children were found in what is known as the "Haikawa Residence Incident." A mysterious mark left at the scene reappears seven years later, a mysterious communal life, a suspect known as "Father", six survivors of the incident, and layers of hidden truths. The unfolding mysteries lead to an unpredictable ending, the beginning of a human suspense story. Adapted from the manga series "Furitsumore Kodokuna Shi yo" (降り積もれ孤独な死よ) written by Inoryuu Hajime (井龍一) and illustrated by Itou Shouta (伊藤翔太).

title: Access All Areas
summary: Adventurer Francesca Chiorando travels around the world to places like Iceland and Morocco, and discovers some of the world's most challenging and terrifying places. She uncovers fascinating stories, meets remarkable people, and investigates long-standing mysteries: human and natural events that have puzzled communities for generations.

title: Wojenne dziewczyny
summary: The series tells the story of the difficult years of the Nazi occupation, seen from the perspective of three young Polish women. Marysia, Ewka and Irka are very young girls who, on the threshold of their adult lives, were dealt a war by fate – one of the most terrible wars that have befallen their country. They are not yet mothers, nor are they wives. Prepared for the first twenty years of childhood and youth to live according to the standards of their environment, they suddenly found themselves defenseless against the powerful forces of evil and darkness. And they decided to take up the fight against them. And for this fight to be effective, they must change and adapt to new conditions. Each of the heroines must face their own fears and the brutal reality of the occupation. Their stories are not only a fight for survival, but also a story of courage, sacrifice and solidarity.

lead_actors: Jun Jong Seo, Kim Moo Yul, Ji Chang Wook, Jung Yoo Mi, Lee Soo Hyuk
title: Queen Woo
summary: Upon the announcement of the king's death in Goguryeo, a fierce battle ensues among tribes. Queen Woo, who immediately becomes the target of princes and five tribes vying for the throne, struggles to crown a new king within 24 hours. Will Queen Woo be able to transcend the constraints of gender and era to carve out her own destiny?

title: Love Is Blind: México
summary: Magical proposals. A idyllic retreat. A hefty dose of reality. The Emmy-nominated experiment arrives in Mexico to test if love truly is blind.

title: Pokémon: Trainer Tour
summary: The Trainer Tour team, Meghan Camarena, Andrew Mahone and their friend Pikachu, are hitting the road to help Trainers overcome personal challenges and evolve their Pokémon Trading Card Game skills. It's time to level up!

title: Dumas
summary: Nearly 30 years ago, Jean Dumas started his small business: Intelco. Over the years, minor investigations gave way to much more complex cases: intellectual property theft, industrial espionage, embezzlement, and money laundering. To carry out these missions, Dumas assembled a team of seasoned investigators from law enforcement. They accept mandates clearly defined by rigorous contracts, in accordance with the law. The family business has thus become one of the largest investigative firms in the country.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Their Wonderful Time
summary: When female game designer Song Lingling was accidentally possessed by the NPC she designed, she was forced to embark on a hilarious cohabitation life with "the client," Xiao Ran. As they worked together to fix the game's bugs, they also strove to fix their own "personal bugs." From being quarrelsome partners to genuinely appreciating each other, along with friends like Zhang Yunfei, they embarked on various adventures between the virtual and real worlds, developing a cross-dimensional romance! In the end, they all harvested valuable friendships and love.

title: Dating Naked UK
summary: In this ultimate dating experiment, the singles will be put to the test as the arrival of naked newbies will shift dynamics and relationship connections already formed. There will also be an array of sexy, hilarious and dramatic dates firing up the passion, and an epic ditching at the Dumping Ground in every episode as Rylan says Laters to the Daters. For those who make it to the end of the experience, there will be a big cash prize up for grabs. With emotions laid bare and romances unbuttoned, will any of them succeed in their quest to find love?

title: Zhan Shen: Fanchen Shenyu
summary: The story follows Lin Qiye, a young man who navigates a society seemingly protected by gods, only to discover that ancient deities and monsters actually pose an active threat to humanity. To protect his city, he joins the "Night Watchmen"—an elite, secret organization of superpowered individuals who battle mythological threats. [1, 2, 3]

title: The Getaway
summary: On a drive across the American West, six creators must weed out the "snitch" sabotaging their $10,000 prize. The twist? They're all the snitch

title: Maruhi no Mitsuko-san
summary: Motomiya Mitsuko is a mysterious total coordinator. To get what her client wants, she changes their visuals from head to toe and also their mentality through coaching. Using any means necessary, she always makes her client successful. Her next client is Imai Natsu, who is a single mother with a string of bad luck. Imai Natsu's aim is to become the president of a large company that is run by a family. Meanwhile, Motomiya Mitsuko has a secret.

title: Normali
summary: Noam is a 24-year-old columnist struggling to establish himself as a writer, and not lose his mind in the process. A challenging task since his father is famous not only for his great talent as a writer, but also for his outrageous borderline personality. When Noam hits rock bottom fueled by a deadly combination of drugs, he finds his own route to normality in the unlikeliest of places: the psych ward.

title: La Voz Ausente
summary: When his older brother is found dead, apparently by suicide, the renowned psychoanalyst Pablo Rouviot is the only one convinced that it is a murder. With the assistance of Officer Cecilia Bermúdez as his sole ally, Pablo takes on the investigation, uncovering a much larger scheme with a serial killer at its core.

title: Per Elisa - Il caso Claps
summary: Elisa leaves to go to mass on a sunny Sunday in September 1993. From that day she disappears until her body is found, 17 years later, in the attic of a church.

lead_actors: Timothée Bardeau, Hannah Vaubien, Kaycie Chase
title: Billy, le Hamster Cowboy
summary: Growing up in the Wild West and raised on the exciting stories told by his father, Billy with his cowboy outfit has a burning desire to hit the trail! And since every new day presents him with an opportunity to go on an adventure worthy of the greatest cowboys, he is determined not to miss out… He takes with him his faithful friend Jean-Claude the worm, and his accomplice Suzie, the stone marten, and off they go!

title: I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History
summary: Alicia is the eldest daughter of the noble Williams family—a bloodline that excels in dark magic. Her jet-black hair and golden eyes command a powerful presence, but her most unique features are, without a doubt, her sharp tongue and malevolent nature. By all means, she is a villainess, but also a fictional character from an otome game! As an ardent admirer of Alicia, a young, unnamed woman wishes to be her. Fortunately, a sleepy truck driver grants her wish in a bizarre twist of events—killing and consequently reincarnating her as a seven-year-old Alicia inside the game. With sufficient knowledge of how the game plays out, "Alicia" is confident that she will go down as the greatest villainess in history as long as she endeavors to work hard. However, she soon begins to realize that escaping Alicia's fate is not so simple as it seemed.

title: 60 Day Hustle
summary: In this high-stakes competition series, twelve determined entrepreneurs are thrust into the ultimate business accelerator challenge. We condense two years of business fundamentals into an intense 60-day showdown. These aspiring moguls will battle it out to demonstrate their knack for success and claim the cash prize that could transform their business dreams into reality.

lead_actors: Полина Айнутдинова, Сергей Фёдоров, Вероника Журавлева, Виктор Бычков, Людмила Артемьева
title: Любопытная Варвара
summary: The plot centers on a smart and well-read girl named Varvara, who comes to the village of Verkhovoye for summer holidays. There she meets a brave and slightly naive boy Vasya, who becomes her faithful companion in the investigation of mysterious incidents. First of all, the children will have to deal with a mysterious scarecrow that comes to life every night and scares the locals. But this is just the beginning of the exciting and fun adventures that await young detectives in a quiet village.

title: Karen Kingsbury's A Thousand Tomorrows
summary: From NYT best-selling author Karen Kingsbury, only God knows how many tomorrows we have left. In the dangerous and competitive rodeo world, how will Cody and Ali make the most of their time together?

title: Riley Rocket
summary: Crank up the volume with Megablast! These super sonic heroes save the day with the power of music.

lead_actors: Alexa PenaVega, Carlos PenaVega, Kara Wang, Dhruv Uday Singh, Abigail F. Cowen
title: The Power Couple
summary: Instead of fighting crime, superhero couple Gaby and Vince can't stop fighting each other. Before they can save the day, they must see if they can save their marriage in couples therapy.

lead_actors: Jonathan Langdon, Joshua Graham, Jonathan Sconza, Josette Jorge, Trevor White
title: Open Season: Call of Nature
summary: When Boog and Elliot discover an abandoned Summer Camp in the middle of nowhere, they embark on a brave new adventure of creating a safe and special place to live that welcomes animals of every kind.

title: Jo Brand's Big Splash
summary: Comedian Jo Brand combines stand-up comedy with various tasks involving water.

title: Lee Nelson's Well Funny People
summary: Lee Nelson's back with some old and new friends. Quality!

title: Campus Beats
summary: What starts as an agenda to get closure for her past , a GenZ girl uncovers her hidden dancing talent and in the process experiences the real meaning of friendship, love, freedom and justice in a modern dance academy divided sharply across socio-economic class.

lead_actors: Sandra Lee, Jason Biggs, Bill Yosses, Bryan Ford
title: Blue Ribbon Baking Championship
summary: Blue ribbon-winning bakers from state fairs across the US face off for the first time in an epic baking showdown to win top honors and $100,000.

lead_actors: Roy Wood Jr., Amber Ruffin, Michael Ian Black
title: Have I Got News for You
summary: Have I Got News for You is the comedy panel show which delivers comic observations from the satirical to the surreal through the lens of a news quiz show. An institution in Britain, this an award-winning comedy series is now invading America!
