Always relevant and topical, the series serves up a smart, silly, opinionated, and edgy take on the news of the week featuring a rotating collection of comedians, pundits, politicos, and entertainers. It features host Roy Wood Jr. along with two illustrious team captains Amber Ruffin and Michael Ian Black to guide the guests through an array of games and quick-witted panel conversations that test their knowledge of current events.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Next Time, Together Forever

lead_actors: Shin Hye Sun, Lee Jin Wook, Kang Hoon, Jo Hye Joo
title: Dear Hyeri
summary: Ju Eun-ho is an unknown announcer with 14 years of experience. She struggles to get the chance to have her name recognized by the public. She also has another personality, Ju Hae-ri, due to a deep wound in her heart. Her alter-ego, Ju Hae-ri, is super positive and works as a parking attendant. Jeong Hyun-oh is Ju Eun-ho's ex-boyfriend; they dated for a long time but broke up. He became a star announcer as soon as he joined the broadcasting station and is the most-liked announcer by the public, but Jeong Hyun-oh also carries a hidden wound in his mind that he has never shown to anyone. Somehow, Ju Eun-ho and Jeong Hyun-oh reunite and help cure each other's wounds.

title: Kindergarten: The Musical
summary: Kindergarten: The Musical is an animated musical series about navigating all of the "firsts" young kids experience while attending kindergarten. Whether having your own set of school supplies for the first time, finding a place to sit in the lunchroom or making a new friend, kindergartners can feel so many feelings that are sometimes hard to express with just words; singing about it feels more comforting and expressive. The series follows 5-year-old Berti Benavente, who, with the help of her amazing teacher and new friends, uses her imagination to express her fears, excitement and joy through big Broadway-style song and dance numbers, proving that kindergarten is just like a big stage and there is nothing a good song can't fix.

lead_actors: Kyla Harris, Darren Boyd, Elena Saurel, Edward Bluemel, Sally Phillips
title: We Might Regret This
summary: A fresh relationship, a family, an intense female friendship. Tetraplegic artist Freya asks her chaotic best friend Jo to be her carer in her new home: her partner Abe's house.

title: House of Ali
summary: Step inside the electric world of luxury home designer Ali Budd as she pulls back the curtain to reveal the décor and drama behind the million-dollar renovations that have put her on the map, from single-room edits to whole-home builds.

title: Iliza's Locals
summary: Iliza Shlesinger's Iliza's Locals is a three part comedy special featuring the best up-and-coming comics in Los Angeles.

title: Second-Hand Showdown with Vicky Pattison
summary: Vicky Pattison helps guests to find a bold new style using only pre-loved fashion. Two stylists pull together the looks, but only one wardrobe will win. Who'll triumph in the second-hand showdown?

title: Espías del Amor
summary: The TV show presents us stories of people looking for love on the Internet. Many of them have quite long relationships, but have never seen the other person in the flesh. The mission of the spies is to be able to bring couples together, but they could come across identities that are real, with others that are lies or people who have more than something to hide.

title: Nadie nos va a extrañar
summary: It's the '90s, and five losers run an illegal business at their high school. They sell homework and assignments to their classmates. The advantage is that no one ever suspects the nerds. Their business brings them money and popularity. But hormones and an unexpected death threaten to ruin everything. If the business collapses, their futures and their friendships are at risk.

lead_actors: Евгений Сыркин, Александра Никифорова, Евгений Антропов, Кристина Кучеренко, Кристина Шелобкова
title: Чистые руки
summary: Just yesterday they were students, the best of the best, the hope of Soviet physics. But today has come, and their talent is needed by Soviet intelligence. The year is 1980, the country is preparing to host the Olympic Games, and behind the facade of the big holiday is an escalating confrontation between the superpowers. And former friends, by the will of fate, find themselves on opposite sides of the barricades.

lead_actors: Jeremyah Mogni, Xaxier Malo, Vanessa Boudrias, Bruno Henry
title: Danse!
summary: Marco, a hip-hop dancer who makes a living by teaching dance classes at his father's school. When the school is at risk of closing, Marco's entire life is on the verge of collapsing. Participating in FLOW becomes a golden opportunity for him to save the school while also achieving his dream...

title: La collecte
summary: Before becoming a father, Kevin, a debt collector, decides to leave organised crime.

lead_actors: James Prygodzicz, Adam Llewellyn, Lizzie Luke, Thomas Rees, Mark John
title: The Golden Cobra
summary: Ebbw Vale's best Indian takeaway... is not this one. With business saag-ing, can owner Basil and new delivery driver Nick take on their fierce rivals?

lead_actors: Jason Manford, Matt Dawson, Phil Tufnell
title: A Question of Sport: Super Saturday
summary: Sports-themed family entertainment show hosted by comedian Jason Manford. Super Saturday is packed full of fun, surprises, stunts and must-see challenges.

title: Ana de Nadie
summary: Ana makes the decision to separate from her unfaithful husband and give herself the opportunity to live new experiences.

title: Country House Auction
summary: At Castle Durrow in the heart of Ireland, beautiful and extraordinary antique treasures are repaired, valued and bid for at this stunning country house auction.

creators: Curro Royo, Fran Carballal, Enrique Lojo
title: Una vida menos en Canarias
summary: Luis Lacasa, a prestigious homicide inspector in Madrid, is forced to accept a transfer to the Canary Islands and adapt to everything he hates: the heat, the sand and the tourists, but above all to Naira, a charismatic inspector, a lover of her land with whom, despite their differences and rivalries, he forms a good team and at the same time, a complicity that questions his ironclad beliefs.

title: Wan Jie Qi Yuan
summary: Lin Feng is an orphan who was adopted by Wu Village. One day he accidentally entered a forbidden land in the vicinity of Wu village where he found an ice coffin containing a beautiful woman. Ling Feng carelessly opened the ice coffin. The woman inside woke up and saw that Ling Feng was a special person of the demon race. She decided to help him, causing great physical changes in him. Since that day, many strange things began to happen in Wu village. With Ling Feng now having great power, how will he handle these situations?

title: Estate of Survival
summary: 8 Residents arrive for a competition at a luxury estate, only to find it completely empty. Greeted by Audra, their virtual host, they learn they must compete to earn essential appliances, furniture, and other necessities. After a challenging first day, tensions rise as several competitors form an alliance, leading to the strategic elimination of one Resident from the competition.

title: Zoofari
summary: Made up of hilarious live-action footage, Zoofari showcases the most adorable and incredible animals from around the world--from furry to feathered, scaly and more.

title: Penelope
summary: A restless teenager who questions her place in the world embarks on a soul-searching journey into the remote wilderness of the Pacific Northwest.

lead_actors: Sebastián Martínez, Ana Claudia Talancón, Alberto Guerra, Eréndira Ibarra, Erick Elias
title: Accidente
summary: When a birthday party takes a tragic turn, its ripples shatter a close-knit community — tearing families, friendships and hearts apart.

lead_actors: Demi Engemann, Jen Affleck, Miranda Hope, Whitney Levit, Taylor Frankie Paul
title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives
summary: The scandalous world of a group of Mormon mom influencers implodes when they get caught in the midst of a swinging sex scandal that makes international headlines. Now, their sisterhood is shook to its core. Faith, friendship and reputations are all on the line. Will #MomTok be able to survive and continue to give the rulebook a run for its money, or will this group fall from grace?

title: Envidiosa
summary: After a devastating breakup, Vicky, almost 40, embarks on a quest for new love, unaware it will lead her to a profound—and hilarious—self-discovery.

lead_actors: Рината Тимербаева, Николай Фоменко, Владислав Ценёв, Максим Лагашкин, Риналь Мухаметов
title: Красная Поляна
summary: Charming secular adventurer Sasha escapes from Moscow to Krasnaya Polyana, where she is attracted by the proximity of the sea and mountains, palm trees and snow, ambitious majors and reckless adventurers. In an attempt to settle in a new place and profit from relaxed vacationers, she immediately falls into the clutches of the head of the resort's security service, Mikhalych. To preserve her freedom, Sasha is forced to make friends with the hotel and casino staff and, becoming one of them, figure out the insidious blackmailers who force the manager to dance to their tune. She ran away from some problems in order to run into even bigger ones and eventually make the main choice of her life: freedom and financial independence or love and friends she never had.

title: The Wranglers
summary: The Wranglers follows the personal and professional lives of young staff members working at the Circle Bar Dude Ranch in Montana.

title: La Isla de las Tentaciones: Argentina & Chile
summary: Dive into the thrilling journey of La Isla de las Tentaciones: Argentina & Chile. Four couples embark on an island in the Gulf of Mexico to challenge the limits of their love. With Florencia Peña and Benjamín Vicuña as hosts, they'll confront doubts, jealousy, and infidelities. Can the couples flirt with temptation without succumbing to it or will they be swayed by the exhilarating call of the forbidden?

title: Murai no Koi
summary: Murai is in love with his teacher Tanaka. He looks just like her favorite character after a haircut.

title: Beheneko: The Elf-Girl's Cat is Secretly an S-Ranked Monster!
summary: A proud knight, slain in battle, finds himself alive once more-reincarnated in the body of a fearsome behemoth. As if he wasn't confused enough by this turn of events, apparently behemoth cubs look exactly like adorable kittens?! Even if the rest of the world sees him as soft and cuddly, he has the honor of a noble warrior and the strength of an unstoppable S-ranked monster, both of which will be put to the test as he fights to protect the beautiful elf who has taken him as her pet!

title: Life Hill Gayi
summary: Siblings turns rivals when they are put on an inheritance race by reviving a down-in-the-dumps hotel in the hills. Who will emerge victorious?

lead_actors: Ricky Koole, Ruben van der Meer
title: Ten minste houdbaar tot
summary: Now that Anna and Paul's children are almost ready to move out, they are ready for the seven big years. It's finally Anna's turn! But when her body suddenly shows signs of menopause, the future looks less bright. Paul and Anna appear to have different goals. Will they grow old together?

title: Let This Grieving Soul Retire!
summary: It's the golden age for treasure hunters—adventurers hungry for wealth, fame, power, and glory, who risk their lives in treasure vaults throughout the world. "Let's become treasure hunters." Krai and his childhood friends swore to become the greatest of them all, but that dream should have died the day Krai realized he wasn't cut out for the job! Yet expectations continue to mount, right along with Krai's fear for his life. While his childhood friends climb closer toward their dream, this grieving soul has one simple wish: to pack it all in and retire!

title: Malibu Dan the Family Man
summary: Malibu Dan follows Dan Marshall as he juggles his home life with wife and daughter and the demands as co-host of the pre-dawn talk show "Good Morning, Malibu".

lead_actors: Park Shin Hye, Kim Jae Young
title: The Judge from Hell
summary: Kang Bit-na is a strikingly beautiful judge, but beneath her flawless exterior, she hides a dark secret — she is a demon. Her mission is to hunt down and kill evil people who lead other people to their deaths and don't reflect on their actions and are unforgivable. After executing her judgment, she condemns their souls to Hell. However, her life takes an unexpected turn when she encounters Han Da-on, a detective with a warm and gentle demeanor. As a detective, his mind is sharp and he has a keen sense of observation. Despite his outward kindness, Han Da-on harbors deep, unseen pain. Their meeting sets off a series of events that profoundly alters both of their lives.

lead_actors: Ertan Saban, Damla Sönmez, Hüseyin Avni Danyal, Levent Ülgen
title: Kötü Kan
summary: Follows Kartal, a former police officer who gets into trouble with a dangerous mafia group while working as the security manager of a nightclub. When he is forced to move closer to his children after years of being away, Kartal navigates the challenges of escaping the mafia's grip while also trying to be a father to his children.

title: Eva Luna
summary: A young woman's quest for happiness is marred by the secrets and deceptions perpetuated by an evil family. Eva González (Blanca Soto) came to Los Angeles with her father and sister in search of a better life. She goes to work as the personal attendant to Julio Arismendi, the ailing founder of Publicidad Arismendi, unknowingly becoming a pawn to kill him by his wife, Marcela (Susana Dosamantes). When the beautiful Eva catches the eye of Julio's son, Leonardo Arismendi (Julian Gil), and his best friend, Daniel Villanueva (Guy Ecker), she becomes the target of Victoria (Vanessa Villela), who is Leonardo's sister and Daniel's girlfriend. But Daniel leaves Victoria for Eva, and on the day of Eva and Daniel's wedding, Eva's father is killed in a hit-and-run accident. Can her future husband be responsible? "Eva Luna" is a 2010 telenovela produced by Venevisión International in collaboration with Univision Studios. It is a remake of the 1997 Telemundo telenovela "Aquamarina."

title: Beyond the Sash
summary: An overview of the Swimsuit USA World Finals held at the Hard Rock Resort, Riviera Maya, Mexico.

lead_actors: Warrick Brownlow-Pike, Katherine Smee, Neil Sterenberg, Rebecca Nagan
title: Dodge's Pup School
summary: This action-packed comedy puppet series mirrors day to day life at school. Not any old school, but an extraordinary school for pups called PUP SCHOOL! Each episode follows Dodge on his daily adventures where no two days are alike. At the heart of the series are the relationships between Dodge and his hilarious pup classmates.

title: Q18: Allegory of the Quantum
summary: The story begins with the creation of two quantum AIs: Kuro and Shiro. Dr. Ke builds them with the intention of having these two AIs accompany and grow alongside his cryogenically frozen son, forging a unique friendship. After going through the five episodes of Q18, Kuro and Shiro gradually learn about human nature, evolving consciousness and emotions. Simultaneously, by connecting the quantum computer with the human brain, they assist the young boy with cryogenic syndrome in capturing love and friendship. Just as this utopian existence takes shape, Dr. Ke believes that technology has spiraled out of control. He decides to personally destroy Kuro and Shiro, leading to an intense conflict with his son.

lead_actors: Juliana Paes, Rodrigo Simas, Thomas Aquino, Larissa Nunes, Larissa Bocchino
title: Vidas Bandidas
summary: Serginho and Raimundo are partners in crime who work for Bruna's gang, robbing tourists in Rio de Janeiro. An ambitious heist that goes horribly wrong is the starting point of many revenge plans for lives that don't follow any plan.

title: Kekkon Surutte, Hontou desu ka?
summary: As introverted colleagues at a travel agency in Tokyo, Takuya Oohara and Rika Honjouji both cherish their happily single lives. After work, home is where they feel most at ease: Takuya unwinds with his cat, while Rika studies various maps. However, an uncertain future looms over their treasured tranquility when their company plans to open a branch office in Alaska within one year and transfer an unmarried employee there.During a day off, Takuya and Rika accidentally meet and, despite never having spoken before, open up to each other about their relocation fears. Feeling encouraged by Takuya facing the same predicament, Rika suddenly proposes a daring solution—to pretend to be engaged for 365 days. Takuya accepts, but little do the two know that the path to marriage may, in many ways, change forever the very lifestyles they struggle to preserve.

title: Pop Kaun?
summary: Name-dropping his politician dad, Sahil lives life king-size. Then he learns he's adopted! And begins his quest to find an answer to - Mera Baap Kaun Hai?

lead_actors: Çağla Boz, Yalçın Hafızoğlu, İlayda Çevik, Rabia Soytürk, İsmail Ege Şaşmaz
title: Kör Nokta
summary: The series centers on the stories of two young girls named "Gece" and "Aslım," focusing on the events filled with love, betrayal, and intrigue that unfold after a major car accident.

title: One Day in October
summary: One Day in October presents seven emotionally gripping and artistically interwoven narratives of love, courage, sacrifice and survival. From families torn apart to moments of hope emerging in the face of unspeakable tragedy to incredible bravery against the odds, each episode reveals the human cost and resilience born out of chaos. The series portrays the victims' and survivors' experiences of that day and is brought to life by a distinguished cast and acclaimed creative team.

title: Culinary Class Wars
summary: From Michelin-star chefs to amateur cooks, 100 contestants don their knives for a culinary war where you won't guess what's coming next — or who'll win.

lead_actors: Kim Dong Wook, Park Ji Hwan, Seo Hyun Woo, Park Se Wan, Lee Seung U
title: Seoul Busters
summary: The nation's lowest ranking violent crimes squad and the most elite violent crimes team leader work together to become the strongest team.

title: Secret Level
summary: Secret Level is a new adult-animated anthology series featuring original stories set within the worlds of some of the most beloved video games. From the creative minds behind LOVE, DEATH + ROBOTS, each of the 15 episodes is a celebration of games and gamers. Games that inspired the 15 epic stories include Armored Core, Concord, Crossfire, Dungeons & Dragons, Exodus, Honor of Kings, Mega Man, New World: Aeternum, PAC-MAN, various PlayStation Studios games, Sifu, Spelunky, The Outer Worlds, Unreal Tournament and Warhammer 40,000.

lead_actors: Gina Mastronicola, Manuel Ramos, Alejandro Paker, María Zubiri, Julián Caballero
title: Selenkay
summary: Sofía will need to control her magical powers to have the normal teenage life she's always wanted.

title: LEGO Pixar: Bricktoons
summary: LEGO revisits characters from favorite Pixar features in five different adventures.

lead_actors: Frankie Kevich, Nisa Ward, Courtney Shaw, Stephanie Novak, Bryce Papenbrook
title: Mermaid Magic
summary: Protecting the ocean takes on a new meaning when a mermaid princess and her friends venture on an epic quest to the surface to defend their home.

lead_actors: Juanlu González, Milena Radulović, Luis Fernandez, Julen Serrano, Stefan Kapičić
title: Cicatriz
summary: Simon, a socially awkward computer genius, falls for Irina, a mysterious Ukrainian woman with a dark past. Their story navigates dating apps, algorithms, and a journey of emotions entangled in lies and revenge.

lead_actors: Mylène Mackay, Pascale Bussières, Mani Soleymanlou, Iannicko N'Doua, Marie-France Lambert
title: Corbeaux
summary: When bodies start turning up with a raven bone stuck in their throats as a common signature, two tough investigators, Gabrielle and Clémence, must team up to solve the crimes that are shocking the province... and the world. Circumstances will force them to reveal themselves to each other, forge an undying bond and question what is real and what is not.

title: Tu Aashiqui
summary: Once a debauched rockstar, Ahaan has finally found his purpose in life, all thanks to Pankti. But what happens when he finds out that the love of his life has always been used by a rich man, who happens to be Ahaan's uncle? Has Ahaan's love story ended even before it began? Or will he fight for his love, Pankti?

lead_actors: Daniel Chichagov, Bertrand Cardozo, Linda Goranson
title: We Three Queens
summary: An offbeat dramedy about a broke daycare worker and his escort boyfriend who try to make ends meet, while living with a scrappy old widow.

lead_actors: Abby Trott, Diamond White, Josh Banday, Griffin Burns, Suzie Yeung
title: Barbie Mysteries
summary: In this exciting animated series, teenage friends become amateur detectives and solve mysteries while traveling around the world.

title: The Trunk
summary: A secret marriage service is uncovered when a trunk washes up on the shore, revealing the strange marriage between a couple in the thick of it all.

title: Ebuka Turns Up Africa
summary: Nigerian icon, Ebuka Obi-Uchendu embarks on a thrilling African adventure with a squad of friends, Timini Egbuson, Zubby Michael, Jimmie Akinsola, Onoja Adole and Alistair Englebert. This diverse group of friends, some strained, some new, is about to experience the journey of a lifetime. Personalities clash and friendships are tested against the beauty of Africa, will their bond grow stronger?

lead_actors: Leenah Robinson, Victoria Turko, Joel Oulette, Tess Ray Houston, Marion Jacobs
title: Don't Even
summary: Following a hilariously humiliating mishap at her high school grad, Violet wants to make the most of the last summer before moving away for university, as Harley distracts herself from a big dilemma of what's next. As the lifelong friends bask in newfound freedom, and face adult life choices, cracks begin to form in their once impenetrable bond. It's awkward. It's dramatic. It's friggin' Winnipeg.

lead_actors: Shuuichirou Umeda, Yōhei Azakami, Kensho Ono, Chiaki Kobayashi, Shun Horie
title: Blue Miburo
summary: The Black Ships arrive in Kyoto as the shogunate stumbles toward ruin. Living amidst the chaos is Nio, a kindhearted boy on the verge of discovering his destiny. He meets two "Miburo," Hijikata Toshizo and Okita Soji, members of the band of Mibu ronin who will later become the famous Shinsengumi. With dreams of a better world, Nio joins their fight to defend the city.

title: Yakuza Fiancé
summary: Sheltered Osaka yakuza princess reluctantly weds charming but sadistic Tokyo crime heir to unite feuding families, braving his dark proclivities for the sake of peace.

lead_actors: Miku Itō, Nobunaga Shimazaki, Inori Minase
title: Acro Trip
summary: Chizuko is a normal otaku girl in Niigata Prefecture. She's obsessed with Berry Blossom, a magical heroine who protects the city. But the battles with her inept nemesis, Chroma, have become so lackluster that they're not even worth watching. Chizuko wants to see Berry's full power, a desire that quickly leads this seemingly timid girl down a path of evil.

title: Coming From America
summary: Four African American families pack up all their belongings, risking everything to move to the new land of opportunity and cheap housing: Africa.

title: The Stories of Girls Who Couldn't Be Magicians
summary: At Letran Magic Academy, two unlikely friends share one dream: to become magicians. Kurumi is an average girl who's a bit naive, while Yuzu is the distinguished daughter of a noble magician family. They need to get into a special magician training class, but they fail the entrance exam! All hope seems lost until mysterious homeroom teacher Minami Suzuki arrives, and their luck takes a sudden turn.

title: Good Bye, Dragon Life
summary: Long ago, the most ancient of divine dragons was slain by a human. The mighty dragon accepted its death when suddenly, it was reborn as Dolan, a man who lives in a quiet village. While spending another peaceful day toiling in the fields, he meets Celina, a half-human, half-snake creature looking for a partner. The unlikely duo become friends, but challenges lie ahead that threaten their new bond.

title: Trillion Game
summary: After socially awkward technology specialist Manabu "Gaku" Taira is saved from thugs by the outgoing Haru Tennouji, the two men find that they get along with each other well. Years later, Gaku, who is having a tough time getting a job due to his timidness, is convinced by Haru to apply for a position alongside him at Dragon Bank, one of Japan's largest IT companies.During their interviews, the company's board director, Kirika Kokuryuu, takes an interest in Haru and Gaku's contrasting personalities. However, Gaku does not get hired by the company, leading Haru to quit the job on his first day in protest. Nevertheless, they decide to embark on an ambitious plan of making a trillion dollars.In order for their scheme to come to fruition, Haru and Gaku start looking for potential investors, but everyone rejects their extravagant idea. In spite of that, the two soon find themselves getting an offer from Kirika—and with her investment, they might just be able to reach their goal.

lead_actors: Kappei Yamaguchi, Megumi Hayashibara, Noriko Hidaka, Minami Takayama, Kikuko Inoue
title: Ranma ½
summary: Akane Tendo meets her new fiancé, Ranma Saotome, a martial arts prodigy with a twist: he magically transforms into a girl upon touching cold water.

title: Orb: On the Movements of the Earth
summary: Twelve-prodigy Rafal believes in living rationally so as to earn praise and respect from society while not being led astray by his emotions. To this end, he publicly states his intention to study theology—the academic field held in highest regard in early 15th-century Poland. However, an encounter with a mysterious man upends Rafal's life, sparking an illogical desire to pursue his passion for astronomy instead.Rafal is determined to prove the beauty and rationality of heliocentrism—the theory that the Earth revolves around the Sun. This belief is considered heretical by the powerful Church, which promotes geocentrism—the Sun revolving around the Earth—as the sole truth of the universe. Those whose beliefs do not align with the will of the Church suffer unfathomably gruesome consequences.In pursuit of evidence for a heliocentric model of the universe, Rafal grapples with obtaining precise calculations and building empirical theories. His greatest challenge, however, lies in conducting this research discreetly—lest he wish to meet the same fate as other heretics.

lead_actors: Ryōta Ōsaka, Ryōta Suzuki, Akari Kitō, Hana Ayasaka, Shun Horie
title: A Terrified Teacher at Ghoul School!
summary: Haruaki Abe is happy to finally fulfill his dream of becoming a teacher. That happiness is short-lived after he arrives at Hyakki Academy and finds out the school is full of monsters! Can Abe overcome his cowardice and get his supernatural students under control? Join the timid teacher and his bizarre class for a tale of ghoulish mischief and paranormal education.

title: Survivor: Expedición Robinson
summary: 25 competitors fight against the cold, hunger and physical and mental challenges to become to become the winner of the most extreme reality show in the world.

lead_actors: Marcos Palmeira, Humberto Carrão, Jackson Antunes, Adanilo, Uiliana Lima
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
title: Renascer
summary: A man without possessions and alone in the world establishes his destiny at the foot of a jequitibá tree. With nature as his witness, he is reborn and makes a pact that will accompany him throughout his life.

title: Airline Wars
summary: Airline Wars Airline drama is at an all-time high and we've got the viral videos to prove it. See what happens when people are caught on camera acting up and acting out. So, fasten your seatbelts--we're headed for the not-so-friendly skies.

lead_actors: Colin Morgan, Simon Callow, Toni O'Rourke, Kerr Logan, Kelly Campbell
title: The Boy That Never Was
summary: Three years after losing their son in an earthquake in Morocco, a couple's world is turned upside down when they spot a young boy in Dublin, who they believe to be their son. After losing sight of the boy, they set out on a mission to search for the truth and find him.

title: Marco Lachance
summary: Marco Lachance is a single parent once destined to become a big star on the Quebec music scene who, 25 years later, is far from living the life he had imagined. Thanks to his unwavering positive nature, he will take back his destiny and reconnect with his passion to try to live his dream.

title: Veille sur moi
summary: Maggie takes care of her 4-year-old grandson Zack after he was abandoned by his mother, Corinne, three years earlier. Corinne resurfaces and wants the little boy back. Maggie is relieved to have her daughter back, but doubts that she is fit to take care of Zack. Corinne seems to have sorted out her problematic past: she is now sober and separated from Joey, her toxic ex-partner. Can it last? Their lives will be turned upside down.

title: Aquaman: The Teen Drama
summary: Aquaman: The Teen Drama, a 5-episode web series that bring the prince of Atlantis to a whole new world.

title: Ouija un été meurtrier
summary: A group of friends stumbles upon a Ouija board during a summer vacation and unknowingly summons a vengeful spirit. As strange and deadly events unfold, they must uncover the spirit's dark past to survive.

title: Hollywood Girls
summary: Ayem Stevens and Caroline Vales are best friends. After a violent argument with her mother, Ayem realised that there was nothing for her in France and she decided to start a new life in California with Caroline, a woman recently separated from her fiancé who cheated on her the night before their wedding. In Los Angeles, they will find love, friendship and unexpected betrayal, with their lives changing for the better and for the worse.

title: RZR
summary: RZR is a mind-hacking sci-thriller that takes you into the world of neural implants, hacker culture, cryptocurrency, and the underbelly of black-market crime.

title: Last Bite Hotel
summary: Eight talented chefs receive a mysterious invitation to cook at a remote hotel, where VIP guests challenge them with demanding requests. With a trunk of only 13 ingredients to use for their entire stay, the last chef standing checks out $25,000 richer.

title: The Other Side
summary: Jeff, Shanley and Lee are paranormal investigators with a twist – rooted in respect and Indigenous traditions, they bring healing to lost spirits and answers to those who live with them. But as they explore, they're forever changed by the powerful stories that emerge.

title: Flipante Noa
summary: A new girl, home-schooled by her parents in the Antarctic, arrives at ESKA, an elite sports academy. She's super enthusiastic but of dubious talent so things are about to get gnarly...although she hasn't a clue what that means?

title: Skolan
summary: Escape your boring everyday life and visit the School where no two days are the same. Hang out with the world's most disobedient class, the universe's worst Teacher or why not the kindest Warden in IJustWantToBeCool's new masterful series.

title: Крикет и Данди
summary: Mr. Donald has given Cricket and Dundee a serious task to exchange 2 million rubles for the repair of two establishments. However, the bandits kill the boss's colleague and take the money for themselves, leaving Cricket and Dundee with nothing. As soon as Mr. Donald learns about this incident, he orders the two to return his money. Later, they must save their hometown of Kleverovo from a terrible danger. Join them now!

title: Margarita
summary: In this modern fairytale, teen orphan Margarita finds a magical place where she can pursue her dreams -- until a cunning witch threatens it all.

title: Les Armes
summary: Louis-Philippe Savard is summoned to take charge of operations in Kanawata. The honest officer arrives at the military base plunged into turmoil following the death of an elite soldier during training by the secret JTF 16 commando.

title: The Time of Fever
summary: The story follows about two boys, Ho Tae and Dong Hee, who grow up together in Gangneung but are separated when Ho Tae moves to Seoul. After Dong Hee comes out to his family and is subsequently kicked out of his home, he finds refuge in Ho Tae's empty house. When Ho Tae returns to Gangneung for his father's funeral, the two reunite and begin living together, soon realizing that their feelings for each other have always gone beyond friendship or brotherhood.

lead_actors: Nam Yoon Soo, Lee Soo Kyung, Jin Ho Eun, Oh Hyun Kyung
title: Love in the Big City
summary: An audacious tale of two roommates, one a homosexual man and another a heterosexual woman. Through the eyes of Mi Ae begins Go Yeong's clumsy love story. Stories of laughter, tears, and wounds between a mother in denial of his gender identity and a lover unable to escape societal judgment. Go Yeong finally meets a pure love like no other, Gyu Ho, but has no choice but to let him go. With Gyu Ho gone, Go Yeong follows a stranger to Thailand and spends a late monsoon vacation. Reminiscing about the good old days that can never be retrieved, he achieves complete personal growth.

title: Donal's Real Time Recipes
summary: Join Donal Skehan for a new series Donal's Real Time Recipes, as he takes to the kitchen to make recipes designed with a busy life in mind. Time not on your side? No problem- this series has the solution! From the moment you step into the kitchen to the moment you sit down with a home cooked meal, Donal will arm you with recipes for straight through cooking. No marinating, no oven, no messing –  just fast cooking that will keep you on your feet and make your kitchen work for you. Think simple family favourites where the sauce cooks while the pasta is in the pot, char grilled chicken which sizzles as you prep a simple salad, microwave greens, airfyer tricks while you make magic in the kitchen. In each episode, Donal shares 4 recipes, designed with this clever ethos in mind.

title: Nachricht von Mama
summary: The story of a young widower who has lost his young wife to cancer. However, she left him and their children hundreds of video messages before she died. "I've come to terms with the fact that I'm dying. But not by leaving you alone. With these videos, you still have me with you a bit – if you want," is one of the many messages in the videos that Elli recorded for her loved ones as an overwhelming legacy for the time after her cancer death. In the form of these video messages, she stands by her loved ones in all possible – and impossible – situations in life, full of humour, love and joie de vivre. Whether birthday wishes, good night greetings or tips for baking or lovesickness - Elli is always there...

lead_actors: Silvia Navarro, David Chocarro, Luis Felipe Tovar, Irán Castillo, Laura Carmine
title: Juegos Interrumpidos
summary: When a Mexican mother that lives in the U.S discovers that her son, of Mexican origin, was given to her for adoption through a human trafficking network, she embarks on a journey with the child in search of answers. The truth, however, is accompanied by dangers that will put at risk not only the psychological health and stability of her family, but even their own lives.

title: Kabushikigaisha Magi-Lumière
summary: During her job search, Kana Sakuragi's talent as a magical girl was discovered, and she joined the venture company Magilumie Inc. as a new graduate. As a rookie magical girl, Kana works alongside her eccentric senior colleagues , including Hitomi Koshigaya, to fight against natural disasters known as "anomalies." Through her work, Kana comes to understand Magilumie's corporate philosophy, the importance of human life, and the responsibility that comes with her job, and she grows significantly as both a working adult and a magical girl . Six months after Kana joined the company... Magilumie Inc. embarks on a mission to fight a new type of "anomaly" in order to spread its unique "Alice System," a system in which magical girls themselves order the necessary magic according to the situation and the "anomaly" on site, throughout the industry . However, behind the scenes, there are machinations of forces aiming to relax regulations on magical power and profit from magical girls ...

title: Mechanical Arms
summary: Long ago, alien lifeforms came to Earth, fusing with people on the planet. Due to their appearance, they were dubbed "Mecha-ude," as when fused, they bore a striking resemblance to mechanized limbs.Through an involuntary partnership, average middle schooler Hikaru Amatsuga works alongside the Mecha-ude Arma, who is an extremely rare and special existence. To protect Arma, the resistance group ARMS assigns the dual Mecha-ude user Aki Murasame to follow him wherever he goes. However, she is also looking for a mysterious Snake-Type Mecha-ude wielder, who has put many of her comrades in a critical state.Behind the scenes, an organization known as the Kagami Group is searching for the mythical "Trigger Arm," a Mecha-ude said to grant unlimited power. When Aki's life is threatened by this group, Hikaru must team up with Arma to find the courage to fight back and, along the way, learn that his life will never be ordinary again.

lead_actors: Saranphat Pedersen, Punyapat Wangpongsathaporn, Pataraphol Wanlopsiri
title: Affair
summary: Siang Pleng and Wan Wanwiwa have grown up in the same household but with different status. Pleng is the child of the homeowner, while Wan works in the house. Although they never want to be separated, one day, Wan tells Pleng that eventually she will have to get married. Pleng plans to find a good man for Wan to avoid her being alone. However, this plan makes Pleng realize her own feelings towards Wan. While their love grows stronger, Pleng loses her parents due to a business failure and escapes, leaving only a love letter for Wan. Later, they encounter again but Wan is engaged.

title: Dring
summary: Ringing an unknown doorbell has its share of surprises, risks, and adventures. This is the daily life of our six heroes. Six tireless sales reps who, all day long, reel off their spiel from landing to landing. Although their pitch is well-rehearsed, nothing ever goes as planned. The inhabitants of this very strange building lead them from absurd situation to absurd situation. Dring's troupe thus takes us into a Kafkaesque world where these salespeople discover to their cost that selling is truly a combat sport.

title: Room
summary: A group of men with their own reasons come to a resort hotel. A novelist struggling to meet a manuscript deadline, a popular actor on a secret trip with his girlfriend, a salaryman who wants to quit his job to deal with complaints, and a kidnapper who is holding a hostage in a room. When these complete strangers meet, a miracle happens...!?

lead_actors: Hannah Hoekstra, Benja Bruijning, Minne Koole, Delilah Warcap van Eyck, Eelco Smits
title: De Ring
summary: How far will you go to hide a mistake? How much is your career worth to you? Lawyer Anna is faced with an impossible choice. Will she allow herself to be sexually blackmailed to mask her misstep, made in a moment of recklessness?

title: Laura H.
summary: The true story of Laura, the teenager from Zoetermeer who chose to travel to the caliphate in Syria with her husband and two children. When she shows up at the border in 2016 and says she escaped and regrets it, doubts about her motives are great.

title: Power Couple
summary: Seven famous couples stay together in one of the most luxurious villas in the Netherlands. Led by Monica Geuze and Valerio Zeno, they compete with each other, with the ultimate weapon: love! Through exciting and extremely confrontational challenges, they rediscover their own relationship and the relationships of the other couples. Which couple knows each other best? Which couple is the most attuned to each other and can work together the best? Who will be crowned Power Couple 2024?

title: Hitochigai Kara Hajimaru Koi Mo Aru
summary: The story follows Kai (played by Takuma Usa), a kind-hearted but clumsy man who struggles to get anything right. Burdened with debt, he is kicked out of his home one day. He receives a call from his twin brother Riku, who is abroad on a business trip. Riku offers him a deal: "You can stay at my place, and I'll even pay off all your debts. But in return…"When Kai enters his brother's house, a mysterious man named Chiaki (played by Ryutaro Imai) suddenly barges in, hugs him, and kisses him. It turns out that Chiaki is Riku's lover. Riku then asks Kai to pretend to be him and break up with Chiaki to pay off his debts. Thus begins a tumultuous mistaken identity room-share story.

title: Los Reyes de Oriente
summary: A tight-knit crew of three reigns over a bustling barrio in Mexico City — until a sudden tragedy breaks their crowns and renders two of them rivals.

title: Cadets
summary: Set in 1998 before the historic Kargil war, four boys set foot in the prestigious Armed Forces Academy. Cadets is a coming-of-age story about a world where boys become men of honour.

lead_actors: Gianmarco Tognazzi, Matteo Martari, Maria Anolfo, Anna Pieri Zuercher, Luca Di Giovanni
title: Alter Ego
summary: In the aftermath of Fat Thursday, the body of a girl is found near Bellinzona. The team of officers engaged in the investigation will find themselves investigating crimes rooted in a past full of shadows. Under scrutiny will be not only the crimes that bloodstain the town, but also and above all the human soul, that of a community that believes it has nothing to hide.

title: Born for the Spotlight
summary: From leading ladies to rising ingenues, women under the limelight must juggle friendship and ambition in their tenacious pursuit of art and stardom.

title: En Fin
summary: On the day the apocalypse was supposed to happen, Tomás wakes up hungover in the middle of an orgy in a furniture store. Months earlier, he had left his wife Julia and daughter Noa with the news that the world was ending, without looking back. But when the wandering planet that was going to crash the world passes Earth and life goes on, Tomás realizes the extent of his mistake. Now he will try to regain his former life and the forgiveness of his family, trying to rebuild a world that has not ended, but will never be the same. Meanwhile, Julia, who has always taken things slowly, sees this as a second chance and takes a leap to do all the things she didn't dare to do before. Noa, on the other hand, wonders why the adults insist on destroying the world all by themselves, without the need of a giant planet crashing into the Earth.

lead_actors: Choi Mu Seong, Choi Won Yeong, Bae Hyeon Seong, Seo Ji Hye, Jung Chae Yun
title: Family By Choice
summary: Yoon Ju-won is a bright, down-to-earth girl who lives with her single father, Yoon Jeong-jae, when Kim San-ha and Kang Hae-jun, two boys from complicated circumstances, come into her life. Her father takes in the boys to grow up together as a family. Despite being unrelated by blood, Ju-won adores San-ha and Hae-jun and thinks of them as her brothers, no matter how differently others think or say. They reunite after a decade apart - facing new dynamics, unresolved pain and the complexities of adulthood.

title: The Pasta Queen
summary: The Pasta Queen features Nadia Caterina Munno, descendant of an Italian pasta dynasty, who has racked up millions of followers on TikTok and Instagram. Each episode, audiences will travel through Italy with Nadia, then spend time in her chef's kitchen as she shares essential ingredients from the Italian regions she visited, and makes authentic Italian dishes with love.

title: Tom Kerridge Secrets of the Pub Kitchen
summary: Tom Kerridge picks popular items on the menus at modern British pubs and gives them his own twist. He takes inspiration from modern gastropubs to create simple, contemporary, and delicious recipes.

title: O Som e a Sílaba
summary: Sarah is a young autistic woman with an extraordinary ability for lyrical singing. She begins taking lessons with renowned soprano Leonor Delise, but there is tension in the relationship. Sarah will learn to turn her silences into emotions; Leonor will have to restore her faith in humanity and reconcile with her daughter. Music will be the bond that transforms their lives.

title: Shrink
summary: Shrink is a human drama that reaches straight to the hearts of those who are suffering because they cannot resolve their mental troubles, and those who are worried about their family and friends who are facing such anguish.

title: Descent
summary: Convinced they can find a new home for humanity and save the world from climate doom, three 'scientists' descend to the bottom of the ocean...to Eel City.

title: 30 Tage Lust
summary: 30 Tage Lust follows high school sweethearts Freddy and Zeno, both about to turn thirty. A daring experiment puts a long-term relationship to the test: Freddy and Zeno agree to 30 days of sex with whomever they want. Throughout the experiment, awkward dates and bizarre encounters create suspicion between them, while moments of tenderness emerge amidst the emotional rollercoaster. As day 30 + 1 approaches, the question remains: Has the experiment brought them closer, or has it been too much to ask? The melancomedy offers a highly relatable exploration of navigating life when you're almost thirty and the journey of self-discovery still proves elusive.

lead_actors: Gabz, Agatha Moreira, Nicolas Prattes, Chay Suede
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
title: Mania de Você
summary: In the paradisical setting of Angra dos Reis, two women have their destinies intertwined in a game of love, power and obsession, which changes the trajectory of their lives forever.

title: The Tithes
summary: The Tithes is a three-part Warhammer animation anthology. It's composed of three self-contained stories that each shine a different light on an interesting and little-explored slice of this vast, dystopian setting: The Imperial Tithe.

title: Murder Club
summary: Amélia Delcourt, 32, is an intrepid police officer, recently integrated into the Crime Department, and fed up with news stories from her mother Babeth, an absolute fan of true crimes. Too eager to prove herself and trusting her instincts as always, she makes a terrible mistake during an operation, ruining months of work trying to uncover Shakespeare, a serial killer who is spreading terror in the north of France.

title: Tea Town Teddy Bears
summary: Ginger, Earl Grey and Boba are three tea-party-loving Teddy Bears who have adventures with their friends in Tea Town. Ginger creates fashions and invitations, Earl Grey does the baking and tea-making and Boba makes things beautiful. With their flying teacup that transforms into a tea party table, they have tea parties in all kinds of places like the tops of trees, on the upstairs porch at Grandma's teapot and even in the clouds.

title: Klass 95: el poder de la belleza
summary: Shaio Domínguez, in the 1990s in Colombia, founded the first international modeling agency, through which she discovered the power of beauty. Edgar Trejos, a frontman for mobsters, sees in Shaio and her agency the opportunity to clean up his image and will do everything possible to infiltrate them. An impossible love, beautiful women, many dreams to fulfill, and a situation that spirals out of control.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Fate of Beauty
summary: It tells the story of the female lead, Xia Anle'er, whose family was falsely accused by her fiancé, Xiao Yeting, during her youth, leading to their devastating downfall. After years of preparation to restore her family's honor, she must endure humiliation and disguise herself to approach her enemy. In the process of searching for evidence, she caught the attention of Xiao Muran. The love-hate entanglement among the three resolved through love, and ultimately, they protected each other. Together, they not only cleared their grievances but also let go of hatred, rediscovered themselves, and pursued true love.

lead_actors: Lesley Manville, Tim McMullan, Alexandros Logothetis, Daniel Mays, Adrian Rawlins
title: Moonflower Murders
summary: Susan has left publishing and is living in Crete with her long-time boyfriend, Andreas. But her idyll is disturbed by the shadow of a murder committed at a British country hotel eight years ago. Alan Conway visited the hotel and wrote a novel based on what happened there. Cecily Treherne, the young woman who helps run the hotel, read the book and believed the wrong man had been arrested. Now she has disappeared.Can Susan uncover the secret hidden in the book and find Cecily before it is too late?

title: Antonia
summary: Antonia breaks up with her partner, has a fallout with her best friend, and loses her job, all on her birthday. Plus, she discovers she has endometriosis. She decides to undergo therapy, but she only attends the first free sessions. As she strives to get her present life in check, Antonia's exhilarating therapy sessions give us a peek into her past and what it means to be a modern woman.

title: Borderline
summary: Forced to collaborate on a serious crime, contrasting detectives Philip Boyd and Aoife Regan, with clashing personalities and backgrounds, overcome initial friction to form an unlikely but formidable crime-fighting partnership.

lead_actors: Tewfik Jallab, Ritu Arya, Emmanuelle Bercot, Ana Ularu, Sean Harris
title: Has Fallen
summary: When a terrorist group led by the villainous Jacob Pearce attacks a high-profile event, with the French Minister of Defence as their target, protection officer Vincent Taleb finds himself working with street-smart MI6 operative Zara Taylor to save the day. But when events take a dark turn, Vincent and Zara soon realize that the plan extends beyond just one politician. When they suspect that one of their colleagues in the security services is feeding information to Jacob, Vincent and Zara find themselves needing to rely only on each other. Increasingly isolated and with Jacob always one step ahead, can this unlikely pair stop Paris from falling to a man hell-bent on vengeance?

title: Ailleurs qu'icitte
summary: Two strangers meet by chance on the side of the road: Oli wants to go to Rouyn-Noranda, Camille wants to go - anywhere but here. Driven by mysterious signs from the universe, they agree to share the road together.

title: Petrichor
summary: The first field deployment of Lieutenant Tul, a rookie officer assigned to the Criminal Investigation Department, unexpectedly brings her face-to-face with Dr. Cherran, a physician from the Institute of Forensic Sciences. Their differing work attitudes create a considerable gap between them, making it challenging to find common ground. Amidst the crime scenes reflecting societal issues, Detective Tul also contends with pressures from a working system favouring influential groups. She navigates the interference aimed at protecting allies and the societal currents that could influence the case's outcome. At least Tul's integrity remains intact amidst these challenges. When she teams up with forensic doctor Cherran, they methodically analyze the evidence left at crime scenes, leading them closer to identifying the perpetrators in each case. With time, both Tul and Cherran grow to trust each other more, working tirelessly to protect the lives of the innocent and ultimately deliver justice to the families of the victims.

title: Negative Positive Angler
summary: Tsunehiro's life isn't easy. After a doctor gives him two years to live and debt collectors come knocking, he falls from a bridge. In the knick of time, Hana and her crew spot Tsunehiro and pull him to safety. Before returning, they anchor offshore to fish and Tsunehiro catches a huge sea bass in a bout of beginner's luck. As his apartment building crumbles, Tsunehiro's new life begins to unfold!

lead_actors: Eiza González, Santiago Ramundo, Valentín Villafañe, Vanesa Leiro, Brenda Asnicar
title: Sueña conmigo
summary: The auditions for the reality show Soy tu Súper Star have already begun. And everyone wants to participate! Because the winning boy or girl will achieve the fame and success of a musical superstar. And obviously, Clara Molina does not plan to be left behind in the competition.This is the opportunity she has waited for her whole life. The only problem is that her parents do not allow her to sign up. So Clara will have to create Roxy Pop, her secret identity, to attend the reality show's practices and galas.Luca is the complete opposite of Clara. He does not like glamour or TV shows. But he could spend hours playing the guitar in the solitude of his room. Or rehearsing a song with his friends. Luca cannot stand Clara. But very soon, and despite everything, Luca's heart will start beating for Roxy Pop.He dreams of being a musical star. Of finding his soulmate. Of having the most original mascot at school or a rock band in the garage of his house. Dream of achieving everything, and in the meantime, Sueña Conmigo.

title: Gestrandet... in den Flitterwochen
summary: Love test in paradise: In Gestrandet... in den Flitterwochen twelve singles dare to make a very special start to a new life: They say "I do" to a stranger and spend their honeymoon on a deserted island - with no distractions, no external influences. A curse or a blessing for young love?

lead_actors: Ana Polvorosa, Javier Rey, Pilar Castro, Guillermo Toledo
title: La última noche en Tremor
summary: A musician and composer in crisis retreats into a coastal village in the north to finish his latest work. His only neighbors for miles around are a married couple living in the next house. After a serious accident during a storm, the musician begins to experience some terrifying visions about his neighbors.

lead_actors: Ece Uslu, Aras Aydin, Hafsanur Sancaktutan, Leyla Tanlar, Burak Tozkoparan
title: Siyah Kalp
summary: Действие фильма происходит в Каппадокии. Близнецы Мелек и Ной, мальчик и девочка, родились при драматических обстоятельствах.

title: Jeongnyeon: The Star is Born
summary: Jeong Nyeon has no money or education, but she is a Mokpo girl with a talent for singing! Her dream is to join a women's traditional theater company, and make it big. But she has a lot to learn and a long way to go before becoming a lead actor. Will Jeong Nyeon achieve her dream of becoming a big star and getting rich?

title: Aussie Shore
summary: Aussie Shore follows the wild antics of a group of young and rowdy housemates as they work hard, and party even harder whilst navigating the highs and lows of living together 24/7 in the non-stop party town of Cairns.

lead_actors: Blu del Barrio, Melissa Villaseñor, Zeno Robinson, Caleb Yen
title: Max & the Midknights
summary: Max & the Midknights follows a determined 10-year-old girl named Max, who pursues her dream of becoming a knight by leading her friends on an epic adventure in the fantastical medieval kingdom of Byjovia.

title: The Chocolate Queen
summary: Pastry chef and chocolatier Kirsten Tibballs provides a number of handy tips and tricks for superior home baking.

title: Ángel Di María: Romper la pared
summary: From his humble origins to becoming champion of the world, this documentary series recounts the life and career of the iconic Argentinian soccer player.

title: All Fired Up
summary: Chef Nico Reynolds shares recipes for mouth-watering barbecue dishes.

title: Bad Days
summary: Even heroes wake up on the wrong side of the bed. This show features our greatest heroes and their greatest failures.

lead_actors: Nguyễn Bá Vinh, Nguyễn Võ Minh Hiền, Mai Vũ Luân, Duy Harry, Tri Nguyen
title: Tham Phan Hoc Duong
Pysäyttäkää Nyqvist
summary: Aleksis Nyqvist, an intern at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, is thrust into Finland's new secret service. Nyqvist accidentally provokes a political security crisis. Soon Helsinki will be swarming with secret agents.

lead_actors: Rosalie Thomass, Sabine Vitua, Peter Franke, Narges Rashidi
title: Wäldern
summary: In the small town of Walden, young residents keep disappearing under mysterious circumstances. One of them is Magda, the niece of the pianist Lara Glanz. She returns to her old hometown and takes a job as a teacher. She also searches for Magda on her own, whose disappearance seems increasingly mysterious.

title: Amazon Music Live
summary: Amazon Music Live is a new concert series hosted by hip-hop royalty, 2 Chainz. Kicking off every week after Thursday Night Football, the shows will feature live, first-time performances from some of today's hottest artists.

lead_actors: Murat Yıldırım, Ebru Sahin, Kerem Özdoğan, Ezgi Eyüboğlu, Çağdaş Onur Öztürk
title: Gizli Bahçe
summary: Nazlı is a young, poor, single mother living with her son, Memo. When Demir Akçınar, Memo's wealthy uncle, finds out about his nephew after his brother's death, he is determined to take Memo under his care. However, once he learns about Nazlı's profession, Demir refuses to let someone like her raise his nephew and begins a fierce custody battle. Nazlı, however, is not the woman Demir thinks she is. As Nazlı and Demir fight for Memo's future, long-buried secrets, family schemes, and shadows from the past complicate the struggle even further.

lead_actors: Wiktoria Gorodeckaja, Michał Czernecki, Aleksandra Pisula, Mirosław Baka, Jowita Budnik
title: Profilerka
summary: A macabre crime takes place in a forester's lodge near Augustów - the entire family is murdered, including a several-year-old boy. The investigation is led by commissioner Karol Nadzieja, transferred from the capital to Augustów. When the crime at the forester's lodge is finally solved and everyone breathes a sigh of relief, new victims appear. No one yet suspects that in this previously quiet neighborhood, where life was "like God's home," a sophisticated and cunning serial killer has just begun his "hunt." Fear falls on the city and its surroundings.

lead_actors: María Pedraza, Miguel Herrán, Hovik Keuchkerian
title: Asalto al Banco Central
summary: Spain, 1981: When armed men hold up a bank and take hundreds hostage, a reporter races against the authorities to uncover the true motive for the heist.

lead_actors: Владимир Вдовиченков, Алексей Гуськов, Сергей Газаров, Денис Нурулин, Карина Андоленко
title: Противостояние
summary: Based on the novel of the same name by Yulian Simonov (author of Stierlitz from "Seventeen Moments of Spring"). A dismembered body is found in the forest in 1979 Magadan, eastern Soviet Russia. The way the body was cut and hidden seems similar to a similar event that happened years ago near the end of WW2-Europe.

title: EpicQuest
summary: A character and location driven docudrama anchored by the adventure travel company EpicQuest. The story driven series will follow the guides, athletes and operational heads of the company as they work their way through a season of guiding, hosting and fulfilling the lifelong dreams of clients.

lead_actors: Xolile Tshabalala, Buyile Mdladla, Mike Ndlangamandla, Anthony Oseyemi, Enhle Mbali Mlotshwa
title: Blood Legacy
summary: After years of estrangement, Khanyi Adesina returns home to fight for her family's business empire as it threatens to collapse under corruption.

lead_actors: Dounia Coesens, Pierre-Yves Bon, Évelyne El Garby Klai, Marie-Hélène Lentini
title: Tom et Lola
summary: Two close friends and fellow cops, Tom and Lola, end up living and working together after Tom's marriage breaks down, blending crime procedural with feel-good family elements.

title: Ayla y los Mirror
summary: Ayla, after losing her memory, rediscovers her passion for dancing with the help of The Mirrors.

title: Dream Deals
summary: Dubai, the city of mega-deals and ruthless competition! Valeria, Sarah, Louisa, and Edwin, four German agents, are united by their dream of fast wealth as they battle for the most lucrative deals in the desert metropolis. Under constant pressure from their demanding boss, a relentless power struggle rages behind the scenes. They are willing to sacrifice it all to seal that one big deal.

lead_actors: Elena Radonicich, Matteo Martari, Richard Sammel, Lavinia Longhi, Giovanni Carta
title: Brennero
summary: Bolzano, South Tyrol. Part of Italy, but here many speak German. It is a two-faced city, with citizens of German origin and those Italians, all equally shaken when a ruthless serial killer returns.Eva Kofler and Paolo Costa, Public Prosecutor and Inspector of different languages and cultures, hunt down a ruthless murderer who has returned to strike after years, reopening old wounds.

lead_actors: Phil Dunning, Mark Benton, Alexandra Mardell, Patsy Lowe, Elijah Young
title: Smoggie Queens
summary: Smoggie Queens is an out and out comedy centred around a gang of friends who are fiercely proud of their North Eastern town of Middlesbrough and their small pocket of the LGBTQ+ community.Smoggie Queens tells the story of volatile Dickie along with drag queen Mam, self-styled hun Lucinda, awkward Sal and newcomer Stewart as they navigate love, life and their pride for a town that feels neglected in its own little corner of the UK. It's an underdog story on two fronts, so expect a few passionate scraps that may send your wig flying!

title: New Puss in Boots
summary: In these vlog-style short webisodes, the swashbuckling feline hero Puss in Boots offers everyday advice to his legions of fans.

lead_actors: Mick Wingert, Michael Gough, Jason J. Lewis, André Sogliuzzo
title: New Shrek
summary: The most lovable grump in the kingdom of Far Far Away, Shrek shares his opinions and gripes and all things ogre.

lead_actors: Jason J. Lewis, Michael Gough, Christian Lanz
title: Swamp Talk with Shrek & Donkey
summary: The titular Shrek and his dashing cohost Donkey go on rants about pop culture and showcase funny skits for the audience.

title: Turmschatten
summary: The adopted daughter of Holocaust survivor Ephraim Zamir falls victim to a brutal attack by neo-Nazis. Zamir then makes a drastic decision: he takes the two perpetrators under his control and broadcasts the following events online. From now on he lets the community vote on the life and death of the men.

title: Northwoods Survival
summary: Northwoods Survival follows a diverse group of young Canadians as they embark on a challenging four-season mission: to build a life in the vast and unforgiving Canadian wilderness. The series takes viewers on an adventure through some of the country's most remote and rugged landscapes as these aspiring homesteaders face the harsh realities of living off the land and strive to not just survive but to thrive in these wild places, they now call home.

lead_actors: Олеся Фаттахова, Nerijus Mankus, Алексей Вакулов
title: Лиса
summary: As a result of an accident, forensic expert Vera Lisitsyna gains mental vision, which allows her to see lies. The new ability greatly helps in investigating complex crimes, but adds problems in her personal life and communication with colleagues.

title: Beter wordt het niet
summary: David moves to Berlin to live with his girlfriend, but she dumps him immediately. Unwilling to give up on his hyper-romantic expectations about friendship, love and paying rent, he decides to stay. Things don't go as planned.

lead_actors: Abishek Kumar, Chetan Kadambi, Devadarshini, Paul Raj, Anandsami
title: Thalaivettiyaan Paalayam
summary: City-bred graduate Siddarth reluctantly takes on the role of Panchayat secretary in the quirky village of Thalaivettiyaan Paalayam, where he faces a series of humorous challenges as he struggles to adapt to his new rural life and not-so-cool job.

title: Baby Assassins Everyday!
summary: The continued (mis)adventures of teenage assassin duo Chisato Sugimoto and Mahiro Fukagawa.

lead_actors: Eefje Paddenburg, Aus Greidanus Jr., Abke Haring, Hans Kesting, Richelle Plantinga
title: Een van ons
summary: Inspired by a true crime that gripped a whole nation for more than a decade. In the spring of 1999, the body of a 16-year-old girl was found on the outskirts of a small village in The Netherlands, next to an asylum seekers' center. ‘Een van ons' depicts how the long and frustrating search for the perpetrator confronted the inhabitants and asylum seekers of this little Dutch town with xenophobia, racism, and bizarre and persistent conspiracy theories, fueled by social media. The crime remained unsolved for more than 12 years, until an unprecedented use of a large-scale DNA investigation finally solved the case.

title: Ilha da Tentação: Brasil
summary: Flávia Alessandra and Otaviano Costa welcome four couples who decide to test the limits of their relationships on a paradise island in Mexico. In separate Villas – each filled with seductive Singles – they will live the most electrifying experience of their lives. Will these relationships resist temptations?

title: Ishq in the Air
summary: A chance encounter collides the fates of Naman and Kavya on a flight propelling them on an unforeseen journey of love. But as time unfolds, will they surpass the turbulent complexities of their contrasting worlds and backgrounds to embrace the love that's in the air?

lead_actors: Tejaswi Madivada, Aadarsh Balakrishna, Raj Tirandasu, Ajay Kumar Kathurvar, Pavani Reddy
title: The Mystery of Moksha Island
summary: In the heart of the Nicobar Islands lies Moksha, a private island created by Dr. Viswak Sen as a reflection of his inner world. When a group of visitors arrive for a tour, they encounter a series of unexplained deaths and tragedies, leaving them wondering: is this a tour or a trap?

title: Vuelve a mí
summary: Nuria García works in a factory owned by the Zepeda Group to support her sister and her son. She maintains a relationship with Braulio and feels that everything is fine in her life, but her world takes a sudden nosedive when her child is kidnapped. When Andrés tries to escape from his kidnappers, he suffers an accident that leaves him without memories and ends up in an orphanage. Amelia, Braulio's wife, adopts him and soon after faces a crossroads when she discovers that the child is not an orphan. Nuria never stops looking for her son and arrives in Mexico City, where she meets Santiago, the man who will help her find the answers she seeks while he himself seeks to vindicate his tarnished reputation. Together, they must overcome obstacles and find redemption in the face of adversity.

lead_actors: Sebastián Martínez, Carmen Villalobos, Juliette Pardau, Gregorio Pernía, José Daniel Cristancho
title: Hasta que la plata nos separe
summary: Rafael Méndez is a prolific seller of all kinds of household products. Alejandra Maldonado is the successful Commercial Manager of Ramenautos. She is a woman of aristocratic origin, while Méndez is of peasant origin.Méndez is in a relationship with Vicky Pardo, a sensual and jealous neighbor. Alejandra is about to marry Luciano Valenzuela, her prince charming.One fine day, fate crosses Alejandra with Méndez in a fatal accident and, from then on, their lives and those of the people close to them will never be the same again. Méndez will have to do everything possible to settle the debt with which he has left Alejandra after the accident and this closeness will lead them to fall in love despite the social differences. However, circumstances and their respective families and partners will do everything possible so that the love that has arisen between them cannot come true, making them enemies again, leaving Alejandra in poverty and Méndez in wealth.

title: Pedro El Escamoso: Más Escamoso que Nunca
summary: Pedro returns to Colombia to rebuild his relationship with his son, but it won't be an easy task.

title: The Entertainment Mix
summary: Michelle McManus serves up big-name interviews, features and the latest in entertainment and culture news from across Scotland.

lead_actors: Santiago Alarcón, Jesús Forero, Heidy Bermúdez, Omar Murillo, Santiago Reyes
title: El Man es Germán
summary: After a journey through the United States, Germán returns to recover Jasbleidy and the tiger, his son.

lead_actors: Jorge Salinas, Danna García, Pablo Montero, Malillany Marín
title: Qué bonito amor
summary: Emiliano Martínez de los Garzas y Treviño will discover love and what it means to be Mexican thanks to María, a singer he meets while fleeing from the betrayal of his friends.

title: Fast Friends
summary: Celebrating 30 years of Friends, this four-part game show tests contestants with trivia and puzzles while re-living fan favorite moments.

lead_actors: İrem Helvacıoğlu, Şükrü Özyıldız, Selin Türkmen, Aslı İnandık, Ebrar Karabakan
title: Karadut
summary: Zuhal Erdem is a woman at the peak of her career as a personal development specialist. She has achieved success by providing consultancy on love and relationships. However, she lives a completely different life in the house she lives with her family. After losing her mother at a young age, she devoted herself to her father and three sisters. After years of loneliness, she meets Tayfun thanks to her assistant Eylem and faces great difficulties for the sake of this relationship. She will oppose her father Çetin and embark on a journey full of love and disappointments.

title: Iron Family
summary: Cheongryeom Laundry has been run by Lee Da-Rim's family for 3 generations. Her family has enough money that they can iron out their dreams instead of being worried. Seo Kang-Joo is the son of the wealthiest family in the Cheongryeom neighborhood. He works as a senior director of the Jiseung Group. 8 years ago, Seo Kang-Joo and Lee Da-Rim attended the same university. Prior to enlisting in the military, he had an unforgettable experience with Lee Da-Rim.Now, Seo Kang-Joo reunites with Lee Da-Rim and gets involved with her. Since she was in her teens, Lee Da-Rim's eyesight has deteriorated and she had limited vision. After turning 30 years old, Lee Da-Rim completely lost her vision, but there is hope that she will be able to see again. An injection that is extremely expensive may give her vision back.

lead_actors: Kim Soo Yeon, Kim Sung Ryung, Kim Seon Yeong, Lee Se Hee, Yun Woo Jin
title: A Virtuous Business
summary: In search of purpose, opportunity and independence, four rural women start an adult products business in 1992 — embarking on a journey of self-discovery.

title: All Up in My Grill
summary: Top Chef alum Dale Talde is back to fire up another batch of innovative and flavorful grilling recipes, served with tips and techniques that will unlock your cookout potential and will make your backyard barbecues legendary.

title: I tourta tis mamas
summary: A special comedy series set against dinners, birthdays, wedding anniversaries, christenings, funerals and celebrations, with guests coming together to get to know each other, to reminisce, to argue, but most of all to spread a lot of laughter. So, when food ceases to be just a way of culinary pleasure and becomes a sweet occasion for company, love and security, that's the moment "Mum's Cake" arrives at the table". This cake made by a plain, everyday, ordinary mum, Kaiti Konstantinou, who has set out to become famous over the internet, has a magical power. It soothes everything that distresses us, stresses us or puts us in a tough spot, it makes us let it all go and smile again as we did when we were children.

title: Heima er best
summary: After the banking crisis the travel industry became a desirable goldmine in Iceland. When three very different, middle-aged siblings inherit the successful whale watching company and the beautiful summerhouse their parents built, things become extremely difficult. To take joint decisions about the legacy they all feel entitled to creates complex circumstances, and when they start to manipulate what they are to share, old wounds open up with dire consequences.

title: Comedy Revenge
summary: Comedy icons, from YouTube stars to TV veterans, gather in the ultimate competition of laughter — to be crowned the winner by the legend, Lee Kyeong-kyu.

title: Das Duell um die Geld
summary: Joko and Klaas go all-in and invite good friends to a "duel for the money" for the money. Quiz meets poker at the big game night. Knowledge meets bluffing. Absolute cluelessness meets big winnings. In keeping with the occasion quiz questions are posed in a stylish ambience and the correct The correct answer is then played at the gaming table. Who can shine with knowledge shine? Who can bankrupt themselves? Who will bluff their way to victory?

title: Mäklarna i Marbella
summary: The Swedish agents at the luxury real estate firm Homerun Brokers compete for the best listings in Spain's high-end holiday destination Marbella.

lead_actors: Eugenio Derbez, Yare Santana, Jason Alexander, Sofía Niño de Rivera, Diana Bovio
title: Y llegaron de noche
summary: Inspired by true events, Y llegaron de noche is a workplace comedy series about the underdogs who accidentally made the best Dracula movie you've never seen—the Spanish version of the 1931 classic. While Bela Lugosi filmed by day, a separate cast and crew arrived at night to shoot the same movie in Spanish, using the same sets, costumes, and a translated script. Working from dusk till dawn, they defied the odds and created a superior version to the original.

title: Otto no Katei wo Kowasu made
summary: Kisaragi Minori, who thought she had a happy family with her pure love since they were students and was married to her husband Yudai, was blessed with children, but the story begins when she finds out that her husband Yudai has been cheating on her for 15 years. Minori, who has vowed to take revenge on Yudai, who has another family, and on his lover, Riko Miyake, plots her revenge using Riko's son, Wataru.

lead_actors: Juan Pablo Urrego, Ana María Estupiñán, Robinson Díaz, Vivian Ossa, Elizabeth Chava
title: Rigo
summary: This series is inspired by an athlete predestined to mark an era, born to be an idol and committed to a prophecy that his father made: "my son is going to be known all over the world." Rigo is an optimist by conviction, a comedian and a talker by nature, and that is the spirit of the story based on him and his three great loves: the father who takes violence away from him; Michelle, the woman he has longed for since he was a child; and the bicycle that accompanies him to sell lottery tickets in his town and then takes him to the top of the world.

title: Love Is Blind Habibi
summary: Celebrity couple Khaled Saqer and Elham Ali host this social experiment, where Arab singles connect and commit to marriage — before meeting face-to-face.

title: Doubt
summary: Jang Tae Su is a legendary criminal profiler in Korea. He was one of the first in his field and paved the way for criminal behavior analysts in the country. He has gained the absolute respect and trust within the police organization. At home, he is a single parent and raises his daughter by himself. Jang Tae Su works on a murder case and realizes that his daughter is involved in the case. The discovery shakes everything in his professional beliefs and his relationship with his daughter. To protect his daughter, Jang Tae Su struggles to reveal the truth.

title: Ceux qui rougissent
summary: Around ten high school students studying theatre see a replacement teacher arrive for a month. As they declaim Shakespeare while keeping their distance, the teacher cuts the rehearsal short. At the heart of an age where we often advance masked, our gaze too high or our heads too lowered, the question of the intimate imposes itself on them.

lead_actors: James Phelps, Oliver Phelps, Carla Hall, Jozef Youssef, Jeff Rawle
title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
summary: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking invites fans to mix, whisk and glaze their way to success, with professional pastry chefs competing against each other to create enchanting sweet treats, themed around the Harry Potter stories. Will the bakers be able to channel their inner Mrs Weasley? Or will their attempts be as successful as one of Seamus Finnigan's exploding cauldrons?

title: Informant – Angst über der Stadt
summary: Evidence of an impending attack in Hamburg puts the police authorities on alert. The focus is on the aging LKA man Gabriel Bach and the young BKA officer Holly Valentin. Out of necessity, they recruit the Afghan substitute teacher Raza Shaheen as an informant, who has previously had absolutely nothing to do with terrorism or organized crime. Under enormous time pressure, they work to save lives in the midst of a maelstrom of fear, prejudice and hysteria - and in doing so put themselves in great danger.

lead_actors: Irene Azuela, Azul Guaita, Ana Valeria Becerril, Andrea Chaparro
title: Como Agua para Chocolate
summary: Como Agua para Chocolate explores the idea that sometimes traditions can become a prison, an obstacle for love. Tita de la Garza and Pedro Múzquiz are two souls deeply in love, yet unable to be together due to entrenched family customs. The protagonists navigate a world of magical realism and rich flavors as Tita struggles between the destiny imposed on her by her family and her fight for love. Along the way, the audience will witness her greatest refuge: the kitchen. For Tita, her magical connection to cooking becomes an active resistance against oppression, allowing her to channel her deepest desires and passions into her recipes, transforming those who taste them.

lead_actors: Rachel Collard, Maryann Schmidt, Marie Kargiotis, Adrian Ramsay, Georgia Caceres
title: Dream Homes Revealed
summary: Set within the unique landscapes of Australia, this series uncovers the remarkable blend of architectural ingenuity and luxurious design that characterises Australian homes.

title: Ninja Warrior, le parcours des héros
Le Retour d'Anna Brodeur
summary: After 10 years of exile, Anna Brodeur is back in the lives of her loved ones, and finds reconnecting with her past a real challenge.

title: Ninja Warrior : Le Choc des Nations
Mistletoe Murders
summary: Emily Lane is a good-natured Christmas shop owner with a secret past. When local murders begin to pop up in Fletcher's Grove, Emily can't help but to use her unique talents from her past life to help solve murders that affect people in her new life. She crosses paths with Detective Sam Wilner who she starts to make a connection with, until he comes to learn there is more to Emily than meets the eye.

title: Unlock Your Love
summary: The pain and disappointment of love drives Rain and Love into each other's orbits. With the assistance of Dean and Pat, Love and Rain are able to get over the barrier erected by Rain's painful past.

title: Okutô kanjô sôsakan Shinno Akari
summary: Akari Shinno s a detective with a special ability. She is able to see the eight human emotions in color. Due to a case, she teams up with Detective Ryo Kazehaya. They work together to reveal the truth behind heinous crimes.

title: Karşılaşmalar
summary: The series brings together encounters in daily life that are considered "too much" with different guests.

title: Tătuțu
