summary: About 20 years before Clanul, Bebe Udrea (George Mihaita), aka "Macelaru" (The Butcher), aimed to build his own clan and rise to the top of the mafia. The series reveals his dangerous journey and the origins of beloved Clanul characters.

lead_actors: Данила Якушев, Анна Богомолова, Дарья Ленда, Марина Гончарова
title: Блонды
summary: The series "Blondes" will tell about the work of a secret special department for solving especially complex crimes in St. Petersburg. The agents have an extremely unusual cover - their office exists under the guise of the "Blondes" marriage agency. The department is supervised by an experienced investigator Smolov, who has gathered three completely different girls under his wing. This is a former employee of the Investigative Committee - rational Kiseleva, a bright and daring lover of horoscopes and men Gorskaya and uncompromising Boyko, a master of martial arts. Together they will have to not only catch offenders, but also learn to work in a team.

title: Another Journey to the West
summary: Wu Cheng'en vividly depicts a world full of fantasies and myths in his 16th-century novel Journey to the West. Some say his portrayal was not mere fiction, but drawn from personal experience. Join him and his companions on a legendary pilgrimage to the "Western Regions" as they seek their path of Enlightenment after many trials and suffering.

title: My Merry Marriage
summary: By showing various aspects of marriage such as divorce, remarriage, and graduation, it asks about the true meaning of 'happiness'. A delightful family drama that will resonate and laughter across all generations.

lead_actors: Juan Pablo Romero, Ana Victoria Dinapo
title: Dino Dex
summary: Dex is a 9-year-old artist, explorer, and ‘paleontologist in training'. Like Dan, Trek, and Dana before him, Dex uses his Dino Field Guide to magically see and study dinosaurs in the real world. But Dex envisions them a little differently. Thanks to his artistic eye, Dex wants to reconsider how dinosaurs looked and lived and he's not afraid to get right into the action to do it. Fortunately, he's got his geology-loving neighbor Kayla along for this prehistoric ride. Join Dex and Kayla as they re-examine and question everything we thought we knew about dinosaurs.

lead_actors: Kim Se Jung, Lee Jong Won, Shin Do Hyun, Baek Seong Cheol
title: Brewing Love
summary: Chae Yong-ju is a former member of the special forces in the military. She's physically and mentally strong and has her own unique cheerfulness. She is also good at hiding her true emotions. Now working as a salesperson for a liquor company for the past six years, she has been dubbed the sales king. Despite her dedication, her branch is on the verge of closing. To avoid the closure, she carries out a mission to sell a new beer made by brewmaster & CEO of the brewery company, Yun Min-ju. Min-ju is a sensitive man good at sensing other people's emotions. He lives in a peaceful, quiet rural area to focus on making beer. When Yong-ju appears in front of him, however, his life is about to change.

lead_actors: Frida Sofía Cruz Salinas, Mauro Guzmán, Nova Coronel, Iazua Larios, La Bruja de Texcoco
title: El secreto del río
summary: When a young boy arrives in a small Mexican village, an unlikely friendship blossoms with a local kid — and a dark secret seals their bond forever.

title: Tales From The Void
summary: Tales From The Void is an episodic horror anthology series adapted from the most viral and haunting stories from the depths of the internet. Based on stories from the r/NoSleep community, each tale blends genre thrills with social commentary to explore the darker side of the human psyche.From creepy dolls to unborn children, unexplained invasions to paranormal hauntings, unsolved mysteries to serial murders, Tales From The Void draws from a wide spectrum of horror sub-genres with each episode paying homage to a classic and cult films from the eighties and nineties.Unnerving, uncompromising, and rooted in character, Tales From The Void finds all the ways to keep you up at night.

title: MasterChef Portugal
summary: The biggest cooking competition in the world kicks off under the command of three of the most renowned Portuguese chefs to discover the best amateur chefs in the country. After a casting process, the MasterChef Portugal hopefuls will begin a series of weeks of competition, with challenges in the studio and grandiose tests in such special and emblematic locations of our country, our history and our traditions.

title: The Charlie Puth Show
summary: With the help of famous friends, Charlie Puth attempts to scale the zeitgeist and go beyond pop stardom to become a multi-hyphenate talent after being told it's no longer enough to just be a musician.

title: Apple My Love
summary: After getting her vision back, Kris sees a person in her dreams, but when she wakes up, the only thing she can remember are a pair of eyes. She starts drawing them to help her remember, but when she sees Karn for the first time, she recognizes that the pair in her dreams and Karn's are one and the same.

lead_actors: Deniz Baysal, Çağlar Ertuğrul, Şükran Ovalı, Timuçin Esen, Sarp Akkaya
title: Kalpazan
summary: Adem turns his life upside down with a surprise he makes for his son, Arda. What seems like an innocent gesture leads to an irreversible downfall in Adem's life, bringing him to the brink of losing his job, his wife Canan, and even his son. Things take a further turn for the worse with the arrival of his charismatic yet cunning brother, Kartal, during this difficult period. As the two brothers challenge the law, the only person who can bring about their downfall is Police Officer Ayşe. Kartal's unexpected encounter with Ayşe and his subsequent love for her will shift the balance entirely.

title: Las abogadas
summary: The story of 20-year-old lawyer Lola González Ruiz and her group of friends who challenged the Francoist dictatorship with the law at hand, from 1969 up to the Atocha killings in 1977.

title: Fugitives: Caught on Tape
summary: "Fugitives Caught on Tape" follows law enforcement officers as they pursue fugitives on the run. With unprecedented access to a multitude of cameras including body and dash cams, security and traffic cams, personal doorbell footage, smartphone cams and more, viewers get a look at how agencies track down fleeing suspects.

title: Life and Dirt
summary: A man's desire to make it quick leads him to a race against time to preserve his life while hiding his dirt.

title: Tenday
summary: #Tenday is the first immersive reality show in China featuring 39 people with different backgrounds in a world like squid game.

title: Anakhot
summary: Exploring the intersection of Thai culture and future tech, this anthology delves into the gripping moral quandaries sparked by their inevitable clash.

title: La mente del poder
summary: This Argentine thriller follows the president-elect's psychologist, who is extorted by a mysterious organization that threatens to reveal his darkest secret unless he gets the newly elected chief executive to resign.

lead_actors: Woranuch Wongsawan, Cindy Bishop, Pitchapa Phanthumchinda
title: Don't Come Home
summary: A mother moves into her family's eerie old mansion, where she confronts dark secrets from the past after her young daughter mysteriously vanishes.

title: G&T
summary: Friends since childhood, Giulio and Tommy are at a college party, when, a little tipsy, they end up kissing in the bathrooms of the place. Since then, Tommaso does everything he can to erase that episode and even Giuls from his existence. But, inevitably, five years later the lives of the two intertwine again.

lead_actors: Hazal Kaya, Çağlar Ertuğrul, Ebru Aykaç, Umut Kaya, Melisa Döngel
title: Sorgu
summary: "How many lies does a truth consist of?" Interrogator Cihan's father is found dead. The file of this suspicious death is given to Cihan's colleague Metin. As the truths about the file emerge, the deep love between Cihan and Metin will be tested. Because there is no one in this story who will not become a potential murder suspect!

lead_actors: Samuel Silva, Andrei Marques, Patrick Congo, Wendy Queiroz, Maria Ibraim
title: Os Quatro da Candelária
summary: To be remembered, they must first be seen. This series reimagines a real police-led massacre in Rio de Janeiro through the eyes of four children.

title: It's Florida, Man
summary: This irreverent late-night comedy series brings to life unbelievable ripped-from-the-headlines tales of the Sunshine State - straight from the people who live there. Featuring interviews from everyday Floridians and playful recreations starring a rotating cast of actors and comedians, including Anna Faris, Jake Johnson, Randall Park, Juliette Lewis, Sam Richardson, Ego Nwodim and more, this hilarious and outrageous series sheds light on the viral, wacky and weird. Covering diverse topics - from mermaids to witches, extreme fantasies and feral bunnies with equal parts humor and heart, IT'S FLORIDA, MAN is a love letter to the beaches, backwaters, and especially the people of a misunderstood yet magical state.

title: Cleddau
summary: Cleddau is an emotionally charged thriller that sees DI Ffion Lloyd partnering up with her ex-lover DS Rick Sheldon, to find out who is responsible for murder in a coastal town in West Wales.They set about finding the killer while revisiting the past with devastating results. Cleddau is a forensic examination of a love affair that may have ended but remains raw and unresolved.

lead_actors: Woo Do Hwan, Lee Yoo Mi, Oh Jung Se, Kim Hae Sook
title: Mr. Plankton
summary: Lee Yoo Mi stars as a bride-to-be whose medical conditions threatens her marriage to a family obsessed with continuing their grand lineage.

title: Bad Together
summary: Bad Together follows the evolving friendship between two gay men as they learn to accept and love both themselves and one another.

title: Death's First Love
summary: This drama is a love story between Kataoka Sakuya, a grim reaper who comes to the human world for the first time, and Mochizuki Nayuki, a woman who lost her father at a young age and has devoted her life to raising her only remaining family—her younger brother. As they meet, they gradually come to understand each other, and slowly, they begin to fall in love. However, a fate that will dramatically change their lives awaits them both…

title: Шеф
summary: Kai is a talented and ambitious chef in a trendy Moscow restaurant. He hopes to receive the title of the best chef in Russia and maintains a high level of service and service. One day, Kai comes into conflict with a boorish visitor, who turns out to be a high-ranking official, and loses his job. Desperate, Kai gets a job as a cook in a women's colony in the hope that eventually he will be able to open his own restaurant and win the country's main culinary competition.

title: n00b
summary: n00b depicts a 2005 Gore teenager's social downfall from an all-around-party animal after he is outed as gay and loses his place on the college's rugby team.

title: Dcera národa
summary: Karel Havlíček Borovský dies leaving his daughter Zdeňka an orphan. She is taken care of by Czech revivalists led by František Ladislav Rieger. Revivalists want to make her a perfect symbol of the tenderness of Czech culture but rebellious Zdeňka wants to live her life according to her ideas. When she falls in love with a Polish officer of the Austrian army she turns in public eyes from a girl loved by the crowd literally to a traitor of the nation and a whore. Will Zdeňka manage to assert her romantic love, or will she give in to the pressure and marry a boring landowner from a good Czech family?

title: Dadao Chaotian
summary: A person who has traveled all over the green mountains is still young, but when he suddenly looks back, the sword is just between his eyebrows, but in his heart. Jing Jiu, who lives in a mountain village in Chaotian Continent, unexpectedly receives Liu Shisui, who is born with Taoism, as a book boy. The two came to the Qingshan Sect by chance, but they were criticized because the "mediocre" Jing Jiu actually took the "extraordinary genius" Liu Shisui as his servant. At the sword inheritance conference, Jing Jiu also met Zhao Layue, a Sanwu girl from Shenmo Peak. Jing Jiu, who is surprisingly "lazy", just wants to practice quietly, but little does he know that fate will involve the three of them in a huge river and lake dispute... Under the Taixu, are the green mountains far away? Not far.

title: Before They Kill Again
summary: To stop a madman before he kills - or kills again - sometimes the only option is to get inside the mind of a monster. These cops engage in high-stakes, one-on-one battles of wits with the most dangerous and deadly criminals, predicting their next moves before they strike. In these psychological life-or-death chess matches, only one will emerge victorious. Everyone is playing for keeps, and a single wrong move can have deadly consequences.

title: Feuds Turned Fatal
summary: Same here to avoid to many feuds: Retaliation and revenge unfold as friendships turn into furious feuds. As each conflict escalates, former friends, family members, and partners spiral from minor disagreements to murder. Both sides of the feud share their stories of revenge gone wrong.

lead_actors: Havana Joy Josephine Braun, Damian Hardung, Rick Okon, Stipe Erceg, Dennis Scheuermann
title: Love Sucks
summary: Trained as a boxer by her father, Zelda fights in the family boxing ring against fairground visitors. That's where she falls for the sensitive and sophisticated Ben who hides a secret - he's a vampire. As Zelda is faced with this horrible realisation, she learns another secret closer to home - her family are vampire slayers and a brutal feud between the two families has existed for generations. While the tension between the two families grows, does Ben and Zelda's love stand a chance?

lead_actors: Jermaine Richards, Trevaunn Richards, Heather Gallant, Lucas Lopez, Hassan Phills
title: The Office Movers
summary: Everett & Eric Saunders run a dysfunctional office-moving company. The goal is to build the business, sell it & never move furniture again.

title: Good or Bad Dong Jae
summary: Seo Dong Jae is a prosecutor and works in the Cheongju District Prosecutors' Office. He is ambitious and places a priority on his success as a prosecutor. Nevertheless, he is not completely cold hearted as a person. Due to the label given to him as a corrupt prosecutor, his future as a prosecutor is not bright at all. While mired in trouble over a redevelopment case, he takes on a high school student murder case. He begins to walk a fine line between his intuition as a prosecutor and instinct as an opportunist.This is a spin-off of "Stranger" (2017) drama.

title: Baddies Caribbean Auditions
summary: Executive Producer Natalie Nunn, along with music sensation Shenseea, reality stars Spice & Bobby Lytes and the Baddies East all-stars, help to choose the cast for the next season of Zeus Network's original hit Baddies franchise. Also featuring special guest, NeNe Leakes.

lead_actors: Natalie Nunn, Gia Mayham, Scotlynd Ryan, Jelaminah Lanier, Damerlin Baez
title: Baddies Caribbean Reunion
summary: The Baddies come together in LA to relive the Caribbean. Hosted by rap artist Saucy Santana and Janeisha John.

title: Our Beautiful Summer
summary: The story of A Reum, Da Un, Yu Ri and our three siblings who were born as quadruplets and lost the youngest, Na Ra, and became three, and the lonely summer when no one was there, meeting and falling in love again and becoming happy.

title: Cook with Luke
summary: Your home of quick, tasty, good food. Cooking healthy and delicious meals has never been easier with Luke Hines in your kitchen.

lead_actors: Venice May Wong, Kaido Lee Roberts, Peja Anne, Eva Blythe, Misha Bautista
title: The 4PM Club
summary: The 4PM Club follows the hijinks, romances, and friendships of a group of Attaway Middle School students who find themselves in the unenviable position of spending their afternoons stuck in detention.

title: Tono To Inu
summary: In the warring states era, there were those who performed feats resembling demons or gods—though that is now a thing of the past. The Lord now lives in a completely declined and impoverished tenement. The Lord who has fallen into such circumstances, encounters a single dog. Feeling pity for its peculiar short-limbed appearance, the Lord reaches out a hand, but soon becomes amused by its mischievous behaviors. Thus begins the cohabitation of the fearsome Lord and cheerful dog, bringing peace and harmony to their lives!

lead_actors: Robert Clotworthy, Marty Lagina, Rick Lagina, Tony McMahon, Doug Crowell
title: Tales From Oak Island
summary: Tales From Oak Island explores the most captivating theories, legendary figures, and momentous events surrounding Oak Island.  Offering new information and key flashbacks, the series dives deeper than ever before into the incredible people, fascinating theories, and critical discoveries made by the many searchers who have devoted their lives to unlocking the locale's many secrets and treasures.  What could be hidden in the vault deep under Oak Island?  Priceless religious relics connected to the Knights Templar?  A stolen haul of silver from a sunken Spanish galleon?  The spoils from a colonial-era military victory in the Caribbean?  Could they all be connected to the same mysterious group of medieval conspirators?   Mysteries will be explored and secrets will be revealed by those who have studied, explored and lived through one of the longest running treasure hunts known to man.

lead_actors: Senan Jennings, Kathryn McKiernan, Joseph McGucken, Kate Brady, Ally Ní Chiaráin
title: The Unreal
summary: It's a bit like Bosco meets Stranger Things as RTÉ One broadcasts a brand-new four-part mini-series for the whole family - and mixes the nostalgic with the surreal.Set in Lough Dan in Wicklow, where the Kelly clan decamp to for a reluctant family Holiday. But the dilapidated holiday park isn't as dull as it initially seems to 12-year-old Kevin, his screen-obsessed sister Katie and their distracted parents Mary and Tom. In fact, before long, things get really weird.

title: Joseline's Cabaret Texas
summary: The Puerto Rican Princess takes her cabaret to Texas where everything is bigger...including the drama.

title: Hetero
summary: A close-knit queer friend group, struggle with the task of diversifying the line up of their school's GSA, Gay Straight Alliance, with more than themselves, before the two week deadline that will lead to the club's demise.

title: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers
summary: In season one, athlete pranks include the NFL's Baker Mayfield from the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, who goes undercover to blow the minds of Bucs diehards.

title: Gastronauts
summary: Culinary masterminds compete in a series of challenges created by the most unhinged comedians.

title: Regreso a las Sabinas
summary: Gracia returns to Las Sabinas, where she grapples with a terrible secret and reunites with Miguel.

title: Shatter Belt
summary: From creator James Byrkit comes a collection of stories from the other side of consciousness. A modern mind bender for a new generation, Shatter Belt dives head first into the deep end of questions concerning our relationship to reality, our connection to the universe, and the endlessly weird paradox of free will.

title: Wonder Pets: In The City
summary: Wonder Pets: In The City introduces a trio of heroes: Izzy the Guinea Pig, Tate the Snake and Zuri the Bunny. These heroic classroom pets live in a kindergarten in New York City and travel all around the globe in their amazing "Jetcar" to rescue animals in musical, mini-opera-themed adventures. When the going gets tough, Izzy, Tate and Zuri always remember to combine their talents and abilities and work together to save the day — because together, there's nothing they can't do!

lead_actors: Markiplier, Franz Drameh, Eve Harlow, Lio Tipton
title: The Edge of Sleep
summary: When a night watchman finishes his shift at work, he is terrified to discover that everyone in the world who went to sleep the previous night has died. Now he and a band of survivors must stay awake and uncover the secret of this global epidemic, before they fall asleep.

title: Honeymoon Photographer
summary: Newlyweds Adhir and Zoya Irani's Maldives trip turns tragic when Adhir's body is found buried on a beach. Suspicion falls on their friends, family, and Zoya herself as the investigation unfolds.

title: 1000 Babies
summary: Enter a cradle of mysteries where a man with a dark past manipulates multiple lives through a series of cryptic letters and deadly games.

title: Kiedy ślub?
summary: A story about parting, recovering from the "end of the world", navigating modern relationships and relationships, sex and the reality of constant change. "When is the wedding?" is a comedy-drama that naturally tells about the world of today's young people, with contemporary dialogues and ironic, intelligent humour.

title: The Last Woodsmen
summary: The Last Woodsmen takes us deep into the secluded wilderness with these courageous and highly skilled loggers as they literally risk their lives. It's a rarely explored, dangerous business which translates to incredibly engrossing television.On a floating barge hundreds of miles from civilization, veteran logger Jared Douglas puts everything on the line to harvest the largest timber in the world. One misstep in this high-risk industry could cost tens of thousands of dollars, or even a life. Joining him at the edge of the world is a tight-knit crew of lumbermen who, with only axes and hand-held power saws, take down massive, highly valuable trees that can be worth up to $70K each.

title: Ghosts Off Grid
summary: Ghosts Off Grid dives deep into the idea that everything around us is made of energy, even our own bodies. When we die, where does that energy go? In this series, the hosts search for electrical impulses away from the built infrastructure.

title: Остров сокровищ. Знаки судьбы
summary: Participants literally sail to an uninhabited island to get its treasures. All the heroes are divided into three tribes according to the elements of water, air and earth. They will not only have to survive in unusual conditions for a whole month, but also pass tests to get resources, immunity or other bonuses. Each episode, the heroes gather in an amphitheater, where they decide who will leave the game. Only four will make it to the final, and only one of them will be able to take the island's treasures for 10 million rubles.

title: Yorkshire Air 999
summary: Yorkshire Air 999 gives viewers exclusive access to the high-risk, high-adrenaline world of some of the U.K.'s most advanced medics, saving lives in a place of savage beauty.

lead_actors: Saran Naraprasertkul, Chayanit Chansangavej, Sanya Kunakorn, Toni Rakkaen, Mahidol Pibulsonggram
title: Good Doctor
summary: A man with autistic disorder and a savant syndrome overcomes bias and discrimination by the society and becomes a paediatrician by utilizing his exceptional abilities that the disorder brings.

lead_actors: Michelle Rodríguez, Diana Bovio, Luz Aldan, Mauricio Isaac, Omar Elizondo
title: Somos Oro
summary: Vanessa and Marilú decide to leave behind the messed-up world they come from and set out to beat the system no matter the consequences. But when they finally start to see the fruits of their ‘work', they will realize that sometimes the mess isn't in the circumstances but within themselves.

title: Du gewinnst hier nicht die Million bei Stefan Raab
summary: In each show Raab competes against one of five candidates. Only who can answer all the questions correctly and prevail in duels against the the legend in duels has the chance to win the gigantic prize money: 1 million euros!

title: Les enfants sont rois
summary: A reality-TV has-been turned mommy vlogger fills her social media feeds with daily updates about her two precocious children. When her older daughter disappears and is thought kidnapped, the bereft momfluencer faces a police investigation that calls into question the very existence of child.

title: Chutney Sambar
summary: An orphaned street vendor unexpectedly becomes part of his wealthy stepbrother's family, navigating the challenges of gaining acceptance in his new circumstances.

title: Sram
summary: Following the lives of teenagers that attend high school, everyday issues of teenage life, such as friendships, romantic relationships and mental health.Croatian remake of the Norwegian series Skam

title: My Perfectt Husband
summary: Saraswathi believes she is the only woman in her husband Bharathi's life. However, a marriage alliance for their son brings back a blast from the past.

lead_actors: Joo Ji Hoon, Jung Yoo Mi, Kim Ye Won, Lee Si Woo
title: Love Your Enemy
summary: A reunion romance that takes place over 15 years when two men and women, who loved each other passionately when they were in school but had to make a painful breakup due to antagonism between families and the mischief of fate, meet again.

lead_actors: Im Ji Yun, Choo Young Woo
title: The Tale of Lady Ok
summary: A work that contains the fierce survival and success of a female slave during the Joseon Dynasty, and depicts the story of a woman whose name, status, and even her husband are fake.

title: Love Is Blind: Argentina
summary: In this groundbreaking reality series, men and women pop the question to their soulmates — all while having no idea of what they actually look like.

title: Papás por Conveniencia
summary: Papás por Conveniencia follows single father Tino and successful businesswoman Aidé as they form a family born out of convenience when Tino discovers he is the father of Aidé's twin teenagers. Tino takes a job with Aidé to get to know his children, but his family's move into Aidé's home creates a chaotic environment, forcing them to navigate their complex relationship while overcoming obstacles to find true love and happiness.

title: Ghostbreakers
summary: A group of bumbling paranormal investigators goes to spooky places and gets entangled in bizarre, inane, and absurd nocturnal misadventures.

title: Familier som vores
summary: In a not-too-distant future, Denmark faces total evacuation due to rising water levels. As the nation prepares to leave their homes, high school student Laura must choose between her divorced parents and the boy she's fallen in love with.

title: Toon In with Me
summary: Cartoons, sketches, and pop culture.

lead_actors: Margarida Vila-Nova, Rafael Morais, Lara Dutta, Helena Caldeira, Paula de Magalhães
title: Irreversível
summary: A tormented psychologist, Júlia Mendes, and a determined inspector, Pedro Sousa, team up to solve a brutal murder of a young girl in a coastal town. As they solve the crime, they battle their own demons and try to keep their lives intact. In a city where everyone is hiding something and is willing to do anything to protect their loved ones, the search for the truth may cost more than Julia imagines, since from the moment the secrets of the past are revealed, everything becomes irreversible. Does love justify everything?

lead_actors: Greg Cipes, Liv Andrusier, Rebekah Hinds
title: Beast Boy: Lone Wolf
summary: Action-comedy shorts follow Beast Boy, embarking on his first solo adventures, proving he can be a superhero without the Teen Titans – even if no one believes him!

title: Brigada Nimic
summary: In a humorous approach, the series follows the small and insignificant cases that the policemen of the Nothing Brigade: Arrow, Giovanni, Carmola and Toma have to solve.

lead_actors: Tomoaki Maeno, Ryota Takeuchi, Ai Fairouz
title: Tokyo Override
summary: When a lonely hacker gets entangled with a group of underground couriers, they uncover the dark truth lurking beneath Tokyo's seemingly perfect facade.

title: Asaf
summary: Asaf is an ordinary driver with strong moral values, trying to find a way to get his life back on track after his separation from his wife and son. Following an unfortunate traffic accident, he gets entangled with the wrong people and finds himself sucked into a world of mystery. His life will never be the same.

title: Alienated
summary: Teenage outcast Luna has difficulties fitting in at school. A loner, she is bullied and feels despised for being ‘ugly' and ‘poor'. She really wants everyone to like her - or at least Jake, whom she has a crush on. A freak accident one day forces her down an unexpected path through alternate realities in search of happiness, only to face dreadful consequences.

title: Rap:Public
summary: RAP:PUBLIC invites you to a hip-hop survival world you have never seen before. It's a real hip-hop survival show where the participants compete and survive using rap as their weapon. The rappers form their own 'blocks' and compete as a team to survive in a society disconnected from the outside world. In this society where cooperation and competition coexist, they can only decide their fate through games that use rap. The final winning block will be given 300,000 dollars as a prize and become the first owner of RAP:PUBLIC.

title: Ratamo
summary: A fast-paced action-thriller about the Finnish Security Intelligence Service detective Arto Ratamo who is assigned a very delicate case that threatens the national security of Finland. The investigation gets complicated as it seems that the Prime Minister of Finland is either being blackmailed by a Russian oligarch - or has he leaked the classified information himself?

title: Charlie the Interviewer of Things
summary: A funny and clumsy sheep interviews all sorts of everyday objects.

title: Marry You
summary: Level seven government worker Jung Ha-na's dream is to retire peacefully, but her feisty attitude lands her in the Marriage Promotion Team at Injeong City Hall, a role she finds baffling as she doesn't believe in marriage herself. To make matters worse, her ex-boyfriend Ki-jun, whom she nearly married three years ago, appears as her new team leader, adding to her disbelief. Desperate to escape the team, Ha-na is tasked with marrying off local bachelor Cheol-hee. Though Cheol-hee initially refuses, believing he's not suited for marriage, Ha-na's determination gradually softens his heart. As they open up to each other, Ha-na and Cheol-hee, who both doubted their worthiness of marriage, find themselves questioning if they can take the plunge after all. Will Ha-na and Cheol-hee finally gather the courage to believe in love and marriage?

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
summary: Follows Dept of Homeland Security officers at five different airports across the country, from San Francisco, Detroit, Newark, Atlanta, and Honolulu, as they search for contraband both leaving and coming into the US.

title: 90 Day: The Last Resort Between the Sheets
summary: 90 Day: The Last Resort Between the Sheets is an unfiltered, one-hour after-show that dives deeper into each week's episodes. Cast members from this season of 90 Day: The Last Resort will provide behind-the-scenes commentary and personal reflections on their experiences at the resort. Through never-before-seen footage, and unique therapist interviews, viewers will get an exclusive insider look at what really went down when the cameras were and weren't rolling. This has all the juicy secrets, hilarious anecdotes and emotional moments as your favorite couples dissect jaw dropping scenes.

lead_actors: Stephanie Hsu, Zosia Mamet, Tommy Martinez, Michael Angarano
title: Laid
summary: A woman finds out her former lovers are dying in unusual ways and must go back through her sex timeline to confront her past in order to move forward – "Laid" is a f*cked up rom-com where the answer to "why can't I find love, is there something wrong with me?" is a resounding "Yes. There is. The problem is definitely you."

title: Dünentod - Ein Nordsee-Krimi
summary: As a rough guy, the idiosyncratic Tjark Wolf investigates in the rough landscape of East Frisia. At his side is the police chief Femke Folkmer, with whom he - of course - forms an unequal investigator duo. They make a grisly discovery on the North Sea coast - and little do they know that this will begin their collaboration in a series of murder cases that will push them to their limits - or even beyond.

title: Штурм
summary: On the occasion of the Day of Defenders of Ukraine, ICTV presents the first Ukrainian action series Sturm about the work of a special SBU unit that counteracts the most serious crimes against the national security of Ukraine.

lead_actors: Lee Min Ki, Han Ji Hyeon, Lee Yi Kyung, Jun Bae Soo
title: Face Me
summary: A medical mystery thriller that traces the truth of the incident of a famous plastic surgeon, who had a reputation as a righteous man, who fell into the abyss after being caught up in an unexpected incident and underwent reconstructive plastic surgery for crime victims.

title: Большое переселение
summary: In the new reality show "The Big Relocation", the village family of the Morozovs will challenge the most glamorous and large family of show business - the family of Dzhigan and Oksana Samoilova. The Morozovs will go to live in the luxurious Dzhigan mansion, and the Dzhigan family will go to the village "apartments" of the Morozovs. Will those who are used to a luxurious life be able to adapt to the countryside? And will those who have never seen luxury be able to survive in luxury conditions? TNT will swap the two families and check out what came of it.

lead_actors: Vanessa Scalera, Paolo De Vita, Giulia Perulli, Imma Villa, Federica Pala
title: Qui non è Hollywood
summary: One of the most famous cases in Italian true crime involves the disappearance of a girl named Sarah.

lead_actors: Masakazu Morita, Yuki Matsuoka, Hiroki Yasumoto, Noriaki Sugiyama, Kentaro Ito
title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War
summary: After an awe-inspiring battle with Ichibei Hyousube—leader of the Soul Society's Royal Guard—the powerful Yhwach moves into the final stage of his master plan. He aims to slay the Soul King, the being whose very existence maintains the status quo of three worlds: Hueco Mundo, the Soul Society, and the realm of humans that Ichigo Kurosaki and his closest friends hail from. Conquering his own bout with the remainder of the Royal Guard, Uryuu Ishida joins Yhwach in his efforts to create a new world in his image.With a flood of resolution and newfound power, Ichigo rushes to stop Yhwach from accomplishing his ultimate goal and save the countless lives within the three existing realms. But Ichigo has a complicated lineage, one that leaves him susceptible to Yhwach's sinister influence.Meanwhile, in a final desperate gambit, Jirou Sakuranosuke Shunsui Kyouraku, the newly promoted head captain of the Soul Society's combat corps, enlists the help of an old enemy whose immense power may turn the tide of battle.

title: Press Start!
summary: Sunny and his sister Rue are all about the exciting, fast-paced world of "24 KARAT QUEST" video game. Athletic, brave and funny, Super Rabbit Boy is the hero of this fantastical Game-World. When the siblings end up able to play IN the game, their life is flipped upside down.

title: The Empress of Ayodhaya
summary: Jinda, daughter of the lord of Lopburi, and excellent in appearance and intellect, was born to the highest of destinies. It is her great duty to seize the throne from Phra Chairacha, the warrior king of Ayodhaya, and return it to her own Lavo dynasty line. Jinda must therefore offer herself as one of four royal concubines, inevitably separating her from her lover Wamon. Her journey has her face the other three royal concubines of foreign origin, Jittrawadi, La-ongkham, and Tanyong, each vying for the position of queen consort.

lead_actors: Ирина Старшенбаум, Сергей Гилёв, Павел Прилучный, Татьяна Яхина, Павел Попов
title: 13 Клиническая. Начало
summary: USSR, 1970s. The world's first mystical hospital opens its doors to the demonically possessed. Doctor Yana heads the clinic to return her son, who was kidnapped by otherworldly forces.

title: Society of Virtue
summary: Adventures of the greatest heroes, facing the problems you probably didn't even know they had... and maybe would rather not know.

title: Cuisine Ouverte

The banker, the prosecutor, and the governor are all involved in some strange gambling game, the meaning of which is hidden from the uninitiated.

Now an inconvenient witness, Quentin has no choice but to become a hitman himself, working in tandem with Blanche.

summary: Nadya lives in the village with her parents. One day she meets a Muscovite, Vitaly Bolshakov, and immediately falls in love with the young and promising guy. Despite having a fiancé at home, the girl is determined to conquer the capital and the heart of her new lover. Meanwhile, in Moscow, Vitaly has his own life, work, and beloved woman. The persistent Nadya is not ready to just give him up to another, so she intends to do everything in her power to win her place in the sun. But will this bring her happiness?

Collision between the classical culture and our modern tics, this new series is as satiric as educational.

Nicole has married Manuel and has become a powerful woman, owner of the Marbella nightlife and the fashionable nightclub, Nicole's. She has managed to gather the entire jet. Everything points to a perfect night, but the arrival of a stranger surprises everyone: it is Eva.

title: Ein Fall für Katharina Tempel

Under the leadership of her new superior, Chief Inspector Georg König, she begins the murder investigation in the Hanseatic city. She is supported by her new colleague Dela Tahiri, her husband Volker, the celebrated press spokesman for the Hamburg police, and her best friend and prosecutor Golda Hopkins.

title: Neuf Meufs
summary: Nine snapshots during the day of nine women of different ages who live in the same Parisian building without necessarily knowing each other, who desire, dare, doubt, amuse and touch us.

title: H24

title: Bête noire
summary: Bête noire presents the side effects of an unforgivable act committed by Jérémy, a 16-year-old teenager. With the help of the investigating psychiatrist-coroner, his mother tries to figure out how her son, a seemingly trouble-free boy, came to commit an act of hate. What was the trigger for this nightmare? When did everything change? Together, the two women make it their mission to unravel the mystery of Jérémy.

title: Têtard
summary: Têtard wants to be the initiatory journey of these two parents in the making, awaiting this unidentified object which is their unborn child.

title: Mike

Mike is a singer who had a fleeting glory in the early 2000s: he sold a million singles of his song "Dis-le moi en face," a very trendy French pop tune. But since then his inspiration, his fans and his savings have all left him.

title: Enjoy !
summary: It follows a delivery boy for fictional home-delivery app Enjoy!, who lands a dream job as an intern on a 24-hour news channel with a reactionary editorial line. His destiny soon collides with Igor, an ambitious young lawyer who dreams of defending great cases.

title: Tout est vrai (ou presque)

title: Eppure cadiamo felici
summary: Gioia is 16 years old: full adolescence, a terrible period for everyone. But she is also affected by all the changes that her mother, Sabrina, young and beautiful, forces her to face.

title: H24 , 24 heures de la vie d'une femme
summary: Inspired by twenty-four real facts, a series written by twenty-four European authors who chronicle violence against women on a daily basis, from the most banal incident to the most terrible tragedy. Twenty-four daring films interpreted by twenty-four exceptional actresses.

title: Gazebo
summary: Marie and Loulou move away from the deafening noise of the city. While Loulou dreams of self-sufficiency, Marie wonders how she will be able to meet her professional commitments and have an exciting social life.

title: Or noir
summary: A group of four thieves from the cities pull off a masterful blow and steal millions of euros in gold bars. How to dispose of this nest egg which stirs up all covetousness? The owners of the gold, the city bosses, the local mafia gangs, the more or less crooked police, everyone wants to recover the treasure and everyone is looking for them.

title: L'Effet secondaire
summary: The side effect is Anouk, Marco, Fanny, Alex, Safa, Emma, Ahmed and many others who are going through high school with their heads filled with plans, doubts and intense emotions! It is also the effect of friendships that transform, unexpected rivalries, loves that are born, adults who take up too much space and trials that weaken. In the corridors of the school as in the courtyards, people stick together and confront each other, have fun and intimidate each other ... In short, it's everyday life, with its ups and downs, turned in a way rhythmic - in the manner of docurality - to capture hyper spontaneous slices of life.

title: Qu'est-ce qu'on attend pour être heureux ?
Bébéatrice
summary: Self-proclaimed "princess"of the family, Bébéatrice reigns supreme! Surrounded by adults, she has assimilated to everything since she first learned to speak.

title: Nemausus
summary: The journey of a Latin-speaking Roman who has traveled through time from Ancient Rome until Nîmes (France) in 2018.

title: Townies

Meet Boy, a 13-year old underdog dreamer who hopes to be the world's first hang-WOMAN executioner. Together with her fellow teens, they live it up before they have to grow up, get married, and get killed...at the ripe age of fifteen.

title: Zone 42

summary: Melanie, a young woman who seemed to have everything, lost everything in her life. Just because driving through a tunnel with a 'time distortion' caused her life clock to disappear for a year! Everything she ever had, everything she ever got But her life was changed. It was someone's fault that caused it to be so. She received a 'special thing' instead of an apology, a 'watch necklace' that can turn time forward or backward five times. But with one condition, if she wants to change the date, she must 'kill' one life to use it to get through.

title: Rang Badalti Odhani
summary: Khanak a simple, spirited young woman, living in village Dhulwadi, Bhuj , is newly married to her sweetheart, Suraj. In a tragic accident, Suraj is killed. The man who caused Suraj's death is Shantanu Khandelwal , the younger son of a business tycoon called Sunil Khandelwal. Under pressure from the village council (panchayat) of Dhulwadi, Shantanu marries Khanak and takes her to his home in the city. Khanak struggles to adjust to the unfamiliar environment, while Shantanu learns to accept his responsibilities. Meanwhile, Shantanu's arrogant mother Madhavi and sister-in- law Khushboo conspire to separate him from Khanak. This does not happen and Shaan and Khanak fall in love in the end.However, despite it all Khanak joins the family bond watch the family blossom their love and care for each other.

title: The Blubburbs
summary: For centuries, a whale has been swallowing sailors, explorers, scientists and tourists. Now, they're all stuck together in a dysfunctional community inside the whale with neighbors they never asked for. The Blubburbs follows a handful of whale dwellers as they plot to escape the whale, deal with new characters the whale swallows, and generally try to tolerate each other's nonsense.

title: Ça, c'est Paris

But unlike his father, Dary, Gaspard has not been able to perpetuate the reputation of the establishment. The arrival of a new investor, accompanied by his son, will shake up Gaspard and profoundly change the lives and destinies of the entire Tout-Paris team.

summary: Between insurmountable complexes, thwarted love affairs, difficulty fitting in or false rumors, a group of twelve schoolchildren tell their stories every day. We go from laughter to tears we help each other and we always find a solution at François Truffaut College!

Five minutes a day, wedged between work and family life, sketching out the year that will see these two looking for, finding or missing each other. More than just a matter of time, 18h30 is above all a setback.

summary: Géolocaliser l'amour is the series adaptation of the eponymous novel by poems by Simon Boulerice. Through a succession of sexual conquests, we accompany Simon in his nomenclature of disappointments, emotions and disarray that pave the way for his search for a soul mate (or a one-night stand) on dating apps. . Behind the telling of these stories, each more anecdotal than the other, hides a deep loneliness and a need to feel wanted. Simon can only rely on the loyalty of his best friend, Jocelyn, and Siri to get him to say "I love you" without panicking. Will he be able to find love in the age of smart phones?

summary: After 10 years of living together, two adored children and a dog, Romane and Philippe have separated. From this unique adventure, they made a film: "L'Amour flou". So here they are installed in this strange life, which in many ways turns out to be miraculous: the threat of separating no longer exists since it is done, the tensions between Philippe and Romane seem to have disappeared and they now speak the language. friendship. Children, on the other hand, seem to be bathed in happiness, with both parents close at hand. But the daily life of the Rebbot-Bohringer family is as crazy and vague as ever.

The following year, the next team arrives at the Showa Base station and a miraculous reunion occurs between a dog handler accompanying the new tean and two dogs, Taro and Shiro, that are brothers.

summary: The series brings to the fore an original love story, between two mature people, caught between two completely different worlds, but who have the chance to rebuild their lives, next to each other and find happiness beyond all the hardships they have had and continues to take part. Ştefan (Adi Nartea), a former footballer in a top team from Great Britain, used to the rhythm of the luxurious life in the city, but divorced and the father of a teenage child, arrives in the idyllic village where Anda (Michaela Prosan), a single mother, respected doctor in the community where life has a different rhythm. The two end up experiencing a totally unexpected love. Dark secrets, jealousies, intrigues and lies of all kinds will stand in their way every step of the way until they find their way to each other, in a place where people live and love by different rules.

summary: A Fluffy Pony named Fluffle Puff

summary: Winter 1915, a French trench was shelled, all the soldiers were buried leaving only one survivor. Underground, he manages to extract himself and crawl into a hole leading to a tunnel. Then begins a journey which will embark our soldier in the mysterious village of Gliwensbourg, in 1925 ...

Weaving together CGI, archival footage, and expert testimony—and with up to four incredible stories per one-hour episode—it's a wild ride as these incredible outposts gradually reveal their secrets.

At first, it looks like her life is ruined. But Donna isn't so easily defeated. With her best friend and roommate, Milou, she makes her own video and launches a counterattack against pick-up artist Pascal and all the toxic incels on the internet. She announces that within a month she'll have more followers than Pascal—a mere 1.5 million, after all.

Her boyfriend, her cousin, a wine merchant, a museum guard. The list of those she pushes to the limit grows every day. But ultimately, the first to suffer is Iris.

summary: Ren Kosaka arrives in Japan to take up a special temporary lecturer position at an art university in Kamakura, Japan. Like butterflies that surround a flower, he is surrounded by other people. One day, he meets a certain woman and, because of her, his emotions begin to change. Even though he knows it will hurt ... nevertheless.

Helped by Alan the bard, he will do everything to thwart the plans of the King of Brocéliande. On their way, they will meet a series of colorful characters like Blööm and Pace, two elves trying to cover up the crime of a knight of the Round Table that they have committed; as well as Ferrigno and Zif, an orc and a goblin, soldiers of the army of Logre.

summary: Get ready to embark on a transformative journey of creativity and resilience when Budget Battlers premieres on Wednesday, December 4, at 8.30pm on Channel 9  and 9Now. Hosted by former Block favourites, Jess Eva and Norm Hogan, this groundbreaking new series tackles full-blown makeovers with an unprecedented challenge: transforming four different Aussie homes in four weeks on the tightest budget yet seen on Australian television. As inflation, soaring living costs and interest rate increases keep the idea of home renovation out of reach for many, Budget Battlers arrives to prove that dreams can still come true – on a budget. The Budget Battlers team gears up with just $10,000 per home, a group of selfless volunteers and only five working days, to inspire viewers with jaw-dropping transformations, changing the lives of those who need it the most.

title: Från Insidan

Inside the institution, a life and death power struggle is going on: who is your friend and who can you really trust? Through the conversations with the prison psychologist, hope arises for a better life - but how difficult is it to break away from a criminal lifestyle and take the step to another life?

On the other, a brilliant surgeon with explosive doses of cynicism, trying to return to surgery after a trauma. United by an unexpected and dangerous situation, they end up forming an unbeatable medical duo.

Zhenya's husband believes that here, far from everyone, they will finally be happy. However, in her native land, the heroine unexpectedly meets Artyom, her first love, and feelings flare up with a new force that they cannot resist. But neither Artyom's wife nor Zhenya's husband intend to let them go so easily.

Lera decides to find and punish the culprit at all costs. To top it all off, her husband Andrey tells her about her divorce, he started an affair with his boss and leaves the family. Meanwhile, Angela decides to learn a wedding dance, brings her fiancé Ilya to Lera's studio and makes him learn to dance. Lera soon falls in love with her new student and does not suspect that he is the very person she is looking for.

Through interactions with different partners, they gradually understand their own bottom lines and genuine emotional needs. They often gather at Mama's AS Bistro bar to share their relationship frustrations and seek advice from Mama. Despite their different sexual orientations, they sincerely share their longings and frustrations in love, striving to overcome their personalflaws to find relationships that make them feel comfortable. No label, no tag, just love is the key spirit in this show.

Berlin during the Third Reich, Nesvizh in 1942 and the present serve as a historical background against which exciting events unfold in the search for the family heirloom of the Radziwill family - the golden statues of the Twelve Holy Apostles. Legends and reality, secrets and mysticism, murder and love intertwined in this search and confrontation between Soviet and German intelligence, members of occult societies and other heroes of the film.

Óscar turns 30 on New Year's Eve and has his life pretty much sorted out: he loves being a doctor, has loyal friends, and a relationship that comes and goes. On the night they both turn 30, they meet, fall in love and start a relationship with ups and downs that will last for ten years.

Cookbooks are the cornerstone of how the average person has learned to cook for hundreds of years, testing the technical and creative skills of home cooks. In this competition, chefs from across the country take recipes from the page to the plate by cooking from history's greatest and the world's toughest cookbooks.

In this crazy extreme experiment, comedians will reveal much more than their repertoire of jokes. What will be their challenge? Make each of their opponents laugh while keeping a straight face.

Rory prepares elegant dishes for cooks who want something a little different, including potted lobster, duck leg curry with Indian spieces and apple cider vinegar, a surprising Irish salad and apple Betty with chocolate and mincemeat.

title: Royals Next Door

In line with King Bob's royal motto "Closer to the people" they decide to live in a normal house in an ordinary suburb.

title: Golden Kamuy: Hokkaido Shisei Shujin Soudatsuhen
summary: Set immediately after movie "Golden Kamuy," the hunt for the escaped prisoners with the tattoos that collectively reveal the location of hidden gold is in full swing. Retired war veteran Sugimoto Saichi and Ainu native Asirpa are in the hunt to find the gold before others do so and their journey to find the gold nuggets enters a new phase.

title: De Tatta's: De Serie

Laura looks for a job to support the family, Daan clumsily pursues love and Jessica finds her footing at her first job. And Richard? He argues with everyone, but remains irresistible.

title: Uonderbois: Il Tesoro Segreto di Napoli

When the statuette is stolen by their idol, Tonino Uonderboi, the new Munaciello of Naples, their adventure begins in the city's underground, in search of a mysterious treasure.

title: Winter Palace

He convinces wealthy aristo Lord Fairfax to come on board, and the two find themselves battling demanding clientele, rebellious staff and a hostile climate to make their dream a reality.

Journalist Asmi witnesses the attack and breaks the news, gaining a lead to investigate.

title: Śleboda
summary: Anka Serafin, a young anthropologist from Krakow, who escapes to the mountains in search of herself and accidentally discovers a corpse. Anka quickly becomes entangled in solving a murder mystery, and her fate is inextricably intertwined with Sebastian, a journalist looking for sensations, and Jędrek, a local policeman with whom she was close as a teenager.

title: Invisible
summary: Capi, a 12-year-old boy with a normal life, suffers from a terrible accident that causes him severe post-traumatic stress. No one seems to have more information: neither the school, his friends, nor his family can explain what has happened. However, the psychologist who treats him is willing to dive into his history and discover the reasons that have led him to this situation. Little by little, Capi begins to trust him and tells him that he has the power of invisibility, and that the terrible nightmares that lurk him every night have to do with the monsters and the dragon that haunt him. But in their history, they are not all threats. There is someone who does want to help you: a mysterious teacher, a newcomer to the institute, who will try by all means to make the invisible visible.

title: LIAM
summary: An android with the appearance of a teenager named Liam, helped by a group of young people, must escape the laboratory where he was secretly designed if he wants to avoid being reset. What he does not know is that a powerful weapon is hidden deep inside him.Beneath his appearance of a 16-year-old teenager, Liam is in fact an android secretly designed in the World Artificial Intelligence Laboratory. His existence must be revealed at the Belmont science fair, which will bring together young geniuses from all over the world. However, Liam must escape the laboratory, and quickly, because one of his creators, Dr. Wood, wants to reset him since he knows that the android has developed emotions. What Liam does not know is that a powerful weapon is hidden deep inside him. A few kilometers away, far from suspecting the terrible threat that is rumbling, Rafaële, 17, is preparing to welcome the most promising scientists to her father's inn. While she is participating in the inauguration of the science fair, she comes face to face with Liam. A strange connection unites them on the spot. Upset by the young android's dismay, she agrees to help him escape, then to hide him at her home. Lonely and hypersensitive, Rafaële is not convinced that she is the ideal candidate to save humanity. So she decides to turn to her cousin Alexis and the young people she is hosting: Osny, Anne and Rym. Together, they will have to protect Liam, thwart Dr. Wood's plans and lead the investigation to discover the secret hidden in Belmont Forest. What if everything was connected?

title: El Ángel de Aurora
summary: Aurora Campero, president of Corporativo Campero, faces betrayal from her sister Jezabel, who manipulates a construction worker to assault her. Aurora becomes pregnant, and her fiancé, Antonio, abandons her upon discovering the truth. Don Miguel, her father, takes the baby away and gives him to a humble family. Twenty-nine years later, Gabriel, now named Ángel, falls in love with Helena, Antonio's daughter, while Aurora continues to search for her son. The return of Antonio and the schemes of Jezabel and Demián complicate their lives, but the power of love and forgiveness prevails.

It was there that he came to his senses and realized the past had been erased from his memory. Almost simultaneously, Berestov became the prime suspect in the case of the Jeweler, a serial killer with a distinctive signature who murders young girls and places pearls in their mouths. In the woods near the highway, Berestov stumbled upon the body of one of the victims. And when he touched the girl, he "saw" the whole crime scene...

title: Drill
summary: They break you down and build you up. Strip you of your individuality. Roast you, train you, drill you. Everyone's got a boot camp story…this is Drill, a sketch comedy series that recreates and parodies those most iconic moments and stories with drill instructors and drill sergeants.

title: Čornobiļa 2022. Iebrukums
summary: Latvian-Ukrainian co-production series based on the events discussed in the documentary "Chernobyl 2022" – three young friends go on an extreme trip to the closed zone of Chernobyl, shortly before the Russian invasion. The main character Santa acts at the centre of the series. She goes to the Chernobyl zone for a video blog and meeting here recently on Tinder met love.

title: Whiskey on the Rocks

Prime Minister Thorbjörn Fälldin tries to resolve the conflict and avoid a world war between two nuclear powers while struggling with a wise foreign minister and a belligerent commander-in-chief.

lead_actors: Sasson Gabai, Hadas Yaron, Rotem Abuav, Michaeli Rivka
title: Kugel
summary: Kugel, the captivating prequel to Shtisel, takes viewers on an emotional journey into the lives of Nuchem and Libbi, father and daughter, set in Antwerp's Orthodox Jewish community. Nuchem, played brilliantly by Sasson Gabay, is a witty jewelry dealer whose charm lies as much in his storytelling as in his trade. His daughter, Libbi, portrayed by Hadas Yaron, is a seminar teacher yearning to make her mark in the Orthodox literary world.

title: La sombra de la tierra
summary: In 1896, Villaveza del Agua is an impoverished town where two rival widows, Garibalda and Atilana, engage in a power struggle. This battle drags their children into a cursed inheritance, and neither can see the impact until it's too late.

title: Vargasommar
summary: Haparanda police officer Hannah Wester makes a macabre discovery when a dead wolf is found with human remains in its stomach. The find soon turns out to be the first in a series of brutal events that shake the small border town to its core.

title: Edificio Corona
summary: If before COVID-19 no neighbors knew each other, it will be under the current circumstances that causes the confinement, that they will begin to relate in the midst of daily conflicts product of coexistence.

title: Echo serca
summary: Psychologist Magdalena Borska returns to Poland after a few years of absence from the country and starts working in a hospital. On the very first day, the doctor has to face not only the patients' problems, but also the reluctance of the entire medical team, especially Andrzej Stommy, the head of surgery. The hospital employees hide from Magda the trauma they experience after a failed rescue operation that took place six months earlier, and one of the best surgeons in the hospital, Jan Sowiński, was accused of malpractice. How will the fate of the heroes go?

title: Zongmen Li Chule Wo Dou Shi Wodi
Miss Fallaci
summary: Based on the story of Italian journalist and writer Oriana Fallaci. Set in the late 1950s, this season follows the early career of Oriana Fallaci, when she was still known as "the girl from the movies" and worked as a reporter for the Italian weekly magazine L'Europeo. It was during this time that Fallaci turned her first trip to the United States into a unique opportunity, meeting extraordinary figures and painting a sharp, often raw and ironic, portrait of American culture and the reality behind the glamorous façade of Hollywood. These years were also marked by deep personal turmoil, including an intense and troubled relationship with fellow journalist Alfredo Pieroni. This relationship, full of passion but also insecurities and fears, eventually dragged Fallaci into a spiral of self-destruction. Above all, it was a period when a young woman with extraordinary determination and talent discovered her true mission: to tell the truth. And she realized that to do so, all she needed was her most powerful weapon: her voice, unique and distinctive.

lead_actors: Ana Paula Padrão, Érick Jacquin, Helena Rizzo, Henrique Fogaça, Diego Lozano

Among them was Mikhail, now he is Olga's husband and considers it his duty to carefully protect her from traumatic memories of her sister. But suddenly all participants in that fateful meeting receive an invitation to gather again outside the city. Now they will not be able to hide from the past and hide the truth - everyone is under suspicion.

title: Harikatha
summary: In a village, Arjun, a young man of that village as the president of the village panchayat makes the village a model village by providing all kinds of facilities and rectifying people's problems. He earns a lot of love and the whole village follows him.

Three judges: Elio, Katia Follesa, and Angelo Pintus. Their mission? To find the tenth contestant for LOL 4! They'll travel through Italy and be assisted by a different guest judge on every episode.

title: Marconi - L'uomo che ha connesso il mondo

Saving Grace

As they bond amid threats from the authorities and Grace's abusive mother, Anna confronts her painful past, realizing that she needs healing as much as Grace does.

title: Cosme & Damião: Quase Santos
summary: Cosme and Damião earn their living selling candy on the street – it is the megalomania of the first combined with the innocence of the second that will lead them to the biggest robberies in Realengo.

title: Gassal
summary: Gassal tells the story of a gassal who pursues the question "Who will wash me when I die?" and tells the story of Baki, who decides to reshape his life after coming face to face with death. Living side by side with death as a gassal, Baki discovers new meanings about life while looking for someone to wash him. The series invites the audience to both think and understand the value of life, while also offering an enjoyable experience with humorous elements here and there.

title: Les Carnets de Julie
summary: Julie Andrieu travels across various regions in France and explores their landscape, culture and culinary heritage.

title: The Pet Rescuers
summary: The Pet Rescuers follows the work of a team on a mission to give abandoned pets a second chance.

title: Naka De Salon
summary: On Laem Sing Beach in the Buddhist era 2540 (1997), on a day when the grey sky portended a coming storm, Kamol gave birth to Suricha in the middle of a fishing boat. In the depths below them was the shadow of a great serpent waiting to give its blessing. Kamol did not survive, however, and Suricha was raised by a single father. Fifteen years later, out of nowhere, Suricha loses another important figure in her life to suicide. There was only a tuft of fiery red hair by her father's body. In Chanthaburi 2565 (2022), twenty-five-year-old Suricha is a beautician with particular skills. When she touches someone's hair, she sees numbers related to their fate. When that skill gives her the knowledge to help the salon of a famous makeup artist out of its plight, she gains the disfavour of the manager Yukha.

title: Koek
summary: When Cape Town housewife Christelle Smit discovers evidence her husband is having an affair with a stripper named Candy Floss, her investigation takes her to a world poles apart from the suburban utopia she knows.

title: Putain
summary: When Brussels resident Gigi discovers that his mother Anaïs is dating her ex Fabrice again, with whom she shared a drug addiction in the past, in addition to love, he gives her an ultimatum: her son or her lover.

title: Homestead: The Series
summary: A continuation of the movie Homestead... Amid chaos, ex-Green Beret joins prepper compound; love grows, truths arise, and a community unites.

title: A Taiwanese Tale of Two Cities
summary: A Taipei doctor and a San Francisco engineer swap homes in a daring pact, embarking on journeys filled with trials, secrets and unexpected encounters.

title: Iqtidar
summary: After her brother's murder, Mehrunisa seeks justice against influential figures trying to cover up the truth, facing deceit and corruption along the way.

title: Moonwalk
summary: Moonwalk follows two thieves, Tarik Pandey and Maddy Kapoor, as they go head-to-head to steal the heart of a local heartthrob, Chandini Lakhani. Their rivalry and competition lead to dangerous yet hilarious consequences and something far more valuable...and out of this world- a piece of rock from the Moon that lands on Earth!

title: Doctors
summary: Doctors is set at the high-stakes Elizabeth Blackwell Medical Centre in Mumbai, where Dr. Nitya Vasu begins her surgical residency with a personal vendetta against Dr. Ishaan Ahuja, believing he is responsible for her brother's disability. However, as she works alongside him, Nitya realizes Ishaan is not the villain she thought, and her animosity turns to attraction. The series explores intense medical cases and the personal struggles of residents, including ambition, love, and betrayal. The season culminates in shifting relationships, with old enemies becoming allies, a tragic event reshaping the group, and Nitya and Ishaan's love emerging at great personal cost.

title: A Lista
summary: Alice, Micaela, Bruno, Sérgio and Paulo get together, ten days after Patricia's unexpected death. Together, they open the bottle of origamis to fulfill her dreams, among which there are bizarre and illegal requests.

title: House of Heat
summary: Adult content creators move into a house to help grow each other's fanbase on OnlyFans, TikTok & Instagram. In this house, they better bring the heat!

title: Spooksoeker
summary: When he is suddenly thrust into the supernatural realm, a teenage boy must quickly learn how to banish ghosts and save his town, friends, and family.

title: Hameln
summary: Return of the Pied Piper In the Middle Ages he kidnapped 130 children. Now the Pied Piper of Hamelin is returning with them after almost eight centuries. Only a blind woman, a deaf man and a person with a walking disability can stop him. In present-day Hamelin, the blind Finja meets the deaf Jannik, who claims to have seen Finja and Ruben, a boy with a walking disability, in his dreams. The young people Finja, Jannik and Ruben witness mysterious events that seem to have something to do with the Pied Piper of Hamelin. Is the legend just an old myth or will the three soon have to fear for their own lives?

title: Snow Crew
summary: Set in the country's top ski resort follows a young, charismatic crew across the winter 2022 as they manage 6,000 people on each mountain each day of the season

title: Heart Beat
summary: RK Multispeciality Hospital is a beacon of hope and healing. Its doctors are resilient even when they have to deal with medical and personal challenges.

title: Gus Plus Us
summary: Get lost in the world of Gus and his simple, lovable charm as he embarks on imaginative adventures with his zany, faithful sidekick, Karrot. Learn about the elementary mysteries of life with their whimsical, friend Lucy as their guide.

title: Yo, adicto
summary: A thirty-year-old audiovisual professional, voluntarily checks himself into a rehabilitation center due to his alcohol and cocaine use.

title: Vintage
summary: A journey towards maturity and a humorous portrait of toxic masculinities.

title: Nile Perch no Joshikai
summary: Career woman, Shimura Eriko, works for a large general trading company on equal footing with the men. She is beautiful and highly educated. Her parents have a house in Tokyo's Setagaya ward. Life seems to be going well for Eriko whose single greatest hang-up is the fact that she does not have any female friends. Her secret pleasure is to read a popular journal written by a housewife influencer of the same age on social media. At one point, she happens to meet Maruo Shoko, the writer of the diary, who lives nearby. Shoko also has no female friends. The two of them who have this point in common, quickly become close. However, some incident causes their relationship to develop in an unexpected direction.

title: Build for Off Road
summary: If it has wheels and goes off road, Ian Johnson will work on it! He takes you along for the "do it yourself" ride, as we tackle everything from simple bolt-ons to full-on fabrication.

title: Reisen mit Muddi
summary: Agnetha Lakshmi Pfeiffer has a whole lot of problems on her hands: Because of her shopping addiction, the bailiff is now after her. She takes the bull by the horns and because she doesn't know where to go, she sets off on a journey that she has been avoiding for the past few weeks: her mother Naina Zareen Pfeiffer has died. She hasn't had a relationship with her mother, a former Bhagwan follower, for many years.

title: Poulets grillés
summary: Commander Anne Capestan leads a brigade of the judicial police of Lyon to which only alcoholic, depressed and maladjusted police officers are assigned. Despite this, she managed to successfully process the most important investigation of the moment.

title: Makeup With Mud
summary: Yuzuhara Miku is a temporary employee who works for a reception desk at a department store. She has low self confidence and worries about what others think of her, but is clueless when it comes to makeup. Her elite lawyer boyfriend Haruhisa however, constantly tells her she he prefers seeing her that way, so she wore minimal makeup because he favors her "modest" look. One day, she meets Takakura Eve, a guy with a special love for makeup. When he applied red lipstick on her, Miku felt a sense of exhilaration. However, when Haruhisa found out about this, he transforms into an emotionally abusive man.

title: En haute mer
summary: Aurélie, an inspector who clumsily let a young man suspected of being involved in the disappearance of his girlfriend go, learns that he was arrested on a Swiss merchant navy cargo ship for the murder of a sailor. Sent to South Africa to repatriate him, she discovers that the missing girl was a passenger on this cargo ship a few weeks earlier. She continues her investigation alone, facing resistance from the crew.

title: Algorytm miłości
summary: Participants in the series parody Algorytm miłości put their fate in the hands of artificial intelligence to find a perfectly matched love and win the program. Find out how much you can do for reach, fame and money!The new series from the creators of The Office PL is not only a sharp parody of reality, but of the entire entertainment and mass entertainment. Because although sometimes it is embarrassing to admit it, we all love it.

title: Vestiaires
summary: In the locker room, Stéphane welcomes the new members of the swimming club. Pierre, the team coach, unveils the club's new official outfit. Reactions are mixed. Everything gets tougher when it comes time to choose their rallying cry.

title: Snake Boss
summary: Former pastry chef Julia Baker, aka Snake Boss, is a fearless snake charmer whose face-to-face encounters with Queensland's most dangerous reptiles are a regular day in the office. From uncovering deadly eastern brown snakes inside children's bedrooms to removing them off rooftops, this brand new series will follow Julia as she visits the homes of Brisbane residents to remove these unwanted slithering visitors.Brisbane is one of the most competitive places in the world for snake catchers and Julia Baker is one of just a handful of women in Australia relocating snakes for a living. Her foray into the snake catching industry started with a bucket list, and among the many bold goals she successfully ticked off, her greatest passion that remained was her love for snakes – in particular, the venomous species. And so this thrill seeker turned her passion into her profession, even recruiting her Scottish partner, Johnny Gallacher as her apprentice.Julia has made it her mission to help people understand snakes and not fear them. Follow her and her snake catching team, Johnny and their Jack Russell terrier, Bonnie on every slithery twist and turn as they rescue Brisbane's ophidiophobic residents (and face some of their own phobias) in Snake Boss.

title: Aap Ke Aa Jane Se
summary: A love story between a 42 year old middle class, conservative single mother, Vedika and a 24 year old irresponsible, maverick, Sahil, from a traditional, super rich business family.

title: The Offseason
summary: Follows 11 NWSL players as they spend two weeks in Miami training, living together, and providing uncensored access into their personal lives, rivalries, and on-field journey.

lead_actors: Sébastien Chassagne, Tiphaine Daviot, Louise Monot, Juliette Navis, Jean-Charles Clichet
title: Une belle histoire
summary: Love, secrets, and unexpected twists—meet the couples navigating the unpredictable journey of romance in this lively drama. Following the intertwined, rhythmic paths of three couples—three men and three women—exploring the pursuit of happiness in youth and balance in later years.

title: Sad Power
summary: After an ordinary group of people gain superpowers in a car accident, they come together to help society and one another with their issues.

title: Когда на юг улетят журавли
summary: Irina Egorova works as a school teacher and raises her daughter alone. One day, Liza feels ill in kindergarten and is taken to the hospital. After an examination, it turns out that the girl has a heart defect and needs an expensive operation.

title: Ikiru Toka Shinu Toka Chichioya Toka
summary: Tokiko's mother died 20 years ago and her father Tetsuya is now in his 70's. Her father has a free spirit and is cute. Tokiko is in her mid 40's and still single. She has a strong personality. In their past, Tokiko and Tetsuya did not have a good relationship. It got so bad that they almost ended their relationship, but now they occasionally meet. They go out to eat together and have conversations. Tokiko decides to publish an essay about her father Tetsuya. To collect information for her essay, she meets Tetsuya and listens to various stories, but it's not just pleasant memories.

title: Ready, Set, Glow!
summary: Wes Brown visits the most spectacular holiday light displays in the USA, and gets to know the families and communities behind them.
