title: Boy Hood
Usotoki Rhetoric
summary: It is 1926, the first year of the Showa era. Urabe Kanoko has left her hometown after it turns against her for having the ability to hear lies when spoken. She collapses from hunger after arriving in a town called Tsukumoya, where she meets a poverty-stricken detective named Iwai Souma. Is this fate? Or something more?

title: Fynskrif
summary: A law firm in South Africa takes on various cases, while the partners and associates need to balance their personal lives and keep the firm alive.

lead_actors: Giuseppe Fiorello, Paolo Briguglia, Enrica Pintore, Roberta Rigano, Lorena Cacciatore
title: I Fratelli Corsaro
summary: In the unique and inimitable setting of the city of Palermo, the Corsaro brothers move. Fabrizio is a black journalist, Roberto is a criminal lawyer: for this reason they often find themselves forced to work on the same case. Impulsive and libertine Fabrizio, precise and calm Roberto, despite the constant bickering, will be able to solve even the most difficult of mysteries.

title: Buck Denver Asks: What's in the Bible?
summary: The Bible Made Easy! Buck Denver and his friends take your children through the WHOLE Bible. Perfect viewing for the entire family - laugh and learn together. In his first new project since VeggieTales, Phil Vischer has set out to teach kids (and parents!) the story of the Bible – God's great rescue plan! We know the stories of Moses, Noah, David, and Jesus, but in this groundbreaking new series, we learn how they all fit together to tell one big, redemptive story. Vischer's signature wit shines through with his all-new cast of characters, fast-paced flash animation, and catchy tunes. This is one journey through the Bible you won't want to miss!

title: Alone - Überlebe die Wildnis
summary: Ten candidates are left separately in the Canadian wilderness and have to survive alone. The last one standing wins 75,000 euros. Who can last the longest?

lead_actors: Mike Holmes, Mike Holmes Jr., Sherry Holmes
title: Holmes on Homes: Building a Legacy
summary: In Holmes on Homes: Building a Legacy, Mike Holmes joins forces with his children, Michael and Sherry, as they continue his legacy – helping homeowners in need. From renovations gone wrong by crooked or incompetent contractors to bad DIY, to worthy homeowners in need of a life-changing renovation, the Holmes trio continues the work that made Mike a household name. They go behind the walls and above code to focus on safe, functional, efficient, and healthy homes. They do this while promoting a career in the skilled trades. Each project is more than just a renovation, it's an opportunity to help make people's lives better.

title: Reverend Gadget's Garage
summary: In an old lightbulb factory in South Central Los Angeles, Reverend Gadget is converting classic cars into powerful electric vehicles. A mad-scientist, real-life Doc Brown from Back to the Future, Gadget is saving the planet, one car at a time!

title: The Golden Bull Agent
summary: This story follows the covert mission of four "tigers," elite spies concealing themselves to wipe clean the evil path of mogul Pa Sing. Pa Sing excersises great influence over the village of Ban Huai Krathing Thong. Outwardly, he's a benign help to the villagers. Behind the scenes, however, he's running illegal business. Four exeptional talents are therefore gathered from round the county to take up the secret Golden Bull mission and infiltrate Sing's territory. Jak works on the railroad, Khatha becomes an able seaman on a passenger ship, Sang a Likay star and Mai-ek a comedian. They face many direct obstacles from Sing's right-hand man Big and Sing's three wives Fonthong, Judy and Khaikung as well as obstacles of the heart. Jak is faced with police officer Kathi—the daughter of the village head—and Khatha has feelings for Pa Sing's daughter Dujdao.

title: Love and Scandal
summary: Urajawasi has a perfect life with her boyfriend Rames until her cousin Inthu-orn comes to her with a vengeful heart. Inthu-orn is fabricated that Urajawasi's family involves in her mother's death, so she spreads scandals while pretending to be a good person. However, Urajawasi is not an innocent woman. She sees through Inthu-orn's mask. Will the conflict between them be solved or will the real mastermind behind their misunderstanding be smiling behind the curtain?

lead_actors: Tukky Sudarat Butrprom, Napapa Thantrakul, Nitidon Pomsuwan, Carissa Springett
title: Ghoul to School
summary: Khru Phensri is the principal of Nongmaeped Witthaya School. With the school at risk of being shut down, Khru Phensri does all she can to prepare her school for assessment. As part of her efforts, she hires a beautiful new English teacher Khru Lady. Shortly after Lady's arrival, the school's chickens are found brutally slaughtered. Khru Phensri witnessed Lady consume raw entrails and believes her to be a ghoul. Khru Phensri wants nothing more than to expose Khru Lady, but Lady is a caring and beloved teacher. Plus, her kind little brother Khru Boy has feelings for Lady.

title: Selina's Gold
summary: Selina's father sells her to Tiago who makes her a sex slave. With the help of Domeng, Tiago's blind slave, she plans their way out of this living hell.

lead_actors: Kitkong Khamkrith, Paparwadee Chansamorn, Ratthee Vorarojyothin, BamBam Nasamon Niyomdecha, Mhoo Pusana Buangam
title: Lady Behind the Mask
summary: Kung is a graceful, beautiful woman who has grown up in the slum, with a mysterious background about her birth. Due to employment obligations, Kung finds herself traveling to Kheha Nang Khoi which is located on a cliff. She is employed as a caretaker for a mentally challenged woman who wears a mask all the time. Kung later discovers that the lady is not crazy and may be related to precious lost jewelry, "The Pink Diamond".

lead_actors: Vasin Asvanarunat, Chanapol Sataya, Paparwadee Chansamorn, Apa Bhavilai, Amp Pheerawas Khunlanunthwatn
title: Pang Sanaeha
summary: After a failed operation to capture the infamous drug dealer, Jiang, Investigator Techit finds himself traveling to his friend Sritang's resort in order to take a break. There, he meets a sweet-voiced ghost who haunts his room and can not remember anything about her past. He decides to call her Siangwaan because of her pretty voice, and the two then begin to find out her real identity.

title: Rhett & Link's Wonderhole
summary: From outrageous challenges to heartwarming encounters, through docu-comedy, music and sketch Rhett and Link's Wonderhole pushes the boundaries of entertainment, delivering an experience that is both hilarious and thought-provoking.

title: Kharze Zarka
summary: The tale of two families, one is Syrian and the other is Lebanese, who are united by many harsh conditions and challenges, yet things become more difficult when Zain falls for Alia, the daughter of the other family.

title: 40 y 20
summary: The series follows Paco, a forty-something divorcé with a fascination for younger women, his son Fran, a twenty-something with a weakness for women in their forties. Together, they enjoy every weekend together in good company.

title: Bad Boys vs Crazy Girls
summary: Bad Boys vs Crazy Girls tells the story of the most popular boy and girl who hate each other have the surprise of their lives when they find out that they are engaged. For Kate, Liam is her mortal enemy.

title: Only in Aotearoa
summary: Short, sharp, comedy skits told from a distinctly Māori perspective, with real-time conversations between characters that mirror an issue or common experience that affects Māori in a funny, feel-good fashion.

lead_actors: Marc Thompson, James Brown Jr, Samantha Cooper
creators: Jee-hyun Kim, Joogong Meang, Taewook Koh
title: Hero Inside
summary: Heroes can pop out of their comic books when summoned in this comedic action-adventure.

lead_actors: Tokino Sora, Natsuiro Matsuri, Shirakami Fubuki, Oozora Subaru, Nakiri Ayame
title: Holo no Graffiti
summary: From unraveling the secrets of opening and closing doors to defusing surprise packages more commonly known as bombs, there is never a dull day at the Hololive Production office! Holo no Graffiti follows an eccentric cast of Virtual YouTubers, also known as "VTubers," going about their absurd yet hilarious daily lives, detailing all their cute moments and mishaps.

title: My Syblings Romance
summary: Dating show with a family twist. Four pairs of biological brothers and sisters, share a house to assist each other in finding love. No one can reveal who their sibling is. Romantic feelings will be revealed during their 10 day stay.

lead_actors: Varitthisa Limthammahisorn, Tussaneeya Karnsomnuch, Phattharapon Dejpongwaranon, Santiraj Kulnoppakiet, Chingching Kharittha
title: Le Rai Game Luang
summary: The rivalry between two famous actresses begins when the seemingly perfect married life of Phatchanin turns into a bitter pill. Ingdao seeks revenge, aiming to shatter Phatchanin's life over an old grudge. But the game doesn't involve only them—an ambitious businessman with his own vendetta enters the scene, stirring emotions and complicating the stakes, along with a resilient girl nearly led astray by a revenge she didn't cause.

title: My Haunted Hometown
summary: Think your hometown is safe? Think again. My Haunted Hometown will have you questioning everything you know about the town you love. This brand-new series is an immersive, original, and dynamic road trip to small and scary towns across North America.Following the terrifying stories of three paranormal witnesses per episode, we learn exactly how the past can come back to haunt you. We relive the most frightening moments of our witnesses' lives inside the harrowing location that the hauntings occurred in. And find out which spirits, ghosts, and demons also call these towns home.

lead_actors: Mashannoad Suvanamas, Jaron Sorat, Thames Sanpakit, Piamchon Damrongsunthornchai
title: Investigation of Love
summary: Lawyer Pat's first encounter with Wasu, an enthusiastic politician of a newer generation, doesn't go so smoothly. Fate keeps putting them in each others paths, however, and they ultimately end up working together investigating a case concerning a powerful figure, sparking a transformation in their relationship.

lead_actors: Jespipat Tilapornputt, Thanapat Kawila, Peechaya Wattanamontree, Sinjai Plengpanich, Nattaya Thongsaen
title: Past Life, Present Love
summary: Strong-willed Mild lives happily with her talented chef boyfriend in the US until fate strikes and she suddenly has to return to Thailand. There, her family is in total chaos. To make matters worse, she is forced to get engaged to Theethut, the difficult son of a wealthy businessman. But fate is not kind: Theethut and Mild's boyfriend's cars collide. Mild desperately tries to find out the truth. But then her old love reappears – and everything gets even crazier!

title: Fils De
summary: Gangster Franck Pistone, who's been on the run for 17 years after having pulling off the heist of the century, returns to Brussels to reconcile with his children because he feels his end is near.

title: The Dreamcatchers
summary: Four indigenous tweens discover that their ancestors have given them superpowers to defend Mother Earth from invasive species and evil corporations, whose destructive activities are revealed to them in dreams.

title: Takedown with Chris Hansen
summary: Over the past two decades, Chris Hansen's investigations have led to hundreds of would-be sex criminals being stopped in their tracks. Amazingly, after 500 arrests and hundreds of millions of video views, men continue to try to meet children online. So his mission continues.

title: Naati Pinky Ki Lambi Love Story

lead_actors: Вера Сотникова, Елена Дудина, Алика Котова, Ольга Погодина, Константин Соловьёв
title: Людмила
summary: A biopic about the life of singer Lyudmila Zykina.

title: Le Refuge d'Audrey
summary: Le Refuge d'Audrey is a French-Canadian-Spanish animated series produced by Watch Next Media, Image-In Atlantique, and Peekaboo Animation. The series follows the daily life of a seven-year-old girl named Audrey, who lives in a sanctuary dedicated to endangered species. As she grows up in this environment, Audrey and her best friend Tommy continuously discover new animals and learn to coexist with them.

title: La Promesa
summary: 1913. The whole world is on the brink of the abyss, but there are havens of peace isolated from the conflicts. Like the La Promesa Palace, in the valley of Los Pedroches, property of the Marquises of Luján, one of the largest landowners in the country.Can love quench the thirst for revenge? Could you forget those who ruined your life? The murderers of your mother? Those who made your brother disappear? A woman, revenge and a great love story are the ingredients of La Promesa.

title: Desired by My Unknown Husband
summary: Frank, a small-town boy, hastily married urbanite Andrew, chosen by his grandmotherly friends, without recognizing each other. Andrew disappeared after going abroad for work. A year later, Frank's boss, the wealthy and charming Andrew, pursued him, leading to an affair. The once-playboy Andrew learned commitment and restraint, while Frank, once betrayed, regained trust and learned to love freely. At the divorce site, Frank discovered his husband and boss were the same person.

title: And Then There Were None
summary: 10 men and women are called to the Natural Island Hotel on the isolated island of Heitaijima off Yachijojima by the owner, Nanao Shin. They take the dinner that has been prepared while filled with a mix of expectation and anxiety about what is going to happen and why they have been invited to this island.

title: How NOT To Draw
summary: In How NOT To Draw, a drawing tutorial parody series, animators bring beloved Disney characters to life, and the characters bring…CHAOS!

lead_actors: Abdulrahman Thaher, Ola Yaseen, mahmud Riziq
title: Fenjan Albalad
summary: 3 seasons of satirical Palestinian series that reviews social and political issues in a black comedy style.

title: Piedone - Uno sbirro a Napoli
summary: Vincenzo Palmieri, a student of the famous Commissioner Rizzo "Piedone", returns to Naples to face his past. He must earn the trust of his new team and demonstrate the effectiveness of his unconventional methods in a complex city. Commissioner Sonia Ascarelli, his opposite, will give him a hard time. Between investigations full of twists and turns and light-hearted moments, Vincenzo will try to reconcile himself with his inner demons, while Naples continues to offer valuable life lessons.

title: Lana Longbeard
summary: Lana is a super-feisty, forward-thinking and passionate 11-year-old girl, who is also the heir to her father's adventuring ship, the Mighty Windbreaker. Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. But first, she must overcome some challenging obstacles: impulsivity, stubbornness, extreme curiosity, disdain for rules … and a love of pancakes. All the best things about her!

title: Toad & Friends
summary: Kenneth Grahame's literary classic ‘Wind in the Willows' springs to life in this series following the further adventures of the much loved characters: kind and considerate Mole, reliable Rat and of course incorrigible Toad. Situated on and around the river that is such a big part of their lives and landscape, they are now joined by irrepressible Hedge the Hedgehog, Kingfisher, Heron and Adder.

title: Subterranea
summary: Subterranea, Kenya's first sci-fi series, follows eight participants of a psychological experiment who are placed in an underground bunker to test the effects of close-quarter secluded relationships on humans.

lead_actors: Adi Havshush, Tamir Bar, Oshri Cohen, Tomer Capone, Rony Herman
title: Save the Date
summary: When successful wedding planner Dassy suddenly finds herself single again, her grandmother casts an ancient love potion to summon up Dassy's one true love. But something goes wrong with Grandma's spell, and suddenly Dassy is spoiled for choice! Instead of just "The One", Dassy now has four suitors from her past and present vying for her heart. With just two weeks to organize a high-stakes wedding for her high school mean girl, Dassy must navigate this romantic chaos and decide which man – if any – leads to her own "happily ever after".

title: Gospodin Savršeni
summary: The Croatian edition of The Bachelor. The series follows a single bachelor who is given a list of romantic interests from which he must choose a fiancée. During the season, the bachelor eliminates candidates each week which finally results in his last choice receiving a marriage proposal.

title: La isla de las tentaciones
summary: Five couples agree to test their relationship by spending their vacation in separate corners of an island.

title: Три аккорда
summary: The project covers the whole variety of genres of Russian music, not constrained by the framework of pop music, chanson, rock pop and classical music, while enjoying enormous popular popularity. The show's episodes are dedicated to urban romance, author's song, movie hits, cinema, the work of Russian emigration and some other genres.

title: Залетай в тренды
summary: A show where any aspiring artist gets a chance to become trending by recording a track with a top artist. In times when information is consumed very quickly, we will show that you can win the love of the audience in literally 30 seconds and you don't need anything other than your talent to do this.

title: Theme Song Takeover
summary: Theme Song Takeover is a comedy short series featuring characters from various Disney Channel shows performing theme song remakes of that series.

title: Broken Karaoke
summary: In Broken Karaoke, your favorite Disney Channel characters take the stage and sing hilarious parodies of iconic pop songs.

title: ABCiee Shūgyō Nikki
summary: I'm Ebishi!I dreamed of becoming a TV man, so I got a job at Ebishi TV...But I never heard it would be this tough!!The rules of the TV industry, my unique colleagues, the quirky performers,and my slightly unusual family...Will I really be able to become a top TV man?Please keep a warm eye on me as I go behind the scenes of the TV industry and follow my struggles and turmoil!!!

title: Turning Teddy
summary: Three assistants attempt to navigate the worlds of their famous Hollywood bosses.

title: CAPSULES
summary: Capsules (often referred to as the Capsule Project) is an acclaimed anthology of original animated short films produced by Bilibili. Similar in concept to Love, Death & Robots, it showcases diverse 2D and 3D styles from Chinese indie animation studios, with each episode exploring unique themes based on color-coded human emotions.

lead_actors: Kaspars Dumburs, Dita Lūriņa, Toms Liepājnieks, Klinta Reinholde, Anna Nele Āboltiņa
title: Nebaidies ne no kā
summary: TV series about the most notorious Latvian drug trafficker Rolands Priverts. It's a story that gives insights of why and how the main character lived his life outside of the regular system and morals.

title: Leaked!
summary: Enter the life of Mumbai's elite attending the prestigious "Oakwood High School". Rebellious teenagers, bursting with emotions as they navigate their complex lives filled with secrets, we all would want to know. The ‘seemingly perfect' lives of privileged teenagers go for a toss when the ‘IT Girl' of the school is found dead.

title: Takk for alt
summary: Norwegian celebrities get to experience their own funeral before they die. Lying in an open coffin, they listen to family, friends and colleagues eulogizing them.

title: NightMara
summary: Mara is an 11-year-old foster kid with the power to traverse through people's nightmares in the nightmare world. When people in her town of Brighton City fail to wake up, it seems she's the only one who can save them. But after discovering other NightWalkers are trying to stop her from starting a war of the collected unconscious, Mara has to team up with her own monsters to take on the nightmares.

title: Improbably Poppy
summary: An air of transcendence only further stirs the swirl of ambiguity — is Poppy real? Is she a NPC? Do the puppets really die? Those that tune in will be the first to know. Or will they?

title: Epic Drives
summary: Join Motor Trend as we hit 200mph on a German autobahn in a Corvette ZR1, take an Audi R8 past the fjords of Norway, or drive a Lotus Evora 1500 miles through the Rockies. Epic Drives is the ultimate road trip show that puts some of the world's coolest cars on the some of the world's greatest roads -- and brings you along for the ride.

title: Se potessi dirti Addio
summary: Marcello, a mysterious patient with no memory, in hospital for over a year. Elena, a passionate neuropsychiatrist searching for the person responsible for her husband's death. When these two lives intersect, it doesn't happen by chance. Maybe these two lives have something that connects them.

title: Creepy Bits
summary: Creepy Bits is a 10-episode chilling horror collection that delves deeper into the unknown, drawing inspiration from contemporary issues and venturing into uncharted territories of fear. Each episode is helmed by a diverse range of innovative filmmakers, including Ashlea Wessel, Adrian Bobb, Kelly Paoli, Sid Zanforlin, and  creator David J. Fernandes. The series explores themes of human vs. nature, the invasion and destruction of the natural world, and isolation within a vast, eerie landscape that fights back. From the depths of the forest to the darkness of the lake, to quaint small towns, each episode promises to unsettle and disturb.

title: La cacería
summary: La cacería is inspired by shocking police cases that have shaken public opinion in Chile, with the aim of reflecting on these, looking backwards from today. On each season, the former detective César Rojas (Francisco Melo) deals with stucked unresolved cases due to authorities' negligence.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Dragonero - I Paladini
Akedo: Ultimate Arcade Warriors
summary: Jet, Bria and Cub are determined to become legends in the Akedo Championships. They do their best to level up their skills to reach their goal.

lead_actors: Антон Феоктистов, Наталья Николаева, Андрей Биланов, Ольга Стрелецкая, Елена Захарова
title: Солнечный зайчик
summary: The story of the life and sincere love of a real woman. The story begins with the twenty-year-old age of the main character, Irina. Then a great feeling settled in her kind heart, which she carried through many years of living together with her lover, who became Irina's husband. But time becomes a test for love, and not every man is able to appreciate devotion.

title: Escupiré sobre sus tumbas
summary: Determined to avenge his dead brother, Brian goes undercover to exact his plan — but ends up falling for the ambitious cop on the case.

title: Без башни
summary: There are 9 characters in the program, each with a bright personality. They all go out into the city to carry out their special mission. They provoke, argue, misbehave... In general, they use all possible means to bring out various emotions in unsuspecting people on the street.At this time, a hidden camera is watching them - the resulting stories are watched in the studio by viewers, the host of the show Dominic Joker and a jury consisting of three show business stars. The author and participant of the most reckless story becomes the winner, he is awarded a prize - an Oscar statuette without brains.

title: The Devil's Dinner Party
summary: Six strangers are shown into a dining room. They're introduced by the host (referred to as "The Devil's Broker"), and have a brief chat over a pre-dinner glass of wine. The contestants then rank each other from favourite down to least favourite, and the person with the worst rank leaves without even sampling the soup.The remaining five sit down for dinner, and are spotted £1,000 for their prize pool. In turn, each will be asked a question intended to reveal something about themself. For instance, "Who out of four categories of people would you like to live next door to?" The other four pool their brains to predict what answer will be given, and a correct prediction adds £1,000 to the prize pool.Repeat this so each contestant faces a poser, a process that takes about half an hour.There's another elimination here, done almost at random. The contenders pick a card at random, one of the cards is marked. That person has to pick their favourite and least favourite contestants, and their least favoured is off the show.A final question is posed to one contender, where the answer is one of the other three players. There's another £1,000 in the prize fund for a correct answer, bringing the total prize money to a maximum of £7,000.Who wins this amount? The four remaining players rate each other again, and the contestant with the highest rating takes the money home.

title: Ohnivý kuře
summary: The protagonists Mike and Burák arrive in the small town of Janovy Lázně after a twelve-month stint behind bars to run a pub that Burák inherited from his uncle. Hot on their heels is a pesky probation officer who is waiting for their first step on the edge of the law to send them back behind bars. The pub is in a state of disrepair, however, and gastronomy is out of the question. And so Mike and Burák slowly start to get acquainted with the competition and potential new friends and lovers...

title: 3 Seconds Later, He Turned Into a Beast
summary: Tsumugi is a female college student who carries trauma from an aggressive man in her past. She meets Kaname at a mixer she requested specifically for unaggressive "herbivore"-type men. She and Kaname hit it off, and Kaname resembles Tsumugi's older brother a little bit, so she relaxes her guard around him. Kaname, however, feigns to be a "herbivore"-type man, but is in reality an aggressive "carnivore"-type man, and he can change his demeanor in an instant.

title: Let's Go Luna!
summary: Luna the moon guides three friends -- a wombat, a butterfly and a frog -- as they visit new places around the world with their parents' traveling performance troupe.

title: Inside
summary: Ten influencers. One house. One million pounds. All the Insiders have to do is complete the challenges and not blow the cash — easy, right?

title: Xun Jian
summary: Honored Master ordered to go out of the mountains to join the world, to join the family as a son-in-law for the last wish, everyone in the world said that I was incompetent, but who knows, in fact, I am a peerless sword fairy who looks down on the world? let's watch my sword sweep the universe and break through the sky!

title: Vytoč mého agenta
summary: Call My Agent tells comedic stories from a casting agency. Every day is full of work and human pitfalls. Trying to satisfy the demanding needs of acting stars, a constant battle with competition, complicated personal relationships that often get mixed up in work matters. The agency team has to manage all of this and survive the daily struggle that brings with it many absurd and comical situations, as well as touching moments and real human dramas.

title: Adikts
summary: Max, Mell, Ema, Robin and Sonia. As part of a responsible approach to their studies, five addictionology students decide on an experiment - to take drugs that could temporarily solve the problems of each of them. As Professor Jensen says, drugs are shortcuts to solving problems. But the experiment has one significant catch. The effect of the drugs will become permanent for everyone. Fun and newly acquired "superpowers" lead the young heroes to the edge of their possibilities, but also of their strength. And all this in a situation where the function of a drug coordinator has been established in the country, which approaches the drug problem with maximum severity...

title: To se vysvětlí, soudruzi!
summary: Eight cases for the Authority for the paranormal phenomena

title: Vlastně se nic nestalo
summary: Zofie and Andrea offer paid content on adult platforms. While Zofie tries to rebuild her damaged self-esteem after breaking up with Roman and experiment with these platforms, Andrea longs for financial freedom which moves her from her original goal of making a living by serious modeling. Zofie sees adult platforms as a kind of emancipation tool, while financial situation and demands of fans drive once famous Andrea deeper into darker waters of sex influencership.

title: Lež na pláži
summary: The owners of a successful IT start-up, Hynek, Gabriel and Stepan, threaten the interests of a dangerous mobster and have to flee Prague. On the run, they find asylum in a hotel where they pose as bartenders under false identities.

title: Policie Hvar
summary: Even in holiday paradise, sometimes things go wrong. And sometimes they kill.

title: Mozaika
summary: The story of a family, which is shaken by the sudden separation of the parents. They decide to find themselves, but each separately. Before that, they have to find a new homes, so they temporarily travel to the families of their children.

title: Krematorium
summary: The story of the Záhorský family and their family crematorium. One would think that it would be quite dead in such an enterprise, but strange, mysterious (and it must be said, very funny) events begin to happen to the Záhorskys, which cross the line of life, death, and above all black humor.

title: #annaismissing
summary: Anna is a controversial influencer and best known for her provocative online content, but suddenly she goes silent on her social media profiles and mysteriously stops posting any updates. When fifteen-year-old Nina finds a half-naked photo of Anna on her dad's phone, she decides to track down the missing influencer. The shocking events that follow will change not only Nina's life but also her family's. The thriller #annaismissing is a standalone film continuation of the successful series #martyisdead, which was honored with an International Emmy Award in 2020

title: Bodyguardi
summary: Even gangsters can be fun. Each part carries a complete story. The individual stories are told with a disarmingly inaccurate exaggeration, taking the best of what has been created in the genre of crime and gangster films and working with interesting pop culture references.

title: Agrometal
summary: A comedy TV series set in the wild countryside. To save his marriage, Lukyn decides to take part in an amateur band competition, in which he wins a beautiful motorbike. When he succeeds, he takes his wife out on the motorbike and she will surely forgive him for everything. In short, a perfect plan! What does it matter that Lukyn doesn't have a band and that he can't really play anything...

title: The 50
summary: In an unprecedented spectacle we present to you the hottest 50 reality stars in Germany, including Jenny Elvers, Cosimo, Yasin, Cora Schumacher, Georgina Fleur and Matthias Mangiapane - all in one show! In a mysterious castle, ruled by a mischievous lion they fight not for themselves, but for their fans, one of whom will be awarded the prize

title: The Yorkshire Exorcist
summary: Ordained exorcist Ian Lawman is about to embark on his most personal and challenging case yet. This time he isn't cleansing a home or spooky location … he's going to the heart of the issue and tackling a suspected possessed person directly.

title: Il collegio
summary: Eighteen adolescents between the ages of 14 and 17 have to study for two weeks in a sixties-style boarding school to obtain the diploma of middle school at that time.

title: Horror Candy
summary: Presents nine eclectic tales of terror, each a unique nightmare ranging from dystopian futures to haunted space stations.

title: Král Šumavy
summary: It is the spring of 1948. Twenty-four-year-old cook Josef Hasil serves in the kitchen of the National Security Corps in Zvonková. Wild boy. He had already experienced the war in a German labor camp and as a link between partisans.

title: Případy mimořádné Marty
summary: Marta is an incredibly intelligent and very individual woman who lacks respect for any authority. He wants nothing to do with the police at any cost. However, when, thanks to her uncontrollable desire to intervene in things and move them forward in an ingenious and innovative way, police chief Klára Hořavová offers her the position of consultant in the homicide department, she finally accepts after a short hesitation. Together with Captain Kreiner and his team, he begins to unravel complicated murder cases with his own personality. Czech adaptation of the 2021 French series HPI.

title: Chlap
summary: The successful doctor Ondřej Frank wakes up in a reality he does not know at all. He must gradually discover and understand the world around him, but especially his own personality.

title: Jitřní záře
summary: Deals with a clash of values, when a child is taken away from a family because of an inappropriate name. Where does a person's personal freedom end and where does the social norm begin? Is it even possible to live outside the given system today?

title: Dobré ráno, Brno!
summary: The series shows the environment of a live morning show, which it talks about with huge exaggeration. The morning show whose mission is to prepare viewers for the day ahead with a good mood. The show does not have it easy.

title: Chaos
summary: When Lise, the host of Denmark's morning TV show, meets the charming and adventurous Johannes, who lives a simple life in his van on the Danish coast, she faces the biggest dilemma of her life. Should she risk throwing away her successful career and marriage with co-host Martin in pursuit of adventure and true love? The choice is anything but easy, and Lise's life suddenly feels like great chaos.Chaos is a romantic and modern love story, which is about achievement and high expectations, not least of yourself, but also about having the courage to realise that happiness is in reality letting go of control and daring love, even when it comes inconveniently.

title: Puffins Impossible
summary: Puffins Impossible follows the adventures of four superhero puffins. With the assistance of their mentor, Johnny Puff, they protect Taigasville from problems caused by the villainous engineer Otto von Walrus.

title: Тэгри Чину
summary: This series is a fictional, fantasy, action adventure. A fantastic epic journey across the steppe around 800 BC with detailed history that mixes truth and fantasy in a mesmerizing way. Before Ghengis Khan, 33 total tribes of the Steppe united and rose against those that desecrated and mined their land, their descendants who would come to conquer the known world.

title: Salom Uka
summary: A rich family, accustomed to a comfortable life, loses absolutely everything. They only have their father's house in the village, where they are forced to move and find a common language with a relative and with the local residents.

title: Maktab
summary: A coming of age story about a high-schooler, Sanjar, and his friends.

title: Toshkent 94
summary: The events take place in 1994. Mukha, a well-known person in the criminal world, gets stabbed in the next fight and falls into the river. Internal affairs officers join his gang in order to catch actor Zakir Boho, who is his look-alike.

title: Fara Tashkentskiy
summary: An authoritative Almaty racketeer, after lying in a coma for 23 years, suddenly regains consciousness. To his horror he realizes that it is 2021, his children have grown up, he himself has aged and the world has changed beyond recognition.

title: Hello oyijon
summary: Halima (55 years old) sends her son Shokhrukh (25 years old) to study in America, he returns after studying, and says that he is bringing his daughter-in-law with him. Halima's joy knows no bounds, and she has already gathered all her relatives in the house. But when she sees Shokhrukh's chosen one, the mother is horrified - a dark-skinned girl, Julia, has arrived with her son. Halima does not want to put up with this - after all, this is a disgrace to the entire village. Now Shokhrukh must prove to his mother that there should be no prejudices for true love

title: Meni sev
summary: According to Uzbek traditions, a bride for a son is chosen by his parents. Imagine Anvar's (25) surprise when his first school love agreed to marry him. But immediately after the wedding, Anvar realizes that it was a forced marriage, and Afruza does not love him. Being an honest and decent person by nature, contrary to tradition, Anvar promises his beloved that he will not touch her until she truly loves him. And he begins to seek the love of his wife.

title: Blago nama
summary: The plot of the series follows a family that, in part and forcibly, has to live under the same roof. Ana and Boris are a young married couple with whom, due to a combination of circumstances, her sister and her entire family suddenly move in, as well as her and Ana's father.

title: Unbelievable Space Love
summary: Gazing at the scenic view of the sky, a man is joined by a stranger who informs him that he is in a dream. Unable to recall the memories of his life, he relies on the visitor to take him on a journey of discovery. Revealing everything—from their seven-year relationship to the emotional hardships they faced together—the two rekindle their bond severed by time. Behind this beautiful love story, however, lies a much darker truth.

lead_actors: Satoshi Hino, Yumi Hara, Manami Numakura, Ayane Sakura, Mikako Komatsu
title: Ple Ple Pleiades
summary: Ple Ple Pleiades (ぷれぷれぷれあです) is an anime spin-off of the Overlord series featuring chibi SD characters and taking a more comedic approach.

title: Bea's Block
summary: From the makers of Sesame Street, this animated preschool series follows Bea Mantilla, a compassionate and curious Mexican-American five-year-old, as she figures out what it takes to be a good friend. Along with her two best friends, Ty and Lexi, Bea's quest leads them on wacky "Kindness Adventures" around their diverse and inclusive neighborhood of Blocktown. Whether they're creating a "Blocketball" skills camp or searching for a lost chameleon, these three best friends explore a range of emotions from disappointment to excitement, all while learning how to be kind.

title: Bijeli put
summary: After a year and a half of investigation, the police "Department for Special Investigations and Combating Organized Crime" managed to arrest Željko Matić Željco, a former gangster who legalized his business and used it to launder money earned from illegal activities. The arrest was spectacular, but it was overshadowed by the murder of the outgoing chief of the Šibenik-Knin Police Department, Petar Mikulandra, and the discovery of the body of Gabriela Ochoa from Mexico, who had been presumed dead for seven years. The chief's murder casts doubt on the connection between the police and organized crime.

title: Pinkalicious & Peterrific
summary: Pinkalicious & Peterrific follows the adventures of Pinkalicious and her brother Peter. Pinkalicious imagines creative possibilities everywhere she looks. She is an artist at heart—and, like most creative people, she sees the world differently from others. She knows what she likes, and she's not afraid to express herself—though she sometimes needs help from her brother, Peter, and her neighborhood friends.

title: Papa datte, Shitai
summary: Asumi Kouya is a college student who wants to earn some extra money. Utilizing his talents for cooking and cleaning, he accepts a part-time job as a housekeeper. His employer is single father Keiichi Naruse, an attractive young man with a troubling history regarding his former staff.Naruse's time is constantly dominated by work and his adorable son Ichika, and he rarely gets time to himself. Cleaning the man's room, Asumi gets a startling insight into just how frustrating the life of a single parent can be. He finds a pile of adult videos, which results in plenty of implications.Despite Naruse being a man, Asumi finds himself completely drawn in by his employer's beautiful face and gentle personality. With the promise of allowing the frustrated father sexual relief, Asumi's life as part of this small family has only just begun.

lead_actors: Виктория Алмаева, Анна Литкенс, Алексей Кирилин, Лариса Маркина, Александр Марченко
title: Верное средство
summary: A multidisciplinary clinic treating a wide range of traumas and human dramas. A variety of medical specialists work here, from anaesthetists and gynaecologists to plastic surgeons. Nurses are also available, where without them. Every day, these people not only save lives, treat illnesses and help people, they also have their own lives - their own problems, which, more often than not, lead to extremely difficult life situations. You may doubt it, but these doctors care about their own problems, and they care a lot!

title: Partner's Territory
summary: An irresistible rough romance between three men who invade each other's realm.Lee Je-jae and Shin Jin-gi have been separated and reunited. He now lives with Shin Jin-gi, a married man who is married by contract, but he remembers the selfish Shin Jin-ki who said he was not a homosexual and told him to stop.Meanwhile, a new owner Lee Cheok appears in front of Lee Yi Je, who works as a manager at Soul Brush, and Shin Jin Ki complains about his charismatic appearance.

title: Kostas
summary: Kostas Charitos is head of the Homicide Section of the Athens Police. Tenacious, he does not lose heart even when faced with the most difficult cases. Kostas is married to Adriana and has a daughter, Caterina, for whom he feels total love. In The commissioner's family background looms over the despotic figure of his policeman father at the time of the Colonels' dictatorship and passive spectator, if not accomplice, of the interrogations and violence inflicted on the regime's opponents.

title: Antikduellen
summary: In each episode, 2 people compete to make the best purchases, which they later sell at auction. whoever has earned the most money wins.

title: Baharı Beklerken
summary: The story of a mother, a father and a child who overcome obstacles to find each other and become a family again...

title: Amor Sem Igual
summary: Their lives could not be more different. While his workday is ending, hers is just beginning. In this story, Angélica is a beautiful prostitute, known as ‘Poderosa', who regularly visits a roadside gas station. It is there that she meets the agronomist Miguel, a nobleman from São Paulo with a good character, who sells the vegetables he grows on his property. They barely cross paths, the attraction is evident, although they have no idea what the future holds for them.Rejected by her father as a child, Angélica is a woman who soon became independent and is, without knowing it, involved in many mysteries. One of them has to do with a conspiracy to assassinate her. A task that is not easy at all, and which will be made more difficult by the unconditional passion that grows between the Angélica and Miguel.

title: Joulukalenteri: Kiltteyskriisi Korvatunturilla
summary: Who decides what kindness is? Santa Claus encounters a surprising problem at the forge: The gift warehouse is overflowing with packages that are in danger of not being delivered. It seems that this Christmas, almost no one will meet the requirements of the Great Book of Kindness, written by the overly cocky elf Hörö. Kindness Crisis at Korvatunturi is a family-friendly situation comedy that mixes suspense, crime mystery, and infatuation in the freezing cold.

title: Roni Back: Suomen Suurinta Piilosta
summary: Roni Back: Finland's Greatest Hide and Seek is a six-part series that brings the highly popular hide-and-seek games of favorite YouTuber Roni Back from YouTube to Ruutuu! In the series, Roni and his guests - both other well-known YouTubers and TV celebrities - compete against each other in a game of hide-and-seek in the most special places around Finland. Each episode offers unexpected twists and surprises that keep both the seeker and the hiders in suspense and take hide-and-seek to a whole new level!

title: Rahdinmetsästäjät
summary: Rahdinmetsästäjät follows the everyday lives of Finnish truck drivers on the endless highways of the United States and Canada.

title: Juniori Suurmestari
summary: The junior version of the phenomenal Grandmaster puts children in the spotlight! The basic idea of the program is the same as for adults: children compete in tasks created by the Grandmaster that require intelligence, skill and wit. There will be speed and wild situations, as well as downright cutting analysis in the studio. The Grandmaster is rightfully Jaakko Saariluoma, and his right-hand man is judge Pilvi Hämäläinen.

title: Il metodo Fenoglio - L'estate fredda
summary: The epic story of how in the 1990s Bari crime transformed into a real mafia in the same years in which the Cosa Nostra attack on the heart of the state took place in Sicily with the massacres of Giovanni Falcone, Paolo Borsellino and of their respective stocks.

title: Murha Hangossa
summary: Prodigal father Ruben Waara returns to his hometown and becomes embroiled in a murder investigation led by his police inspector daughter.

title: Berlin Blues
summary: Jonah, Talia, and their four-year old daughter, Renny, move to Berlin to start over - only to find out that they might be able to escape Israel, but they can't escape themselves. Based on the real-life experiences of series creator, Dana Idisis, "Berlin Blues" is a nuanced comedy about the challenges of moving to a new city and the complexities of Israeli Jews relocating to the country that just decades ago orchestrated their persecution. Jonah - a classical musician and oboe player - has always dreamed of playing with a prestigious world orchestra. But instead, he finds himself nearing forty, working as a private music teacher, and feeling that there's no place for him as an oboe player in Israel. Jonah's sense of professional failure and resulting financial hardships rouse fantasies of relocating to Berlin, a privilege made possible by the German citizenship he inherited from his grandparents. He convinces his wife, Talia, to join him. As a writer, Talia happily embraces Jonah's request to move to Berlin, thinking she will find inspiration for her second book. The relocation is thrilling, and materializes precisely at the right time. But Berlin turns out to be far from what the couple had prophesied; while Jonah flourishes as a member of a German orchestra, Talia struggles to write and feel at home. "Berlin Blues" tackles trials and tribulations of moving to a new city, a new home, and making new friends in a country vastly different from one's own - a never-ending set of hurdles.

title: Сказочный патруль. Хроники чудес
summary: The animated series is targeted at children three years old and up. Each episode tells about the Fantasy Patrol characters, who are already familiar to young viewers: Cat the Scientist, Magic Flower, Elizabeth Wise, Wood-Sprite, the sorceresses themselves, and many others. Plots and stories, made in the style of motion comics, reveal these characters and explain the motives of their actions. Viewers will learn about the past and previously-hidden secrets.

title: Kayangan
summary: Kayangan is a realm of spirits and monsters. Habil, television host and lecturer has secrets. One, his father was a movie star. Two, the hero his father played was not fiction and Habil is heir to his father's mystic powers. Along with Ana, Bob and Zain, they assist Captain Jabbar and Vicky from the BASE task force to save citizens from Kayangan's threats.

title: Çırak

Having experienced great injustices in the past, Çırak thinks that he is doing a good deed for humanity because the people who should be killed are bad people. However, one day, an event he witnesses changes his entire life and he finds himself in a struggle he never expected

title: Hell of a Night
summary: Behind the slums and dark alleys of Kuala Lumpur, Sam cheats and poses as a shaman to survive. His victims are those who are easily fooled by black magic and by taking advantage of them, Sam makes money from them with cheap deception and illusions.Sam also has a sixth sense and can see supernatural beings, but he rejects this belief because for him it is a curse. Dina, Sam's ex-lover, comes to ask for help in finding her missing sister after hearing supernatural voices, Sam tries to help Dina.The loss of Alia is just the beginning of a bigger threat, involving a group of heretics from the elite led by a mysterious and charismatic man named Gusti. Together with Dina and Suria, Sam will be suspected of unexpected events while the city of Kuala Lumpur witnesses Gusti's grand plan in action.

title: Riot!
summary: Riot! follows four students in a university where the misconducts of a professor often go unnoticed. Fed up with the injustice, they turn to music to ignite a rebellion that echoes beyond campus walls.

title: Framed
summary: Lia discovers a mysterious polaroid camera that prints pictures of future tragedies. Can Lia prevent them from happening while investigating a bigger conspiracy surrounding her mother's disappearance?

lead_actors: Μάρκος Παπαδοκωνσταντάκης, Chara Mata Giannatou, Μέγκυ Σούλι, Νίκος Ψαρράς, Μιχάλης Οικονόμου
title: Diafani Agapi
summary: A murder, lives shattered, pain, grief and a woman alone in danger. A vision, a door that closes without being crossed... Divided between reality and desire... Because all he took with him was love... We are on the roof of an abandoned building where two bodies lie there with their guns next to them. They seem to have shot each other. The blue police beacons are flashing and the officers are isolating the crime scene.

title: Adventurer Carly
summary: Carly teams up with tech guru Bobby and wolf-transforming Morgan, following her dad's puzzling notebook to uncover Yilo Kingdom's Book of Life secrets linking her to a glowing flower and Morgan's morphing abilities.

title: Spoiled Marriage of an Overprotective Young Husband
summary: This story follows the sweet and "overprotective" newly-wed life between Someya Yukito, a young master of an established inn in Asakusa, and Tsuruoka Io, a pure-hearted female apprentice training to be a chef. Tsuruoka was in the depths of despair until she found solace in the sweet konpeito candy given to her by Someya. Since then, she has earnestly cherished her feelings while training as a chef. Yukito's affectionate words and actions reserved only Tsuruoka, along with his excessively cute jealousy, create an irresistibly heart-fluttering devotion with a charming gap that's impossible to resist!

Kazakhstan in the 1990's. Aman is a successful doctor who is severely depressed. This causes him to drink heavily. After one such drink, he falls down on the street and is picked up by some unknown people. He wakes up shaved and chained to a post in an unknown location. Aman finds himself in the labor slavery of the cruel Kazbek. His henchmen are bringing in alcoholics and addicts from around the city. Kazbek first breaks the wills of his prisoners by keeping them in the scorching heat without food or water. Then he sends them out to work. Unwilling to accept their fate, Aman plots an escape.

lead_actors: Наталья Терехова, Сергей Мухин, Маргарита Дьяченкова, Александр Макогон, Данила Якушев
title: Возраст любви
summary: Olga and Igor meet at a hospital and literally fall in love at first sight. Their overwhelming feelings for one another turn out to be stronger than their current commitments.

title: Dieciocho
summary: Celia and Moha meet in a kitchen. For Celia, this job is a punishment: a judge has ordered her to do community service. For Moha, this job is a reward that brings her closer to her goal of getting her papers. Although it may not seem like it, they have a lot in common, and they will discover it as they both overcome their prejudices and begin to see each other as they truly are.

title: Ena. La reina Victoria Eugenia
summary: Ena. La reina Victoria Eugenia is the story of a queen and also of a woman. Of a young Englishwoman who had never dreamed of being what she was: queen of Spain. On the journey, Victoria Eugenia leaves behind her family, her customs, her culture and has to renounce her religion to live in a strange land, where the first thing she suffers is an attack on her wedding day.She never felt accepted or loved, but she never gave up and always fought to achieve both. Modern in a traditional environment, she was an icon of fashion and of the liberation of feminine customs: she smoked, wore pants... When she discovered the continuous infidelities of King Alfonso XIII, she did not give up her role as queen. And she did so with discretion and, above all, resilience. She suffered the curse of transmitting hemophilia, to her husband's sorrow in view of the difficult dynastic succession that this entailed. In exchange, she improved the health of many Spaniards with a work which has gone down in history: the reconstruction of the Red Cross.ENA was a woman who fought to be happy with all her strength in a bitter period, in which she witnessed two world wars, a civil war and the deadly Spanish flu. For all these reasons, ENA, as a series, not only tells the story of Victoria Eugenia's life, it is also a portrait of an era that changed the world.

title: The Real Housewives Suomi
summary: The Real Housewives, which has become an iconic reality TV format, is getting a Finnish version, and the program follows the joys and sorrows of the friendship of five female entrepreneurs, without forgetting luxury.

title: Tuurenmäki 98
summary: Tuurenmäki 98 is a funny, touching and nostalgic drama Comedy about a group of teenage friends getting caught up in the twists and turns of the internet and adulthood in the golden 90s.

title: Hallonbacken
summary: The series is about the poor and tubercular girl Stina who is sent to the Hallonbacken sanatorium to recover. But once out there, she stumbles upon the sanatorium's secrets.

title: Kriittinen piste
summary: A talented, but troubled girl wants to forget her ski jumping past and reconcile with her father, until she meets a stubborn old ski jump coach, who hasn't forgotten the glory days of this dying sport.

title: Metro Crime Series: Siapa Lelaki Itu?
summary: The series revolves around the brutal murder of Syerinie. Fatema, a journalist for Harian Metro, is determined to cover a case that has shaken the country. However, her request is not approved by her editor. Instead, the coverage is assigned to her colleague, Rozimi.Fatema is a hot-tempered person. So it is no wonder that she has decided to disobey orders and cooperate with Rozimi.Interviews with witnesses to the incident have led to the discovery of details that have been obscured by the police. According to the witness, he saw a man who may have been Syerinie's killer.Only Fatema and Rozimi report the sighting of this mysterious man. This gives Harian Metro an advantage.The next day, the main suspect is arrested. However, the man is not the man seen by the witnesses to the incident. So, the question that needs to be solved through the 10 episodes of this series is: 'Who is the Man?'

title: Wild Heroes
summary: Segawa Kiichi, a former delinquent, happens to encounter a lonely 10-year-old girl who looks like she is going to be killed by the Yakuza. He saves her by reflex and later realizes that she lost her memory. She doesn't know why the Yakuza are after her and Kiichi is attacked time and again because of that. With his own life in sudden danger, he calls on six friends from his high school days as a delinquent. These enthusiastic, single-minded men band together to protect her to the end.

title: Lahti 2001
summary: Lahti 2001 tells the story of the biggest doping scandal in Finnish sporting history through fiction. The six-part drama series delves into the painful past - what happened and why? The plot of the series takes place in several time frames, but the main focus is on the events around the 2001 World Championships in Lahti.

title: Amnêsia
summary: What would happen if we all lose our memory at the same time ? ALL OF US. Seven billion people.

title: Året i sagoskogen
summary: Join Silva and her grandmother as they explore nature and the seasons. Silva finds nature to be both exciting and scary, but with her little stuffed fox and her imagination, there are no obstacles to exploring the forest outside Grandma's red cabin. But are all the creatures she encounters actually real, or are they just in Silva's imagination?

title: Умник
summary: Popular writer Roman Strakhov has to submit his latest masterpiece to the publisher in two weeks. But, as luck would have it, he suffers from a creative crisis. Strakhov goes to the Investigative Committee for inspiration. In order to study the material, the writer has to share his heroic everyday life with the employees of the investigative department. The strict and very nice investigator Zhenya Ogareva becomes the main character not only of Strakhov's stories, but of his whole life. Zhenya inspires the writer for a new novel. Both literally and figuratively...

summary: The head of the detective agency "Beagle" Andrey Rostovtsev always act as it sees fit, and do not hesitate invades another's privacy.

summary: Little Nando and his dog Kai are so curious that they throw themselves in fun adventures to discover the scientific mysteries and learn from the world around us.

title: Un air de star
summary: Un Air de Star is a French TV Shows broadcasted live. It's an adaptation of the international format Your Face Sound Familiar.

title: The Colors of Our Time
summary: It tells the romance of Yu Ra a web novel writer who planed her new romance novel when she saw by chance the photographer Jung Woo but ended up being the main character of the story.

title: Party Till I Die
summary: When a group of filthy rich 19 year olds decide to take a weekend trip to a Goa farmhouse for a brand shoot, the party takes a deadly turn and friends turn on each other for the race to survival.

title: Петербургский роман
summary: On her twentieth wedding anniversary, Nadezhda Grushina loses everything that gave meaning to her life: her businessman husband leaves her for another woman, and her grown daughter moves abroad. Nadezhda is left alone in her parents' large apartment in the center of St. Petersburg.She doesn't know that her neighbor, municipal official Pavel Bobrov, and his lawyer have been clearing out her house for two years to turn it into a luxury hotel. Pavel hopes to make a fortune, and nothing will stop him. Now it's Nadezhda Grushina's turn...The protagonist's storyline is closely intertwined with the city on the Neva, its residents, their stories, the white nights, and all the myths and legends that permeate St. Petersburg.

title: Stucky
summary: On duty at the Treviso Police Headquarters, Stucky is an apparently absent-minded inspector, often underestimated, who is guided by his instinct, curiosity and out-of-the-box thinking. He appears to be modeled after Lieutenant Colombo, down to the trenchcoat and the ever-present cigar.

title: Terapie
summary: The THERAPY series is unique for its psychological depth, well developed characters and the setting, mostly concentrated in one area. Most of the story takes place in the consulting room of psychologist Marek Posta (Karel Roden) who attends to several patients with a variety of traumas during the weekdays. Every Monday the psychologist receives a saucy Sandra (Tatiana Pauhofová) who confesses in the opening episode that she is in love with Marek.

title: La Gata
summary: Esmeralda, whom everybody calls "The Stray Cat", grew up in a suburban slum under miserable conditions; ever since she was a little girl she has lived with Doña Rita, who exploits her by sending her out on the streets to beg or sell candies in order to "earn her food and bed". As a child, she became friends with Pablo, a wealthy child who cares for her and tries to help her behind his mother´s back, Lorenza, who looks down on "The Stray Cat" due to her social prejudices which make her reject poor, uneducated people. Esmeralda has turned into a beautiful woman over time and although she is still very poor, she has managed to always look pretty in front of Pablo. They have grown together, but Pablo has problems with noticing that he feels more than just affection for her.
