title: Fugitivos
summary: Julian is an engineer who overnight destroys his life, his marriage, and his work, as he is blamed for a murder he did not commit. After being sentenced to 26 years in prison, he decides to run away to find the only witness who knows the real culprit.

title: La Promesa
summary: Lured by promises of a better life, three young women are sold into prostitution and must risk their lives and their families to escape.

title: La Bruja
summary: This is the story of two characters, a witch and a known mafia boss, who strongly influence Colombia's political destiny at the end of the 1970s, changing the entire future of the country.

title: Tool Academy
summary: Twelve men think they're taking part in a reality show that hopes to find the "ultimate lad". In fact, their girlfriend's have nominated them for Tool Academy, where they'll be transformed from lazy boyfriends to the perfect partner - or so they think...

title: Bad Boy
summary: A comedian recounts how his wit kept him alive inside a brutal juvenile detention center in this raw, coming-of-age drama inspired by true events.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Field to Fire
summary: In Field to Fire, lifelong outdoorsman and chef Andrew Zimmern heads back into the field to source his favorite proteins. From wild pigs in South Carolina to redhead duck in Texas, culinary icon Andrew Zimmern is geared up to hunt, fish, and harvest everything our country has to offer. After the catch, Andrew will demystify cooking wild food over an open fire while sharing tips for creating the ultimate wild game meal.

title: Diário de Pilar
summary: Pilar is a girl who loves traveling and dreams about knowing all the countries in the world.

title: Airport Security: Rome
summary: At Rome's Fiumicino Airport, security personnel work around the clock to keep Italy's busiest airport free of criminal activity. Italian State Police tackle drug trafficking and illegal immigration at this gateway to Italy and the European Union. And a crack security team remain alert for signs of thieves in the airport's expansive shopping areas. Illegal drugs, fake passports and purloined perfume: it's all in a day's work at Fiumicino.

lead_actors: Chelsea Boy, Envy Peru, Janey Jacké, Megan Schoonbrood, Vanessa Van Cartier
title: Make Up Your Mind
Ex on the Beach
summary: To find new love, a group of hot singles moves into a luxury villa in Mexico. Among the women and men are well-known reality stars who are looking for love in front of the camera again.

lead_actors: Ольга Копосова, Юлия Вайшнур, Андрей Лавров, Олег Осипов, Сергей Пиоро
title: Садовник
summary: One of the main lines of "Gardener" is a homicidal maniac, the prototype of which was the infamous " Bitsevsky maniac. In the Federal Service, the situation is not simple : high management in the Ministry decided to leave only one structure — a specialized division of the Ministry of internal Affairs or an experimental FES. The FES is conducting an operation to catch the killer. And this time, the very existence of the service depends on the results of the team's work.

title: Новости
summary: We see them every day, turning on the TV when we want to know what is happening in the world. Beautiful and impartial news anchors tell about the most important events in the world. But what are they like when the camera turns off? A happy family, a married couple who have succeeded in their careers together? Or hypocrites and liars, whose whole life is built on lies?

title: Infieles
summary: Erotic comedy about infidelity and the different situations that lead human beings to commit it.

title: I Love Tokyo Legend - Kawaii Detective
summary: Detective Tsukiko Otonashi, who is obsessed with the "Toshi Densetsu" manga, believes all kinds of crimes are somehow linked to urban legends.

title: Talkback
summary: Malcolm White is the hard-talking, right-leaning king of talkback radio. But when a younger, left-leaning personality takes the number one spot, how far will Malcolm go to rule the airwaves again?

title: Mini Reni
summary: Known for her large-scale renovations, Joanna Gaines takes on the challenge to renovate three rooms in one week. In each episode, she makes a few budget-friendly changes to completely transform outdated spaces in need of a refresh.

title: 0.5 no Otoko
summary: The story revolves around the Tachibana family, who live in a 2.5-generation household. In this type of household, the parents and their children live together in a two-generation home, with the addition of a single sibling from the younger generation. The Tachibana family decides to rebuild their old home into a 2.5-generation household, and the 40-year-old unemployed and reclusive protagonist, Masaharu Tachibana, ends up living with his sister and her family.Although Masaharu is revered as a gaming expert in the virtual world, he faces challenges in his new living situation as his sister asks him to help with household chores, and his teenage niece rejects him as "weird." Having lived life at his own pace until now, Masaharu gradually learned to interact with people and regain a more social lifestyle amidst the changing environment.

lead_actors: Zhang Jia Yi, Li Xiao Ran
schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Meihao Shenghuo
summary: On the brink of divorce, a Chinese man returns home after 10 years in America. At the airport, he suffers a heart attack but survives thanks to a transplant that gives him another chance in life.

title: Hey Girl
summary: 'Hey Girl' is a half-hour comedy series focusing on the modern, web savvy young woman's reaction to dating, fashion, friendship, pop culture, body issues, embarrassing moments and much more. This series is comprised of an ensemble cast of popular comedians, bloggers and online personalities. Enhancing the talking head format are rotating man-on-the-street segments, sketches, musical parodies and animated pieces. Drawing from social platforms and web culture, nothing is off limits as each episode comments on the experience of a millennial girl in a comedic way.

title: Sunt celebru, scoate-ma de aici!
summary: Romanian version of I'm a Celebrity...Get Me Out of Here!

lead_actors: Radu Vâlcan, Madalina Draghici, Diana Dumitrescu, Augustin Viziru, Adela Popescu
title: Iubire și onoare
summary: Iubire și onoare is the story of a love affair between a Romanian woman and a sheikh from the Emirate of Beled el Nur, which presents as its main subject the crime of honor, still very common in some Arab states.

title: This Little Show of Mine
summary: Hayley Harris creates a one-woman stage show following the death of her mother in North Carolina.

title: The Dolls
summary: The Dolls, a reality TV dance series follows dance coach Dianna Williams and her Dancing Dolls, a group of talented young girls looking to better their futures at an HBCU and become professional dancers. A fresh DD4L elite team surfaces, as Dianna Williams looks to continue expanding her global brand, while balancing her life as a mother and wife.

lead_actors: Adam Bardy, Martina Zábranská, Larisa Mižigar, Tomáš Hindra, Vladimír Kobielsky
title: Mama na prenájom
summary: Mama na prenájom is a touching and suspenseful story in which the paths of two families cross thanks to chance and a little girl's wish to get to know her mother... Martin Toman, a successful gynaecologist and co-owner of a prestigious obstetric clinic, raises a kindergarten girl, Hana, alone with her father Ed. Her mother left them so long ago that Hanka doesn't remember her at all. However, Martin has unwisely promised Hanka that her mother will come for her sixth birthday, and now she has no idea how he will fulfill his promise. She finds unexpected salvation in the unbridled and somewhat crazy Nadi Vernerova, who runs the family restaurant with her father Dušan and siblings Beata and Juraj. Hana and Nadia are united by the fact that Nadia's mother has long been absent from the Verners' lives. The meeting of Nadia and Martin triggers a sequence of unexpected twists and events that will eventually intertwine the two families, flushing out dark secrets of the past while giving Hanka hope that one day she will indeed find her dream mother.

title: Renovation Hunters
summary: Introducing Renovation Hunters, a new network original where home improvement meets the outdoor lifestyle. Hosted by Hal Shaffer, hunter and outdoorsman, this show is dedicated to preserving the family tradition of the outdoors. Our mission is to ensure that your hunting, fishing, or vacation camp can be passed on to the next generation.Our talented crew of Renovation Hunters is made of home improvement specialists from all over the United States, that love both their craft and the outdoors! If your selected, they will dedicate their skills for a solid week to do whatever it takes to ensure that your family camp is the place that your family memories will continue. See the trials, mishaps, and fun as the Renovation Hunters come to your town to preserve your family camp so you can enjoy the great outdoors again!

title: Love of the Two Realms
summary: When a love story between a human and a crocodile begins, how will it end? Can they truly love each other? And will they be able to restore peace to the waters?

lead_actors: Ксения Алфёрова, Алексей Кравченко, Игорь Ливанов, Раиса Рязанова
title: Крутые берега
summary: Olga Morozova, an investigator of the Moscow Prosecutor's office for particularly important cases, returns to her hometown of Bliznerechensk to take care of her mother, who was robbed the day before. Olga cannot leave her mother alone in such a difficult condition and decides to move to the province.

title: Грибной царь
summary: The life of businessman Mikhail Dmitrievich Svirelnikov is going quite well. But he understands perfectly well that his ex-wife, mistress and daughter want only one thing from him - money. In order to provide for them, Mikhail has to commit fraud. One day, noticing surveillance, Svirelnikov understands that someone has revealed his secrets, and begins his investigation...

lead_actors: Георгий Дронов, Алексей Завьялов, Виталий Хаев, Станислав Дужников, Карэн Бадалов
title: Неудачников.net
summary: A story about the life of our contemporary Alexander Novgorodtsev, forty-two years old, from his four friends, each of whom defends his own version of what happened.But, no matter how much all four of them disagree in their assessment of certain events, they agree on one thing: their Sashka is the last romantic idealist who managed to perform an "ordinary miracle", usually called "success", to reach "amazing heights" and at the same time not bend one iota to the changing world.The boaster Valentin, the emotional Mikhail, the gallant Igor and the reasonable Veniamin lead their narrative.

lead_actors: Татьяна Рыбинец, Полина Ганшина, Маргарита Исаченко, Валерия Забегаева, Елена Доронина
title: Любовь и прочие глупости
summary: The heroes of the series are clients of an ordinary beauty salon "Faces". As usual, when they come to the salon, they tell their, sometimes the most incredible, stories of Love. Some of them are impossible to believe, others will turn out to be just a figment of their imagination and not all will end with a happy ending. The beauty salon will become that "magical" place where everyone will reveal their most intimate love secrets: different and at the same time close to each other. And the grateful listeners will be the visitors of the salon and, of course, its employees.

lead_actors: Lujza Garajová Schrameková, Marián Miezga, Gregor Miler, David Krajčík, Maximilián Bolf
title: Naši
summary: Naši presents the life of a family of five with occasional slightly ironic undertones, so natural for normal relationships between children and parents. Every week, a father and mother struggling to raise their three sons invite us into their daily routine and offer us a tasty cocktail of varied emotions, laughter and screams. Every parent can easily identify with their stories and situations full of humour, but also tenderness and heart-warming human warmth. They provoke us to laugh, smile or think, and the occasional gnashing of teeth cannot be ruled out. Our heroes undoubtedly succeed in dramatically changing the optics through which we view the contemporary family, while sending a reassuring signal to us all that we parents - or our children - are not alone in this.

lead_actors: Ирина Чериченко, Константин Спасский, Денис Юшечкин, Павел Фартуков
title: Невидимки
summary: Mom, dad, two sons, one at the institute, the other works as a bodyguard. If you look at them, they seem like an ordinary family. If you meet one of them in a crowd of city passers-by, you won't pay attention to them – they are invisible. This is only to their advantage, because while you don't notice them, they look at you and see everything that you would hardly want to show to anyone. Everything falls into place when you learn the past of Larisa and Viktor (mom and dad): until recently, they worked in the seventh department of the KGB. Today they are already retired, but, as we know, there are no former employees of the security services, and they continue to engage in surveillance privately and on private orders.

lead_actors: Dávid Uzsák, Noël Czuczor, Juraj Hrčka, Anna Nováková, Eva Mores
title: Nemocnica
summary: In a place where lives are at stake every day, there seems to be no room for anything else, let alone the doctors' own lives. But doctors are only human too, and so it often happens that where there is no room for personal failure, such failure must inevitably occur. The daily struggle for life in the emergency room, and whether God is watching over the patient or everything is solely in the hands of the doctors, brings many traumas, eternal questions and dilemmas to the doctors themselves. Two young doctors arrive at the central reception, still carrying their ideals and ideas from the faculty. These disappear with a flick of a wand when they enter a real hospital, where they are both attested. Agáta and Braňo also have a shared past, which did not go well at school, and so a natural medical rivalry develops between them. Superficiality, superiority, heart, compassion and solidarity are the themes that the doctors deal with day in and day out, and each of them brings their own spin to the job. Every day there is something new to learn, and often the protagonists come to understand that they are not gods. That's probably the hardest lesson of all for the two young doctors who have just arrived and think they can save the world to learn. The doctors at the hospital live their jobs to the fullest, and so have little room to get to know their life partners outside the hospital. Hence, workplace relationships often develop and there is a drawing in of life's vicissitudes and relationship problems right into the ward.

title: Oteckovia
summary: Four fathers were brought together in a kindergarten attended by their offspring. Alex, a lawyer, Marek, a divorcee, Vlado, a pizzeria owner, and Tomáš, a widower, are trying to cope with their lives and their roles as fathers and partners.

lead_actors: Ondřej Malý, Tomáš Materna, Dagmar Křížová, Tereza Beranová, Tomáš Váhala
title: 4teens
summary: The main characters are only fifteen or sixteen years old at the beginning, having left primary school and starting high school. They are no longer children and they are ready to jump straight into everything. They are going through a period of rebellion against parents and teachers, a period of searching and disappointment, first fateful loves, friendships and enmities. Different types of people meet in the classroom. They have different interests, attitudes, family backgrounds, dreams and different ideas about how to spend their free time. Some are skateboarders, others are nerds, some live for music, others for computers. There are athletes and intellectuals among them. Some are sociable, others are withdrawn. Chatting, computer games and virtual reality are more important to some than real friendship.

title: Последняя минута
summary: Four directors, twenty gripping stories, a kaleidoscope of genres from thriller to comedy. Each episode is an hour of real time that the viewer will live together with the characters of the series. An hour that will become a turning point in the characters' destinies, an hour after which nothing will be the same as before...The format of "The Last Minute" is unusual: there are no through characters, no single story. The episodes are separate short stories, the plots of which develop in real time. The characters live ordinary lives, they have their own concerns, affairs, work, family and secrets. But life can make a sharp turn in an instant, and then everything turns upside down. The secret becomes clear, friends - enemies, chance encounters - fatal... How will the characters of the series act? How will it all end? Who will be the winner, and who will have to part with life? Everything will become clear only at the last minute...

title: Tempo Final
summary: Six unrelated stories of crimes of passion, with a lot of suspense .

lead_actors: Rosa Diletta Rossi, Alessandro Fella, Fortunato Cerlino, Christian Burruano, Federica De Cola
title: Maria Corleone
summary: The young Maria Corleone has moved from Palermo, Sicily to Milan and is realizing her dream of becoming a stylist; she has a partner, Luca Spada, a young prosecutor with whom she is expecting a child. Having returned to Sicily for the big party for her parents' wedding anniversary, she is involved in an attack that will change her life forever. Little by little Maria will enter the criminal mechanisms of the mafia, coming to terms with her conscience to defend the life and honor of the Corleones: but this will weigh dramatically on her relationship with Luca and their child.

lead_actors: Tomáš Maštalír, Vladimír Kobielsky, Martin Mňahončák, Eva Sakálová
title: Dr. Dokonalý
summary: The series focuses on Daniel Ludsky, a forensic expert and expert diagnostician.

lead_actors: Tomáš Maštalír, Vladimír Kobielsky, František Kovár, Vanessa Biermannová, Jana Kolesárová
title: Dr. Ludsky
summary: The original JOJ TV series presents medical stories in a completely different way than before.The fictional stories about medical errors or failures are in many cases inspired by real events.Tomáš Maštalír as MUDr. Daniel Ludsky is an expert on diagnoses and medical malpractice. As a forensic expert, he often cooperates with the police. Dr. Ludsky is not the hero we are used to - he is intelligent, uncompromising, arrogant and impatient. He hates sloppiness and incompetence, so he doesn't have many friends among his colleagues. But he believes in the truth and in the patient's right to be treated decently. He is not very happy in private either. He is divorced and, alongside his work, struggles to find time for his teenage daughter.

title: Wer weiß denn sowas?
summary: Celebrities answer very difficult questions about everyday things and problems.

title: Gefragt – Gejagt
summary: Gefragt – Gejagt ("Asked - Hunted") is the German adaptation of the British show The Chase. In this beloved show, a team of four candidates competes against a superbrain, the "Hunter". That's not an easy task, as the hunters are proven quiz professionals.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
title: Tout le monde a son mot à dire
summary: Daily mental gymnastics to have fun with the French language and enrich your general knowledge.

title: Charming Boys
summary: In this Prince Charming spin-off, former contestants from the dating show and new participants go on a flirtation course. Against a picturesque backdrop, they go on breathtaking dates in search of Mr. Right.

lead_actors: Rajeev Siddhartha, Manraj Singh Sharma, Srishti Rindani, Suchitra Pillai, Manini Mishra
title: Romil & Jugal
summary: Two men, Jugal and Romil, fall in love with each other but are scared that their orthodox family would not accept them. However, they decide to overcome all their obstacles together.

title: Buchstaben Battle
summary: Buchstaben Battle is a German TV game show hosted by Ruth Moschner, following an international "Alphabet Games" format. The show focuses on wordplay, letters, and speed, with contestants competing in various challenges based on spelling and word construction.

title: Trailer Park Boys: The SwearNet Show
summary: Take three Trailer Park Boys, add one dysfunctional TV network, stir in a bunch of illicit activity and a healthy dose of profanity. Whaddya get? A combo platter of comedy entertainment that will spawn shipping containers of laughter. Welcome to Trailer Park Boys: The SwearNet Show.

title: Electro Monolog
summary: A new style; musical tirade. Musician Emre Yusufi and actress Nilperi Şahinkaya interpret monologues from classic theater plays that are still relevant, with a musical tirade.

lead_actors: Kübra Balcan, Nilay Erdönmez, Funda İlhan, Oral Özer
title: Meta Aşk
summary: Meta Ask, Turkey's first and only platform that offers dating in the Metaverse universe, has turned into a pavilion that forces its employees to consommation in order to gather more members. The chief designer of the company, Günes, is now overwhelmed by this vulgarity. The ruthless CEO Sebnem does not want to leave her side in this critical period.

lead_actors: Deniz Göktaş, Buse Sinem İren, Çağla Alkan, İsmail Türküsev, Aksel Gürel
title: Tuz Biber Stand-Up Special
summary: Türkiye's alternative stand-up comedy club TuzBiber is at GAİN with its diverse cast of comedians.

title: Ultra Loin
summary: In a house in the Parisian suburbs, nine roommates from overseas live together. They are welcomed by Guillaume, a Reunionese. This year, a documentary will be shot on this roommate like no other...

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: Bondi Band
summary: In prehistoric times a strange pink stone with an imaginable power crashed on Earth. This stone was responsible for the extinction of the dinosaurs, getting buried under the ground for thousands of years. Tony, Laila, Azim, Nina, David and Boris are six friends who live an ordinary life in the city of Vila Tornasol, to discover the plans of the malicious Miss C. Lebrity. Her goal is to dominate the world using the effects of the pink stone, doing everything to remove it from the center of the Earth. Due to this, the kids are chosen by the guard of Vila Tornasol, Peter Solfa, to protect their city from attacks by the villain. The children form the literal "band" of superheroes, and utilize the powers of their magical instruments.

title: KodoTsura
summary: Watabe and Nokishita are ordinary elementary school students who live in Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan, around 1990. They like to play a popular RPG game or they usually buy the popular chocolate snacks with stickers inside.

title: Oyunlar Holding
summary: Can Bonomo, Can Temiz and Can Sungur will play a number of games and create fun content, along with their topics from the "O Tarz Mı?" podcast.

title: Eee Sonra?
summary: "What Then?" is an interactive series about tactics in the male-female relationship. In the series with Deniz Işın and Sarp Bozkurt in leading roles, two characters who could not find the love they have been searching for yet, just give up and begin to consult different tactic books. We will watch funny and emotional moments of Sarp and Deniz, who ruin their date because of the tactics they read in the book, as they try to know each other. In fact, not only will we watch it, but we will also watch and see how the story goes on with different endings by deciding on the progress of the story thanks to the options we come across.

title: Deneme Çekimi
summary: Kübra, who is trying to hold on to the cinema and television world, sometimes meets with fringe directors who target festivals in her casting auditions; Sometimes it intersects with opportunistic producers aiming for totality. This diversity of test shoots will challenge both his acting and social identity.

title: Dünya Bu
summary: Love, hatred, passion, inconsistency, anger, meatballs, headman, shooting scenes, necessary and unnecessary big movements, the rule of law, the desolate man in the desolate man and many more… Thirty-two different stories, one world, from the creators of KALT and Errands.

title: Mad House
summary: Abby Lee Miller is back and it's not about plastic trophies anymore. Inviting a group of young adult dancers to live with her, she looks to test their abilities with challenges, as they compete for a spot on Abby's new team.

title: Tertemiz
summary: Faysal and Gülbahar are employees of a private company cleaning up after dark events such as bloody murders and tragic suicides, and they encounter absurd, funny and sometimes heartbreaking situations in the places they clean.

title: Das 1% Quiz – Wie clever ist Deutschland?
summary: Presenter Jörg Pilawa is looking for the smartest people in Germany. The 100 candidates on the show fight their way to the final question, which only 1% of Germans can answer.

title: 1 Man's Treasure
summary: Legendary comedian Ron James decides to give up his life as a stand-up comedian to pursue his true passion as a treasure hunter. With a map he found in an old boat, he is now determined to uncover the long-lost treasure of Oak Island.

title: Swearnet Studios
summary: These are the stories of SwearNet Studios. Its ongoing mission: to create an all-swearing network, to bring joy and laughter to all civilizations, to boldly go where no fucking network has gone before!

title: Acacias 38
summary: Acacias 38, the address of a stately apartment building where our stories unfold, is set in 1899 and tells the story of a group of maids and the bourgeois families they serve, in a single block in a distinguished neighborhood of a large Spanish city. Two worlds colliding in a universe of crossed lives.

title: André Hazes: The Next Chapter
summary: André Hazes was followed by cameras for two years, during perhaps the most difficult period of his life. He is at a crossroads where he struggles with fears and demons. André enters into battle, especially with himself, and that involves some rigorous decisions. We see an extremely vulnerable and honest André. All masks must come off.

title: André Hazes: Crossroads
summary: André Hazes was followed by cameras for two years, during perhaps the most difficult period of his life. He is at a crossroads where he struggles with fears and demons. André enters into battle, especially with himself, and that involves some rigorous decisions. We see an extremely vulnerable and honest André. All masks must come off.

schedule_days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
title: You ni cai xing fu

lead_actors: Lio, Camille Japy, Florence Thomassin, Ariane Séguillon, Nicole Shirer
title: Tiger Lily, quatre femmes dans la vie
summary: In the late 60s, Rita, Rachel, Muriel, and Stéphane formed a rock band called Tiger Lily. Two decades later, after long having put away their guitars, the women look back at their lives.

title: Red Bull Ultimate Rush
summary: The ultimate athletes and the ultimate filmmakers paired with Hollywood story telling: Pulitzer Prize-nominee and Hollywood screenwriter Stephen Schiff (Wall Street: Money Never Sleeps, Lolita, True Crime) teams up with the action-sports wizards from MSP and Red Bull Media House to ask the ultimate questions: Why do these athletes do what they do? Why do they risk everything to achieve something as fleeting as a ski line on a remote crag, a momentary descent down a waterfall few have ever seen, or a leap through space between man-made mounds created solely for a leap through space? Chris Davenport, Antoine Montant, Hervé Cerutti, Steve Fisher and other action sports legends join forces with cameramen greats like Scott Gaffney, Dustin Lindgren and Guillaume Tessier to explore the fine line between extreme sport, philosophy and art. Directed by Murray Wais and Steve Winter, this cinematic quest will take you from the Rocky Mountains to Morocco, from Bolivia to China, and from Thailand to Norway, as it gives rise to the most breathtaking stories. Narrated by three time Academy Award-nominee Nick Nolte.

title: Maschek
summary: The television images from all channels, from "Zeit im Bild" to sports, from prime time shows to social media, are analyzed, reinterpreted and brought to the Maschek remix once a month. The television material in the (almost) lip-synced flashback of the two voice anarchos - real fake and cleverly stupid.

title: Jeopardy!
summary: 2024 Danish version of the popular quiz show. Contestants are provided with the answers by the host, to which they would then have to supply the questions.

lead_actors: Mary Malone, Maria Friedman, Rakie Ayola, Sergei Polunin, James Graham
title: Play in a Day
summary: Newly graduated and deprived of opportunities, budding young performers backed by creative teams are given 24 hours to stage a 15-minute production.

title: Sign2Win
summary: Sign2Win is the BSL ZONE's first game show in BSL. Presented by Fifi Garfield, three teams will go head to head to win £1000. Over five rounds, the teams must rely on a mix of skills based on their BSL language from reaction and memory to Deaf culture knowledge, in a battle for the prize. Who will take home the prize?

lead_actors: Christopher Bayemi, Juliette Plumecocq-Mech, Charlie Bruneau
title: A l'instinct
summary: Teva Royer, a police lieutenant in Cayenne who is close to his feelings and without a filter, trusts his instincts blindly. Raised in a village in the heart of the Amazon, he survived alone in the jungle for seven months when he was just a child. No one knows what happened during those long weeks, but since then, no emotion, no hesitation, no movement escapes Teva.

title: Monster Lab
summary: After a scientist dies in a house fire, his assistants Katz and Uno are forced to move to a different house. One day they stumble upon a familiar book left by the scientist.

title: Tilda Apfelkern
summary: Tilda Appleseed is a small white church mouse. She loves her friends, delicious food and picnics. Every day is a wonderful day in Tilda's charming little village, where greater and smaller adventures await its inhabitants.

lead_actors: Joan Bailador, Ugaitz Amundarain, Dorleta Urretabizkaia, Ibai Ugarte, Ander Rovira
title: Irabazi arte!
Ab in die Ruine!
summary: In this show, the actors try to renovate and redesign a home with the external appearance of a building site to make it more attractive. In doing so, they take the renovation work into their own hands and become active as craftsmen.

title: Roasted: Verdens Sjoveste Ferie
summary: Linda P has invited 5 of Denmark´s funniest comedians on a holiday in sunny Marbella. Along she brings a suitcase with embarrassing ammunition from the comedians ‘past. Every evening, they take turns in the hot seat to get roasted by their colleagues. It´s a war of words with lots of surprises and laughs - because how far can you really go when it comes to jokes?

title: DC Metal Force
summary: DC Metal Force is a miniseries about Justice League. A mysterious entity has brought the powers of good and evil together to participate in the ultimate super-powered showdown!

title: falsch, aber anders lustig
summary: Laugh until the tears come: In this unique comedy show, it's not who's right that counts, but who has the best sense of humor. Two teams of two comedians compete in a witty battle for the most absurd answers to crazy questions. The comedy highlight is hosted by Moritz Neumeier - known for his biting humor and spot-on punchlines. "Wrong, but funny in a different way" guarantees entertainment at the highest level.

title: A Caverna Encantada
summary: The plot tells the story of Anna, daughter of Paulo, a missionary doctor. The two live together in the north of Minas Gerais. Paulo receives a call to a dangerous mission and, unfortunately, Anna will not be able to accompany him. The father leaves his daughter at a boarding school in the interior of São Paulo, where the girl will live with very different children. Paulo promises to return on his daughter's birthday, but mysteriously, he doesn't return.

title: Tian Yu
summary: A millennium ago, the Five Monarchs guarded the land of the Xia Dynasty with magical artifacts. Later, the leader of the Dragon Clan, Zu Long, assisted humanity by establishing the Yun Chui Empire. The Empire faces the Tranquil Ocean where the Xi and Black Water Clans have defended it throughout a peaceful millennium. Now, the waves are surging from below and chaos will rise once again.

title: Bears' Lair
summary: Bears' Lair is an exciting new series that offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to aspiring Indigenous entrepreneurs. Follow their journeys as they pitch their best ideas to four business experts and face off in a collaborative competition!

lead_actors: Hiroshi Abe, Aoi Miyazaki, Tomoko Yamaguchi
title: Going My Home
Reset - Wie weit willst du gehen?
summary: The seemingly perfect life of the self-confident, successful presenter Flo suddenly falls apart: she finds her teenage daughter Luna dead in her room - suicide. When Flo finds out about the Plan B agency, which can send its clients back in time in order to avoid mistakes and set a different course in life, she doesn't hesitate to take the second chance.

lead_actors: Frank Rautenbach, Monique Rockman, Tyrone Keogh, Jan Combrink, Terry Norton
title: Summertide
summary: Love, loss, rivalry, and relationship woes. Follows the lives of the Field family in beautiful Simon's Town as they tackle trials and tribulations. Watch as secrets come to the surface and their lives intertwine with other residents of the town.

title: Basique, le concert
summary: Meeting with a singer or a band and retransmission of one of their concerts.

title: Tamanho Família
summary: Márcio Garcia gathers celebrities and their families in games that reveal routines, stories and intimacy details that only those who are from home know.

summary: Unicornland is an 8-episode webseries about Annie, who explores her sexuality post-divorce by dating couples. ...Over drinks, at dinner, and in bed. Each episode features a date with a new couple, from Williamsburg hipsters, to Wall Street power duos, to Bushwick burners, as Annie becomes not just sexually active, but activated. Unicornland was created/produced by Lucy Gillespie, directed by Nick Leavens, and shot by a 70% female cast and crew. Unicornland celebrates the ethnic and social diversity of New York City, with a cast that's 60% non-white, including trans, genderqueer and disabled actors. Unicornland contains themes of polyamory and open relationships, and was made with the full support of the New York sex positive community. In the final episode, Annie attends her first inclusive sex party at the Hacienda Villa, a renowned epicenter of the New York scene.

Together, they navigate grief, healing, and the awkward yet often hilarious process of reconnecting across generations and clashing values.The series explores themes of LGBTQ+ identity, acceptance, family dynamics, and small-town life; all through a uniquely Greek lens.
